```sql
  'refused saves leave the crosswalk as it was'
);

-- Saves that succeed.

-- 34. A first save before any dataset is added.
select is (
  pg_temp.save (
    p_settings => pg_temp.base_settings () || '{"name":"Empty for now","description":null}'::jsonb,
    p_columns => '[]'::jsonb,
    p_layouts => '[]'::jsonb,
    p_datasets => '[]'::jsonb,
    p_mappings => '[]'::jsonb,
    p_crosswalk_id => 'c4700003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'::uuid
  ),
  'no error',
  'a crosswalk with no layouts yet saves'
);
reset role;

-- 35. Read in its own statement: the outer query of a statement does not
-- see writes made by a function it calls.
select is (
  format(
    'name=%s description=%s layouts=%s',
    (select name from public.crosswalks where id = 'c4700003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'::uuid),
    (select description from public.crosswalks where id = 'c4700003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'::uuid),
    (select count(*) from public.crosswalks__layouts where crosswalk_id = 'c4700003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'::uuid)
  ),
  'name=Empty for now description= layouts=0',
  'the empty save wrote its settings'
);

-- 36.
select is (
  pg_temp.save (p_settings => pg_temp.base_settings () || '{"codes_output_as":"codes"}'::jsonb),
  'no error',
  'a Data Sources editor saves columns, layouts, memberships, and mappings'
);
reset role;

-- 37.
select is (
  format(
    'name=%s description=%s codes=%s source=%s columns=%s layouts=%s memberships=%s mappings=%s reference=%s entry=%s',
    (select name from public.crosswalks where id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select description from public.crosswalks where id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select codes_output_as from public.crosswalks where id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select adds_source_column from public.crosswalks where id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select count(*) from public.crosswalks__columns where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select count(*) from public.crosswalks__layouts where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select count(*) from public.crosswalks__datasets where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select count(*) from public.crosswalks__mappings where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select id from public.crosswalks__layouts where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid and is_reference),
    (select entry_id from public.crosswalks__columns where id = 'c4720002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid)
  ),
  'name=Kings and Queens description=Every borough line list on one layout. codes=codes source=true columns=3 layouts=3 memberships=3 mappings=5 reference=c4710001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 entry=c4600001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
  'the save wrote the settings and every set'
);

-- 38.
select results_eq (
  $q$
    select fill, status::text, confidence, reason::text, layout_id, column_id
    from public.crosswalks__mappings
    where id = 'c4730002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid
  $q$,
  $q$
    values (
      '{"version":1,"kind":"column","source_column":"CaseNo","convert":null,"code_list_id":null,"holds_labels":false}'::jsonb,
      'suggested',
      0.92::numeric,
      'name_and_type',
      'c4710002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid,
      'c4720001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid
    )
  $q$,
  'a mapping keeps its fill, status, confidence, and reason as sent'
);

-- 39.
select ok (
  (select updated_at > '2020-01-02T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz from public.crosswalks where id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
  'a save moves the crosswalk''s updated_at'
);

-- A membership the editor cannot see, added as the table owner the way an
-- admin's save would add it, and the memberships as they are now.
insert into public.crosswalks__datasets (workspace_id, crosswalk_id, dataset_id, layout_id)
values ('c4100001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, 'c4450004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004'::uuid, 'c4710002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid);

create temporary table cw_memberships_before as
select id, dataset_id
from public.crosswalks__datasets
where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid;

-- 40. A second save renames case_id, drops the third layout (its mapping
-- goes with it), moves Kings 2026-04 to the reference layout, and turns
-- one fill into a fixed value. It leaves out the Bronx membership, which
-- the editor cannot see.
select is (
  pg_temp.save (
    p_columns => jsonb_set(pg_temp.base_columns (), '{0,name}', '"case_number"'),
    p_layouts => jsonb_set(pg_temp.base_layouts () - 2, '{1,status}', '"review"'),
    p_datasets => jsonb_set(pg_temp.base_datasets (), '{1,layout_id}', '"c4710001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"'),
    p_mappings => jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(pg_temp.base_mappings () - 3, '{1,fill}', '{"version":1,"kind":"constant","value":"Kings"}'),
      '{1,status}',
      '"confirmed"'
    )
  ),
  'no error',
  'a second save renames a column, drops a layout, moves a dataset, and changes a fill'
);
reset role;

-- 41.
select is (
  format(
    'column=%s layouts=%s status=%s m4=%s m2=%s/%s',
    (select name from public.crosswalks__columns where id = 'c4720001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select count(*) from public.crosswalks__layouts where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select status from public.crosswalks__layouts where id = 'c4710002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid),
    (select count(*) from public.crosswalks__mappings where id = 'c4730004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004'::uuid),
    (select fill ->> 'value' from public.crosswalks__mappings where id = 'c4730002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid),
    (select status from public.crosswalks__mappings where id = 'c4730002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid)
  ),
  'column=case_number layouts=2 status=review m4=0 m2=Kings/confirmed',
  'the column and the mapping kept their ids, and the dropped layout took its mapping'
);

-- 42.
select results_eq (
  $q$
    select d.dataset_id, d.layout_id, b.id is not null
    from public.crosswalks__datasets d
    left join cw_memberships_before b on b.id = d.id
    where d.crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid
    order by d.dataset_id
  $q$,
  $q$
    values
      ('c4450001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, 'c4710002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid, true),
      ('c4450002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid, 'c4710001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, true),
      ('c4450003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'::uuid, 'c4710001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, true),
      ('c4450004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004'::uuid, 'c4710002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'::uuid, true)
  $q$,
  'memberships keep their ids, the moved one changed layout, and the hidden one survived'
);

-- 43. Dropping the layout that holds the hidden membership would delete
-- it, so the save is refused.
select is (
  pg_temp.save (
    p_layouts => pg_temp.base_layouts () - 2 - 1,
    p_datasets => '[{"dataset_id":"c4450001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","layout_id":"c4710001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"},{"dataset_id":"c4450002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","layout_id":"c4710001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"},{"dataset_id":"c4450003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003","layout_id":"c4710001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"}]'::jsonb,
    p_mappings => jsonb_build_array(pg_temp.base_mappings () -> 0)
  ),
  'dataset_not_readable',
  'a layout holding a dataset the caller cannot view cannot be dropped'
);
reset role;

-- 44.
select is (
  format(
    'layouts=%s bronx=%s',
    (select count(*) from public.crosswalks__layouts where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid),
    (select layout_id from public.crosswalks__datasets where crosswalk_id = 'c4700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid and dataset_id = 'c4450004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004'::uuid)
  ),
  'layouts=2 bronx=c4710002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002',
  'the refused save kept the layout and the hidden membership'
);

select * from finish ();

rollback;
```

`pg_temp.save` takes every argument with a default, so a test names only the piece it changes (`p_columns => ...`). Defaults that call other `pg_temp` functions resolve at call time; the base functions are created first because a default is parsed when the function is created. `jsonb - 2` removes the third layout, and `pg_temp.base_layouts () - 2 - 1` keeps only the reference. Like slice 1's save test, each successful call leaves the session as `authenticated` (the `set local role` inside the `execute` is not rolled back), so every call is followed by `reset role`.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the RPC and its helpers.**

`supabase/schemas/50.rpc_crosswalks__save.sql`:

```sql
/**
 * Replaces one crosswalk's settings, the columns of its combined dataset,
 * its layouts, its dataset memberships, and its mappings with the given
 * sets in one transaction.
 *
 * SECURITY DEFINER because the four child tables are select-only for
 * signed-in users: this function is their only write path. It checks Data
 * Sources editor on the crosswalk's own workspace before it reads anything
 * else, and locks the crosswalk so two saves run one at a time. Every
 * refusal raises with a stable `hint` that the client maps to copy.
 *
 * Columns, layouts, and mappings are upserted by id, and the ones left out
 * are deleted. Memberships are upserted by dataset, and one left out is
 * deleted only when the caller can view its dataset, so a save never
 * removes a dataset the caller cannot see. For the same reason, a layout
 * that holds such a membership must stay in the set.
 *
 * @param p_crosswalk_id The crosswalk whose contents are replaced.
 * @param p_settings `{ name, description, codes_output_as,
 *   adds_source_column }`.
 * @param p_columns The full set, as `[{ id, name, position, data_type,
 *   entry_id }]`.
 * @param p_layouts The full set, as `[{ id, signature, column_names,
 *   is_reference, status }]`.
 * @param p_datasets Every membership the caller can view, as
 *   `[{ dataset_id, layout_id }]`.
 * @param p_mappings The full set, as `[{ id, layout_id, column_id, fill,
 *   status, confidence, reason }]`, where `fill` is a stored fill.
 */
create or replace function public.rpc_crosswalks__save (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_settings jsonb,
  p_columns jsonb,
  p_layouts jsonb,
  p_datasets jsonb,
  p_mappings jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql security definer
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_columns jsonb := coalesce(p_columns, '[]'::jsonb);
  v_layouts jsonb := coalesce(p_layouts, '[]'::jsonb);
  v_datasets jsonb := coalesce(p_datasets, '[]'::jsonb);
  v_mappings jsonb := coalesce(p_mappings, '[]'::jsonb);
begin
  v_workspace_id := public.crosswalks__authorize (p_crosswalk_id);

  perform public.crosswalks__check_payload (p_settings, v_columns, v_layouts, v_datasets, v_mappings);
  perform public.crosswalks__check_columns (p_crosswalk_id, v_workspace_id, p_settings, v_columns);
  perform public.crosswalks__check_layouts (p_crosswalk_id, v_layouts);
  perform public.crosswalks__check_datasets (p_crosswalk_id, v_workspace_id, v_layouts, v_datasets);
  perform public.crosswalks__check_mappings (p_crosswalk_id, v_columns, v_layouts, v_mappings);

  perform public.crosswalks__write_columns (p_crosswalk_id, v_workspace_id, v_columns);
  perform public.crosswalks__write_layouts (p_crosswalk_id, v_workspace_id, v_layouts);
  perform public.crosswalks__write_datasets (p_crosswalk_id, v_workspace_id, v_datasets);
  perform public.crosswalks__write_mappings (p_crosswalk_id, v_workspace_id, v_mappings);

  -- Always written, so `updated_at` moves on every save.
  update public.crosswalks
  set
    name = btrim(p_settings ->> 'name'),
    description = nullif(btrim(p_settings ->> 'description'), ''),
    codes_output_as = (p_settings ->> 'codes_output_as')::public.crosswalks__codes_output,
    adds_source_column = (p_settings ->> 'adds_source_column')::boolean
  where id = p_crosswalk_id;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `crosswalk_payload_invalid` unless the settings carry every field
 * with the right type and each set is an array of objects with
 * well-formed fields, then raises `crosswalk_name_required` for a blank
 * name. Called only by `rpc_crosswalks__save`.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_payload (
  p_settings jsonb,
  p_columns jsonb,
  p_layouts jsonb,
  p_datasets jsonb,
  p_mappings jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if
    jsonb_typeof(p_settings) is distinct from 'object' or
    jsonb_typeof(p_settings -> 'name') is distinct from 'string' or
    jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_settings -> 'description', 'null'::jsonb)) not in ('string', 'null') or
    coalesce(p_settings ->> 'codes_output_as', '') <> all (
      enum_range(null::public.crosswalks__codes_output)::text[]
    ) or
    jsonb_typeof(p_settings -> 'adds_source_column') is distinct from 'boolean'
  then
    raise exception 'Settings need a name, a description, how codes come out, and whether a source column is added'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from (values (p_columns), (p_layouts), (p_datasets), (p_mappings)) as s (items)
    where jsonb_typeof(s.items) is distinct from 'array'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Columns, layouts, datasets, and mappings must be arrays'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  -- Only now is every set known to be an array.
  if exists (
    select 1
    from (values (p_columns), (p_layouts), (p_datasets), (p_mappings)) as s (items)
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(s.items) as e (item)
    where jsonb_typeof(e.item) <> 'object'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every column, layout, dataset, and mapping must be an object'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  perform public.crosswalks__check_column_fields (p_columns);
  perform public.crosswalks__check_layout_fields (p_layouts);
  perform public.crosswalks__check_membership_and_mapping_fields (p_datasets, p_mappings);

  if btrim(p_settings ->> 'name') = '' then
    raise exception 'A crosswalk needs a name'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'crosswalk_name_required';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `crosswalk_payload_invalid` unless every column has a uuid id, a
 * text name, a whole-number position, a known type, and a uuid or null
 * entry, with no id twice. Runs before anything casts the columns.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_column_fields (p_columns jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_uuid_pattern constant text :=
    '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_columns) as e (col)
    where
      coalesce(e.col ->> 'id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      jsonb_typeof(e.col -> 'name') is distinct from 'string' or
      jsonb_typeof(e.col -> 'position') is distinct from 'number' or
      coalesce(e.col ->> 'position', '') !~ '^[0-9]+$' or
      coalesce(e.col ->> 'data_type', '') <> all (
        enum_range(null::public.datasets__ava_data_type)::text[]
      ) or
      (e.col ->> 'entry_id') !~* v_uuid_pattern
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every column needs an id, a name, a whole-number position, and a known type'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_columns) as e (col)
    group by lower(e.col ->> 'id')
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'A column id appears more than once'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `crosswalk_payload_invalid` unless every layout has a uuid id, a
 * signature, a non-empty list of text column names, a boolean
 * `is_reference`, and a known status, with no id twice. Runs before
 * anything casts the layouts.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_layout_fields (p_layouts jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_uuid_pattern constant text :=
    '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_layouts) as e (layout)
    where
      coalesce(e.layout ->> 'id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      jsonb_typeof(e.layout -> 'signature') is distinct from 'string' or
      btrim(coalesce(e.layout ->> 'signature', '')) = '' or
      jsonb_typeof(e.layout -> 'column_names') is distinct from 'array' or
      jsonb_typeof(e.layout -> 'is_reference') is distinct from 'boolean' or
      coalesce(e.layout ->> 'status', '') <> all (
        enum_range(null::public.crosswalks__layout_status)::text[]
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every layout needs an id, a signature, column names, a reference flag, and a known status'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  -- Only now is every `column_names` known to be an array.
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_layouts) as e (layout)
    where
      jsonb_array_length(e.layout -> 'column_names') = 0 or
      exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_array_elements(e.layout -> 'column_names') as n (column_name)
        where jsonb_typeof(n.column_name) <> 'string'
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every layout needs at least one column name, each a text'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_layouts) as e (layout)
    group by lower(e.layout ->> 'id')
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'A layout id appears more than once'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `crosswalk_payload_invalid` unless every membership names a uuid
 * dataset and layout, with no dataset twice, and every mapping has a uuid
 * id, layout, and column, a known status, a known or null reason, and a
 * null confidence or one from 0 to 1, with no id twice. The fill is
 * checked later, with its own hint.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_membership_and_mapping_fields (p_datasets jsonb, p_mappings jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_uuid_pattern constant text :=
    '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_datasets) as e (membership)
    where
      coalesce(e.membership ->> 'dataset_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.membership ->> 'layout_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_datasets) as e (membership)
    group by lower(e.membership ->> 'dataset_id')
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every dataset needs a layout, and joins the crosswalk once'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_mappings) as e (mapping)
    where
      coalesce(e.mapping ->> 'id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.mapping ->> 'layout_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.mapping ->> 'column_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.mapping ->> 'status', '') <> all (
        enum_range(null::public.crosswalks__mapping_status)::text[]
      ) or
      (e.mapping ->> 'reason') <> all (
        enum_range(null::public.crosswalks__mapping_reason)::text[]
      ) or
      case jsonb_typeof(coalesce(e.mapping -> 'confidence', 'null'::jsonb))
        when 'null' then false
        when 'number' then (e.mapping ->> 'confidence')::numeric not between 0 and 1
        else true
      end
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_mappings) as e (mapping)
    group by lower(e.mapping ->> 'id')
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every mapping needs an id, a layout, a column, a known status and reason, and a confidence from 0 to 1'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'crosswalk_payload_invalid';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises with a stable hint when a set of columns cannot be saved into a
 * crosswalk: an id another crosswalk owns, a blank name, two names equal
 * ignoring case and spaces, a column named like the source column while
 * the crosswalk adds one, or an entry from outside the workspace.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_columns (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_settings jsonb,
  p_columns jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_columns) as c (id uuid)
    join public.crosswalks__columns cc on cc.id = c.id
    where cc.crosswalk_id <> p_crosswalk_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every column must be new or belong to this crosswalk'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'item_not_in_crosswalk';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_columns) as c (name text)
    where btrim(c.name) = ''
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every column needs a name'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'column_name_required';
  end if;

  -- `source_dataset` is `CrosswalkModule.SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME`, the column
  -- the combined dataset starts with when `adds_source_column` is on.
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_columns) as c (name text)
    group by lower(btrim(c.name))
    having count(*) > 1
  ) or (
    (p_settings ->> 'adds_source_column')::boolean and exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_columns) as c (name text)
      where lower(btrim(c.name)) = 'source_dataset'
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Two columns of the combined dataset cannot share a name'
      using errcode = '23505', hint = 'column_names_not_unique';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_columns) as c (entry_id uuid)
    where
      c.entry_id is not null and
      not exists (
        select 1
        from public.data_dictionaries__entries en
        where en.id = c.entry_id and en.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'A column''s entry must belong to a dictionary in this workspace'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'entry_not_in_workspace';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises with a stable hint when a set of layouts cannot be saved into a
 * crosswalk: an id another crosswalk owns, two layouts with one
 * signature, or, when there are layouts, anything but exactly one
 * reference layout that is mapped.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_layouts (p_crosswalk_id uuid, p_layouts jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as l (id uuid)
    join public.crosswalks__layouts cl on cl.id = l.id
    where cl.crosswalk_id <> p_crosswalk_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every layout must be new or belong to this crosswalk'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'item_not_in_crosswalk';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as l (signature text)
    group by l.signature
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'Two layouts of one crosswalk cannot share a signature'
      using errcode = '23505', hint = 'layout_signatures_not_unique';
  end if;

  -- A crosswalk with no datasets yet has no layouts, and no reference.
  if jsonb_array_length(p_layouts) > 0 and (
    (
      select count(*)
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as l (is_reference boolean)
      where l.is_reference
    ) <> 1 or
    exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as l (is_reference boolean, status text)
      where l.is_reference and l.status <> 'mapped'
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'A crosswalk with layouts has exactly one reference layout, and it is mapped'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'reference_layout_required';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises with a stable hint when a set of memberships cannot be saved: one
 * names a layout that is not in the set, or a dataset that is missing, in
 * another workspace, or one the caller cannot view. Also refuses a set of
 * layouts that leaves out a layout still holding a membership the caller
 * cannot view, because deleting the layout would delete that membership.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_datasets (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_layouts jsonb,
  p_datasets jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_datasets) as d (layout_id uuid)
    where not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as l (id uuid)
      where l.id = d.layout_id
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every dataset must join a layout saved with it'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'item_not_in_crosswalk';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_datasets) as d (dataset_id uuid)
    left join public.datasets ds on ds.id = d.dataset_id and ds.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    where
      ds.id is null or
      not public.util__auth_user_can_access_resource (
        'dataset'::public.resource_type,
        d.dataset_id,
        'viewer'::public.role_level
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every dataset must be one you can open in this workspace'
      using errcode = '42501', hint = 'dataset_not_readable';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.crosswalks__datasets cd
    where
      cd.crosswalk_id = p_crosswalk_id and
      not exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as l (id uuid)
        where l.id = cd.layout_id
      ) and
      not public.util__auth_user_can_access_resource (
        'dataset'::public.resource_type,
        cd.dataset_id,
        'viewer'::public.role_level
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'A layout this save removes still holds a dataset you cannot open'
      using errcode = '42501', hint = 'dataset_not_readable';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises with a stable hint when a set of mappings cannot be saved: an id
 * another crosswalk owns, a layout or column not in the set, two mappings
 * for one layout and column, or a fill that is not a valid version 1
 * fill.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_mappings (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_columns jsonb,
  p_layouts jsonb,
  p_mappings jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_mappings) as m (id uuid)
    join public.crosswalks__mappings cm on cm.id = m.id
    where cm.crosswalk_id <> p_crosswalk_id
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_mappings) as m (layout_id uuid, column_id uuid)
    where
      not exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as l (id uuid)
        where l.id = m.layout_id
      ) or
      not exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_to_recordset(p_columns) as c (id uuid)
        where c.id = m.column_id
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every mapping must be new or belong to this crosswalk, and fill a column saved with it for a layout saved with it'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'item_not_in_crosswalk';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_mappings) as m (layout_id uuid, column_id uuid)
    group by m.layout_id, m.column_id
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'A layout fills each column once'
      using errcode = '23505', hint = 'mappings_not_unique';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_mappings) as e (mapping)
    where not public.crosswalks__is_fill_valid (e.mapping -> 'fill')
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every fill must be a version 1 fill of a known kind'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'fill_invalid';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Whether a stored fill is a valid version 1 fill: an object with
 * `version` 1 and a known `kind`, where a `column` fill names a non-blank
 * `source_column`, a `constant` has a text `value`, and an `expression`
 * has non-blank `sql`. The browser's versioned parser checks the rest.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__is_fill_valid (p_fill jsonb) returns boolean language sql immutable
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_typeof(p_fill) = 'object' and
    p_fill -> 'version' = '1'::jsonb and
    case p_fill ->> 'kind'
      when 'column' then
        jsonb_typeof(p_fill -> 'source_column') = 'string' and
        btrim(p_fill ->> 'source_column') <> ''
      when 'constant' then jsonb_typeof(p_fill -> 'value') = 'string'
      when 'expression' then
        jsonb_typeof(p_fill -> 'sql') = 'string' and
        btrim(p_fill ->> 'sql') <> ''
      when 'empty' then true
      else false
    end,
    false
  );
$$;

/** Upserts a crosswalk's columns and deletes the ones left out. */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__write_columns (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_columns jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  -- Park saved names under a unique placeholder first, so a save that swaps
  -- two names never meets the unique name index partway through.
  update public.crosswalks__columns c
  set name = '~' || c.id::text
  where c.crosswalk_id = p_crosswalk_id;

  insert into public.crosswalks__columns (id, workspace_id, crosswalk_id, name, position, data_type, entry_id)
  select
    c.id, p_workspace_id, p_crosswalk_id, btrim(c.name), c.position,
    c.data_type::public.datasets__ava_data_type, c.entry_id
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_columns) as c (
    id uuid, name text, position integer, data_type text, entry_id uuid
  )
  on conflict (id) do update
  set
    name = excluded.name,
    position = excluded.position,
    data_type = excluded.data_type,
    entry_id = excluded.entry_id
  where public.crosswalks__columns.crosswalk_id = excluded.crosswalk_id;

  -- Their mappings go with them.
  delete from public.crosswalks__columns c
  where
    c.crosswalk_id = p_crosswalk_id and
    not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_columns) as pc (id uuid)
      where pc.id = c.id
    );
end;
$$;

/** Upserts a crosswalk's layouts and deletes the ones left out. */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__write_layouts (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_layouts jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  -- Park saved signatures and clear the reference first, so a save that
  -- swaps two signatures or moves the reference never meets a unique
  -- index partway through.
  update public.crosswalks__layouts l
  set signature = '~' || l.id::text, is_reference = false
  where l.crosswalk_id = p_crosswalk_id;

  insert into public.crosswalks__layouts (id, workspace_id, crosswalk_id, signature, column_names, is_reference, status)
  select
    l.id, p_workspace_id, p_crosswalk_id, l.signature, l.column_names,
    l.is_reference, l.status::public.crosswalks__layout_status
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as l (
    id uuid, signature text, column_names text[], is_reference boolean, status text
  )
  on conflict (id) do update
  set
    signature = excluded.signature,
    column_names = excluded.column_names,
    is_reference = excluded.is_reference,
    status = excluded.status
  where public.crosswalks__layouts.crosswalk_id = excluded.crosswalk_id;

  -- Their memberships and mappings go with them. The checks already
  -- refused dropping a layout that holds a membership the caller cannot
  -- view.
  delete from public.crosswalks__layouts l
  where
    l.crosswalk_id = p_crosswalk_id and
    not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_layouts) as pl (id uuid)
      where pl.id = l.id
    );
end;
$$;

/**
 * Deletes the memberships left out whose dataset the caller can view, and
 * upserts the given ones by dataset, so a moved dataset keeps its
 * membership id. A membership the caller cannot view is never deleted.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__write_datasets (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_datasets jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  delete from public.crosswalks__datasets cd
  where
    cd.crosswalk_id = p_crosswalk_id and
    not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_datasets) as d (dataset_id uuid)
      where d.dataset_id = cd.dataset_id
    ) and
    public.util__auth_user_can_access_resource (
      'dataset'::public.resource_type,
      cd.dataset_id,
      'viewer'::public.role_level
    );

  insert into public.crosswalks__datasets (workspace_id, crosswalk_id, dataset_id, layout_id)
  select p_workspace_id, p_crosswalk_id, d.dataset_id, d.layout_id
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_datasets) as d (dataset_id uuid, layout_id uuid)
  on conflict (crosswalk_id, dataset_id) do update
  set layout_id = excluded.layout_id;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Deletes the mappings left out, and any whose layout or column the set
 * changes, then upserts the given ones by id. A mapping's layout and
 * column never change in place, so the unique `(layout_id, column_id)`
 * pair is never met partway through.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__write_mappings (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_mappings jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  delete from public.crosswalks__mappings cm
  where
    cm.crosswalk_id = p_crosswalk_id and
    not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_mappings) as m (id uuid, layout_id uuid, column_id uuid)
      where m.id = cm.id and m.layout_id = cm.layout_id and m.column_id = cm.column_id
    );

  insert into public.crosswalks__mappings (
    id, workspace_id, crosswalk_id, layout_id, column_id, fill, status, confidence, reason
  )
  select
    m.id, p_workspace_id, p_crosswalk_id, m.layout_id, m.column_id, m.fill,
    m.status::public.crosswalks__mapping_status, m.confidence,
    m.reason::public.crosswalks__mapping_reason
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_mappings) as m (
    id uuid, layout_id uuid, column_id uuid, fill jsonb, status text, confidence numeric, reason text
  )
  on conflict (id) do update
  set
    fill = excluded.fill,
    status = excluded.status,
    confidence = excluded.confidence,
    reason = excluded.reason
  where public.crosswalks__mappings.crosswalk_id = excluded.crosswalk_id;
end;
$$;
```

Why the checks are written the way they are:

- **Shape before casts.** Every field check reads `->>` text and compares it with a uuid pattern, an enum range, or `^[0-9]+$`; nothing is cast until those pass. `jsonb_to_recordset (... id uuid ...)` in the later checks is safe for the same reason. `->` and `->>` return `NULL` rather than failing when the JSON is not an object, so `jsonb_typeof(p_settings -> 'name')` is safe on any input. Each `jsonb_array_elements` over a nested value runs only after an earlier statement proved it is an array, because SQL does not promise the order an `or` is evaluated in.
- **Reading through the definer.** The helpers run as the function owner, so their reads of the child tables bypass RLS, including the hidden memberships. `util__auth_user_can_access_resource` still answers for the caller, because it reads `auth.uid()` from the request's claims.
- **Upserts scoped to the crosswalk.** `on conflict (id) do update ... where <table>.crosswalk_id = excluded.crosswalk_id` never updates another crosswalk's row; the checks already refused such ids, so the clause is a second guard, as in the dictionary save.

### Task 4: `rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset` (schema, red until Task 5)

The browser compiles the stacked SQL (Tasks 10 to 12) and hands this RPC everything the combined dataset needs: its name, `raw_sql`, its columns in output order, the reference bindings of its governed columns, and the fingerprint of every code list it embedded. The RPC writes all of it in one transaction and records `compiled_at` and `compiled_code_lists` on the crosswalk. A failure anywhere, including after the dataset row was written, rolls the whole save back.

**Creating.** When the crosswalk has no `output_dataset_id`, the RPC creates a virtual dataset the way `datasets__virtual__create_linked` does: it calls `public.rpc_datasets__add_virtual_dataset` from inside the SECURITY DEFINER function, with `dataset_column_input` rows built inline (`original_name = name`, `detected_data_type = datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb(data_type)`, `original_data_type` the same type as text, `column_idx` from the payload's order, starting at 0). `rpc_datasets__add_dataset` reads `auth.uid()` from the request's claims, so the caller owns the new dataset, exactly as for an import. Creating a dataset needs workspace admin, so the RPC checks `util__can_manage_workspace_settings` first and raises `dataset_creator_required` (the inner function would raise the same refusal with no hint).

**Updating.** When the crosswalk has a combined dataset, `p_dataset_id` must be it (`combined_dataset_mismatch`), and the caller needs dataset editor on it (`dataset_editor_required`, through `util__auth_user_can_access_resource`). The RPC updates `datasets.name` and `datasets__virtual.raw_sql`, then reconciles `dataset_columns` by name ignoring case, as DuckDB compares column names: a column whose name matches keeps its id (so its description and any user-set fields survive) and takes the payload's name, type, and position; a new name is inserted; every other column is deleted, and its binding cascades with it. A kept column's `original_name` and `original_data_type` are rewritten too, because the SQL's output name and type are its original ones, exactly as a create writes them (Contract note 8). Kept-original copies (`dictionary_binding_id` set) are never kept: the bindings are replaced as reference, so no convert binding is left to own them.

**Bindings.** Both paths replace the dataset's bindings whole with `p_bindings`, as `reference` bindings at the dictionary's current `version`, attached to the column with the binding's name (ignoring case). Reference bindings are what make the code-list tag, Ask Avandar, and Used by work on the combined dataset with no new agent code. A binding's dictionary, entry, and code list must be in the crosswalk's workspace, the entry in its dictionary, and the code list one of the entry's codings (`binding_not_in_workspace`, Contract note 7).

**File number.** The RPC calls `rpc_datasets__add_virtual_dataset` (70) and `datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb` (52) and builds `dataset_column_input` rows (60), so the file is `71.rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset.sql` (Contract note 1). It also calls `crosswalks__authorize` from `11.crosswalks.sql`.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/schemas/71.rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset.sql`
- Test: `supabase/tests/database/crosswalks/rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset.test.sql`

`supabase/tests/database/crosswalks/rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset.test.sql`:

```sql
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

/**
 * `rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset` creates a crosswalk's combined
 * dataset, or updates it: its name, `raw_sql`, columns reconciled by name
 * ignoring case, and the reference bindings of its governed columns. It
 * records `output_dataset_id`, `compiled_at`, and `compiled_code_lists`.
 * Only a Data Sources editor can call it; creating also needs workspace
 * admin, and updating needs editor rights on the dataset. Every refusal
 * raises a stable `hint` and changes nothing.
 */
begin;

set search_path to extensions, public;

create function pg_temp.error_hint (p_sql text) returns text language plpgsql as $$
declare
  v_hint text;
begin
  execute p_sql;
  return 'no error';
exception
  when others then
    get stacked diagnostics v_hint = pg_exception_hint;
    return v_hint;
end;
$$;

-- The first combine's payload, one function per argument.
create function pg_temp.base_sql () returns text language sql as $$
  select 'SELECT * FROM "c5450009-0000-4000-8000-000000000009"';
$$;

create function pg_temp.base_columns () returns jsonb language sql as $$
  select '[
    {"name":"source_dataset","data_type":"varchar"},
    {"name":"case_id","data_type":"varchar"},
    {"name":"sex","data_type":"varchar"},
    {"name":"outcome","data_type":"varchar"}
  ]'::jsonb;
$$;

create function pg_temp.base_bindings () returns jsonb language sql as $$
  select '[
    {"column_name":"sex","dictionary_id":"c5400001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","entry_id":"c5600001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","code_list_id":"c5500001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","direction":"encode"},
    {"column_name":"outcome","dictionary_id":"c5400001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","entry_id":"c5600002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","code_list_id":"c5500002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","direction":"encode"}
  ]'::jsonb;
$$;

create function pg_temp.base_code_lists () returns jsonb language sql as $$
  select '[
    {"code_list_id":"c5500001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","fingerprint":"p1.00000000000000a1"},
    {"code_list_id":"c5500002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","fingerprint":"p1.00000000000000b2"}
  ]'::jsonb;
$$;

-- Runs one combine and returns its hint, or 'no error'. By default the
-- workspace owner creates the combined dataset of the crosswalk under
-- test.
create function pg_temp.combine (
  p_user_id uuid default 'c5000001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid,
  p_crosswalk_id uuid default 'c5700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid,
  p_dataset_id uuid default 'c5450001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid,
  p_dataset_name text default 'Kings and Queens',
  p_raw_sql text default pg_temp.base_sql (),
  p_columns jsonb default pg_temp.base_columns (),
  p_bindings jsonb default pg_temp.base_bindings (),
  p_compiled_code_lists jsonb default pg_temp.base_code_lists ()
) returns text language plpgsql as $$
begin
  return pg_temp.error_hint (format(
    $s$
      set local role authenticated;
      select set_config('request.jwt.claims', %L, true);
      select public.rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset (%L::uuid, %L::uuid, %L, %L, %L::jsonb, %L::jsonb, %L::jsonb);
    $s$,
    json_build_object('sub', p_user_id, 'role', 'authenticated')::text,
    p_crosswalk_id,
    p_dataset_id,
    p_dataset_name,
    p_raw_sql,
    p_columns,
    p_bindings,
    p_compiled_code_lists
  ));
end;
$$;

-- Creates the combined dataset as the workspace owner and returns what
-- the RPC returns.
create function pg_temp.create_as_owner () returns uuid language plpgsql as $$
declare
  v_dataset_id uuid;
begin
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub":"c5000001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","role":"authenticated"}', true);
  set local role authenticated;
  v_dataset_id := public.rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset (
    'c5700001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid,
    'c5450001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid,
    'Kings and Queens',
    pg_temp.base_sql (),
    pg_temp.base_columns (),
    pg_temp.base_bindings (),
    pg_temp.base_code_lists ()
  );
  reset role;
  return v_dataset_id;
end;
$$;
```

Test 16 calls the RPC directly rather than through `pg_temp.error_hint`, so a refusal there fails the test loudly instead of returning a hint. Like the linked-dataset test, `create_as_owner` sets and resets the role inside the function.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the RPC and its helpers.**

`supabase/schemas/71.rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset.sql`:

```sql
/**
 * Creates a crosswalk's combined dataset, when it has none, or updates
 * it: its name, `raw_sql`, its columns reconciled by name ignoring case,
 * and the reference bindings of its governed columns, replaced whole.
 * Records `compiled_at` and `compiled_code_lists` on the crosswalk.
 * Returns the combined dataset's id.
 *
 * SECURITY DEFINER because bindings are select-only for signed-in users
 * and the crosswalk's managed columns are refused to them. It checks Data
 * Sources editor on the crosswalk before it reads anything else, then
 * workspace admin to create a dataset, as any import needs, or editor
 * rights on the dataset to update it. A refusal at any point, including
 * after the dataset row was written, rolls the whole save back.
 *
 * @param p_crosswalk_id The crosswalk whose combined dataset this is.
 * @param p_dataset_id The combined dataset's id: a new id chosen by the
 *   caller when creating, the crosswalk's `output_dataset_id` when
 *   updating.
 * @param p_dataset_name The combined dataset's name.
 * @param p_raw_sql The compiled SQL that stacks every mapped dataset.
 * @param p_columns The columns in output order, as `[{ name, data_type }]`.
 * @param p_bindings The governed columns' bindings, as `[{ column_name,
 *   dictionary_id, entry_id, code_list_id, direction }]`.
 * @param p_compiled_code_lists The code lists the SQL embedded, as
 *   `[{ code_list_id, fingerprint }]`.
 * @returns The combined dataset's id.
 */
create or replace function public.rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset (
  p_crosswalk_id uuid,
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_dataset_name text,
  p_raw_sql text,
  p_columns jsonb,
  p_bindings jsonb,
  p_compiled_code_lists jsonb
) returns uuid language plpgsql security definer
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_output_dataset_id uuid;
begin
  v_workspace_id := public.crosswalks__authorize (p_crosswalk_id);

  if coalesce(btrim(p_dataset_name), '') = '' then
    raise exception 'The combined dataset needs a name'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'combined_dataset_name_required';
  end if;

  perform public.crosswalks__check_combined_payload (p_columns, p_bindings, p_compiled_code_lists);
  perform public.crosswalks__check_combined_bindings (v_workspace_id, p_columns, p_bindings);

  select c.output_dataset_id
  into v_output_dataset_id
  from public.crosswalks c
  where c.id = p_crosswalk_id;

  if v_output_dataset_id is null then
    perform public.crosswalks__create_combined_dataset (v_workspace_id, p_dataset_id, btrim(p_dataset_name), p_raw_sql, p_columns);
  else
    perform public.crosswalks__update_combined_dataset (
      v_workspace_id, v_output_dataset_id, p_dataset_id, btrim(p_dataset_name), p_raw_sql, p_columns
    );
  end if;

  perform public.crosswalks__write_combined_bindings (v_workspace_id, p_dataset_id, p_bindings);

  update public.crosswalks
  set
    output_dataset_id = p_dataset_id,
    compiled_at = now(),
    compiled_code_lists = p_compiled_code_lists
  where id = p_crosswalk_id;

  return p_dataset_id;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `combined_columns_invalid` unless the three sets are arrays, the
 * columns are at least one `{ name, data_type }` with a non-blank name, a
 * known type, and no two names equal ignoring case, and the bindings and
 * code lists are well formed. Runs before anything casts the payload.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_combined_payload (
  p_columns jsonb,
  p_bindings jsonb,
  p_compiled_code_lists jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if
    jsonb_typeof(p_columns) is distinct from 'array' or
    jsonb_typeof(p_bindings) is distinct from 'array' or
    jsonb_typeof(p_compiled_code_lists) is distinct from 'array'
  then
    raise exception 'Columns, bindings, and code lists must be arrays'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'combined_columns_invalid';
  end if;

  -- Only now are the three sets known to be arrays.
  if jsonb_array_length(p_columns) = 0 or exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_columns) as e (col)
    where
      jsonb_typeof(e.col -> 'name') is distinct from 'string' or
      btrim(coalesce(e.col ->> 'name', '')) = '' or
      coalesce(e.col ->> 'data_type', '') <> all (
        enum_range(null::public.datasets__ava_data_type)::text[]
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'The combined dataset needs at least one column, each with a name and a known type'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'combined_columns_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_columns) as e (col)
    group by lower(e.col ->> 'name')
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'Two columns of the combined dataset cannot share a name'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'combined_columns_invalid';
  end if;

  perform public.crosswalks__check_combined_binding_fields (p_bindings, p_compiled_code_lists);
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `combined_columns_invalid` unless every binding names a column, a
 * dictionary, an entry, a code list, and a known direction, with no column
 * twice, and every embedded code list names a uuid and a text fingerprint.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_combined_binding_fields (p_bindings jsonb, p_compiled_code_lists jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_uuid_pattern constant text :=
    '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) as e (binding)
    where
      jsonb_typeof(e.binding -> 'column_name') is distinct from 'string' or
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'dictionary_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'entry_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'code_list_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'direction', '') <> all (
        enum_range(null::public.dataset_columns__binding_direction)::text[]
      )
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) as e (binding)
    group by lower(e.binding ->> 'column_name')
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every binding needs a column, a dictionary, an entry, a code list, and a direction, with no column twice'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'combined_columns_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_compiled_code_lists) as e (item)
    where
      coalesce(e.item ->> 'code_list_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      jsonb_typeof(e.item -> 'fingerprint') is distinct from 'string'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every embedded code list needs an id and a fingerprint'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'combined_columns_invalid';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises with a stable hint when a binding names a column the combined
 * dataset does not have, or a dictionary, entry, or code list outside the
 * crosswalk's workspace, an entry outside its dictionary, or a code list
 * its entry does not use.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__check_combined_bindings (
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_columns jsonb,
  p_bindings jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (column_name text)
    where not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_columns) as e (col)
      where lower(e.col ->> 'name') = lower(b.column_name)
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every binding must name a column of the combined dataset'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'binding_column_missing';
  end if;

  -- The entry's workspace stands for all three: its dictionary has the
  -- same workspace (composite key), and so does every list it codes with.
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (dictionary_id uuid, entry_id uuid, code_list_id uuid)
    where not exists (
      select 1
      from public.data_dictionaries__entries en
      join public.data_dictionaries__entry_codings ec on ec.entry_id = en.id
      where
        en.id = b.entry_id and
        en.dictionary_id = b.dictionary_id and
        en.workspace_id = p_workspace_id and
        ec.code_list_id = b.code_list_id
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every binding''s dictionary, entry, and code list must belong together in this workspace'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'binding_not_in_workspace';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * The combined dataset's columns as rows, in the payload's order, with
 * `column_idx` counting from 0.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__read_combined_columns (p_columns jsonb) returns table (
  name text,
  data_type public.datasets__ava_data_type,
  column_idx integer
) language sql immutable
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  select
    e.col ->> 'name',
    (e.col ->> 'data_type')::public.datasets__ava_data_type,
    (e.column_index - 1)::integer
  from jsonb_array_elements(p_columns) with ordinality as e (col, column_index);
$$;

/**
 * Creates the combined dataset as a virtual dataset the caller owns, with
 * the payload's columns, after checking that the caller may add a dataset
 * to the workspace.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__create_combined_dataset (
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_name text,
  p_raw_sql text,
  p_columns jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not public.util__can_manage_workspace_settings (p_workspace_id) then
    raise exception 'Only a workspace admin can add a dataset'
      using errcode = '42501', hint = 'dataset_creator_required';
  end if;

  -- The columns are built inline, as `datasets__virtual__create_linked`
  -- builds them.
  perform public.rpc_datasets__add_virtual_dataset (
    p_dataset_id,
    p_workspace_id,
    p_name,
    null,
    (
      select
        array_agg(
          row(
            w.name,
            w.name,
            null,
            public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (w.data_type)::text,
            public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (w.data_type),
            w.data_type,
            w.column_idx
          )::public.dataset_column_input
          order by w.column_idx
        )
      from public.crosswalks__read_combined_columns (p_columns) as w
    ),
    p_raw_sql
  );
end;
$$;

/**
 * Updates the crosswalk's combined dataset: its name, its SQL, and its
 * columns, after checking that `p_dataset_id` is that dataset and that
 * the caller can edit it. Locks the dataset for the rest of the save.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__update_combined_dataset (
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_output_dataset_id uuid,
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_name text,
  p_raw_sql text,
  p_columns jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if p_dataset_id is distinct from p_output_dataset_id then
    raise exception 'This crosswalk updates a different combined dataset'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'combined_dataset_mismatch';
  end if;

  if not public.util__auth_user_can_access_resource (
    'dataset'::public.resource_type,
    p_dataset_id,
    'editor'::public.role_level
  ) then
    raise exception 'Only an editor of the combined dataset can update it'
      using errcode = '42501', hint = 'dataset_editor_required';
  end if;

  perform 1 from public.datasets where id = p_dataset_id for no key update;

  update public.datasets
  set name = p_name
  where id = p_dataset_id;

  update public.datasets__virtual
  set raw_sql = p_raw_sql
  where dataset_id = p_dataset_id;

  perform public.crosswalks__reconcile_combined_columns (p_workspace_id, p_dataset_id, p_columns);
end;
$$;

/**
 * Makes the combined dataset's columns the payload's. Each payload column
 * keeps the first existing column with its name ignoring case (by
 * position), so its id, description, and bindings' targets survive, and
 * takes the payload's name, type, and position; new names are inserted;
 * every other column is deleted, kept-original copies included.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__reconcile_combined_columns (
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_columns jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_kept_ids uuid[];
begin
  with kept as (
    select distinct on (lower(dc.name))
      dc.id,
      lower(dc.name) as name_key
    from public.dataset_columns dc
    where dc.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and dc.dictionary_binding_id is null
    order by lower(dc.name), dc.column_idx, dc.id
  ), updated as (
    update public.dataset_columns dc
    set
      original_name = w.name,
      name = w.name,
      original_data_type = public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (w.data_type)::text,
      detected_data_type = public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (w.data_type),
      data_type = w.data_type,
      column_idx = w.column_idx
    from public.crosswalks__read_combined_columns (p_columns) as w
    join kept k on k.name_key = lower(w.name)
    where dc.id = k.id
    returning dc.id
  )
  select coalesce(array_agg(updated.id), '{}')
  into v_kept_ids
  from updated;

  delete from public.dataset_columns dc
  where dc.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and dc.id <> all (v_kept_ids);

  insert into public.dataset_columns (
    dataset_id, workspace_id, original_name, name, original_data_type, detected_data_type, data_type, column_idx
  )
  select
    p_dataset_id, p_workspace_id, w.name, w.name,
    public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (w.data_type)::text,
    public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (w.data_type),
    w.data_type, w.column_idx
  from public.crosswalks__read_combined_columns (p_columns) as w
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from public.dataset_columns dc
    where dc.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and lower(dc.name) = lower(w.name)
  );
end;
$$;

/**
 * Replaces the combined dataset's bindings with the given set, as
 * reference bindings at each dictionary's current version, on the column
 * of the binding's name ignoring case.
 */
create or replace function public.crosswalks__write_combined_bindings (
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_bindings jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  delete from public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings b
  where b.dataset_id = p_dataset_id;

  insert into public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings (
    workspace_id, dataset_id, dataset_column_id, dictionary_id, entry_id, code_list_id,
    mode, direction, applied_dictionary_version
  )
  select
    p_workspace_id, p_dataset_id, dc.id, b.dictionary_id, b.entry_id, b.code_list_id,
    'reference', b.direction::public.dataset_columns__binding_direction, d.version
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (
    column_name text, dictionary_id uuid, entry_id uuid, code_list_id uuid, direction text
  )
  join public.dataset_columns dc on dc.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and lower(dc.name) = lower(b.column_name)
  join public.data_dictionaries d on d.id = b.dictionary_id;
end;
$$;
```

Notes for the implementer:

- **Who runs what.** `rpc_datasets__add_virtual_dataset` is SECURITY INVOKER. Called from this SECURITY DEFINER function it runs as the function owner, so its insert into `datasets__virtual` passes RLS, while `rpc_datasets__add_dataset` still reads `auth.uid()` from the request's claims and makes the caller the owner. This is the path `datasets__virtual__create_linked` already takes, and the linked-dataset test proves it.
- **The managed column.** The final `update public.crosswalks` runs as the function owner, so `crosswalks__guard_managed_columns` lets `output_dataset_id`, `compiled_at`, and `compiled_code_lists` through.
- **Order inside an update.** Columns are reconciled before the bindings are rewritten, so a binding lands on the column's final name. A column that is deleted takes its old binding with it (`dataset_column_id` cascades), and the delete-then-insert in `crosswalks__write_combined_bindings` removes the rest.
- **Two columns equal ignoring case on the dataset.** A user could have renamed two columns of the combined dataset to names that differ only in case. `distinct on (lower(name))` keeps the first by position; the other is deleted, so the dataset ends with exactly the payload's names.
- **`for no key update`.** The same lock `dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__authorize` takes, so an apply and a combine on one dataset run one at a time without blocking foreign-key checks from other rows.

### Task 5: Migration, generated types, desktop twin, sync list, commit

Tasks 1 to 4 changed only declarative files. This task builds the migration from them on this branch's own stack, runs the four new pgTAP files and the whole database suite, regenerates `shared/types/database.types.ts`, adds the five tables to the desktop's sync list and generates their SQLite twin, and commits everything together, as slice 4's Task 5 did.

The desktop renders crosswalks offline (offline parity), so all five tables go into `ACTIVE_TABLES` in `apps/desktop/sync/syncable-tables.ts`, and they must be listed **before** `pnpm desktop:sqlite:gen-migrations` runs: the generator hard-errors on a `CREATE TABLE` for a table that is in neither `ACTIVE_TABLES` nor `EXCLUDED_TABLES`. Nothing else in the desktop needs a per-table entry: the first-launch snapshot pulls every name in `SYNCABLE_TABLES` through Supabase REST, under the signed-in user's RLS, so `crosswalks__datasets` arrives filtered exactly as on the web.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/desktop/sync/syncable-tables.ts`
- Create (generated): `supabase/migrations/<timestamp>_crosswalks.sql`, `apps/desktop/migrations/<timestamp>_crosswalks.gen.sql`
- Modify (generated): `shared/types/database.types.ts`
- Commit: everything Tasks 1 to 4 created or changed

### Task 6: `fnv1a64Hex`, `toDuckDbTypeSql`, and the Crosswalk, CrosswalkLayout, CrosswalkDataset, and CrosswalkColumn models

Four persisted models follow `DataDictionaryEntry/` exactly: a `*.types.ts` with the id brand, read type, and `SupabaseCrudModelSpec`; a `*Parsers.ts` built with `makeParserRegistry`, a snake_case `DBReadSchema`, and the `ZodConsistencyTests` check against the generated row; and the namespace file. `crosswalks.compiled_code_lists` stays outside the parser's deep key transforms and goes through its own schema, the way a code list's `pairs` do, so a malformed fingerprint fails loudly. Its values are uuids, never keys, so `camelCaseKeysDeep` could not damage them, but a schema is the house pattern for jsonb. `CrosswalkModule` reads RPC hints the way `DictionaryBinding.toApplyErrorHint` does, with one shared helper for both hint lists.

Two small shared helpers come first. `fnv1a64Hex` hashes a string's UTF-8 bytes with 64-bit FNV-1a using `BigInt`, so layout signatures and code-list fingerprints are the same in the browser, Node, and Deno; its test pins the published vectors (`""`, `"a"`, `"foobar"`, verified by running the code). `AvaDataType.toDuckDbTypeSql` gives the DuckDB type an Ava type is cast to, the same names `datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb` gives in SQL.

`Crosswalk.SavePayload` is added in Task 7: it names the mapping model's types. `CrosswalkLayout.types.ts` and the `CrosswalkLayout` namespace already carry `CrosswalkLayoutDataset` and `CrosswalkLayoutGroup` (`CrosswalkLayout.Dataset`, `CrosswalkLayout.Group`), which Task 8's module takes and returns; Task 8 adds the module's export.

**Needs Task 5's generated `shared/types/database.types.ts`.** Each parser's `ZodConsistencyTests` compares its `DBReadSchema` with the generated `Row`, so it expects exactly these fields (any other nullability is a type error in Step 4; fix the schema in Tasks 1 and 2, not the parser):

| `crosswalks__layouts` | `column_names: string[]`, `created_at: string`, `crosswalk_id: string`, `id: string`, `is_reference: boolean`, `signature: string`, `status: Database["public"]["Enums"]["crosswalks__layout_status"]`, `updated_at: string`, `workspace_id: string` |
| `crosswalks__datasets` | `created_at: string`, `crosswalk_id: string`, `dataset_id: string`, `id: string`, `layout_id: string`, `workspace_id: string` |

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { fnv1a64Hex } from "$/utils/fnv1a64Hex/fnv1a64Hex.ts";

describe("fnv1a64Hex", () => {
  it.each([
    ["", "cbf29ce484222325"],
    ["a", "af63dc4c8601ec8c"],
    ["foobar", "85944171f73967e8"],
  ])("hashes %j to the published FNV-1a 64 vector", (text, expected) => {
    expect(fnv1a64Hex(text)).toBe(expected);
  });

  it("hashes the UTF-8 bytes, so an accented letter differs from its base", () => {
    expect(fnv1a64Hex("é")).not.toBe(fnv1a64Hex("e"));
    expect(fnv1a64Hex("é")).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{16}$/);
  });

  it("keeps leading zeros, so every hash is 16 digits", () => {
    const hashes = ["x", "y", "zip", "Kings", "1", "2"].map(fnv1a64Hex);

    expect(
      hashes.every((hash) => {
        return hash.length === 16;
      }),
    ).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

`shared/utils/fnv1a64Hex/fnv1a64Hex.ts`:

```ts
const FNV_OFFSET_BASIS = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
const FNV_PRIME = 0x100000001b3n;
const UINT64_MASK = 0xffffffffffffffffn;

/**
 * A 64-bit FNV-1a hash of a string's UTF-8 bytes, as 16 lowercase hex
 * digits. Use it for a short, stable fingerprint that is the same in the
 * browser, Node, and Deno, for example to tell whether a list of values
 * changed since it was last read. It is not a cryptographic hash.
 */
export function fnv1a64Hex(text: string): string {
  const hash = new TextEncoder().encode(text).reduce((current, byte) => {
    return ((current ^ BigInt(byte)) * FNV_PRIME) & UINT64_MASK;
  }, FNV_OFFSET_BASIS);
  return hash.toString(16).padStart(16, "0");
}
```

`shared/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk.types.ts`:

```ts
import type { DataDictionary } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionary/DataDictionary.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry.ts";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding.ts";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType.ts";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset.ts";
import type { SupabaseCrudModelSpec } from "$/models/SupabaseCrudModelSpec.ts";
import type { User } from "$/models/User/User.ts";
import type { UserProfile } from "$/models/User/UserProfile.ts";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace.ts";
import type { Enums } from "$/types/database.types.ts";
import type { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import type { UUID } from "@avandar/utils";
import type { SetOptional } from "type-fest";

type ModelType = "Crosswalk";
export type CrosswalkId = UUID<ModelType>;

/**
 * How a combined dataset writes a coded column: the code list's `labels`,
 * such as Male, or its `codes`, such as 1.
 */
export type CrosswalkCodesOutput = Enums<"crosswalks__codes_output">;

/**
 * A code list the combined dataset embedded, and the fingerprint of its
 * pairs then. The stale banner compares it with the list's pairs now.
 */
export type CrosswalkCompiledCodeList = {
  codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeList.Id;
  fingerprint: string;
};

/**
 * A crosswalk: how many datasets with different column layouts map onto
 * one set of columns, and the combined dataset that stacks them.
 */
type CrosswalkRead = Model.Base<
  ModelType,
  {
    /** Whether the combined dataset gets a `source_dataset` column */
    addsSourceColumn: boolean;

    /** How the combined dataset writes coded columns */
    codesOutputAs: CrosswalkCodesOutput;

    /** When the combined dataset's SQL was last saved */
    compiledAt: string | undefined;

    /** The code lists the combined dataset's SQL embedded, with fingerprints */
    compiledCodeLists: CrosswalkCompiledCodeList[] | undefined;

    /** Timestamp of when the crosswalk was created */
    createdAt: string;

    /** Description of the crosswalk */
    description: string | undefined;

    /** Unique identifier of the crosswalk */
    id: CrosswalkId;

    /** Name of the crosswalk */
    name: string;

    /** The combined dataset. Undefined until it is created or once deleted. */
    outputDatasetId: Dataset.Id | undefined;

    /** User id of the owner */
    ownerId: User.Id;

    /** The owner's profile in this workspace */
    ownerProfileId: UserProfile.Id;

    /** Timestamp of when the crosswalk was last updated */
    updatedAt: string;

    /** Workspace this crosswalk belongs to */
    workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
  }
>;

/** Everything `rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset` writes. */
export type CrosswalkCombinePayload = {
  crosswalkId: CrosswalkId;
  datasetId: Dataset.Id;
  datasetName: string;
  rawSql: string;
  columns: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; dataType: AvaDataType.T }>;
  bindings: ReadonlyArray<{
    columnName: string;
    dictionaryId: DataDictionary.Id;
    entryId: DataDictionaryEntry.Id;
    codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeList.Id;
    direction: DictionaryBinding.Direction;
  }>;
  compiledCodeLists: readonly CrosswalkCompiledCodeList[];
};

/** The stable `hint` values `rpc_crosswalks__save` raises with. */
export type CrosswalkSaveErrorHint =
  | "crosswalk_editor_required"
  | "crosswalk_payload_invalid"
  | "crosswalk_name_required"
  | "column_name_required"
  | "column_names_not_unique"
  | "reference_layout_required"
  | "layout_signatures_not_unique"
  | "item_not_in_crosswalk"
  | "dataset_not_readable"
  | "entry_not_in_workspace"
  | "mappings_not_unique"
  | "fill_invalid";

/**
 * The stable `hint` values `rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset` raises
 * with.
 */
export type CrosswalkCombineErrorHint =
  | "crosswalk_editor_required"
  | "combined_dataset_name_required"
  | "combined_columns_invalid"
  | "binding_column_missing"
  | "binding_not_in_workspace"
  | "dataset_creator_required"
  | "combined_dataset_mismatch"
  | "dataset_editor_required";

/** CRUD type definitions for the Crosswalk model. */
export type CrosswalkModel = SupabaseCrudModelSpec<
  {
    tableName: "crosswalks";
    modelName: "Crosswalk";
    modelPrimaryKeyType: CrosswalkId;
    modelTypes: {
      Read: CrosswalkRead;
      Insert: SetOptional<
        CrosswalkRead,
        | "addsSourceColumn"
        | "codesOutputAs"
        | "compiledAt"
        | "compiledCodeLists"
        | "createdAt"
        | "description"
        | "id"
        | "outputDatasetId"
        | "ownerId"
        | "updatedAt"
      >;
      Update: Partial<CrosswalkRead>;
    };
  },
  {
    dbTablePrimaryKey: "id";
  }
>;
```

```ts
} from "@avandar/utils";
import { z } from "zod";
import { supabaseJSONSchema as supabaseJsonSchema } from "$/lib/zodHelpers.ts";
import type {
  CrosswalkCompiledCodeList,
  CrosswalkId,
  CrosswalkModel,
} from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk.types.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset.ts";
import type { User } from "$/models/User/User.ts";
import type { UserProfile } from "$/models/User/UserProfile.ts";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace.ts";
import type { Json } from "$/types/database.types.ts";
import type { Expect } from "@avandar/utils";
import type { ZodSchemaEqualsTypes } from "@utils/zod/index.ts";

const DBReadSchema = z.object({
  adds_source_column: z.boolean(),
  codes_output_as: z.enum(["labels", "codes"]),
  compiled_at: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }).nullable(),
  compiled_code_lists: supabaseJsonSchema,
  created_at: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }),
  description: z.string().nullable(),
  id: z.uuid(),
  name: z.string(),
  output_dataset_id: z.uuid().nullable(),
  owner_id: z.uuid(),
  owner_profile_id: z.uuid(),
  updated_at: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }),
  workspace_id: z.uuid(),
});

/** The stored shape of `crosswalks.compiled_code_lists`. */
const StoredCompiledCodeListsSchema = z.array(
  z.object({ code_list_id: z.uuid(), fingerprint: z.string() }),
);

type ReadWithoutJson = Omit<CrosswalkModel["Read"], "compiledCodeLists">;
type DBReadWithoutJson = Omit<CrosswalkModel["DBRead"], "compiled_code_lists">;

/** Parses stored fingerprints, throwing when one is malformed. */
function _compiledCodeListsFromJson(
  compiledCodeLists: Json,
): CrosswalkCompiledCodeList[] | undefined {
  if (compiledCodeLists === null) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return StoredCompiledCodeListsSchema.parse(compiledCodeLists).map((item) => {
    return {
      codeListId: item.code_list_id as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id,
      fingerprint: item.fingerprint,
    };
  });
}

function _readRow(row: DBReadWithoutJson): ReadWithoutJson {
  const camelCaseRow = camelCaseKeysDeep(row) as ReadWithoutJson;
  return nullsToUndefinedDeep(camelCaseRow) as ReadWithoutJson;
}

/**
 * Parses `public.crosswalks` rows. The compiled fingerprints stay outside
 * the deep key transforms and go through their own schema, so a malformed
 * one fails loudly. The managed columns (`output_dataset_id`, `compiled_at`,
 * `compiled_code_lists`) are written only by the combined-dataset RPC, so
 * writes leave them out unless they are set.
 */
export const CrosswalkParsers = makeParserRegistry<CrosswalkModel>().build({
  modelName: "Crosswalk",
  DBReadSchema,
  fromDBReadToModelRead: (dbRow): CrosswalkModel["Read"] => {
    const { compiled_code_lists: compiledCodeLists, ...row } = dbRow;
    const modelRow = _readRow(row);
    return Model.make("Crosswalk", {
      ...modelRow,
      id: modelRow.id as CrosswalkId,
      outputDatasetId: modelRow.outputDatasetId as Dataset.Id | undefined,
      ownerId: modelRow.ownerId as User.Id,
      ownerProfileId: modelRow.ownerProfileId as UserProfile.Id,
      workspaceId: modelRow.workspaceId as Workspace.Id,
      compiledCodeLists: _compiledCodeListsFromJson(compiledCodeLists),
    });
  },
  fromModelInsertToDBInsert: pipe(
    snakeCaseKeysDeep,
    undefinedsToNullsDeep,
    excludeNullsExceptInProps("description"),
  ),
  fromModelUpdateToDBUpdate: pipe(
    snakeCaseKeysDeep,
    undefinedsToNullsDeep,
    excludeNullsExceptInProps("description"),
  ),
});

/** Keeps the database schema and CRUD row types aligned. */
type CrudTypes = CrosswalkModel;
// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
// @ts-ignore Type tests - this variable is intentionally not used
type ZodConsistencyTests = [
  Expect<
    ZodSchemaEqualsTypes<
      typeof DBReadSchema,
      { input: CrudTypes["DBRead"]; output: CrudTypes["DBRead"] }
    >
  >,
];
```

```ts
import type {
  CrosswalkCombineErrorHint,
  CrosswalkSaveErrorHint,
} from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk.types.ts";

const SAVE_ERROR_HINTS: readonly CrosswalkSaveErrorHint[] = [
  "crosswalk_editor_required",
  "crosswalk_payload_invalid",
  "crosswalk_name_required",
  "column_name_required",
  "column_names_not_unique",
  "reference_layout_required",
  "layout_signatures_not_unique",
  "item_not_in_crosswalk",
  "dataset_not_readable",
  "entry_not_in_workspace",
  "mappings_not_unique",
  "fill_invalid",
];

const COMBINE_ERROR_HINTS: readonly CrosswalkCombineErrorHint[] = [
  "crosswalk_editor_required",
  "combined_dataset_name_required",
  "combined_columns_invalid",
  "binding_column_missing",
  "binding_not_in_workspace",
  "dataset_creator_required",
  "combined_dataset_mismatch",
  "dataset_editor_required",
];

/** The `hint` on a thrown database error, when it is one of `knownHints`. */
function _findKnownHint<Hint extends string>(
  error: unknown,
  knownHints: readonly Hint[],
): Hint | undefined {
  if (typeof error !== "object" || error === null || !("hint" in error)) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const { hint } = error;
  return knownHints.find((knownHint) => {
    return knownHint === hint;
  });
}

/**
 * Helpers for crosswalks: the name of the column that says which dataset a
 * combined row came from, and reading why a save was refused so a view can
 * explain it.
 */
export const CrosswalkModule = {
  /** The column a combined dataset adds when `addsSourceColumn` is on. */
  SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME: "source_dataset",

  /** `rpc_crosswalks__save`'s `hint` on a thrown error, when it is known. */
  toSaveErrorHint: (error: unknown): CrosswalkSaveErrorHint | undefined => {
    return _findKnownHint(error, SAVE_ERROR_HINTS);
  },

  /**
   * `rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset`'s `hint` on a thrown error,
   * when it is known.
   */
  toCombineErrorHint: (
    error: unknown,
  ): CrosswalkCombineErrorHint | undefined => {
    return _findKnownHint(error, COMBINE_ERROR_HINTS);
  },
};
```

```ts
import type { CrosswalkId } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk.types.ts";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType.ts";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset.ts";
import type { SupabaseCrudModelSpec } from "$/models/SupabaseCrudModelSpec.ts";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace.ts";
import type { Enums } from "$/types/database.types.ts";
import type { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import type { UUID } from "@avandar/utils";
import type { SetOptional } from "type-fest";

type ModelType = "CrosswalkLayout";
export type CrosswalkLayoutId = UUID<ModelType>;

/**
 * How far a layout's mapping has come: `to_do` (not every column filled),
 * `review` (filled, not confirmed), `mapped`, or `skipped` (left out of the
 * combined dataset).
 */
export type CrosswalkLayoutStatus = Enums<"crosswalks__layout_status">;

/**
 * One set of column names in a crosswalk. Every dataset with these names,
 * ignoring case and order, is mapped once, through this layout.
 */
type CrosswalkLayoutRead = Model.Base<
  ModelType,
  {
    /** The first dataset's column names, in its column order */
    columnNames: string[];

    /** Timestamp of when the layout was created */
    createdAt: string;

    /** Crosswalk this layout belongs to */
    crosswalkId: CrosswalkId;

    /** Unique identifier of the layout */
    id: CrosswalkLayoutId;

    /** Whether the combined dataset's columns come from this layout */
    isReference: boolean;

    /** A hash of the normalized column names, unique per crosswalk */
    signature: string;

    /** How far this layout's mapping has come */
    status: CrosswalkLayoutStatus;

    /** Timestamp of when the layout was last updated */
    updatedAt: string;

    /** Workspace this layout belongs to, always its crosswalk's */
    workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
  }
>;

/** CRUD type definitions for the CrosswalkLayout model. */
export type CrosswalkLayoutModel = SupabaseCrudModelSpec<
  {
    tableName: "crosswalks__layouts";
    modelName: "CrosswalkLayout";
    modelPrimaryKeyType: CrosswalkLayoutId;
    modelTypes: {
      Read: CrosswalkLayoutRead;
      Insert: SetOptional<
        CrosswalkLayoutRead,
        "createdAt" | "id" | "isReference" | "status" | "updatedAt"
      >;
      Update: Partial<CrosswalkLayoutRead>;
    };
  },
  {
    dbTablePrimaryKey: "id";
  }
>;

/** A dataset as layouts see it: its name and its columns in column order. */
export type CrosswalkLayoutDataset = {
  id: Dataset.Id;
  name: string;
  columns: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; dataType: AvaDataType.T }>;
};

/** Datasets that share one set of column names. */
export type CrosswalkLayoutGroup = {
  /** `CrosswalkLayout.buildLayoutKey` of the shared column names */
  key: string;
  signature: string;
  /** The first dataset's (by name) column names, in its column order. */
  columnNames: string[];
  /** Sorted by dataset name. */
  datasetIds: Dataset.Id[];
};
```
