### Task 7: CrosswalkMapping and its versioned fill

A mapping says how one column of the combined dataset is filled for one layout. Its `fill` is jsonb in a versioned, snake_case shape (`version: 1`). The parser takes `fill` out of the row before `camelCaseKeysDeep` runs, exactly as `DataDictionaryCodeListParsers` takes out `pairs`, and reads it with `fillFromDBJson`, which reads the version first and throws on one it does not know, then parses version 1 with a Zod discriminated union. The version-1 schema also refuses a `column` fill that both converts and translates codes, a blank `source_column`, and a blank `sql`, so a malformed fill fails at load rather than compiling to the wrong SQL. `fillToDBJson` writes the same shape, with `null` for whatever is not set; Task 13's save mutation sends it.

`getCombineColumnNames` reads a Combine expression's `{column name}` placeholders with `COMBINE_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN`, trimmed, each once, in order of first use, so a name with a space (`{Case No}`) works. A blank placeholder names nothing.

This task also adds `Crosswalk.SavePayload`, which names the mapping types.

**Needs Task 5's generated `shared/types/database.types.ts`**, with this `Row` for `crosswalks__mappings`: `column_id: string`, `confidence: number | null`, `created_at: string`, `crosswalk_id: string`, `fill: Json`, `id: string`, `layout_id: string`, `reason: Database["public"]["Enums"]["crosswalks__mapping_reason"] | null`, `status: Database["public"]["Enums"]["crosswalks__mapping_status"]`, `updated_at: string`, `workspace_id: string`.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";

const SEX_LIST =
  "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555" as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id;

const FILLS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, CrosswalkMapping.Fill]> = [
  [
    "a column translated through a code list",
    {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: "GENDER",
      convert: undefined,
      codeListId: SEX_LIST,
      holdsLabels: false,
    },
  ],
  [
    "a column read as a date",
    {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: "onset_dt",
      convert: { kind: "parse_date", format: "%m/%d/%Y" },
      codeListId: undefined,
      holdsLabels: false,
    },
  ],
  [
    "a column padded with zeros",
    {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: "zip",
      convert: { kind: "pad_text", length: 5 },
      codeListId: undefined,
      holdsLabels: false,
    },
  ],
  [
    "a column multiplied",
    {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: "age_mo",
      convert: { kind: "multiply", factor: 1 / 12 },
      codeListId: undefined,
      holdsLabels: false,
    },
  ],
  [
    "a column trimmed and uppercased",
    {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: "name",
      convert: { kind: "trim_and_fix_case", letterCase: "upper" },
      codeListId: undefined,
      holdsLabels: false,
    },
  ],
  ["a fixed value", { kind: "constant", value: "Bronx" }],
  [
    "a Combine expression",
    { kind: "expression", sql: "concat({first_name}, ' ', {last_name})" },
  ],
  ["an empty column", { kind: "empty" }],
];

describe("CrosswalkMapping.fillToDBJson and fillFromDBJson", () => {
  it.each(FILLS)("round-trips %s", (_label, fill) => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkMapping.fillFromDBJson(CrosswalkMapping.fillToDBJson(fill)),
    ).toEqual(fill);
  });

  it("writes version 1 in snake_case with nulls for what is not set", () => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkMapping.fillToDBJson({
        kind: "column",
        sourceColumn: "name",
        convert: { kind: "trim_and_fix_case", letterCase: "lower" },
        codeListId: undefined,
        holdsLabels: true,
      }),
    ).toEqual({
      version: 1,
      kind: "column",
      source_column: "name",
      convert: { kind: "trim_and_fix_case", letter_case: "lower" },
      code_list_id: null,
      holds_labels: true,
    });
  });
});

describe("CrosswalkMapping.fillFromDBJson", () => {
  it("refuses a column fill that both converts and translates codes", () => {
    expect(() => {
      return CrosswalkMapping.fillFromDBJson({
        version: 1,
        kind: "column",
        source_column: "GENDER",
        convert: { kind: "pad_text", length: 2 },
        code_list_id: SEX_LIST,
        holds_labels: false,
      });
    }).toThrow("either converts or translates");
  });

  it("refuses a version it does not know", () => {
    expect(() => {
      return CrosswalkMapping.fillFromDBJson({ version: 2, kind: "empty" });
    }).toThrow("Unknown crosswalk fill version: 2");
  });

  it("refuses a fill with no version", () => {
    expect(() => {
      return CrosswalkMapping.fillFromDBJson({ kind: "empty" });
    }).toThrow();
  });

  it("refuses a column fill with a blank source column", () => {
    expect(() => {
      return CrosswalkMapping.fillFromDBJson({
        version: 1,
        kind: "column",
        source_column: "  ",
        convert: null,
        code_list_id: null,
        holds_labels: false,
      });
    }).toThrow();
  });
});

describe("CrosswalkMapping.getCombineColumnNames", () => {
  it("reads a placeholder whose column name has a space", () => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkMapping.getCombineColumnNames("upper({Case No}) || '-'"),
    ).toEqual(["Case No"]);
  });

  it("lists each name once, trimmed, in order of first use", () => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkMapping.getCombineColumnNames(
        "concat({ last_name }, ', ', {first_name}, {last_name})",
      ),
    ).toEqual(["last_name", "first_name"]);
  });

  it("ignores a blank placeholder", () => {
    expect(CrosswalkMapping.getCombineColumnNames("{ } || {zip}")).toEqual([
      "zip",
    ]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { CrosswalkId } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk.types.ts";
import type { CrosswalkColumnId } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn.types.ts";
import type { CrosswalkLayoutId } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout.types.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { SupabaseCrudModelSpec } from "$/models/SupabaseCrudModelSpec.ts";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace.ts";
import type { Enums } from "$/types/database.types.ts";
import type { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import type { UUID } from "@avandar/utils";
import type { SetOptional } from "type-fest";

type ModelType = "CrosswalkMapping";
export type CrosswalkMappingId = UUID<ModelType>;

/** Whether a mapping is a guess the user has not confirmed yet. */
export type CrosswalkMappingStatus = Enums<"crosswalks__mapping_status">;

/**
 * Why a suggested mapping was made: matching names and types, matching
 * values, carried over from a similar layout, or the AI's reading of what
 * the columns mean.
 */
export type CrosswalkMappingReason = Enums<"crosswalks__mapping_reason">;

/** A change applied to a source column's values before they are cast. */
export type CrosswalkConvert =
  | { kind: "parse_date"; format: string }
  | { kind: "pad_text"; length: number }
  | { kind: "multiply"; factor: number }
  | { kind: "trim_and_fix_case"; letterCase: "keep" | "lower" | "upper" };

/**
 * How one column of the combined dataset is filled for one layout. A
 * `column` fill either converts (`convert`) or translates codes through a
 * code list (`codeListId`), never both. `holdsLabels` says the source holds
 * the list's labels rather than its codes. An `expression` names columns as
 * `{column name}` placeholders.
 */
export type CrosswalkFill =
  | {
      kind: "column";
      sourceColumn: string;
      convert: CrosswalkConvert | undefined;
      codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeList.Id | undefined;
      holdsLabels: boolean;
    }
  | { kind: "constant"; value: string }
  | { kind: "expression"; sql: string }
  | { kind: "empty" };

/** How one column of the combined dataset is filled for one layout. */
type CrosswalkMappingRead = Model.Base<
  ModelType,
  {
    /** The column of the combined dataset this mapping fills */
    columnId: CrosswalkColumnId;

    /** How sure a suggestion was, from 0 to 1. Undefined when set by hand. */
    confidence: number | undefined;

    /** Timestamp of when the mapping was created */
    createdAt: string;

    /** Crosswalk this mapping belongs to */
    crosswalkId: CrosswalkId;

    /** How the column is filled */
    fill: CrosswalkFill;

    /** Unique identifier of the mapping */
    id: CrosswalkMappingId;

    /** The layout whose datasets this mapping reads */
    layoutId: CrosswalkLayoutId;

    /** Why the mapping was suggested. Undefined when set by hand. */
    reason: CrosswalkMappingReason | undefined;

    /** Whether the user has confirmed the mapping */
    status: CrosswalkMappingStatus;

    /** Timestamp of when the mapping was last updated */
    updatedAt: string;

    /** Workspace this mapping belongs to, always its crosswalk's */
    workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
  }
>;

/** CRUD type definitions for the CrosswalkMapping model. */
export type CrosswalkMappingModel = SupabaseCrudModelSpec<
  {
    tableName: "crosswalks__mappings";
    modelName: "CrosswalkMapping";
    modelPrimaryKeyType: CrosswalkMappingId;
    modelTypes: {
      Read: CrosswalkMappingRead;
      Insert: SetOptional<
        CrosswalkMappingRead,
        "confidence" | "createdAt" | "id" | "reason" | "status" | "updatedAt"
      >;
      Update: Partial<CrosswalkMappingRead>;
    };
  },
  {
    dbTablePrimaryKey: "id";
  }
>;
```

`shared/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMappingModule/CrosswalkMappingModule.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import type {
  CrosswalkConvert,
  CrosswalkFill,
} from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping.types.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { Json } from "$/types/database.types.ts";

/** The fill format this code reads and writes. */
const FILL_VERSION = 1;

/** A `{column name}` placeholder in a Combine expression. */
const COMBINE_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN = /\{([^{}]+)\}/g;

const StoredConvertSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("parse_date"), format: z.string().min(1) }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("pad_text"), length: z.number().int().min(1) }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("multiply"), factor: z.number() }),
  z.object({
    kind: z.literal("trim_and_fix_case"),
    letter_case: z.enum(["keep", "lower", "upper"]),
  }),
]);

/**
 * Version 1 of `crosswalks__mappings.fill`, snake_case. A `column` fill
 * converts or translates codes, never both.
 */
const StoredFillV1Schema = z
  .discriminatedUnion("kind", [
    z.object({
      version: z.literal(FILL_VERSION),
      kind: z.literal("column"),
      source_column: z.string().trim().min(1),
      convert: StoredConvertSchema.nullable(),
      code_list_id: z.uuid().nullable(),
      holds_labels: z.boolean(),
    }),
    z.object({
      version: z.literal(FILL_VERSION),
      kind: z.literal("constant"),
      value: z.string(),
    }),
    z.object({
      version: z.literal(FILL_VERSION),
      kind: z.literal("expression"),
      sql: z.string().trim().min(1),
    }),
    z.object({ version: z.literal(FILL_VERSION), kind: z.literal("empty") }),
  ])
  .refine(
    (fill) => {
      return (
        fill.kind !== "column" ||
        fill.convert === null ||
        fill.code_list_id === null
      );
    },
    { message: "A column fill either converts or translates codes" },
  );

/** A fill as `crosswalks__mappings.fill` stores it. */
export type StoredCrosswalkFill = z.infer<typeof StoredFillV1Schema>;
type StoredConvert = z.infer<typeof StoredConvertSchema>;

function _convertFromStored(stored: StoredConvert): CrosswalkConvert {
  if (stored.kind === "trim_and_fix_case") {
    return { kind: stored.kind, letterCase: stored.letter_case };
  }
  return stored;
}

function _convertToStored(convert: CrosswalkConvert): StoredConvert {
  if (convert.kind === "trim_and_fix_case") {
    return { kind: convert.kind, letter_case: convert.letterCase };
  }
  return convert;
}

function _fillFromStored(stored: StoredCrosswalkFill): CrosswalkFill {
  if (stored.kind === "column") {
    return {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: stored.source_column,
      convert:
        stored.convert === null
          ? undefined
          : _convertFromStored(stored.convert),
      codeListId: (stored.code_list_id ?? undefined) as
        | DataDictionaryCodeList.Id
        | undefined,
      holdsLabels: stored.holds_labels,
    };
  }
  const { version: _version, ...fill } = stored;
  return fill;
}

/**
 * Reads a stored fill, whatever version wrote it. Throws on a version this
 * code does not know and on a fill its version's schema refuses, so a
 * malformed mapping fails loudly instead of compiling to the wrong SQL.
 */
function fillFromDBJson(json: Json): CrosswalkFill {
  const { version } = z.object({ version: z.number() }).parse(json);
  if (version !== FILL_VERSION) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown crosswalk fill version: ${version}`);
  }
  return _fillFromStored(StoredFillV1Schema.parse(json));
}

/**
 * A fill in the stored shape, for `crosswalks__mappings.fill` and the save
 * RPC.
 */
function fillToDBJson(fill: CrosswalkFill): StoredCrosswalkFill {
  if (fill.kind === "column") {
    return {
      version: FILL_VERSION,
      kind: "column",
      source_column: fill.sourceColumn,
      convert:
        fill.convert === undefined ? null : _convertToStored(fill.convert),
      code_list_id: fill.codeListId ?? null,
      holds_labels: fill.holdsLabels,
    };
  }
  return { version: FILL_VERSION, ...fill };
}

/**
 * The column names a Combine expression's `{column name}` placeholders
 * name, trimmed, in order of first use, each once. A blank placeholder
 * names nothing.
 */
function getCombineColumnNames(sql: string): string[] {
  const names = [...sql.matchAll(COMBINE_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN)]
    .map((match) => {
      return (match[1] ?? "").trim();
    })
    .filter((name) => {
      return name !== "";
    });
  return [...new Set(names)];
}

/**
 * Helpers for crosswalk mappings: reading and writing a fill in its
 * versioned stored shape, and the column names a Combine expression uses.
 * Used by the mapping parser, the save RPC's client, and the SQL compiler.
 */
export const CrosswalkMappingModule = {
  COMBINE_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN,
  fillFromDBJson,
  fillToDBJson,
  getCombineColumnNames,
};
```

`shared/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMappingParsers.ts`:

```ts
import { makeParserRegistry } from "@avandar/clients";
import { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import {
  camelCaseKeysDeep,
  excludeNullsExceptInProps,
  nullsToUndefinedDeep,
  snakeCaseKeysDeep,
  undefinedsToNullsDeep,
} from "@avandar/utils";
import { z } from "zod";
import { supabaseJSONSchema as supabaseJsonSchema } from "$/lib/zodHelpers.ts";
import { CrosswalkMappingModule } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMappingModule/CrosswalkMappingModule.ts";
import type { CrosswalkId } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk.types.ts";
import type { CrosswalkColumnId } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn.types.ts";
import type { CrosswalkLayoutId } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout.types.ts";
import type {
  CrosswalkMappingId,
  CrosswalkMappingModel,
} from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping.types.ts";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace.ts";
import type { Expect } from "@avandar/utils";
import type { ZodSchemaEqualsTypes } from "@utils/zod/index.ts";

const DBReadSchema = z.object({
  column_id: z.uuid(),
  confidence: z.number().nullable(),
  created_at: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }),
  crosswalk_id: z.uuid(),
  fill: supabaseJsonSchema,
  id: z.uuid(),
  layout_id: z.uuid(),
  reason: z
    .enum(["name_and_type", "same_values", "similar_layout", "meaning"])
    .nullable(),
  status: z.enum(["suggested", "confirmed"]),
  updated_at: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }),
  workspace_id: z.uuid(),
});

type ReadWithoutFill = Omit<CrosswalkMappingModel["Read"], "fill">;
type DBReadWithoutFill = Omit<CrosswalkMappingModel["DBRead"], "fill">;

function _readRow(row: DBReadWithoutFill): ReadWithoutFill {
  const camelCaseRow = camelCaseKeysDeep(row) as ReadWithoutFill;
  return nullsToUndefinedDeep(camelCaseRow) as ReadWithoutFill;
}

/** Snake-cases a mapping write, keeping the nulls of its nullable columns. */
function _plainPropsToDB(
  row: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  return excludeNullsExceptInProps(["confidence", "reason"])(
    undefinedsToNullsDeep(snakeCaseKeysDeep(row)),
  );
}

/**
 * Parses `public.crosswalks__mappings` rows. The fill stays outside the deep
 * key transforms and goes through its versioned schema, so a malformed fill
 * fails loudly. Writes go through `rpc_crosswalks__save`, so the insert and
 * update transforms exist only to satisfy the CRUD client.
 */
export const CrosswalkMappingParsers =
  makeParserRegistry<CrosswalkMappingModel>().build({
    modelName: "CrosswalkMapping",
    DBReadSchema,
    fromDBReadToModelRead: (dbRow): CrosswalkMappingModel["Read"] => {
      const { fill, ...row } = dbRow;
      const modelRow = _readRow(row);
      return Model.make("CrosswalkMapping", {
        ...modelRow,
        id: modelRow.id as CrosswalkMappingId,
        columnId: modelRow.columnId as CrosswalkColumnId,
        crosswalkId: modelRow.crosswalkId as CrosswalkId,
        layoutId: modelRow.layoutId as CrosswalkLayoutId,
        workspaceId: modelRow.workspaceId as Workspace.Id,
        fill: CrosswalkMappingModule.fillFromDBJson(fill),
      });
    },
    fromModelInsertToDBInsert: (model) => {
      const { fill, ...row } = model;
      return {
        ...(_plainPropsToDB(row) as Omit<
          CrosswalkMappingModel["DBInsert"],
          "fill"
        >),
        fill: CrosswalkMappingModule.fillToDBJson(fill),
      };
    },
    fromModelUpdateToDBUpdate: (model) => {
      const { fill, ...row } = model;
      return {
        ...(_plainPropsToDB(row) as Omit<
          CrosswalkMappingModel["DBUpdate"],
          "fill"
        >),
        ...(fill === undefined
          ? {}
          : { fill: CrosswalkMappingModule.fillToDBJson(fill) }),
      };
    },
  });

/** Keeps the database schema and CRUD row types aligned. */
type CrudTypes = CrosswalkMappingModel;
// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
// @ts-ignore Type tests - this variable is intentionally not used
type ZodConsistencyTests = [
  Expect<
    ZodSchemaEqualsTypes<
      typeof DBReadSchema,
      { input: CrudTypes["DBRead"]; output: CrudTypes["DBRead"] }
    >
  >,
];
```

```ts
}
```

### Task 8: Layouts: keys, signatures, grouping, the reference, similarity

A layout is one set of column names. Two datasets share a layout when their names match after trimming and lowercasing, in any order, so `buildLayoutKey` normalizes, de-duplicates, sorts by code point (never by locale, so every machine agrees), and joins with the unit separator `\u001f`, which no column name contains. `buildSignature` is that key's `fnv1a64Hex` with a version prefix (`l1.`), short enough for the `unique (crosswalk_id, signature)` constraint.

`chooseReferenceLayout` picks the layout whose columns cover the largest share of the other layouts' columns, weighted by how many datasets each has; a column counts as covered when a candidate column has the same normalized name or a `ColumnProfile.getNameScore` of at least `MATCH_SCORE` (0.9). The scores the tests rely on were read by running the scorer: `zip`/`zip_code` 1, `GENDER`/`sex` 1, `CaseNo`/`case_id` 0.5, `onset_dt`/`rash_onset` 0.5, `onset_date`/`rash_onset_date` 0.8. In the worked example a Bronx layout with one dataset and an extra `county` column beats Kings with 23 datasets, because it covers every Kings column and half of Queens' (112 of 132 weighted columns) while Kings covers 24 of 45. Ties go to more datasets, then more columns, then the lower key.

`findMostSimilarLayout` uses plain name overlap (Jaccard on normalized names) rather than the scorer: it only chooses which layout's fills to carry over, and `CrosswalkMatch.carryOverFills` then keeps only the fills whose columns exist.

`shared/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayoutModule/CrosswalkLayoutModule.ts`:

```ts
import { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile.ts";
import { fnv1a64Hex } from "$/utils/fnv1a64Hex/fnv1a64Hex.ts";
import type {
  CrosswalkLayoutDataset,
  CrosswalkLayoutGroup,
  CrosswalkLayoutId,
} from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout.types.ts";

/** Separates column names in a layout key; no column name contains it. */
const KEY_SEPARATOR = "\u001f";

/** The layout key format `buildSignature` hashes. */
const SIGNATURE_PREFIX = "l1.";

/** `findMostSimilarLayout`'s default: half the names in common. */
const DEFAULT_MIN_OVERLAP = 0.5;

/** A locale-free order, so the same names sort the same everywhere. */
function _compareCodePoints(textA: string, textB: string): number {
  if (textA === textB) {
    return 0;
  }
  return textA < textB ? -1 : 1;
}

function _normalizeColumnName(columnName: string): string {
  return columnName.trim().toLowerCase();
}

function _getNormalizedNames(columnNames: readonly string[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(columnNames.map(_normalizeColumnName))];
}

/**
 * The key two datasets share when they have the same columns: the names
 * trimmed, lowercased, each once, sorted, and joined. Column order and case
 * never change it, so `CaseNo` and `caseno ` share one.
 */
function buildLayoutKey(columnNames: readonly string[]): string {
  return _getNormalizedNames(columnNames)
    .sort(_compareCodePoints)
    .join(KEY_SEPARATOR);
}

/** A short, stable hash of a layout's key, unique per crosswalk. */
function buildSignature(columnNames: readonly string[]): string {
  return `${SIGNATURE_PREFIX}${fnv1a64Hex(buildLayoutKey(columnNames))}`;
}

function _compareDatasets(
  datasetA: Readonly<CrosswalkLayoutDataset>,
  datasetB: Readonly<CrosswalkLayoutDataset>,
): number {
  return (
    _compareCodePoints(datasetA.name, datasetB.name) ||
    _compareCodePoints(datasetA.id, datasetB.id)
  );
}

function _getColumnNames(dataset: Readonly<CrosswalkLayoutDataset>): string[] {
  return dataset.columns.map((column) => {
    return column.name;
  });
}

/** A group of datasets sorted by name, named after its first dataset. */
function _toGroup(
  key: string,
  sortedDatasets: readonly CrosswalkLayoutDataset[],
): CrosswalkLayoutGroup {
  const columnNames = sortedDatasets[0]
    ? _getColumnNames(sortedDatasets[0])
    : [];
  return {
    key,
    signature: buildSignature(columnNames),
    columnNames,
    datasetIds: sortedDatasets.map((dataset) => {
      return dataset.id;
    }),
  };
}

/**
 * Groups datasets that share one set of column names, most datasets first,
 * then by the first dataset's name. Each group is named and ordered by its
 * datasets' names.
 */
function groupDatasetsByLayout(
  datasets: readonly CrosswalkLayoutDataset[],
): CrosswalkLayoutGroup[] {
  const datasetsByKey = new Map<string, CrosswalkLayoutDataset[]>();
  datasets.forEach((dataset) => {
    const key = buildLayoutKey(_getColumnNames(dataset));
    datasetsByKey.set(key, [...(datasetsByKey.get(key) ?? []), dataset]);
  });
  return [...datasetsByKey.entries()]
    .map(([key, groupDatasets]) => {
      const sorted = [...groupDatasets].sort(_compareDatasets);
      return { group: _toGroup(key, sorted), firstName: sorted[0]?.name ?? "" };
    })
    .sort((rankA, rankB) => {
      return (
        rankB.group.datasetIds.length - rankA.group.datasetIds.length ||
        _compareCodePoints(rankA.firstName, rankB.firstName) ||
        _compareCodePoints(rankA.group.key, rankB.group.key)
      );
    })
    .map((rank) => {
      return rank.group;
    });
}

function _isCovered(
  columnName: string,
  candidateNames: readonly string[],
): boolean {
  const normalizedName = _normalizeColumnName(columnName);
  return candidateNames.some((candidateName) => {
    return (
      _normalizeColumnName(candidateName) === normalizedName ||
      ColumnProfile.getNameScore(candidateName, columnName) >=
        ColumnProfile.MATCH_SCORE
    );
  });
}

/**
 * How many of the other layouts' columns a candidate layout's columns
 * cover, each weighted by how many datasets have it. A column is covered
 * when a candidate column has the same name, ignoring case, or a name
 * score of at least `ColumnProfile.MATCH_SCORE`, so `zip` covers `zip_code`.
 */
function getCoverage(
  options: Readonly<{
    candidate: readonly string[];
    others: ReadonlyArray<{
      columnNames: readonly string[];
      datasetCount: number;
    }>;
  }>,
): { matchedCount: number; totalCount: number } {
  return options.others.reduce(
    (counts, other) => {
      const matchedNames = other.columnNames.filter((columnName) => {
        return _isCovered(columnName, options.candidate);
      });
      return {
        matchedCount:
          counts.matchedCount + matchedNames.length * other.datasetCount,
        totalCount:
          counts.totalCount + other.columnNames.length * other.datasetCount,
      };
    },
    { matchedCount: 0, totalCount: 0 },
  );
}

function _getCoverageShare(
  group: Readonly<CrosswalkLayoutGroup>,
  groups: readonly CrosswalkLayoutGroup[],
): number {
  const { matchedCount, totalCount } = getCoverage({
    candidate: group.columnNames,
    others: groups
      .filter((other) => {
        return other.key !== group.key;
      })
      .map((other) => {
        return {
          columnNames: other.columnNames,
          datasetCount: other.datasetIds.length,
        };
      }),
  });
  return totalCount === 0 ? 1 : matchedCount / totalCount;
}

/**
 * The key of the layout that makes the best reference: the one covering
 * the largest share of the other layouts' columns, then the one with the
 * most datasets, then the most columns, then the lowest key. Undefined when
 * there are no layouts.
 */
function chooseReferenceLayout(
  groups: readonly CrosswalkLayoutGroup[],
): string | undefined {
  const ranked = groups
    .map((group) => {
      return { group, share: _getCoverageShare(group, groups) };
    })
    .sort((rankA, rankB) => {
      return (
        rankB.share - rankA.share ||
        rankB.group.datasetIds.length - rankA.group.datasetIds.length ||
        rankB.group.columnNames.length - rankA.group.columnNames.length ||
        _compareCodePoints(rankA.group.key, rankB.group.key)
      );
    });
  return ranked[0]?.group.key;
}

/**
 * How alike two layouts' column names are, from 0 to 1: the names they
 * share, ignoring case, over the names either has.
 */
function getNameOverlap(
  namesA: readonly string[],
  namesB: readonly string[],
): number {
  const setA = new Set(_getNormalizedNames(namesA));
  const setB = new Set(_getNormalizedNames(namesB));
  const sharedCount = [...setA].filter((name) => {
    return setB.has(name);
  }).length;
  const unionCount = setA.size + setB.size - sharedCount;
  return unionCount === 0 ? 0 : sharedCount / unionCount;
}

/**
 * The candidate layout whose column names overlap these the most, at
 * least `minOverlap` (half by default). The first candidate wins a tie.
 * Undefined when none overlaps enough.
 */
function findMostSimilarLayout(
  options: Readonly<{
    columnNames: readonly string[];
    candidates: ReadonlyArray<{
      id: CrosswalkLayoutId;
      columnNames: readonly string[];
    }>;
    minOverlap?: number;
  }>,
): CrosswalkLayoutId | undefined {
  const minOverlap = options.minOverlap ?? DEFAULT_MIN_OVERLAP;
  const best = options.candidates.reduce<
    { id: CrosswalkLayoutId; overlap: number } | undefined
  >((current, candidate) => {
    const overlap = getNameOverlap(options.columnNames, candidate.columnNames);
    return overlap >= minOverlap && overlap > (current?.overlap ?? -1)
      ? { id: candidate.id, overlap }
      : current;
  }, undefined);
  return best?.id;
}

/** Whether a dataset's current columns no longer match its layout's key. */
function hasColumnsChanged(
  options: Readonly<{
    layoutKey: string;
    currentColumnNames: readonly string[];
  }>,
): boolean {
  return buildLayoutKey(options.currentColumnNames) !== options.layoutKey;
}

/**
 * The status a layout that is neither mapped nor skipped takes after its
 * fills change: `review` once every column has a fill, `to_do` before then
 * and while there are no columns.
 */
function getStatusAfterFill(
  options: Readonly<{
    columnIds: readonly string[];
    filledColumnIds: ReadonlySet<string>;
  }>,
): "to_do" | "review" {
  const isEveryColumnFilled =
    options.columnIds.length > 0 &&
    options.columnIds.every((columnId) => {
      return options.filledColumnIds.has(columnId);
    });
  return isEveryColumnFilled ? "review" : "to_do";
}

/**
 * Pure helpers for a crosswalk's layouts: the key and signature datasets
 * with the same columns share, grouping datasets into layouts, choosing the
 * reference layout, and finding the layout a new one is most like. Used by
 * the crosswalk view's reducer and by the combined dataset's compiler.
 */
export const CrosswalkLayoutModule = {
  buildLayoutKey,
  buildSignature,
  groupDatasetsByLayout,
  getCoverage,
  chooseReferenceLayout,
  getNameOverlap,
  findMostSimilarLayout,
  hasColumnsChanged,
  getStatusAfterFill,
};
```

### Task 9: Matching a layout onto the reference

`CrosswalkMatch` scores a layout's columns (the sources) against the combined dataset's columns (the targets, profiled from the reference dataset, or name-and-type profiles for added columns) with slice 2's `ColumnProfile.getMatchScore`, keeps the match and suggestion bands, and pairs them one to one, best score first, ties by target order and then source order. A match is `same_values` when the values agree (value score 0.9 or more) and the names do not (name score under `SUGGESTION_SCORE`), otherwise `name_and_type`. Every score the tests pin was read by running the scorer on the fixtures, not guessed:

| Target | Source | Name | Type | Values | Score | Band, reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` (text) | `CaseNo` (text) | 0.5 | 1 | none | 0.654 | suggestion, name and type |
| `sex` 1/2 (bigint) | `pt_sex_cd` 1/2 (bigint) | 0.5 | 1 | 1 | 0.775 | suggestion, same values |
| `rash_onset_date` (date) | `onset_dt` (text) | 0.8 | 0.5 | none | 0.708 | suggestion, name and type |
| `zip` 00501/10451 (text) | `zip` 501/10451 (bigint) | 1 | 0.5 | 1 | 0.9 | match, name and type |
| `GENDER` 1/2 | `sex_cd` 1/2 | 0.667 | 1 | 1 | 0.85 | suggestion, name and type |

The `zip` values agree because `ColumnProfile.getComparisonKey` drops a numeric code's leading zeros, so `00501` and `501` compare equal; `suggestConvert` then pads the source to five digits. `GENDER`/`sex_cd` is a name match (0.667 is over 0.6), so the value-only case uses `pt_sex_cd`.

`DictionaryMatch` gains `getBestCodeList`, its private `_getBestCoverage` without the name score: the list and direction covering the most rows, the primary list first on a tie and codes before labels, and the primary list holding codes when the values were not compared (every coverage is undefined, so the first candidate wins). `chooseCodeList` turns that into a fill's `codeListId` and `holdsLabels`.

`prefillLayout` puts it together: fills carried over from a similar layout first, as suggestions with reason `similar_layout`; then the scorer fills the rest from the source columns no carried `column` fill uses, a match confirmed and a suggestion not, with the score as the confidence. A governed column's fill translates codes; any other gets `suggestConvert`.

```ts
function _profile(
  columnName: string,
  dataType: ColumnProfile.T["dataType"],
  values?: ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, number]>,
): ColumnProfile.T {
  const listed = values?.map(([value, rowCount]) => {
    return { value, rowCount };
  });
  const rowCount = listed
    ? listed.reduce((sum, item) => {
        return sum + item.rowCount;
      }, 0)
    : 100;
  return {
    datasetId: "dataset-kings" as Dataset.Id,
    datasetName: "Kings 2026-03",
    columnName,
    dataType,
    rowCount,
    nonNullCount: rowCount,
    distinctCount: listed?.length ?? 100,
    values: listed,
    dateShare: undefined,
    numberRange: undefined,
  };
}

function _pairs(
  pairs: ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, string]>,
): DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair[] {
  return pairs.map(([code, label]) => {
    return { code, label, acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false };
  });
}
```

```ts
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn.ts";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping.ts";
import type { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile.ts";

/**
 * A column of the combined dataset that a layout's columns are matched
 * against.
 */
export type CrosswalkMatchTarget = {
  columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
  /**
   * From the reference dataset, or a name-and-type profile for an added
   * column.
   */
  profile: ColumnProfile.T;
};

/** One source column the scorer would fill a target with. */
export type CrosswalkMatchT = {
  columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
  sourceColumn: string;
  score: number;
  band: "match" | "suggestion";
  reason: "name_and_type" | "same_values";
};

/** A fill the layout starts with, and how sure the match was. */
export type CrosswalkPrefill = {
  columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
  fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill;
  status: CrosswalkMapping.Status;
  confidence: number | undefined;
  reason: CrosswalkMapping.Reason | undefined;
};
```

`shared/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatchModule/CrosswalkMatchModule.ts`:

```ts
import { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping.ts";
import { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile.ts";
import { DictionaryMatch } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryMatch/DictionaryMatch.ts";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn.ts";
import type {
  CrosswalkMatchT,
  CrosswalkMatchTarget,
  CrosswalkPrefill,
} from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatch.types.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry.ts";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType.ts";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset.ts";

/** A value share at or above this, with unlike names, is a value match. */
const SAME_VALUES_SCORE = 0.9;

const DIGITS_PATTERN = /^[0-9]+$/;

type CarriedFill = {
  columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
  fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill;
};

/** A column of the combined dataset, as prefilling reads it. */
type PrefillColumn = {
  id: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
  entryId: DataDictionaryEntry.Id | undefined;
  dataType: AvaDataType.T;
};

type Candidate = CrosswalkMatchT & { targetIndex: number; sourceIndex: number };

/**
 * Profiles that hold only a dataset's column names and types, with no
 * values, for a dataset that has not been read yet. The scorer rescales to
 * name and type when values are missing.
 */
function toNameAndTypeProfiles(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;
    datasetName: string;
    columns: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; dataType: AvaDataType.T }>;
  }>,
): ColumnProfile.T[] {
  return options.columns.map((column) => {
    return {
      datasetId: options.datasetId,
      datasetName: options.datasetName,
      columnName: column.name,
      dataType: column.dataType,
      rowCount: 0,
      nonNullCount: 0,
      distinctCount: 0,
      values: undefined,
      dateShare: undefined,
      numberRange: undefined,
    };
  });
}

function _toCandidate(
  target: Readonly<CrosswalkMatchTarget>,
  source: Readonly<ColumnProfile.T>,
  indexes: { targetIndex: number; sourceIndex: number },
): Candidate | undefined {
  const matchScore = ColumnProfile.getMatchScore(target.profile, source);
  if (matchScore.band === "none") {
    return undefined;
  }
  const isValueMatch =
    (matchScore.valueScore ?? 0) >= SAME_VALUES_SCORE &&
    matchScore.nameScore < ColumnProfile.SUGGESTION_SCORE;
  return {
    columnId: target.columnId,
    sourceColumn: source.columnName,
    score: matchScore.score,
    band: matchScore.band,
    reason: isValueMatch ? "same_values" : "name_and_type",
    ...indexes,
  };
}

/**
 * The source column each target is filled with, one to one: every pair in
 * the match or suggestion band, best score first, ties by target order and
 * then source order. Returned in target order. Used to prefill a layout
 * from the scorer.
 */
function matchLayoutColumns(
  options: Readonly<{
    targets: readonly CrosswalkMatchTarget[];
    sources: readonly ColumnProfile.T[];
  }>,
): CrosswalkMatchT[] {
  const candidates = options.targets
    .flatMap((target, targetIndex) => {
      return options.sources.flatMap((source, sourceIndex) => {
        const candidate = _toCandidate(target, source, {
          targetIndex,
          sourceIndex,
        });
        return candidate ? [candidate] : [];
      });
    })
    .sort((candidateA, candidateB) => {
      return (
        candidateB.score - candidateA.score ||
        candidateA.targetIndex - candidateB.targetIndex ||
        candidateA.sourceIndex - candidateB.sourceIndex
      );
    });
  const chosen = candidates.reduce<Candidate[]>((picked, candidate) => {
    const isTaken = picked.some((pick) => {
      return (
        pick.targetIndex === candidate.targetIndex ||
        pick.sourceIndex === candidate.sourceIndex
      );
    });
    return isTaken ? picked : [...picked, candidate];
  }, []);
  return chosen
    .sort((pickA, pickB) => {
      return pickA.targetIndex - pickB.targetIndex;
    })
    .map(
      ({ targetIndex: _targetIndex, sourceIndex: _sourceIndex, ...match }) => {
        return match;
      },
    );
}

function _findColumnName(
  name: string,
  columnNames: readonly string[],
): string | undefined {
  const key = name.trim().toLowerCase();
  return columnNames.find((columnName) => {
    return columnName.trim().toLowerCase() === key;
  });
}

function _carryOverFill(
  fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill,
  columnNames: readonly string[],
): CrosswalkMapping.Fill | undefined {
  if (fill.kind === "column") {
    const sourceColumn = _findColumnName(fill.sourceColumn, columnNames);
    return sourceColumn === undefined ? undefined : { ...fill, sourceColumn };
  }
  if (fill.kind === "expression") {
    const hasEveryColumn = CrosswalkMapping.getCombineColumnNames(
      fill.sql,
    ).every((name) => {
      return _findColumnName(name, columnNames) !== undefined;
    });
    return hasEveryColumn ? fill : undefined;
  }
  return fill;
}

/**
 * The fills of a similar layout that still work for a layout with these
 * column names: a column fill whose source column exists here, ignoring
 * case and renamed to this layout's spelling; every constant and empty; and
 * a Combine expression whose placeholders all exist here.
 */
function carryOverFills(
  options: Readonly<{
    fills: readonly CarriedFill[];
    columnNames: readonly string[];
  }>,
): CarriedFill[] {
  return options.fills.flatMap((item) => {
    const fill = _carryOverFill(item.fill, options.columnNames);
    return fill === undefined ? [] : [{ columnId: item.columnId, fill }];
  });
}

/**
 * The code list a governed column should translate with, and whether its
 * source holds the list's labels: the entry's list covering the most of
 * the profiled values, or its primary list holding codes when the values
 * were not compared. Undefined when the entry has no code list.
 */
function chooseCodeList(
  options: Readonly<{
    profile: ColumnProfile.T;
    entry: DictionaryMatch.Entry;
  }>,
):
  | {
      codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeList.Id;
      holdsLabels: boolean;
      coverage: number | undefined;
    }
  | undefined {
  const best = DictionaryMatch.getBestCodeList(options.profile, options.entry);
  return best === undefined
    ? undefined
    : {
        codeListId: best.codeListId,
        holdsLabels: best.direction === "encode",
        coverage: best.coverage,
      };
}

/** The one length every listed value has when every one is digits. */
function _getDigitLength(
  profile: Readonly<ColumnProfile.T>,
): number | undefined {
  const values = (profile.values ?? []).map((item) => {
    return item.value.trim();
  });
  const lengths = new Set(
    values.map((value) => {
      return value.length;
    }),
  );
  const isAllDigits = values.every((value) => {
    return DIGITS_PATTERN.test(value);
  });
  return values.length > 0 && isAllDigits && lengths.size === 1
    ? [...lengths][0]
    : undefined;
}

function _needsPadding(
  source: Readonly<ColumnProfile.T>,
  length: number,
): boolean {
  const values = (source.values ?? []).map((item) => {
    return item.value.trim();
  });
  return (
    (source.dataType === "bigint" || source.dataType === "varchar") &&
    values.length > 0 &&
    values.every((value) => {
      return DIGITS_PATTERN.test(value) && value.length <= length;
    }) &&
    values.some((value) => {
      return value.length < length;
    })
  );
}

/**
 * The conversion a source column likely needs to fill a target: read as a
 * date when the target is a date and the source is text in a detected
 * format, or padded with zeros when every target value is a digit string of
 * one length and some source values are shorter, such as ZIP `501` against
 * `00501`. Undefined when neither applies.
 */
function suggestConvert(
  options: Readonly<{
    source: ColumnProfile.T;
    target: ColumnProfile.T;
    targetDataType: AvaDataType.T;
    dateFormat: string | undefined;
  }>,
): CrosswalkMapping.Convert | undefined {
  const isDateTarget =
    options.targetDataType === "date" || options.targetDataType === "timestamp";
  if (
    isDateTarget &&
    options.source.dataType === "varchar" &&
    options.dateFormat !== undefined
  ) {
    return { kind: "parse_date", format: options.dateFormat };
  }
  const length = _getDigitLength(options.target);
  return length !== undefined && _needsPadding(options.source, length)
    ? { kind: "pad_text", length }
    : undefined;
}

function _toMatchedFill(
  options: Readonly<{
    column: PrefillColumn;
    source: ColumnProfile.T;
    target: ColumnProfile.T;
    entriesById: ReadonlyMap<string, DictionaryMatch.Entry>;
    dateFormat: string | undefined;
  }>,
): CrosswalkMapping.Fill {
  const { column, source } = options;
  const entry =
    column.entryId === undefined
      ? undefined
      : options.entriesById.get(column.entryId);
  if (entry !== undefined) {
    const codeList = chooseCodeList({ profile: source, entry });
    return {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: source.columnName,
      convert: undefined,
      codeListId: codeList?.codeListId,
      holdsLabels: codeList?.holdsLabels ?? false,
    };
  }
  return {
    kind: "column",
    sourceColumn: source.columnName,
    convert: suggestConvert({
      source,
      target: options.target,
      targetDataType: column.dataType,
      dateFormat: options.dateFormat,
    }),
    codeListId: undefined,
    holdsLabels: false,
  };
}

function _toCarriedPrefill(item: CarriedFill): CrosswalkPrefill {
  return {
    columnId: item.columnId,
    fill: item.fill,
    status: "suggested",
    confidence: undefined,
    reason: "similar_layout",
  };
}

function _getSourceKeysUsedBy(fills: readonly CarriedFill[]): Set<string> {
  return new Set(
    fills.flatMap((item) => {
      return item.fill.kind === "column"
        ? [item.fill.sourceColumn.trim().toLowerCase()]
        : [];
    }),
  );
}

type PrefillOptions = Readonly<{
  columns: readonly PrefillColumn[];
  targets: readonly CrosswalkMatchTarget[];
  sources: readonly ColumnProfile.T[];
  carriedOver?: readonly CarriedFill[];
  entriesById: ReadonlyMap<string, DictionaryMatch.Entry>;
  dateFormatsBySourceColumn?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
}>;

function _toMatchPrefill(
  match: CrosswalkMatchT,
  options: PrefillOptions,
  pool: Readonly<{
    targets: readonly CrosswalkMatchTarget[];
    sources: readonly ColumnProfile.T[];
  }>,
): CrosswalkPrefill | undefined {
  const column = options.columns.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === match.columnId;
  });
  const source = pool.sources.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.columnName === match.sourceColumn;
  });
  const target = pool.targets.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.columnId === match.columnId;
  });
  if (!column || !source || !target) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const fill = _toMatchedFill({
    column,
    source,
    target: target.profile,
    entriesById: options.entriesById,
    dateFormat: options.dateFormatsBySourceColumn?.get(source.columnName),
  });
  return {
    columnId: column.id,
    fill,
    status: match.band === "match" ? "confirmed" : "suggested",
    confidence: match.score,
    reason: match.reason,
  };
}

/** The scorer's fills for the columns and sources no carried fill took. */
function _getMatchPrefills(
  options: PrefillOptions,
  carried: readonly CarriedFill[],
): CrosswalkPrefill[] {
  const carriedIds = new Set(
    carried.map((item) => {
      return item.columnId;
    }),
  );
  const usedSourceKeys = _getSourceKeysUsedBy(carried);
  const pool = {
    targets: options.targets.filter((target) => {
      return !carriedIds.has(target.columnId);
    }),
    sources: options.sources.filter((source) => {
      return !usedSourceKeys.has(source.columnName.trim().toLowerCase());
    }),
  };
  return matchLayoutColumns(pool).flatMap((match) => {
    const prefill = _toMatchPrefill(match, options, pool);
    return prefill ? [prefill] : [];
  });
}

/**
 * The fills a layout starts with, in column order. Fills carried over from
 * a similar layout come first, as suggestions. The scorer then fills the
 * rest from the source columns no carried fill uses: a match is confirmed,
 * a suggestion is not, and the score is the confidence. A governed
 * column's fill translates codes with `chooseCodeList`; any other column's
 * gets `suggestConvert`.
 */
function prefillLayout(options: PrefillOptions): CrosswalkPrefill[] {
  const columnIds = new Set(
    options.columns.map((column) => {
      return column.id;
    }),
  );
  const carried = (options.carriedOver ?? []).filter((item) => {
    return columnIds.has(item.columnId);
  });
  const prefillsByColumnId = new Map<string, CrosswalkPrefill>(
    [
      ...carried.map(_toCarriedPrefill),
      ..._getMatchPrefills(options, carried),
    ].map((prefill) => {
      return [prefill.columnId, prefill] as const;
    }),
  );
  return options.columns.flatMap((column) => {
    const prefill = prefillsByColumnId.get(column.id);
    return prefill ? [prefill] : [];
  });
}

/**
 * Pure helpers for mapping a layout onto a crosswalk's columns: scoring its
 * columns against the combined dataset's, carrying fills over from a
 * similar layout, choosing a governed column's code list, and spotting a
 * conversion a column needs. Used by the crosswalk view's reducer, on the
 * device, so it works offline.
 */
export const CrosswalkMatchModule = {
  toNameAndTypeProfiles,
  matchLayoutColumns,
  carryOverFills,
  chooseCodeList,
  suggestConvert,
  prefillLayout,
};
```

```ts
} from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatch.types.ts";

export { CrosswalkMatchModule as CrosswalkMatch } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatchModule/CrosswalkMatchModule.ts";

/** Public namespace for matching a layout's columns onto a crosswalk's. */
export namespace CrosswalkMatch {
  /** One source column a target would be filled with. */
  export type T = CrosswalkMatchT;
```

### Task 10: Compiling the combined SQL

`CrosswalkSql` turns a crosswalk into the combined dataset's SQL. It builds text only and runs nothing; Task 11 runs it on DuckDB. Each layout becomes one `SELECT` whose every output is aliased (an unaliased expression in `UNION ALL BY NAME` becomes a column of its own); its datasets share their column names ignoring case, so they stack first with `SELECT *` under each dataset's name, as `__ava_source_dataset`, and the layouts then stack with `UNION ALL BY NAME`. Every fill is cast to its column's type with `TRY_CAST`, so a bad value becomes empty instead of failing the whole query, and a column a layout does not fill is a typed `NULL`. Every literal goes through `quoteSqlLiteral` and every identifier through `quoteSqlIdentifier`; a Combine placeholder is replaced with a function, never a replacement string, so a name holding `$&` stays data.

Code translation reuses slice 4's `ColumnConversion.toCaseSql`, whose hostile-label tests already pass. `toTranslation` builds the `ColumnConversion.T` whose pairs map each pair of the fill's list to its counterpart in the entry's primary list, so two codings of one entry come out alike: the primary list's label in labels mode, its code in codes mode. In codes mode a pair with no counterpart becomes an `empty` override, so a code of another list never passes through as if it were a primary code; in labels mode it keeps its own label. The translation's output stays text and `toFillSql` casts it, so a codes-mode column with whole-number primary codes comes out `BIGINT`. `compile` reports every list it embedded, the primary list included when a second coding is reconciled to it, and `getCodeListFingerprint` hashes each list's pairs as an array of `[code, label, acceptedSpellings, isMissing]`, so the fingerprint ignores object key order and changes with any label.

`toExpressionSql` is exported so `validateCombineExpression` (Task 12) checks exactly the SQL `compile` runs.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { CrosswalkSql } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkSql/CrosswalkSql.ts";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn.ts";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout.ts";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry.ts";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset.ts";

function _pair(
  code: string,
  label: string,
  acceptedSpellings: string[] = [],
): DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair {
  return { code, label, acceptedSpellings, isMissing: false };
}

const SEX_129 = [
  _pair("1", "Male"),
  _pair("2", "Female"),
  _pair("9", "Unknown"),
];
const SEX_MFU = [
  _pair("M", "male", ["man"]),
  _pair("F", "Female"),
  _pair("X", "Other"),
];

const LIST_129 = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
const LIST_MFU = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";
const ENTRY_SEX =
  "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333" as DataDictionaryEntry.Id;

const CODE_LISTS: CrosswalkSql.CodeLists = {
  codeListsById: new Map([
    [LIST_129, { pairs: SEX_129 }],
    [LIST_MFU, { pairs: SEX_MFU }],
  ]),
  primaryCodeListIdByEntryId: new Map([[ENTRY_SEX as string, LIST_129]]),
};

function _column(
  name: string,
  dataType: CrosswalkSql.Column["dataType"],
  entryId?: DataDictionaryEntry.Id,
): CrosswalkSql.Column {
  return { id: `col-${name}` as CrosswalkColumn.Id, name, dataType, entryId };
}

function _columnFill(
  sourceColumn: string,
  changes: Partial<Extract<CrosswalkMapping.Fill, { kind: "column" }>> = {},
): CrosswalkMapping.Fill {
  return {
    kind: "column",
    sourceColumn,
    convert: undefined,
    codeListId: undefined,
    holdsLabels: false,
    ...changes,
  };
}

function _fillSql(
  fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill | undefined,
  column: CrosswalkSql.Column,
  codesOutputAs: "labels" | "codes" = "labels",
): string {
  return CrosswalkSql.toFillSql({ ...CODE_LISTS, fill, column, codesOutputAs });
}

describe("CrosswalkSql.toFillSql", () => {
  it("is a typed NULL for a column with no fill or an empty fill", () => {
    expect(_fillSql(undefined, _column("outbreak", "boolean"))).toBe(
      "CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN)",
    );
    expect(_fillSql({ kind: "empty" }, _column("age", "double"))).toBe(
      "CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)",
    );
  });

  it("casts a text column plainly and any other with TRY_CAST", () => {
    expect(_fillSql(_columnFill("CaseNo"), _column("case_id", "varchar"))).toBe(
      'CAST("CaseNo" AS VARCHAR)',
    );
    expect(_fillSql(_columnFill("age"), _column("age", "bigint"))).toBe(
      'TRY_CAST("age" AS BIGINT)',
    );
  });

  it("reads a date with TRY_STRPTIME", () => {
    const fill = _columnFill("onset_dt", {
      convert: { kind: "parse_date", format: "%m/%d/%Y" },
    });

    expect(_fillSql(fill, _column("rash_onset_date", "date"))).toBe(
      `TRY_CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(CAST("onset_dt" AS VARCHAR), '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE)`,
    );
  });

  it("pads only a shorter digit string, never truncating", () => {
    const fill = _columnFill("zip", {
      convert: { kind: "pad_text", length: 5 },
    });

    expect(_fillSql(fill, _column("zip", "varchar"))).toBe(
      `TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(CAST("zip" AS VARCHAR)), '[0-9]+') AND length(trim(CAST("zip" AS VARCHAR))) < 5 THEN lpad(trim(CAST("zip" AS VARCHAR)), 5, '0') ELSE trim(CAST("zip" AS VARCHAR)) END AS VARCHAR)`,
    );
  });

  it("multiplies by the factor as JavaScript writes it", () => {
    const fill = _columnFill("age_mo", {
      convert: { kind: "multiply", factor: 1 / 12 },
    });

    expect(_fillSql(fill, _column("age_years", "double"))).toBe(
      `TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST("age_mo" AS DOUBLE) * 0.08333333333333333 AS DOUBLE)`,
    );
  });

  it("refuses a factor that is not finite", () => {
    const fill = _columnFill("age_mo", {
      convert: { kind: "multiply", factor: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY },
    });

    expect(() => {
      return _fillSql(fill, _column("age_years", "double"));
    }).toThrow("finite");
  });

  it("trims, squashes spaces, and fixes the case", () => {
    const upper = _columnFill("name", {
      convert: { kind: "trim_and_fix_case", letterCase: "upper" },
    });
    const keep = _columnFill("name", {
      convert: { kind: "trim_and_fix_case", letterCase: "keep" },
    });

    expect(_fillSql(upper, _column("name", "varchar"))).toBe(
      `TRY_CAST(upper(regexp_replace(trim(CAST("name" AS VARCHAR)), '\\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS VARCHAR)`,
    );
    expect(_fillSql(keep, _column("name", "varchar"))).toBe(
      `TRY_CAST(regexp_replace(trim(CAST("name" AS VARCHAR)), '\\s+', ' ', 'g') AS VARCHAR)`,
    );
  });

  it("decodes through the code list", () => {
    const fill = _columnFill("GENDER", {
      codeListId: LIST_129 as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id,
    });

    expect(_fillSql(fill, _column("sex", "varchar", ENTRY_SEX))).toBe(
      `TRY_CAST(CASE lower(trim(CAST("GENDER" AS VARCHAR))) WHEN lower(trim('1')) THEN 'Male' WHEN lower(trim('2')) THEN 'Female' WHEN lower(trim('9')) THEN 'Unknown' ELSE CAST("GENDER" AS VARCHAR) END AS VARCHAR)`,
    );
  });

  it("leaves the values unconverted when the code list is gone", () => {
    const fill = _columnFill("GENDER", {
      codeListId:
        "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999" as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id,
    });

    expect(_fillSql(fill, _column("sex", "varchar", ENTRY_SEX))).toBe(
      'CAST("GENDER" AS VARCHAR)',
    );
  });

  it("writes a fixed value as a literal, cast unless text", () => {
    expect(
      _fillSql(
        { kind: "constant", value: "O'Brien" },
        _column("county", "varchar"),
      ),
    ).toBe(`'O''Brien'`);
    expect(
      _fillSql({ kind: "constant", value: "2026" }, _column("year", "bigint")),
    ).toBe(`TRY_CAST('2026' AS BIGINT)`);
  });

  it("quotes each Combine placeholder as an identifier, even one with a space or $&", () => {
    const fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill = {
      kind: "expression",
      sql: "concat({Case No}, '-', { $& })",
    };

    expect(_fillSql(fill, _column("case_id", "varchar"))).toBe(
      `TRY_CAST((concat("Case No", '-', "$&")) AS VARCHAR)`,
    );
  });
});

describe("CrosswalkSql.getTranslationOutputs", () => {
  it("outputs each pair's own label when the list is the primary one", () => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkSql.getTranslationOutputs({
        pairs: SEX_129,
        primaryPairs: SEX_129,
        codesOutputAs: "labels",
      }).map(({ output }) => {
        return output;
      }),
    ).toEqual(["Male", "Female", "Unknown"]);
  });

  it("outputs the primary list's labels for a second coding, by label or accepted spelling", () => {
    const outputs = CrosswalkSql.getTranslationOutputs({
      pairs: [_pair("M", " MALE "), _pair("F", "fem"), _pair("X", "Other")],
      primaryPairs: [_pair("1", "Male"), _pair("2", "Female", ["fem"])],
      codesOutputAs: "labels",
    });

    expect(
      outputs.map(({ output }) => {
        return output;
      }),
    ).toEqual(["Male", "Female", "Other"]);
  });

  it("outputs the primary list's codes in codes mode, and nothing for a pair with no counterpart", () => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkSql.getTranslationOutputs({
        pairs: SEX_MFU,
        primaryPairs: SEX_129,
        codesOutputAs: "codes",
      }).map(({ output }) => {
        return output;
      }),
    ).toEqual(["1", "2", undefined]);
  });
});

describe("CrosswalkSql.toTranslation", () => {
  it("decodes a second coding to the primary list's labels", () => {
    const conversion = CrosswalkSql.toTranslation({
      pairs: SEX_MFU,
      primaryPairs: SEX_129,
      holdsLabels: false,
      codesOutputAs: "labels",
    });

    expect(conversion.direction).toBe("decode");
    expect(
      conversion.pairs.map((pair) => {
        return [pair.code, pair.label];
      }),
    ).toEqual([
      ["M", "Male"],
      ["F", "Female"],
      ["X", "Other"],
    ]);
    expect(conversion.overrides).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("empties a code with no counterpart in codes mode rather than passing it through", () => {
    const conversion = CrosswalkSql.toTranslation({
      pairs: SEX_MFU,
      primaryPairs: SEX_129,
      holdsLabels: false,
      codesOutputAs: "codes",
    });

    expect(
      conversion.pairs.map((pair) => {
        return [pair.code, pair.label];
      }),
    ).toEqual([
      ["M", "1"],
      ["F", "2"],
    ]);
    expect(conversion.overrides).toEqual([{ value: "X", action: "empty" }]);
  });

  it("encodes labels and accepted spellings to the primary codes, emptying every spelling with no counterpart", () => {
    const conversion = CrosswalkSql.toTranslation({
      pairs: SEX_MFU,
      primaryPairs: SEX_129,
      holdsLabels: true,
      codesOutputAs: "codes",
    });

    expect(conversion.direction).toBe("encode");
    expect(
      conversion.pairs.map((pair) => {
        return [pair.code, pair.label, pair.acceptedSpellings];
      }),
    ).toEqual([
      ["1", "male", ["man"]],
      ["2", "Female", []],
    ]);
    expect(conversion.overrides).toEqual([{ value: "Other", action: "empty" }]);
  });

  it("lets a code whose label is blank pass through in labels mode", () => {
    const conversion = CrosswalkSql.toTranslation({
      pairs: [_pair("1", "Male"), _pair("5", " ")],
      primaryPairs: [_pair("1", "Male"), _pair("5", " ")],
      holdsLabels: false,
      codesOutputAs: "labels",
    });

    expect(
      conversion.pairs.map((pair) => {
        return pair.code;
      }),
    ).toEqual(["1"]);
    expect(conversion.overrides).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("CrosswalkSql.getGovernedDataType", () => {
  it("is text in labels mode", () => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkSql.getGovernedDataType({
        codesOutputAs: "labels",
        primaryPairs: SEX_129,
      }),
    ).toBe("varchar");
  });

  it("is a whole number in codes mode when every primary code is one", () => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkSql.getGovernedDataType({
        codesOutputAs: "codes",
        primaryPairs: SEX_129,
      }),
    ).toBe("bigint");
    expect(
      CrosswalkSql.getGovernedDataType({
        codesOutputAs: "codes",
        primaryPairs: SEX_MFU,
      }),
    ).toBe("varchar");
  });
});

describe("CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint", () => {
  it("is stable across calls", () => {
    expect(CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint(SEX_129)).toBe(
      CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint(
        SEX_129.map((pair) => {
          return { ...pair };
        }),
      ),
    );
    expect(CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint(SEX_129)).toMatch(
      /^p1\.[0-9a-f]{16}$/,
    );
  });

  it("changes when a label changes", () => {
    expect(
      CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint([
        _pair("1", "Man"),
        ...SEX_129.slice(1),
      ]),
    ).not.toBe(CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint(SEX_129));
  });

  it("ignores the order of a pair's keys", () => {
    const reordered = SEX_129.map((pair) => {
      return {
        isMissing: pair.isMissing,
        acceptedSpellings: pair.acceptedSpellings,
        label: pair.label,
        code: pair.code,
      };
    });

    expect(CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint(reordered)).toBe(
      CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint(SEX_129),
    );
  });
});

describe("CrosswalkSql.compile", () => {
  const CASE_ID = _column("case_id", "varchar");
  const SEX = _column("sex", "varchar", ENTRY_SEX);
  const KINGS: CrosswalkSql.Layout = {
    layoutId: "layout-kings" as CrosswalkLayout.Id,
    datasets: [
      { id: "dataset-k1" as Dataset.Id, name: "Kings 2026-03" },
      { id: "dataset-k2" as Dataset.Id, name: "Kings O'Brien" },
    ],
    fillsByColumnId: new Map([
      [CASE_ID.id as string, _columnFill("CaseNo")],
      [
        SEX.id as string,
        _columnFill("GENDER", {
          codeListId: LIST_129 as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id,
        }),
      ],
    ]),
  };
  const QUEENS: CrosswalkSql.Layout = {
    layoutId: "layout-queens" as CrosswalkLayout.Id,
    datasets: [{ id: "dataset-q1" as Dataset.Id, name: "Queens 2026-03" }],
    fillsByColumnId: new Map([[CASE_ID.id as string, _columnFill("case_id")]]),
  };

  function _compile(
    changes: Partial<CrosswalkSql.Input> = {},
  ): CrosswalkSql.Output {
    return CrosswalkSql.compile({
      ...CODE_LISTS,
      codesOutputAs: "labels",
      sourceColumnName: "source_dataset",
      columns: [CASE_ID, SEX],
      layouts: [KINGS, QUEENS],
      ...changes,
    });
  }

  it("stacks each layout's datasets under their names, then the layouts, every output aliased", () => {
    expect(_compile({ columns: [CASE_ID] }).sql).toBe(
      [
        `SELECT CAST("__ava_source_dataset" AS VARCHAR) AS "source_dataset",`,
        `  CAST("CaseNo" AS VARCHAR) AS "case_id"`,
        `FROM (`,
        `  SELECT 'Kings 2026-03' AS "__ava_source_dataset", * FROM "dataset-k1"`,
        `  UNION ALL BY NAME`,
        `  SELECT 'Kings O''Brien' AS "__ava_source_dataset", * FROM "dataset-k2"`,
        `)`,
        `UNION ALL BY NAME`,
        `SELECT CAST("__ava_source_dataset" AS VARCHAR) AS "source_dataset",`,
        `  CAST("case_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "case_id"`,
        `FROM (`,
        `  SELECT 'Queens 2026-03' AS "__ava_source_dataset", * FROM "dataset-q1"`,
        `)`,
      ].join("\n"),
    );
  });

  it("leaves out the dataset names without a source column", () => {
    const output = _compile({
      columns: [CASE_ID],
      sourceColumnName: undefined,
      layouts: [QUEENS],
    });

    expect(output.sql).toBe(
      [
        `SELECT CAST("case_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "case_id"`,
        `FROM (`,
        `  SELECT * FROM "dataset-q1"`,
        `)`,
      ].join("\n"),
    );
    expect(output.columns).toEqual([{ name: "case_id", dataType: "varchar" }]);
  });

  it("fills a column a layout has no fill for with a typed NULL", () => {
    const sql = _compile({ layouts: [QUEENS] }).sql;

    expect(sql).toContain(`CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "sex"`);
  });

  it("keeps layouts in the given order", () => {
    const sql = _compile({ layouts: [QUEENS, KINGS] }).sql;

    expect(sql.indexOf("dataset-q1")).toBeLessThan(sql.indexOf("dataset-k1"));
  });

  it("outputs the source column first, then the columns in order", () => {
    expect(_compile().columns).toEqual([
      { name: "source_dataset", dataType: "varchar" },
      { name: "case_id", dataType: "varchar" },
      { name: "sex", dataType: "varchar" },
    ]);
  });

  it("lists every code list a translation embedded, with the primary list a second coding reconciles to", () => {
    const mfuLayout: CrosswalkSql.Layout = {
      ...QUEENS,
      fillsByColumnId: new Map([
        [
          SEX.id as string,
          _columnFill("sex", {
            codeListId: LIST_MFU as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id,
          }),
        ],
      ]),
    };

    expect(_compile({ layouts: [mfuLayout] }).usedCodeListIds).toEqual([
      LIST_129,
      LIST_MFU,
    ]);
    expect(_compile({ layouts: [QUEENS] }).usedCodeListIds).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("skips a layout with no dataset", () => {
    const sql = _compile({ layouts: [{ ...KINGS, datasets: [] }, QUEENS] }).sql;

    expect(sql).not.toContain("dataset-k1");
  });

  it("refuses to compile when no layout has a dataset", () => {
    expect(() => {
      return _compile({ layouts: [{ ...QUEENS, datasets: [] }] });
    }).toThrow("crosswalk-nothing-to-combine");
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk.ts";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn.ts";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout.ts";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry.ts";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType.ts";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset.ts";

/** One column of the combined dataset as the compiler sees it. */
export type CrosswalkSqlColumn = {
  id: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
  name: string;
  dataType: AvaDataType.T;
  entryId: DataDictionaryEntry.Id | undefined;
};

/** One layout as the compiler sees it. Skipped layouts are never passed. */
export type CrosswalkSqlLayout = {
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
  /** Sorted by name; at least one. */
  datasets: ReadonlyArray<{ id: Dataset.Id; name: string }>;
  /** By column id. A column with no fill becomes a typed NULL. */
  fillsByColumnId: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkMapping.Fill>;
};

/** The code lists a compile may embed, by id, and each entry's primary list. */
export type CrosswalkSqlCodeLists = {
  codeListsById: ReadonlyMap<
    string,
    { pairs: readonly DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair[] }
  >;
  primaryCodeListIdByEntryId: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
};

/** Everything `CrosswalkSql.compile` reads. */
export type CrosswalkSqlInput = CrosswalkSqlCodeLists & {
  codesOutputAs: Crosswalk.CodesOutput;
  /** "source_dataset" when the crosswalk adds one, otherwise undefined. */
  sourceColumnName: string | undefined;
  /** In position order. */
  columns: readonly CrosswalkSqlColumn[];
  layouts: readonly CrosswalkSqlLayout[];
};

/** The combined dataset's SQL, its columns, and the code lists it embedded. */
export type CrosswalkSqlOutput = {
  sql: string;
  /** Output order: the source column first when added. */
  columns: Array<{ name: string; dataType: AvaDataType.T }>;
  /** Every code list a translation embedded, sorted. */
  usedCodeListIds: string[];
};

/** One pair of a fill's code list, and what a translation outputs for it. */
export type CrosswalkSqlTranslationOutput = {
  pair: DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair;
  /**
   * The primary list's label (labels mode) or code (codes mode). Undefined
   * in codes mode when the primary list has no counterpart.
   */
  output: string | undefined;
};
```
