```ts
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-namespace,import-x/export */
import { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type {
  CrosswalkContents,
  CrosswalkDraftColumn,
  CrosswalkDraftLayout,
  CrosswalkDraftMapping,
  CrosswalkDraftT,
} from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft.types";

/** A dataset's name by its id; an unknown dataset sorts as "". */
type NameOf = (datasetId: string) => string;

type MappingsByLayout = Record<string, Record<string, CrosswalkDraftMapping>>;

/** A new, unsaved crosswalk with no datasets. */
function makeEmpty(
  options: Readonly<{ crosswalkId: Crosswalk.Id; name: string }>,
): CrosswalkDraftT {
  return {
    crosswalkId: options.crosswalkId,
    isSaved: false,
    name: options.name,
    description: undefined,
    codesOutputAs: "labels",
    addsSourceColumn: true,
    outputDatasetId: undefined,
    columns: [],
    layouts: [],
    mappings: {},
  };
}

/**
 * A locale-free order by name, the one `CrosswalkLayout.groupDatasetsByLayout`
 * sorts a layout's datasets by, so a new layout's first dataset (whose
 * spelling its column names take) stays first after a reload. An undefined
 * name sorts last.
 */
function _compareNames(
  nameA: string | undefined,
  nameB: string | undefined,
): number {
  if (nameA === nameB) {
    return 0;
  }
  if (nameA === undefined || nameB === undefined) {
    return nameA === undefined ? 1 : -1;
  }
  return nameA < nameB ? -1 : 1;
}

/** Dataset ids by dataset name, then id, so the order never depends on the server. */
function sortDatasetIdsByName(
  datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[],
  nameOf: NameOf,
): Dataset.Id[] {
  return [...datasetIds].sort((idA, idB) => {
    return _compareNames(nameOf(idA), nameOf(idB)) || (idA < idB ? -1 : 1);
  });
}

/** The reference layout first, then by first dataset name, empty layouts last. */
function sortLayouts(
  layouts: readonly CrosswalkDraftLayout[],
  nameOf: NameOf,
): CrosswalkDraftLayout[] {
  const firstNameOf = (layout: CrosswalkDraftLayout): string | undefined => {
    const firstId = layout.datasetIds[0];
    return firstId === undefined ? undefined : nameOf(firstId);
  };
  return [...layouts].sort((layoutA, layoutB) => {
    if (layoutA.isReference !== layoutB.isReference) {
      return layoutA.isReference ? -1 : 1;
    }
    return (
      _compareNames(firstNameOf(layoutA), firstNameOf(layoutB)) ||
      (layoutA.signature < layoutB.signature ? -1 : 1)
    );
  });
}

function _toDraftColumns(
  columns: readonly CrosswalkColumn.T[],
): CrosswalkDraftColumn[] {
  return [...columns]
    .sort((columnA, columnB) => {
      return columnA.position - columnB.position;
    })
    .map((column, position) => {
      return {
        id: column.id,
        name: column.name,
        position,
        dataType: column.dataType,
        entryId: column.entryId,
      };
    });
}

function _toDraftLayouts(
  contents: CrosswalkContents,
  nameOf: NameOf,
): CrosswalkDraftLayout[] {
  const datasetIdsByLayoutId = new Map<string, Dataset.Id[]>();
  contents.datasets.forEach((membership) => {
    datasetIdsByLayoutId.set(membership.layoutId, [
      ...(datasetIdsByLayoutId.get(membership.layoutId) ?? []),
      membership.datasetId,
    ]);
  });
  const layouts = contents.layouts.map((layout) => {
    return {
      id: layout.id,
      key: CrosswalkLayout.buildLayoutKey(layout.columnNames),
      signature: layout.signature,
      columnNames: layout.columnNames,
      isReference: layout.isReference,
      status: layout.status,
      datasetIds: sortDatasetIdsByName(
        datasetIdsByLayoutId.get(layout.id) ?? [],
        nameOf,
      ),
    };
  });
  return sortLayouts(layouts, nameOf);
}

function _toDraftMappings(contents: CrosswalkContents): MappingsByLayout {
  const mappings: MappingsByLayout = {};
  contents.mappings.forEach((mapping) => {
    mappings[mapping.layoutId] = {
      ...mappings[mapping.layoutId],
      [mapping.columnId]: {
        id: mapping.id,
        fill: mapping.fill,
        status: mapping.status,
        confidence: mapping.confidence,
        reason: mapping.reason,
      },
    };
  });
  return mappings;
}

/**
 * The draft of a saved crosswalk, from its five tables. Layouts and their
 * datasets are sorted by dataset name, which the tables do not hold, so the
 * names come from `datasetsById`.
 */
function fromContents(
  contents: CrosswalkContents,
  options: Readonly<{ datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, { name: string }> }>,
): CrosswalkDraftT {
  const { crosswalk } = contents;
  const nameOf: NameOf = (datasetId) => {
    return options.datasetsById.get(datasetId)?.name ?? "";
  };
  return {
    crosswalkId: crosswalk.id,
    isSaved: true,
    name: crosswalk.name,
    description: crosswalk.description,
    codesOutputAs: crosswalk.codesOutputAs,
    addsSourceColumn: crosswalk.addsSourceColumn,
    outputDatasetId: crosswalk.outputDatasetId,
    columns: _toDraftColumns(contents.columns),
    layouts: _toDraftLayouts(contents, nameOf),
    mappings: _toDraftMappings(contents),
  };
}

function _toPayloadMappings(
  draft: CrosswalkDraftT,
): Crosswalk.SavePayload["mappings"] {
  return draft.layouts.flatMap((layout) => {
    return draft.columns.flatMap((column) => {
      const mapping = draft.mappings[layout.id]?.[column.id];
      return mapping
        ? [
            {
              id: mapping.id,
              layoutId: layout.id,
              columnId: column.id,
              fill: mapping.fill,
              status: mapping.status,
              confidence: mapping.confidence,
              reason: mapping.reason,
            },
          ]
        : [];
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Everything `rpc_crosswalks__save` replaces: memberships in layout order,
 * mappings in layout then column order. A mapping for a layout or column no
 * longer in the draft is left out.
 */
function toSavePayload(draft: CrosswalkDraftT): Crosswalk.SavePayload {
  return {
    crosswalkId: draft.crosswalkId,
    settings: {
      name: draft.name.trim(),
      description: draft.description,
      codesOutputAs: draft.codesOutputAs,
      addsSourceColumn: draft.addsSourceColumn,
    },
    columns: draft.columns.map((column) => {
      const { id, position, dataType, entryId } = column;
      return { id, name: column.name.trim(), position, dataType, entryId };
    }),
    layouts: draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
      const { id, signature, columnNames, isReference, status } = layout;
      return { id, signature, columnNames, isReference, status };
    }),
    datasets: draft.layouts.flatMap((layout) => {
      return layout.datasetIds.map((datasetId) => {
        return { datasetId, layoutId: layout.id };
      });
    }),
    mappings: _toPayloadMappings(draft),
  };
}

/** A `JSON.stringify` replacer that writes every object's keys sorted. */
function _sortKeys(_key: string, value: unknown): unknown {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value;
  }
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(value).sort(([keyA], [keyB]) => {
      return keyA < keyB ? -1 : 1;
    }),
  );
}

/** The rows a draft saves, as JSON whose objects list their keys sorted. */
function _toComparableJson(draft: CrosswalkDraftT): string {
  return JSON.stringify(toSavePayload(draft), _sortKeys);
}

/**
 * Whether two drafts would save the same rows. Ignores `isSaved` and the
 * order of a fill's keys, since a fill read back from the server and one
 * built in the browser can list them differently. An `undefined` field and
 * a missing one compare equal, as they save the same.
 */
function isSameContent(draftA: CrosswalkDraftT, draftB: CrosswalkDraftT): boolean {
  return draftA === draftB || _toComparableJson(draftA) === _toComparableJson(draftB);
}

/** The reference layout, or undefined before one is chosen. */
function getReferenceLayout(
  draft: CrosswalkDraftT,
): CrosswalkDraftLayout | undefined {
  return draft.layouts.find((layout) => {
    return layout.isReference;
  });
}

/** How one layout fills one column, or undefined when it has no fill yet. */
function getFill(
  draft: CrosswalkDraftT,
  layoutId: string,
  columnId: string,
): CrosswalkDraftMapping | undefined {
  return draft.mappings[layoutId]?.[columnId];
}

/** Every dataset in the crosswalk, in layout order. */
function getDatasetIds(draft: CrosswalkDraftT): Dataset.Id[] {
  return draft.layouts.flatMap((layout) => {
    return [...layout.datasetIds];
  });
}

/**
 * How many datasets the crosswalk holds and where they stand. `mapped`
 * counts the reference layout's datasets and every mapped layout's;
 * `unconfirmed` is everything neither mapped nor skipped.
 */
function countDatasets(draft: CrosswalkDraftT): {
  total: number;
  mapped: number;
  skipped: number;
  unconfirmed: number;
} {
  const countWhere = (isCounted: (layout: CrosswalkDraftLayout) => boolean) => {
    return draft.layouts.filter(isCounted).reduce((sum, layout) => {
      return sum + layout.datasetIds.length;
    }, 0);
  };
  const total = countWhere(() => {
    return true;
  });
  const mapped = countWhere((layout) => {
    return layout.isReference || layout.status === "mapped";
  });
  const skipped = countWhere((layout) => {
    return !layout.isReference && layout.status === "skipped";
  });
  return { total, mapped, skipped, unconfirmed: total - mapped - skipped };
}

/** Building, reading, and saving a crosswalk as the browser edits it. */
export const CrosswalkDraft = {
  makeEmpty,
  fromContents,
  toSavePayload,
  isSameContent,
  getReferenceLayout,
  getFill,
  getDatasetIds,
  countDatasets,
  sortDatasetIdsByName,
  sortLayouts,
};

/** Public namespace for the crosswalk draft. */
export namespace CrosswalkDraft {
  /** A whole crosswalk as the browser edits it. */
  export type T = CrosswalkDraftT;
  /** One column of the combined dataset. */
  export type Column = CrosswalkDraftColumn;
  /** One layout and the datasets that share it. */
  export type Layout = CrosswalkDraftLayout;
  /** How one layout fills one column. */
  export type Mapping = CrosswalkDraftMapping;
  /** The crosswalk's five tables, as their clients read them. */
  export type Contents = CrosswalkContents;
}
```

```ts
import type { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry";
import type { DictionaryMatch } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryMatch/DictionaryMatch";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { CrosswalkMatch } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatch";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";

/** The crosswalk view's steps, in order. */
export type CrosswalkStep = "datasets" | "map" | "combine";

/** Everything the reducer reads but does not own, loaded by useCrosswalkCatalog. */
export type CrosswalkContext = {
  /** Every dataset the user can read, with its columns in column order. */
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
  /** Dictionary entries ready to match, primary code list first. */
  entriesById: ReadonlyMap<string, DictionaryMatch.Entry>;
};

/** The reference dataset's binding for one of its columns, read when columns are seeded. */
export type ReferenceColumnBinding = {
  entryId: DataDictionaryEntry.Id;
  codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeList.Id | undefined;
  holdsLabels: boolean;
};

/** The crosswalk view's state: the draft, what was last saved, and what was read. */
export type CrosswalkState = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  /** The draft as last saved; undefined before the first save. */
  savedDraft: CrosswalkDraft.T | undefined;
  /** Layouts whose values were read this session, so each is read once. */
  readLayoutIds: readonly CrosswalkLayout.Id[];
};

/** Everything the user can do to a crosswalk, and what loading tells it. */
export type CrosswalkAction =
  | { type: "renamed"; name: string }
  | { type: "datasets_added"; datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[]; context: CrosswalkContext }
  | { type: "dataset_removed"; datasetId: Dataset.Id }
  | { type: "reference_chosen"; layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id }
  | {
      type: "columns_seeded";
      bindingsByColumnName: ReadonlyMap<string, ReferenceColumnBinding>;
      context: CrosswalkContext;
    }
  | {
      type: "values_read";
      layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
      sources: readonly ColumnProfile.T[];
      targets: readonly CrosswalkMatch.Target[];
      dateFormatsBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
      context: CrosswalkContext;
    }
  | {
      type: "fill_set";
      layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
      columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
      fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill;
    }
  | { type: "suggestion_accepted"; layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id; columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id }
  | { type: "suggestion_rejected"; layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id; columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id }
  | { type: "suggestions_accepted"; layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id }
  | { type: "layout_confirmed"; layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id }
  | { type: "layout_skipped"; layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id }
  | { type: "layout_reopened"; layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id }
  | {
      type: "column_added";
      columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
      name: string;
      dataType: AvaDataType.T;
    }
  | {
      type: "column_changed";
      columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
      changes: {
        name?: string;
        dataType?: AvaDataType.T;
        entryId?: DataDictionaryEntry.Id | null;
      };
      context: CrosswalkContext;
    }
  | { type: "column_removed"; columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id }
  | {
      type: "settings_changed";
      changes: { codesOutputAs?: Crosswalk.CodesOutput; addsSourceColumn?: boolean };
      context: CrosswalkContext;
    }
  | { type: "saved"; draft: CrosswalkDraft.T };

export const SEX_CODES_ID = "eeeeeeee-0000-4000-8000-000000000003" as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id;
/** `M Male`, `F Female`, `U Unknown`. */
export const SEX_LETTERS_ID = "eeeeeeee-0000-4000-8000-000000000004" as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id;

/** The sex entry, primary list first. */
export const SEX_ENTRY: DictionaryMatch.Entry = {

  dictionaryRank: 0,

  codeLists: [

/** A context holding `datasets` and the sex entry. */
export function makeContext(
  datasets: readonly CrosswalkLayout.Dataset[] = [...STARTING_DATASETS, KINGS_MAY],
): CrosswalkContext {
  return {
    datasetsById: new Map(
      datasets.map((dataset) => {
        return [dataset.id, dataset] as const;
      }),
    ),
    entriesById: new Map([[SEX_ENTRY_ID, SEX_ENTRY]]),
  };
}

/** The context most tests use: every fixture dataset. */
export const CONTEXT = makeContext();

/** The reference dataset's sex column, bound to the primary list. */
export const SEX_BINDINGS: ReadonlyMap<string, ReferenceColumnBinding> = new Map([
  ["sex", { entryId: SEX_ENTRY_ID, codeListId: SEX_CODES_ID, holdsLabels: false }],
]);

/** A profile of one column, with `values` listed when given. */
export function makeProfile(
  options: Readonly<{
    dataset: CrosswalkLayout.Dataset;
    columnName: string;
    dataType: AvaDataType.T;
    values?: readonly string[];
  }>,
): ColumnProfile.T {
  const values = options.values?.map((value) => {
    return { value, rowCount: 10 };
  });
  const rowCount = (values?.length ?? 0) * 10;
  return {
    datasetId: options.dataset.id,
    datasetName: options.dataset.name,
    columnName: options.columnName,
    dataType: options.dataType,
    rowCount,
    nonNullCount: rowCount,
    distinctCount: values?.length ?? 0,
    values,
    dateShare: undefined,
    numberRange: undefined,
  };
}

/** The layout that holds `datasetId`; throws when none does. */
export function getLayoutOf(
  state: CrosswalkState,
  datasetId: Dataset.Id,
): CrosswalkDraft.Layout {
  const layout = state.draft.layouts.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.datasetIds.includes(datasetId);
  });
  if (!layout) {
    throw new Error(`No layout holds ${datasetId}`);
  }
  return layout;
}

/** The column of the combined dataset named `name`; throws when none is. */
export function getColumn(
  state: CrosswalkState,
  name: string,
): CrosswalkDraft.Column {
  const column = state.draft.columns.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.name === name;
  });
  if (!column) {
    throw new Error(`No column is named ${name}`);
  }
  return column;
}

/** A new crosswalk with the starting datasets added and Bronx as the reference. */
export function makeAddedState(): CrosswalkState {
  const empty = makeInitialCrosswalkState(
    CrosswalkDraft.makeEmpty({ crosswalkId: CROSSWALK_ID, name: "Measles line lists" }),
    { isSaved: false },
  );
  const added = crosswalkReducer(empty, {
    type: "datasets_added",
    datasetIds: STARTING_DATASETS.map((dataset) => {
      return dataset.id;
    }),
    context: CONTEXT,
  });
  return crosswalkReducer(added, {
    type: "reference_chosen",
    layoutId: getLayoutOf(added, BRONX.id).id,
  });
}

/** `makeAddedState` with the columns seeded from Bronx. */
export function makeSeededState(
  bindings: ReadonlyMap<string, ReferenceColumnBinding> = SEX_BINDINGS,
): CrosswalkState {
  return crosswalkReducer(makeAddedState(), {
    type: "columns_seeded",
    bindingsByColumnName: bindings,
    context: CONTEXT,
  });
}

Assertions about what matching found use exact-name, same-type pairs only (`case_id`, `county`), which score 1 by name and type; a layout's status is compared with `CrosswalkLayout.getStatusAfterFill` over its actual mappings, so no test depends on how the scorer rates `GENDER` against `sex`.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import { CrosswalkSql } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkSql/CrosswalkSql";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import {
  BRONX,
  CONTEXT,
  getColumn,
  getLayoutOf,
  KINGS_APRIL,
  KINGS_MARCH,
  KINGS_MAY,
  makeAddedState,
  makeContext,
  makeProfile,
  makeSeededState,
  QUEENS,
  SEX_CODES_ID,
  SEX_ENTRY,
  SEX_ENTRY_ID,
  SEX_LETTERS_ID,
  STARTING_DATASETS,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/__tests__/crosswalk.fixtures";
import {
  canChangeReference,
  crosswalkReducer,
  isCrosswalkDirty,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { CrosswalkState } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

function _fillOf(state: CrosswalkState, layoutId: string, columnName: string) {
  return CrosswalkDraft.getFill(state.draft, layoutId, getColumn(state, columnName).id);
}

function _expectedStatus(state: CrosswalkState, layoutId: string) {
  return CrosswalkLayout.getStatusAfterFill({
    columnIds: state.draft.columns.map((column) => {
      return column.id;
    }),
    filledColumnIds: new Set(Object.keys(state.draft.mappings[layoutId] ?? {})),
  });
}

function _withSuggestion(state: CrosswalkState): CrosswalkState {
  const kings = getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id);
  const sexId = getColumn(state, "sex").id;
  const suggestion: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping = {
    id: "44444444-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" as CrosswalkMapping.Id,
    fill: {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: "GENDER",
      convert: undefined,
      codeListId: SEX_CODES_ID,
      holdsLabels: false,
    },
    status: "suggested",
    confidence: 0.7,
    reason: "same_values",
  };
  return {
    ...state,
    draft: {
      ...state.draft,
      mappings: {
        ...state.draft.mappings,
        [kings.id]: { ...state.draft.mappings[kings.id], [sexId]: suggestion },
      },
    },
  };
}

describe("crosswalkReducer: datasets", () => {
  it("groups datasets by layout and marks one reference, mapped", () => {
    const state = makeAddedState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    const references = state.draft.layouts.filter((layout) => {
      return layout.isReference;
    });

    expect(state.draft.layouts).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(kings.datasetIds).toEqual([KINGS_MARCH.id, KINGS_APRIL.id]);
    expect(references).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(references[0]?.status).toBe("mapped");
    expect(state.draft.layouts[0]?.datasetIds).toEqual([BRONX.id]);
  });

  it("ignores datasets already in the crosswalk, not readable, or with no columns", () => {
    const state = makeAddedState();
    const noColumns: CrosswalkLayout.Dataset = {
      id: "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-0000000000fe" as typeof BRONX.id,
      name: "Empty upload",
      columns: [],
    };
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, {
      type: "datasets_added",
      datasetIds: [
        KINGS_APRIL.id,
        "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-0000000000ff" as typeof BRONX.id,
        noColumns.id,
      ],
      context: makeContext([...STARTING_DATASETS, KINGS_MAY, noColumns]),
    });

    expect(next).toBe(state);
  });

  it("prefills a layout added after the columns exist", () => {
    const state = crosswalkReducer(makeSeededState(), {
      type: "dataset_removed",
      datasetId: QUEENS.id,
    });
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, {
      type: "datasets_added",
      datasetIds: [QUEENS.id],
      context: CONTEXT,
    });
    const queens = getLayoutOf(next, QUEENS.id);

    expect(queens.status).toBe(_expectedStatus(next, queens.id));
    expect(next.draft.layouts[0]?.isReference).toBe(true);
  });

  it("carries a confirmed fill over from the most similar layout", () => {
    const seeded = makeSeededState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(seeded, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    const withConstant = crosswalkReducer(seeded, {
      type: "fill_set",
      layoutId: kings.id,
      columnId: getColumn(seeded, "sex").id,
      fill: { kind: "constant", value: "Unknown" },
    });
    const next = crosswalkReducer(withConstant, {
      type: "datasets_added",
      datasetIds: [KINGS_MAY.id],
      context: CONTEXT,
    });

    expect(_fillOf(next, getLayoutOf(next, KINGS_MAY.id).id, "sex")).toMatchObject({
      fill: { kind: "constant", value: "Unknown" },
      status: "suggested",
      reason: "similar_layout",
    });
  });

  it("drops a layout left with no dataset, but keeps the reference", () => {
    const seeded = makeSeededState();
    const queensId = getLayoutOf(seeded, QUEENS.id).id;
    const withoutQueens = crosswalkReducer(seeded, {
      type: "dataset_removed",
      datasetId: QUEENS.id,
    });
    const withoutBronx = crosswalkReducer(withoutQueens, {
      type: "dataset_removed",
      datasetId: BRONX.id,
    });

    expect(
      withoutQueens.draft.layouts.some((layout) => {
        return layout.id === queensId;
      }),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(withoutQueens.draft.mappings[queensId]).toBeUndefined();
    expect(CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(withoutBronx.draft)?.datasetIds).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("crosswalkReducer: the reference", () => {
  it("moves the reference and clears every column and mapping", () => {
    const seeded = makeSeededState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(seeded, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    const next = crosswalkReducer(seeded, { type: "reference_chosen", layoutId: kings.id });

    expect(next.draft.layouts[0]?.id).toBe(kings.id);
    expect(next.draft.layouts[0]).toMatchObject({ isReference: true, status: "mapped" });
    expect(getLayoutOf(next, BRONX.id)).toMatchObject({ isReference: false, status: "to_do" });
    expect(next.draft.columns).toEqual([]);
    expect(next.draft.mappings).toEqual({});
    expect(next.readLayoutIds).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("refuses to move once another layout is mapped", () => {
    const seeded = makeSeededState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(seeded, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    const confirmed = crosswalkReducer(seeded, { type: "layout_confirmed", layoutId: kings.id });

    expect(canChangeReference(confirmed.draft)).toBe(false);
    expect(
      crosswalkReducer(confirmed, {
        type: "reference_chosen",
        layoutId: getLayoutOf(confirmed, QUEENS.id).id,
      }),
    ).toBe(confirmed);
  });
});

describe("crosswalkReducer: columns_seeded", () => {
  it("makes one column per reference column, governed where bound", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();

    expect(
      state.draft.columns.map((column) => {
        return [column.name, column.position, column.entryId];
      }),
    ).toEqual([
      ["case_id", 0, undefined],
      ["sex", 1, SEX_ENTRY_ID],
      ["county", 2, undefined],
    ]);
    expect(getColumn(state, "sex").dataType).toBe(
      CrosswalkSql.getGovernedDataType({
        codesOutputAs: "labels",
        primaryPairs: SEX_ENTRY.codeLists[0]?.pairs ?? [],
      }),
    );
  });

  it("fills the reference layout from itself, confirmed", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const referenceId = getLayoutOf(state, BRONX.id).id;

    expect(_fillOf(state, referenceId, "sex")).toMatchObject({
      status: "confirmed",
      fill: {
        kind: "column",
        sourceColumn: "sex",
        convert: undefined,
        codeListId: SEX_CODES_ID,
        holdsLabels: false,
      },
    });
  });

  it("prefills every other layout by name and type", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id);

    expect(_fillOf(state, kings.id, "case_id")).toMatchObject({
      status: "confirmed",
      reason: "name_and_type",
      fill: { kind: "column", sourceColumn: "case_id" },
    });
    expect(_fillOf(state, kings.id, "county")?.status).toBe("confirmed");
    expect(kings.status).toBe(_expectedStatus(state, kings.id));
  });

  it("seeds only once", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    expect(
      crosswalkReducer(state, {
        type: "columns_seeded",
        bindingsByColumnName: new Map(),
        context: CONTEXT,
      }),
    ).toBe(state);
  });
});

describe("crosswalkReducer: values_read", () => {
  it("chooses a code list for a confirmed governed fill that has none", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState(
      new Map([["sex", { entryId: SEX_ENTRY_ID, codeListId: undefined, holdsLabels: false }]]),
    );
    const referenceId = getLayoutOf(state, BRONX.id).id;
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, {
      type: "values_read",
      layoutId: referenceId,
      sources: [makeProfile({ dataset: BRONX, columnName: "sex", dataType: "varchar", values: ["M", "F"] })],
      targets: [],
      dateFormatsBySourceColumn: new Map(),
      context: CONTEXT,
    });

    expect(_fillOf(next, referenceId, "sex")?.fill).toMatchObject({
      codeListId: SEX_LETTERS_ID,
      holdsLabels: false,
    });
    expect(next.readLayoutIds).toEqual([referenceId]);
  });

  it("chooses again a code list the matcher guessed before the values were read", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState(
      new Map([["sex", { entryId: SEX_ENTRY_ID, codeListId: undefined, holdsLabels: false }]]),
    );
    const referenceId = getLayoutOf(state, BRONX.id).id;
    const sexId = getColumn(state, "sex").id;
    const guessed = {
      ...state,
      draft: {
        ...state.draft,
        mappings: {
          ...state.draft.mappings,
          [referenceId]: {
            ...state.draft.mappings[referenceId],
            [sexId]: {
              ...state.draft.mappings[referenceId]![sexId]!,
              fill: { kind: "column" as const, sourceColumn: "sex", convert: undefined, codeListId: SEX_CODES_ID, holdsLabels: false },
              reason: "name_and_type" as const,
              confidence: 0.95,
            },
          },
        },
      },
    };
    const next = crosswalkReducer(guessed, {
      type: "values_read",
      layoutId: referenceId,
      sources: [makeProfile({ dataset: BRONX, columnName: "sex", dataType: "varchar", values: ["M", "F"] })],
      targets: [],
      dateFormatsBySourceColumn: new Map(),
      context: CONTEXT,
    });

    expect(_fillOf(next, referenceId, "sex")?.fill).toMatchObject({ codeListId: SEX_LETTERS_ID });
  });

  it("keeps a code list the user chose", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState(
      new Map([["sex", { entryId: SEX_ENTRY_ID, codeListId: undefined, holdsLabels: false }]]),
    );
    const referenceId = getLayoutOf(state, BRONX.id).id;
    const chosen = crosswalkReducer(state, {
      type: "fill_set",
      layoutId: referenceId,
      columnId: getColumn(state, "sex").id,
      fill: { kind: "column", sourceColumn: "sex", convert: undefined, codeListId: SEX_CODES_ID, holdsLabels: false },
    });
    const next = crosswalkReducer(chosen, {
      type: "values_read",
      layoutId: referenceId,
      sources: [makeProfile({ dataset: BRONX, columnName: "sex", dataType: "varchar", values: ["M", "F"] })],
      targets: [],
      dateFormatsBySourceColumn: new Map(),
      context: CONTEXT,
    });

    expect(_fillOf(next, referenceId, "sex")?.fill).toMatchObject({ codeListId: SEX_CODES_ID });
  });

  it("never replaces a confirmed fill", () => {
    const seeded = makeSeededState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(seeded, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    const countyId = getColumn(seeded, "county").id;
    const withConstant = crosswalkReducer(seeded, {
      type: "fill_set",
      layoutId: kings.id,
      columnId: countyId,
      fill: { kind: "constant", value: "Kings" },
    });
    const next = crosswalkReducer(withConstant, {
      type: "values_read",
      layoutId: kings.id,
      sources: [
        makeProfile({ dataset: KINGS_MARCH, columnName: "case_id", dataType: "varchar" }),
        makeProfile({ dataset: KINGS_MARCH, columnName: "county", dataType: "varchar" }),
      ],
      targets: [
        { columnId: getColumn(seeded, "case_id").id, profile: makeProfile({ dataset: BRONX, columnName: "case_id", dataType: "varchar" }) },
        { columnId: countyId, profile: makeProfile({ dataset: BRONX, columnName: "county", dataType: "varchar" }) },
      ],
      dateFormatsBySourceColumn: new Map(),
      context: CONTEXT,
    });

    expect(_fillOf(next, kings.id, "county")?.fill).toEqual({ kind: "constant", value: "Kings" });
    expect(_fillOf(next, kings.id, "case_id")?.status).toBe("confirmed");
    expect(next.readLayoutIds).toContain(kings.id);
  });
});

describe("crosswalkReducer: fills and suggestions", () => {
  it("stores a set fill as confirmed and marks a filled layout for review", () => {
    let state = makeSeededState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    state.draft.columns.forEach((column) => {
      state = crosswalkReducer(state, {
        type: "fill_set",
        layoutId: kings.id,
        columnId: column.id,
        fill: { kind: "empty" },
      });
    });

    expect(_fillOf(state, kings.id, "sex")).toMatchObject({
      status: "confirmed",
      confidence: undefined,
      reason: undefined,
    });
    expect(getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id).status).toBe("review");
  });

  it("accepts, rejects, and accepts every suggestion", () => {
    const state = _withSuggestion(makeSeededState());
    const kings = getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    const sexId = getColumn(state, "sex").id;

    const accepted = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "suggestion_accepted", layoutId: kings.id, columnId: sexId });
    const rejected = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "suggestion_rejected", layoutId: kings.id, columnId: sexId });
    const allAccepted = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "suggestions_accepted", layoutId: kings.id });

    expect(_fillOf(accepted, kings.id, "sex")).toMatchObject({ status: "confirmed", reason: "same_values" });
    expect(_fillOf(rejected, kings.id, "sex")).toBeUndefined();
    expect(
      Object.values(allAccepted.draft.mappings[kings.id] ?? {}).every((mapping) => {
        return mapping.status === "confirmed";
      }),
    ).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("crosswalkReducer: layout status", () => {
  it("confirms every fill, leaves the rest empty, and marks the layout mapped", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const queens = getLayoutOf(state, QUEENS.id);
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "layout_confirmed", layoutId: queens.id });

    expect(getLayoutOf(next, QUEENS.id).status).toBe("mapped");
    next.draft.columns.forEach((column) => {
      expect(CrosswalkDraft.getFill(next.draft, queens.id, column.id)?.status).toBe("confirmed");
    });
    expect(_fillOf(next, queens.id, "sex")?.fill).toEqual({ kind: "empty" });
  });

  it("skips a layout and reopens it to the status its fills give", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    const skipped = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "layout_skipped", layoutId: kings.id });
    const reopened = crosswalkReducer(skipped, { type: "layout_reopened", layoutId: kings.id });

    expect(getLayoutOf(skipped, KINGS_MARCH.id).status).toBe("skipped");
    expect(getLayoutOf(reopened, KINGS_MARCH.id).status).toBe(_expectedStatus(reopened, kings.id));
  });

  it("never skips the reference", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, {
      type: "layout_skipped",
      layoutId: getLayoutOf(state, BRONX.id).id,
    });
    expect(getLayoutOf(next, BRONX.id).status).toBe("mapped");
  });
});

describe("crosswalkReducer: columns", () => {
  const ADDED_ID = "55555555-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" as CrosswalkColumn.Id;

  it("adds a column with no fills and a column back to to do", () => {
    let state = makeSeededState();
    const kings = getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id);
    state.draft.columns.forEach((column) => {
      state = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "fill_set", layoutId: kings.id, columnId: column.id, fill: { kind: "empty" } });
    });
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "column_added", columnId: ADDED_ID, name: "outbreak", dataType: "boolean" });

    expect(next.draft.columns.at(-1)).toEqual({
      id: ADDED_ID,
      name: "outbreak",
      position: 3,
      dataType: "boolean",
      entryId: undefined,
    });
    expect(CrosswalkDraft.getFill(next.draft, kings.id, ADDED_ID)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(getLayoutOf(next, KINGS_MARCH.id).status).toBe("to_do");
  });

  it("removes a column, its fills, and renumbers the rest", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const sexId = getColumn(state, "sex").id;
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "column_removed", columnId: sexId });

    expect(
      next.draft.columns.map((column) => {
        return [column.name, column.position];
      }),
    ).toEqual([
      ["case_id", 0],
      ["county", 1],
    ]);
    Object.values(next.draft.mappings).forEach((mappings) => {
      expect(mappings[sexId]).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });

  it("governs a column with a new entry and forgets its old code lists", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const countyId = getColumn(state, "county").id;
    const withRead = { ...state, readLayoutIds: [getLayoutOf(state, BRONX.id).id] };
    const next = crosswalkReducer(withRead, {
      type: "column_changed",
      columnId: countyId,
      changes: { entryId: SEX_ENTRY_ID },
      context: CONTEXT,
    });

    expect(getColumn(next, "county")).toMatchObject({ entryId: SEX_ENTRY_ID });
    expect(next.readLayoutIds).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("removes an entry and every fill's code list", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, {
      type: "column_changed",
      columnId: getColumn(state, "sex").id,
      changes: { entryId: null },
      context: CONTEXT,
    });

    expect(getColumn(next, "sex").entryId).toBeUndefined();
    expect(_fillOf(next, getLayoutOf(next, BRONX.id).id, "sex")?.fill).toMatchObject({
      codeListId: undefined,
      holdsLabels: false,
    });
  });

  it("renames a column", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const next = crosswalkReducer(state, {
      type: "column_changed",
      columnId: getColumn(state, "county").id,
      changes: { name: "borough" },
      context: CONTEXT,
    });
    expect(getColumn(next, "borough").position).toBe(2);
  });
});

describe("crosswalkReducer: settings and saving", () => {
  it("re-derives governed types when codes come out as codes", () => {
    const next = crosswalkReducer(makeSeededState(), {
      type: "settings_changed",
      changes: { codesOutputAs: "codes" },
      context: CONTEXT,
    });

    expect(next.draft.codesOutputAs).toBe("codes");
    expect(getColumn(next, "sex").dataType).toBe(
      CrosswalkSql.getGovernedDataType({
        codesOutputAs: "codes",
        primaryPairs: SEX_ENTRY.codeLists[0]?.pairs ?? [],
      }),
    );
    expect(getColumn(next, "county").dataType).toBe("varchar");
  });

  it("marks the draft saved, and keeps an edit made while saving", () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const sent = { ...state.draft, isSaved: true };
    const saved = crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "saved", draft: sent });
    const editedWhileSaving = crosswalkReducer(
      crosswalkReducer(state, { type: "renamed", name: "Renamed" }),
      { type: "saved", draft: sent },
    );

    expect(saved.draft).toBe(sent);
    expect(saved.savedDraft).toBe(sent);
    expect(isCrosswalkDirty(saved)).toBe(false);
    expect(editedWhileSaving.draft).toMatchObject({ name: "Renamed", isSaved: true });
    expect(isCrosswalkDirty(editedWhileSaving)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("counts a draft never saved as dirty", () => {
    expect(isCrosswalkDirty(makeSeededState())).toBe(true);
  });
});

- [ ] **Step 9: Create the prefill helpers.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/prefillCrosswalkLayout.ts`. It owns everything that asks `CrosswalkMatch` for fills and everything that decides a layout's status.

```ts
import { uuid } from "$/lib/uuid";
import { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import { CrosswalkMatch } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatch";
import { CrosswalkSql } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkSql/CrosswalkSql";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkContext,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

/** One layout's mappings, by column id. */
export type LayoutMappings = Readonly<Record<string, CrosswalkDraft.Mapping>>;

type ValuesRead = Extract<CrosswalkAction, { type: "values_read" }>;
type CarriedFill = { columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id; fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill };

/**
 * A layout's status from its fills. The reference is always mapped, and a
 * mapped or skipped layout keeps its status until the user changes it.
 */
export function getRefreshedStatus(
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout,
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
): CrosswalkLayout.Status {
  if (layout.isReference) {
    return "mapped";
  }
  if (layout.status === "mapped" || layout.status === "skipped") {
    return layout.status;
  }
  return CrosswalkLayout.getStatusAfterFill({
    columnIds: draft.columns.map((column) => {
      return column.id;
    }),
    filledColumnIds: new Set(Object.keys(draft.mappings[layout.id] ?? {})),
  });
}

/** The draft with every layout's status refreshed from its fills. */
export function refreshStatuses(draft: CrosswalkDraft.T): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  return {
    ...draft,
    layouts: draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
      return { ...layout, status: getRefreshedStatus(layout, draft) };
    }),
  };
}

/** The draft with one layout's mappings replaced and its status refreshed. */
export function withLayoutMappings(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: string,
  mappings: LayoutMappings,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const withMappings = {
    ...draft,
    mappings: { ...draft.mappings, [layoutId]: mappings },
  };
  return {
    ...withMappings,
    layouts: draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
      return layout.id === layoutId
        ? { ...layout, status: getRefreshedStatus(layout, withMappings) }
        : layout;
    }),
  };
}

/**
 * A column's type: a governed column (its entry has a code list) takes the
 * type its codes come out as; any other column keeps `dataType`.
 */
export function deriveColumnDataType(
  options: Readonly<{
    dataType: AvaDataType.T;
    entryId: DataDictionaryEntry.Id | undefined;
    codesOutputAs: Crosswalk.CodesOutput;
    context: CrosswalkContext;
  }>,
): AvaDataType.T {
  const entry = options.entryId
    ? options.context.entriesById.get(options.entryId)
    : undefined;
  const primaryList = entry?.codeLists[0];
  return primaryList
    ? CrosswalkSql.getGovernedDataType({
        codesOutputAs: options.codesOutputAs,
        primaryPairs: primaryList.pairs,
      })
    : options.dataType;
}

/** Mappings for prefills, keeping the id of a mapping each replaces. */
function _toMappings(
  prefills: readonly CrosswalkMatch.Prefill[],
  existing: LayoutMappings,
): Record<string, CrosswalkDraft.Mapping> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    prefills.map((prefill) => {
      const mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping = {
        id: existing[prefill.columnId]?.id ?? uuid<CrosswalkMapping.Id>(),
        fill: prefill.fill,
        status: prefill.status,
        confidence: prefill.confidence,
        reason: prefill.reason,
      };
      return [prefill.columnId, mapping];
    }),
  );
}

/** The combined dataset's columns as name-and-type profiles to match against. */
function _toNameAndTypeTargets(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  context: CrosswalkContext,
): CrosswalkMatch.Target[] {
  const referenceDatasetId = CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(draft)?.datasetIds[0];
  const referenceDataset = referenceDatasetId
    ? context.datasetsById.get(referenceDatasetId)
    : undefined;
  if (!referenceDataset) {
    return [];
  }
  const profiles = CrosswalkMatch.toNameAndTypeProfiles({
    datasetId: referenceDataset.id,
    datasetName: referenceDataset.name,
    columns: draft.columns,
  });
  return draft.columns.flatMap((column, index) => {
    const profile = profiles[index];
    return profile ? [{ columnId: column.id, profile }] : [];
  });
}

/** A layout's first dataset's columns as name-and-type profiles. */
function _toNameAndTypeSources(
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout,
  context: CrosswalkContext,
): ColumnProfile.T[] | undefined {
  const firstId = layout.datasetIds[0];
  const dataset = firstId ? context.datasetsById.get(firstId) : undefined;
  return dataset
    ? CrosswalkMatch.toNameAndTypeProfiles({
        datasetId: dataset.id,
        datasetName: dataset.name,
        columns: dataset.columns,
      })
    : undefined;
}

/**
 * Confirmed fills of the most similar other layout, carried over to this
 * one. The reference layout is never the source: its fills are identity
 * fills, which name-and-type matching finds anyway, and better.
 */
function _carryOverFromSimilarLayout(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout,
): CarriedFill[] {
  const confirmedFillsOf = (layoutId: string): CarriedFill[] => {
    return Object.entries(draft.mappings[layoutId] ?? {}).flatMap(([columnId, mapping]) => {
      return mapping.status === "confirmed"
        ? [{ columnId: columnId as CrosswalkColumn.Id, fill: mapping.fill }]
        : [];
    });
  };
  const candidates = draft.layouts
    .filter((candidate) => {
      return (
        candidate.id !== layout.id &&
        !candidate.isReference &&
        confirmedFillsOf(candidate.id).length > 0
      );
    })
    .map((candidate) => {
      return { id: candidate.id, columnNames: candidate.columnNames };
    });
  const similarId = CrosswalkLayout.findMostSimilarLayout({
    columnNames: layout.columnNames,
    candidates,
  });
  return similarId
    ? CrosswalkMatch.carryOverFills({
        fills: confirmedFillsOf(similarId),
        columnNames: layout.columnNames,
      })
    : [];
}

/**
 * Fills a layout from its first dataset's column names and types, carrying
 * over fills from the most similar layout first. Used when columns are
 * seeded and when a layout is added after that; values come later, when the
 * layout is opened (`values_read`).
 */
export function prefillLayoutByNameAndType(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout,
  context: CrosswalkContext,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const sources = _toNameAndTypeSources(layout, context);
  const targets = _toNameAndTypeTargets(draft, context);
  if (sources === undefined || targets.length === 0) {
    return draft;
  }
  const prefills = CrosswalkMatch.prefillLayout({
    columns: draft.columns,
    targets,
    sources,
    carriedOver: _carryOverFromSimilarLayout(draft, layout),
    entriesById: context.entriesById,
  });
  return withLayoutMappings(draft, layout.id, _toMappings(prefills, {}));
}

/**
 * Confirmed governed fills, given the code list their values fit. A list the
 * user chose (a fill set by hand, so with no `reason`) is kept; a list the
 * matcher guessed before the values were read is chosen again from them.
 */
function _chooseCodeListsFromValues(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  confirmed: LayoutMappings,
  action: ValuesRead,
): Record<string, CrosswalkDraft.Mapping> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(confirmed).map(([columnId, mapping]) => {
      const { fill } = mapping;
      const column = draft.columns.find((candidate) => {
        return candidate.id === columnId;
      });
      const entry = column?.entryId ? action.context.entriesById.get(column.entryId) : undefined;
      const isChosenByUser = fill.kind === "column" && fill.codeListId !== undefined && mapping.reason === undefined;
      if (!entry || fill.kind !== "column" || fill.convert || isChosenByUser) {
        return [columnId, mapping];
      }
      const profile = action.sources.find((candidate) => {
        return candidate.columnName.toLowerCase() === fill.sourceColumn.toLowerCase();
      });
      const choice = profile ? CrosswalkMatch.chooseCodeList({ profile, entry }) : undefined;
      return [
        columnId,
        choice
          ? { ...mapping, fill: { ...fill, codeListId: choice.codeListId, holdsLabels: choice.holdsLabels } }
          : mapping,
      ];
    }),
  );
}

function _confirmedOnly(mappings: LayoutMappings): LayoutMappings {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(mappings).filter(([, mapping]) => {
      return mapping.status === "confirmed";
    }),
  );
}

function _usedSourceColumns(mappings: LayoutMappings): Set<string> {
  return new Set(
    Object.values(mappings).flatMap((mapping) => {
      return mapping.fill.kind === "column" ? [mapping.fill.sourceColumn.toLowerCase()] : [];
    }),
  );
}

/**
 * Refills a layout from its real values. Confirmed fills are kept (a
 * governed one gets the list its values fit, unless the user chose one); every other
 * column is matched again, carried over first, against the source columns
 * no confirmed fill uses. A suggestion the values no longer support is
 * dropped.
 */
export function applyLayoutValues(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  action: ValuesRead,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const layout = draft.layouts.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === action.layoutId;
  });
  if (!layout) {
    return draft;
  }
  const current = draft.mappings[layout.id] ?? {};
  const confirmed = _confirmedOnly(current);
  const usedSources = _usedSourceColumns(confirmed);
  const openColumns = draft.columns.filter((column) => {
    return confirmed[column.id] === undefined;
  });
  const isOpen = (columnId: string): boolean => {
    return confirmed[columnId] === undefined;
  };
  const prefills = CrosswalkMatch.prefillLayout({
    columns: openColumns,
    targets: action.targets.filter((target) => {
      return isOpen(target.columnId);
    }),
    sources: action.sources.filter((profile) => {
      return !usedSources.has(profile.columnName.toLowerCase());
    }),
    carriedOver: _carryOverFromSimilarLayout(draft, layout).filter((carried) => {
      return isOpen(carried.columnId);
    }),
    entriesById: action.context.entriesById,
    dateFormatsBySourceColumn: action.dateFormatsBySourceColumn,
  });
  return withLayoutMappings(draft, layout.id, {
    ..._chooseCodeListsFromValues(draft, confirmed, action),
    ..._toMappings(prefills, current),
  });
}
```

`applyLayoutValues` is 44 lines; if `oxfmt` wraps it past 45, move the `prefillLayout` call into a `_prefillOpenColumns(draft, layout, action, confirmed)` helper that returns the prefills.

- [ ] **Step 10: Create the draft actions.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkDraftActions.ts`. Each function takes a draft and returns the next one, or the same object when nothing changes, so the reducer can return the same state.

```ts
import { uuid } from "$/lib/uuid";
import { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import {
  deriveColumnDataType,
  getRefreshedStatus,
  prefillLayoutByNameAndType,
  refreshStatuses,
  withLayoutMappings,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/prefillCrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { LayoutMappings } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/prefillCrosswalkLayout";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkContext,
  ReferenceColumnBinding,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

type ActionOf<Type extends CrosswalkAction["type"]> = Extract<CrosswalkAction, { type: Type }>;

function _nameOf(context: CrosswalkContext): (datasetId: string) => string {
  return (datasetId) => {
    return context.datasetsById.get(datasetId)?.name ?? "";
  };
}

function _omitKey<Value>(
  record: Readonly<Record<string, Value>>,
  key: string,
): Record<string, Value> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(record).filter(([candidate]) => {
      return candidate !== key;
    }),
  );
}

function _createLayout(group: CrosswalkLayout.Group): CrosswalkDraft.Layout {
  return {
    id: uuid<CrosswalkLayout.Id>(),
    key: group.key,
    signature: group.signature,
    columnNames: group.columnNames,
    isReference: false,
    status: "to_do",
    datasetIds: group.datasetIds,
  };
}

/** Joins each group to the layout with its key, or makes it a new layout. */
function _mergeGroups(
  layouts: readonly CrosswalkDraft.Layout[],
  groups: readonly CrosswalkLayout.Group[],
  context: CrosswalkContext,
): { layouts: CrosswalkDraft.Layout[]; createdLayoutIds: CrosswalkLayout.Id[] } {
  const existingKeys = new Set(
    layouts.map((layout) => {
      return layout.key;
    }),
  );
  const grown = layouts.map((layout) => {
    const group = groups.find((candidate) => {
      return candidate.key === layout.key;
    });
    return group
      ? {
          ...layout,
          datasetIds: CrosswalkDraft.sortDatasetIdsByName(
            [...layout.datasetIds, ...group.datasetIds],
            _nameOf(context),
          ),
        }
      : layout;
  });
  const created = groups
    .filter((group) => {
      return !existingKeys.has(group.key);
    })
    .map(_createLayout);
  return {
    layouts: [...grown, ...created],
    createdLayoutIds: created.map((layout) => {
      return layout.id;
    }),
  };
}

/** Marks the layout that covers the others best as the reference, if none is. */
function _ensureReference(draft: CrosswalkDraft.T): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  if (CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(draft)) {
    return draft;
  }
  const referenceKey = CrosswalkLayout.chooseReferenceLayout(
    draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
      return {
        key: layout.key,
        signature: layout.signature,
        columnNames: [...layout.columnNames],
        datasetIds: [...layout.datasetIds],
      };
    }),
  );
  return {
    ...draft,
    layouts: draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
      return layout.key === referenceKey
        ? { ...layout, isReference: true, status: "mapped" as const }
        : layout;
    }),
  };
}

/**
 * Adds datasets the draft does not hold yet. Each joins the layout with its
 * key or forms a new one; the first time, a reference is chosen. Once
 * columns exist, every new layout is prefilled by name and type. A dataset
 * with no columns is left out: a layout needs at least one column name.
 */
export function addDatasets(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[],
  context: CrosswalkContext,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const known = new Set<string>(CrosswalkDraft.getDatasetIds(draft));
  const added = [...new Set(datasetIds)].flatMap((datasetId) => {
    const dataset = known.has(datasetId) ? undefined : context.datasetsById.get(datasetId);
    return dataset && dataset.columns.length > 0 ? [dataset] : [];
  });
  if (added.length === 0) {
    return draft;
  }
  const merged = _mergeGroups(
    draft.layouts,
    CrosswalkLayout.groupDatasetsByLayout(added),
    context,
  );
  const withReference = _ensureReference({ ...draft, layouts: merged.layouts });
  const prefilled = merged.createdLayoutIds.reduce((current, layoutId) => {
    const layout = current.layouts.find((candidate) => {
      return candidate.id === layoutId;
    });
    return layout && !layout.isReference
      ? prefillLayoutByNameAndType(current, layout, context)
      : current;
  }, withReference);
  return {
    ...prefilled,
    layouts: CrosswalkDraft.sortLayouts(prefilled.layouts, _nameOf(context)),
  };
}

/**
 * Removes a dataset. A layout left with no dataset goes with its mappings,
 * except the reference, which stays so its columns keep their meaning.
 */
export function removeDataset(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  datasetId: Dataset.Id,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const layout = draft.layouts.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.datasetIds.includes(datasetId);
  });
  if (!layout) {
    return draft;
  }
  const remaining = layout.datasetIds.filter((id) => {
    return id !== datasetId;
  });
  if (remaining.length === 0 && !layout.isReference) {
    return {
      ...draft,
      layouts: draft.layouts.filter((candidate) => {
        return candidate.id !== layout.id;
      }),
      mappings: _omitKey(draft.mappings, layout.id),
    };
  }
  return {
    ...draft,
    layouts: draft.layouts.map((candidate) => {
      return candidate.id === layout.id
        ? { ...candidate, datasetIds: remaining }
        : candidate;
    }),
  };
}

/**
 * Makes another layout the reference, first in the list, and clears every
 * column and mapping so the next Next seeds them again. Every other layout
 * that is not skipped goes back to to do. The reducer checks
 * `canChangeReference` before calling this.
 */
export function chooseReference(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const target = draft.layouts.find((layout) => {
    return layout.id === layoutId;
  });
  if (!target || target.isReference) {
    return draft;
  }
  const others = draft.layouts
    .filter((layout) => {
      return layout.id !== layoutId;
    })
    .map((layout) => {
      return {
        ...layout,
        isReference: false,
        status: layout.status === "skipped" ? ("skipped" as const) : ("to_do" as const),
      };
    });
  return {
    ...draft,
    layouts: [{ ...target, isReference: true, status: "mapped" }, ...others],
    columns: [],
    mappings: {},
  };
}

function _identityMapping(
  column: CrosswalkDraft.Column,
  binding: ReferenceColumnBinding | undefined,
): CrosswalkDraft.Mapping {
  const isGoverned = column.entryId !== undefined;
  return {
    id: uuid<CrosswalkMapping.Id>(),
    fill: {
      kind: "column",
      sourceColumn: column.name,
      convert: undefined,
      codeListId: isGoverned ? binding?.codeListId : undefined,
      holdsLabels: isGoverned ? (binding?.holdsLabels ?? false) : false,
    },
    status: "confirmed",
    confidence: undefined,
    reason: undefined,
  };
}

/**
 * Makes the combined dataset's columns from the reference dataset's, in its
 * column order, governed where the reference binds a known entry. The
 * reference layout fills each from itself, confirmed; every other layout is
 * prefilled by name and type. Does nothing once columns exist.
 */
export function seedColumns(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  bindingsByColumnName: ReadonlyMap<string, ReferenceColumnBinding>,
  context: CrosswalkContext,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const reference = CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(draft);
  const firstId = reference?.datasetIds[0];
  const dataset = firstId ? context.datasetsById.get(firstId) : undefined;
  if (draft.columns.length > 0 || !reference || !dataset) {
    return draft;
  }
  const columns = dataset.columns.map((sourceColumn, position) => {
    const binding = bindingsByColumnName.get(sourceColumn.name);
    const entryId =
      binding && context.entriesById.has(binding.entryId) ? binding.entryId : undefined;
    const dataType = deriveColumnDataType({
      dataType: sourceColumn.dataType,
      entryId,
      codesOutputAs: draft.codesOutputAs,
      context,
    });
    const id = uuid<CrosswalkColumn.Id>();
    return { id, name: sourceColumn.name, position, dataType, entryId };
  });
  const referenceMappings = Object.fromEntries(
    columns.map((column) => {
      return [column.id, _identityMapping(column, bindingsByColumnName.get(column.name))];
    }),
  );
  const seeded = { ...draft, columns, mappings: { [reference.id]: referenceMappings } };
  return seeded.layouts.reduce((current, layout) => {
    return layout.isReference ? current : prefillLayoutByNameAndType(current, layout, context);
  }, seeded);
}

function _hasLayoutAndColumn(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: string,
  columnId: string,
): boolean {
  return (
    draft.layouts.some((layout) => {
      return layout.id === layoutId;
    }) &&
    draft.columns.some((column) => {
      return column.id === columnId;
    })
  );
}

/** Stores a fill the user chose: confirmed, with no reason or confidence. */
export function setFill(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  action: ActionOf<"fill_set">,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  if (!_hasLayoutAndColumn(draft, action.layoutId, action.columnId)) {
    return draft;
  }
  const current = draft.mappings[action.layoutId] ?? {};
  const mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping = {
    id: current[action.columnId]?.id ?? uuid<CrosswalkMapping.Id>(),
    fill: action.fill,
    status: "confirmed",
    confidence: undefined,
    reason: undefined,
  };
  return withLayoutMappings(draft, action.layoutId, {
    ...current,
    [action.columnId]: mapping,
  });
}

/**
 * Rewrites one layout's mappings: `update` returns the mapping to keep, or
 * undefined to drop it. The layout's status is refreshed after.
 */
export function updateMappings(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: string,
  update: (
    mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping,
    columnId: string,
  ) => CrosswalkDraft.Mapping | undefined,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const current = draft.mappings[layoutId];
  if (!current) {
    return draft;
  }
  const next = Object.entries(current).flatMap(([columnId, mapping]) => {
    const updated = update(mapping, columnId);
    return updated ? [[columnId, updated] as const] : [];
  });
  return withLayoutMappings(draft, layoutId, Object.fromEntries(next));
}

function _setLayoutStatus(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: string,
  toStatus: (layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout) => CrosswalkLayout.Status,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  return {
    ...draft,
    layouts: draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
      return layout.id === layoutId && !layout.isReference
        ? { ...layout, status: toStatus(layout) }
        : layout;
    }),
  };
}

/** Confirms every fill of a layout, leaves every other column empty, and marks it mapped. */
export function confirmLayout(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const layout = draft.layouts.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === layoutId;
  });
  if (!layout || layout.isReference) {
    return draft;
  }
  const current = draft.mappings[layoutId] ?? {};
  const mappings: LayoutMappings = Object.fromEntries(
    draft.columns.map((column) => {
      const existing = current[column.id];
      const mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping = existing
        ? { ...existing, status: "confirmed" }
        : {
            id: uuid<CrosswalkMapping.Id>(),
            fill: { kind: "empty" },
            status: "confirmed",
            confidence: undefined,
            reason: undefined,
          };
      return [column.id, mapping];
    }),
  );
  const withMappings = { ...draft, mappings: { ...draft.mappings, [layoutId]: mappings } };
  return _setLayoutStatus(withMappings, layoutId, () => {
    return "mapped";
  });
}

/** Skips a layout: its datasets are left out of the combined dataset. */
export function skipLayout(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  return _setLayoutStatus(draft, layoutId, () => {
    return "skipped";
  });
}

/** Brings a skipped layout back, with the status its fills give. */
export function reopenLayout(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  return _setLayoutStatus(draft, layoutId, (layout) => {
    return layout.status === "skipped"
      ? getRefreshedStatus({ ...layout, status: "to_do" }, draft)
      : layout.status;
  });
}

/** Appends a column with no fills anywhere. */
export function addColumn(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  action: ActionOf<"column_added">,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const isTaken = draft.columns.some((column) => {
    return column.id === action.columnId;
  });
  if (isTaken) {
    return draft;
  }
  const column: CrosswalkDraft.Column = {
    id: action.columnId,
    name: action.name,
    position: draft.columns.length,
    dataType: action.dataType,
    entryId: undefined,
  };
  return refreshStatuses({ ...draft, columns: [...draft.columns, column] });
}

/** Removes a column and its fills from every layout, and renumbers the rest. */
export function removeColumn(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  if (
    !draft.columns.some((column) => {
      return column.id === columnId;
    })
  ) {
    return draft;
  }
  const columns = draft.columns
    .filter((column) => {
      return column.id !== columnId;
    })
    .map((column, position) => {
      return { ...column, position };
    });
  const mappings = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(draft.mappings).map(([layoutId, layoutMappings]) => {
      return [layoutId, _omitKey(layoutMappings, columnId)];
    }),
  );
  return refreshStatuses({ ...draft, columns, mappings });
}

/** Every `column` fill of one column, without a code list. */
function _clearCodeLists(
  mappings: CrosswalkDraft.T["mappings"],
  columnId: string,
): CrosswalkDraft.T["mappings"] {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(mappings).map(([layoutId, layoutMappings]) => {
      const mapping = layoutMappings[columnId];
      if (!mapping || mapping.fill.kind !== "column") {
        return [layoutId, layoutMappings];
      }
      const fill = { ...mapping.fill, codeListId: undefined, holdsLabels: false };
      return [layoutId, { ...layoutMappings, [columnId]: { ...mapping, fill } }];
    }),
  );
}

/**
 * Renames a column, changes its type, or changes its dictionary entry. A
 * governed column's type follows its entry. A changed entry clears every
 * fill's code list for that column, since the old list belongs to another
 * entry; the next `values_read` picks one again.
 */
export function changeColumn(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  action: ActionOf<"column_changed">,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const column = draft.columns.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === action.columnId;
  });
  if (!column) {
    return draft;
  }
  const { changes } = action;
  const entryId =
    changes.entryId === undefined ? column.entryId : (changes.entryId ?? undefined);
  const nextColumn = {
    ...column,
    name: changes.name ?? column.name,
    entryId,
    dataType: deriveColumnDataType({
      dataType: changes.dataType ?? column.dataType,
      entryId,
      codesOutputAs: draft.codesOutputAs,
      context: action.context,
    }),
  };
  return {
    ...draft,
    columns: draft.columns.map((candidate) => {
      return candidate.id === column.id ? nextColumn : candidate;
    }),
    mappings:
      entryId === column.entryId ? draft.mappings : _clearCodeLists(draft.mappings, column.id),
  };
}

/** Changes how codes come out and whether the source column is added. */
export function changeSettings(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  action: ActionOf<"settings_changed">,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const codesOutputAs = action.changes.codesOutputAs ?? draft.codesOutputAs;
  return {
    ...draft,
    codesOutputAs,
    addsSourceColumn: action.changes.addsSourceColumn ?? draft.addsSourceColumn,
    columns: draft.columns.map((column) => {
      return {
        ...column,
        dataType: deriveColumnDataType({
          dataType: column.dataType,
          entryId: column.entryId,
          codesOutputAs,
          context: action.context,
        }),
      };
    }),
  };
}
```

`confirmLayout`, `changeColumn`, and `seedColumns` sit near the 45-line limit after formatting; if `oxfmt` pushes one over, move its inner `map` callback into a module-private function (for `seedColumns`, a `_seedColumn({ sourceColumn, position, bindingsByColumnName, draft, context })` that returns the column).

- [ ] **Step 11: Create the reducer.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.ts`:

```ts
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import {
  addColumn,
  addDatasets,
  changeColumn,
  changeSettings,
  chooseReference,
  confirmLayout,
  removeColumn,
  removeDataset,
  reopenLayout,
  seedColumns,
  setFill,
  skipLayout,
  updateMappings,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkDraftActions";
import { applyLayoutValues } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/prefillCrosswalkLayout";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkState,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

type Handlers = {
  [Type in CrosswalkAction["type"]]: (
    state: CrosswalkState,
    action: Extract<CrosswalkAction, { type: Type }>,
  ) => CrosswalkState;
};

/**
 * The view's starting state. A saved crosswalk's draft is also what was
 * last saved; a new one has nothing saved yet.
 */
export function makeInitialCrosswalkState(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  options: Readonly<{ isSaved: boolean }>,
): CrosswalkState {
  const startingDraft = { ...draft, isSaved: options.isSaved };
  return {
    draft: startingDraft,
    savedDraft: options.isSaved ? startingDraft : undefined,
    readLayoutIds: [],
  };
}

/** Whether the draft holds changes that are not saved. */
export function isCrosswalkDirty(state: CrosswalkState): boolean {
  return (
    state.savedDraft === undefined ||
    !CrosswalkDraft.isSameContent(state.draft, state.savedDraft)
  );
}

/**
 * Whether another layout can become the reference: only while no other
 * layout is mapped, since its confirmed fills were made against this one.
 */
export function canChangeReference(draft: CrosswalkDraft.T): boolean {
  return !draft.layouts.some((layout) => {
    return !layout.isReference && layout.status === "mapped";
  });
}

/** The state with a new draft, forgetting reads of layouts that are gone. */
function _withDraft(state: CrosswalkState, draft: CrosswalkDraft.T): CrosswalkState {
  if (draft === state.draft) {
    return state;
  }
  const layoutIds = new Set(
    draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
      return layout.id;
    }),
  );
  return {
    ...state,
    draft,
    readLayoutIds: state.readLayoutIds.filter((layoutId) => {
      return layoutIds.has(layoutId);
    }),
  };
}

const HANDLERS: Handlers = {
  renamed: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, { ...state.draft, name: action.name });
  },
  datasets_added: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, addDatasets(state.draft, action.datasetIds, action.context));
  },
  dataset_removed: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, removeDataset(state.draft, action.datasetId));
  },
  reference_chosen: (state, action) => {
    const draft = canChangeReference(state.draft)
      ? chooseReference(state.draft, action.layoutId)
      : state.draft;
    return draft === state.draft ? state : { ...state, draft, readLayoutIds: [] };
  },
  columns_seeded: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(
      state,
      seedColumns(state.draft, action.bindingsByColumnName, action.context),
    );
  },
  values_read: (state, action) => {
    const isKnown = state.draft.layouts.some((layout) => {
      return layout.id === action.layoutId;
    });
    if (!isKnown) {
      return state;
    }
    const readLayoutIds = state.readLayoutIds.includes(action.layoutId)
      ? state.readLayoutIds
      : [...state.readLayoutIds, action.layoutId];
    return { ...state, draft: applyLayoutValues(state.draft, action), readLayoutIds };
  },
  fill_set: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, setFill(state.draft, action));
  },
  suggestion_accepted: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(
      state,
      updateMappings(state.draft, action.layoutId, (mapping, columnId) => {
        return columnId === action.columnId && mapping.status === "suggested"
          ? { ...mapping, status: "confirmed" }
          : mapping;
      }),
    );
  },
  suggestion_rejected: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(
      state,
      updateMappings(state.draft, action.layoutId, (mapping, columnId) => {
        return columnId === action.columnId && mapping.status === "suggested"
          ? undefined
          : mapping;
      }),
    );
  },
  suggestions_accepted: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(
      state,
      updateMappings(state.draft, action.layoutId, (mapping) => {
        return { ...mapping, status: "confirmed" };
      }),
    );
  },
  layout_confirmed: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, confirmLayout(state.draft, action.layoutId));
  },
  layout_skipped: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, skipLayout(state.draft, action.layoutId));
  },
  layout_reopened: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, reopenLayout(state.draft, action.layoutId));
  },
  column_added: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, addColumn(state.draft, action));
  },
  column_changed: (state, action) => {
    const before = state.draft.columns.find((column) => {
      return column.id === action.columnId;
    });
    const draft = changeColumn(state.draft, action);
    const after = draft.columns.find((column) => {
      return column.id === action.columnId;
    });
    // A new entry means new code lists to choose, so every layout is read again.
    return before?.entryId === after?.entryId
      ? _withDraft(state, draft)
      : { ...state, draft, readLayoutIds: [] };
  },
  column_removed: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, removeColumn(state.draft, action.columnId));
  },
  settings_changed: (state, action) => {
    return _withDraft(state, changeSettings(state.draft, action));
  },
  saved: (state, action) => {
    // An edit made while the save was in flight stays, unsaved.
    const draft = CrosswalkDraft.isSameContent(state.draft, action.draft)
      ? action.draft
      : { ...state.draft, isSaved: true };
    return { ...state, draft, savedDraft: action.draft };
  },
};

/**
 * Applies one user action, or one loading result, to the crosswalk view's
 * state. Mints ids for the layouts, columns, and mappings it creates, so
 * `useCrosswalkFlow` runs it once per action rather than through
 * `useReducer`.
 */
export function crosswalkReducer(
  state: CrosswalkState,
  action: CrosswalkAction,
): CrosswalkState {
  const handler = HANDLERS[action.type] as (
    state: CrosswalkState,
    action: CrosswalkAction,
  ) => CrosswalkState;
  return handler(state, action);
}
```

`suggestions_accepted` returns every mapping confirmed; a mapping already confirmed is unchanged in content. Part B's `meaning_matches_found` adds one more entry to `HANDLERS` (the `Handlers` type makes a missing one a type error).

```ts
import { where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { CrosswalkClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkClient";
import { CrosswalkColumnClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumnClient";
import { CrosswalkDatasetClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkDatasetClient";
import { CrosswalkLayoutClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayoutClient";
import { CrosswalkMappingClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkMappingClient";
import { ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT } from "@/config/queryOptions.constants";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";

/** Where loading a crosswalk stands. */
export type CrosswalkContentsStatus = "loading" | "ready" | "missing" | "failed";

type QueryFacts = {
  data: unknown;
  isFetchedAfterMount: boolean;
  fetchStatus: string;
  isLoadingError: boolean;
};

/**
 * Whether a query holds current data: fetched since this view mounted, or
 * paused on its cached data because the device is offline.
 */
function _isSettled(query: QueryFacts): boolean {
  return (
    query.data !== undefined &&
    (query.isFetchedAfterMount || query.fetchStatus === "paused")
  );
}

/** The five tables' queries for one crosswalk, each refetched on mount. */
function useContentsQueries(crosswalkId: Crosswalk.Id) {
  const options = { useQueryOptions: ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT };
  const ofCrosswalk = { ...where("crosswalk_id", "eq", crosswalkId), ...options };
  const [crosswalks, , crosswalkQuery] = CrosswalkClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("id", "eq", crosswalkId),
    ...options,
  });
  const [columns, , columnsQuery] = CrosswalkColumnClient.useGetAll(ofCrosswalk);
  const [layouts, , layoutsQuery] = CrosswalkLayoutClient.useGetAll(ofCrosswalk);
  const [datasets, , datasetsQuery] = CrosswalkDatasetClient.useGetAll(ofCrosswalk);
  const [mappings, , mappingsQuery] = CrosswalkMappingClient.useGetAll(ofCrosswalk);
  return {
    data: { crosswalks, columns, layouts, datasets, mappings },
    queries: [crosswalkQuery, columnsQuery, layoutsQuery, datasetsQuery, mappingsQuery],
  };
}

/**
 * Loads one crosswalk's five tables. `ready` only once every table has
 * fetched since mount (or is paused offline on cached data): the persisted
 * cache can hold a crosswalk from before its last save, and a whole-set
 * save built on that would undo it. A failed background refetch after the
 * data loaded does not count as failed.
 */
export function useCrosswalkContents(crosswalkId: Crosswalk.Id): {
  status: CrosswalkContentsStatus;
  contents: CrosswalkDraft.Contents | undefined;
} {
  const { data, queries } = useContentsQueries(crosswalkId);
  const { crosswalks, columns, layouts, datasets, mappings } = data;
  const contents = useMemo(() => {
    const crosswalk = crosswalks?.[0];
    return crosswalk && columns && layouts && datasets && mappings
      ? { crosswalk, columns, layouts, datasets, mappings }
      : undefined;
  }, [crosswalks, columns, layouts, datasets, mappings]);
  if (
    queries.some((query) => {
      return query.isLoadingError;
    })
  ) {
    return { status: "failed", contents: undefined };
  }
  if (!queries.every(_isSettled)) {
    return { status: "loading", contents: undefined };
  }
  return contents
    ? { status: "ready", contents }
    : { status: "missing", contents: undefined };
}
```
