```ts
          codeLists: [],
          codings: [],
          isLoading: mocks.isDictionaryLoading,
          hasLoadFailed: false,
        };
      },
    };
  },
);

function _column(
  datasetId: Dataset.Id,
  name: string,
  columnIdx: number,
): DatasetColumn.T {
  return {
    id: `${datasetId}-${name}`,
    datasetId,
    name,
    dataType: "varchar",
    columnIdx,
  } as unknown as DatasetColumn.T;
}

describe("useCrosswalkCatalog", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mocks.datasets = [
      { id: BRONX_ID, name: "Bronx line list" },
      { id: KINGS_ID, name: "Kings line list" },
    ];
    mocks.columns = [
      _column(BRONX_ID, "county", 2),
      _column(BRONX_ID, "case_id", 0),
      _column(BRONX_ID, "sex", 1),
      _column(KINGS_ID, "CaseNo", 0),
    ];
    mocks.bindings = [
      { id: "binding-1", datasetId: BRONX_ID, datasetColumnId: `${BRONX_ID}-sex` },
      { id: "binding-2", datasetId: KINGS_ID, datasetColumnId: `${KINGS_ID}-CaseNo` },
    ] as unknown as DictionaryBinding.T[];
    mocks.isDictionaryLoading = false;
  });

  it("lists every dataset with its columns in column order", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => {
      return useCrosswalkCatalog([BRONX_ID]);
    });

    expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.context.datasetsById.get(BRONX_ID)).toEqual({
      id: BRONX_ID,
      name: "Bronx line list",
      columns: [
        { name: "case_id", dataType: "varchar" },
        { name: "sex", dataType: "varchar" },
        { name: "county", dataType: "varchar" },
      ],
    });
    expect(result.current.columnNameById.get(`${BRONX_ID}-sex`)).toBe("sex");
  });

  it("makes every dictionary entry ready to match, by id", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => {
      return useCrosswalkCatalog([]);
    });

    expect(result.current.context.entriesById.get(SEX_ENTRY_ID)).toMatchObject({
      entryId: SEX_ENTRY_ID,
      dictionaryId: NYS_ID,
      entryName: "sex",
    });
  });

  it("keeps only the bindings of the given datasets", () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => {
      return useCrosswalkCatalog([BRONX_ID]);
    });

    expect(result.current.bindingsByDatasetId.get(BRONX_ID)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.current.bindingsByDatasetId.has(KINGS_ID)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("is loading until every query has answered", () => {
    mocks.columns = undefined;
    const { result } = renderHook(() => {
      return useCrosswalkCatalog([]);
    });

    expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 18: Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkCatalog/useCrosswalkCatalog.ts`.** It reuses the apply flow's `useWorkspaceDictionaryContents` and builds the same match entries `useApplyDictionariesData` does. Every query is workspace-wide, so the step components that call this hook again share the cached queries.

```ts
import { where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { DictionaryMatch } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryMatch/DictionaryMatch";
import { DictionaryBindingClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBindingClient";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { DatasetColumnClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetColumnClient";
import { ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT } from "@/config/queryOptions.constants";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { useWorkspaceDictionaryContents } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useWorkspaceDictionaryContents";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";
import type { CrosswalkContext } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

/** Everything a crosswalk matches against, and the bindings of its datasets. */
export type CrosswalkCatalog = {
  context: CrosswalkContext;
  /** The bindings of the datasets asked for, by dataset id. */
  bindingsByDatasetId: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly DictionaryBinding.T[]>;
  /** Every dataset column's name, by its id, to read bindings by name. */
  columnNameById: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
  isLoading: boolean;
};

const ID_SEPARATOR = "\u001f";

function _toLayoutDatasets(
  datasets: readonly Dataset.T[],
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[],
): Map<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset> {
  const columnsByDatasetId = new Map<string, DatasetColumn.T[]>();
  columns.forEach((column) => {
    columnsByDatasetId.set(column.datasetId, [
      ...(columnsByDatasetId.get(column.datasetId) ?? []),
      column,
    ]);
  });
  return new Map(
    datasets.map((dataset) => {
      const ordered = [...(columnsByDatasetId.get(dataset.id) ?? [])].sort(
        (columnA, columnB) => {
          return columnA.columnIdx - columnB.columnIdx;
        },
      );
      const layoutColumns = ordered.map((column) => {
        return { name: column.name, dataType: column.dataType };
      });
      return [dataset.id, { id: dataset.id, name: dataset.name, columns: layoutColumns }];
    }),
  );
}

/** Every dataset the user can read, with its columns, and column names by id. */
function useWorkspaceDatasets(workspaceId: Workspace.Id) {
  const inWorkspace = {
    ...where("workspace_id", "eq", workspaceId),
    useQueryOptions: ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT,
  };
  const [datasets] = DatasetClient.useGetAll(inWorkspace);
  const [columns] = DatasetColumnClient.useGetAll(inWorkspace);
  const datasetsById = useMemo(() => {
    return _toLayoutDatasets(datasets ?? [], columns ?? []);
  }, [datasets, columns]);
  const columnNameById = useMemo(() => {
    return new Map(
      (columns ?? []).map((column) => {
        return [column.id as string, column.name];
      }),
    );
  }, [columns]);
  return { datasetsById, columnNameById, isLoading: !datasets || !columns };
}

/** The bindings of `datasetIds`, by dataset id. */
function useBindingsByDatasetId(
  workspaceId: Workspace.Id,
  datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[],
) {
  const [bindings] = DictionaryBindingClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("workspace_id", "eq", workspaceId),
    useQueryOptions: ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT,
  });
  // A key, so a new array holding the same ids does not rebuild the map.
  const datasetIdKey = [...datasetIds].sort().join(ID_SEPARATOR);
  const bindingsByDatasetId = useMemo(() => {
    const wanted = new Set(datasetIdKey.split(ID_SEPARATOR));
    const byDataset = new Map<string, DictionaryBinding.T[]>();
    (bindings ?? []).forEach((binding) => {
      if (wanted.has(binding.datasetId)) {
        byDataset.set(binding.datasetId, [...(byDataset.get(binding.datasetId) ?? []), binding]);
      }
    });
    return byDataset;
  }, [bindings, datasetIdKey]);
  return { bindingsByDatasetId, isLoading: !bindings };
}

/**
 * Loads what a crosswalk is matched against: every dataset the user can
 * read with its columns, every dictionary entry ready to match (primary
 * code list first), and the bindings of `datasetIds`, which seeding reads
 * from the reference dataset. Every query refetches on mount, so a dataset
 * imported or a dictionary edited a moment ago is used.
 */
export function useCrosswalkCatalog(
  datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[],
): CrosswalkCatalog {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const datasets = useWorkspaceDatasets(workspace.id);
  const bindings = useBindingsByDatasetId(workspace.id, datasetIds);
  const contents = useWorkspaceDictionaryContents(workspace.id);
  const { dictionaries, entries, codeLists, codings } = contents;
  const entriesById = useMemo(() => {
    const matchEntries = DictionaryMatch.toMatchEntries({
      dictionaries,
      entries,
      codeLists,
      codings,
    });
    return new Map(
      matchEntries.map((entry) => {
        return [entry.entryId as string, entry];
      }),
    );
  }, [dictionaries, entries, codeLists, codings]);
  const { datasetsById } = datasets;
  const context = useMemo(() => {
    return { datasetsById, entriesById };
  }, [datasetsById, entriesById]);
  return {
    context,
    bindingsByDatasetId: bindings.bindingsByDatasetId,
    columnNameById: datasets.columnNameById,
    isLoading: datasets.isLoading || bindings.isLoading || contents.isLoading,
  };
}
```

`DictionaryBinding.T` has `datasetId` (the bindings table carries `dataset_id`, and `useApplyDictionariesData` filters it by `dataset_id`); confirm the field name with `grep -n "datasetId" shared/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding.types.ts` before running.

### Task 16: The crosswalk view shell: header, steps, saving, and delete

Replaces Task 14's placeholder with the real view: the permission gate, a new crosswalk versus a saved one, loading, not found, and failed states, and, once everything has loaded, the flow itself: the header band, the step bar, a hidden step heading that takes focus on a step change, and the current step. The three step bodies are placeholders here (`<div data-crosswalk-step="...">`), so the shell is testable on its own; Tasks 17, 22, and 23 replace one each in `CrosswalkStepBody.tsx`.

The step lives in the URL (`?step=` and `?layoutId=` on the `$crosswalkId` route), so Back and a reload keep it. A step the crosswalk cannot open yet falls back to **Choose datasets**: **Map each dataset** needs saved columns (a saved draft with at least one column), and **Create combined dataset** also needs a layout with a dataset. A new crosswalk lives on `/crosswalks/new` until its first save, which Task 17's **Next** makes after seeding the columns, so a new crosswalk abandoned on step 1 leaves no row behind (`rpc_crosswalks__save` would accept it earlier: it requires exactly one reference layout only once there are layouts). Next then calls `goToStep("map", layoutId)`, which moves the crosswalk to its own URL; the new route mounts the view again and reads the saved crosswalk back. Renaming a crosswalk that exists dispatches `renamed` and saves; renaming a new one only dispatches, and the name goes with the first save.

`useCrosswalkFlow` is what every step works through (contract note 4). Its `dispatch` runs the reducer once and keeps the result in a ref, and `dispatchAndSave`, `selectLayout`, and `goToStep` read that ref, so a step can write `await flow.dispatchAndSave(action); flow.goToStep(...)` in one handler and the save sends the draft after the action, and the navigation sees the crosswalk as saved. `useSaveCrosswalk` inserts the crosswalk row first for a new crosswalk (as its owner, like `createDictionaryFromDraft`), skipping the insert when a row with the draft's id is already there from an earlier failed attempt, and removes a row it just inserted when the contents save fails. It ignores a second press while one is in flight, refuses offline with the offline copy, explains a refusal from its hint, and shows no success toast: saves happen on every step change, and a toast each time would be noise. Delete lives in an overflow menu, coloured danger, behind a confirm, offered to the crosswalk's owner and to Data Sources admins, which matches the `crosswalks` delete policy.

Read first: `docs/design/app-view-layout.md` (a task view: header band with facts, no rail) and the Named Rules in `DESIGN.md`. The header, step bar, and step heading copy the create flow's (`NewDictionaryHeader`, `NewDictionaryStepper`, `NewDictionaryStepHeading`) and the dictionary view's editable name and actions menu (`DataDictionaryNameField`, `DataDictionaryActionsMenu`, `useCanDeleteDictionary`). None of this is a new surface, so `impeccable` is not loaded here; Task 17 loads it for the step bodies.

```ts
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import type { CrosswalkStep } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

/**
 * The name of each crosswalk step, as the step bar and its heading say it.
 * The last step is Update combined dataset once the crosswalk has one.
 */
export function useCrosswalkStepLabels(
  options: Readonly<{ hasCombinedDataset: boolean }>,
): Record<CrosswalkStep, string> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return {
    datasets: t`Choose datasets`,
    map: t`Map each dataset`,
    combine: options.hasCombinedDataset
      ? t`Update combined dataset`
      : t`Create combined dataset`,
  };
}
```

```tsx
import { Stepper } from "@mantine/core";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkStepper/CrosswalkStepper.module.css";
import type { CrosswalkStep } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

const STEPS: readonly CrosswalkStep[] = ["datasets", "map", "combine"];

type Props = {
  step: CrosswalkStep;
  labels: Record<CrosswalkStep, string>;
  /** The steps the crosswalk can open now; any other step does nothing. */
  reachableSteps: ReadonlySet<CrosswalkStep>;
  onStepClick: (step: CrosswalkStep) => void;
};

/**
 * The crosswalk's step bar: Choose datasets, Map each dataset, then Create
 * or Update combined dataset. Unlike the create flow's, a later step opens
 * as soon as the crosswalk can reach it, since a saved crosswalk is
 * revisited, not walked once.
 */
export function CrosswalkStepper({
  step,
  labels,
  reachableSteps,
  onStepClick,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const isSelectable = (item: CrosswalkStep): boolean => {
    return item !== step && reachableSteps.has(item);
  };
  return (
    <div className={css.crosswalkStepper}>
      <Stepper
        size="sm"
        active={STEPS.indexOf(step)}
        onStepClick={(index) => {
          const target = STEPS[index];
          if (target && isSelectable(target)) {
            onStepClick(target);
          }
        }}
      >
        {STEPS.map((item) => {
          return (
            <Stepper.Step
              key={item}
              label={labels[item]}
              allowStepSelect={isSelectable(item)}
            />
          );
        })}
      </Stepper>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Mantine 9's `Stepper` reads a step's boolean `allowStepSelect` before `allowNextStepsSelect` (`Stepper.mjs`, `shouldAllowSelect`), so each step's own flag decides.

`src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkStepHeading/CrosswalkStepHeading.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Title, VisuallyHidden } from "@mantine/core";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import type { CrosswalkStep } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  step: CrosswalkStep;
  labels: Record<CrosswalkStep, string>;
};

/**
 * The current step's name as a heading no one needs to see, since the step
 * bar shows it. When the step changes, focus moves here so keyboard and
 * screen reader users land at the top of the new step. It does not take
 * focus when the view first opens.
 */
export function CrosswalkStepHeading({ step, labels }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const headingRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const previousStepRef = useRef(step);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (previousStepRef.current !== step) {
      previousStepRef.current = step;
      headingRef.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [step]);

  return (
    <VisuallyHidden>
      <Title order={2} tabIndex={-1} ref={headingRef}>
        {labels[step]}
      </Title>
    </VisuallyHidden>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkErrorMessage/useCrosswalkErrorMessage.ts`.** Every save and combine hint from the contract gets copy; the ones a user can only cause by editing the crosswalk in two places at once share one line. `dataset_not_readable` covers two refusals: a membership whose dataset the user can no longer open, and a save that drops a layout still holding a membership the user cannot see (the drop would delete it). Its copy names neither, so it reads right for both.

```ts
import { getIsOnline } from "@avandar/browser-utils";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";

type ErrorHint = Crosswalk.SaveErrorHint | Crosswalk.CombineErrorHint;

/** The copy for each hint a crosswalk save or combine can refuse with. */
function useHintMessages(): Record<ErrorHint, string> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const sourceColumnName = Crosswalk.SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME;
  const changedElsewhere = t`This crosswalk changed while you were working on it. Reload the page and try again.`;
  return {
    crosswalk_editor_required: t`You need edit access to Data Sources to change this crosswalk.`,
    crosswalk_payload_invalid: changedElsewhere,
    crosswalk_name_required: t`Give the crosswalk a name.`,
    column_name_required: t`Every column of the combined dataset needs a name.`,
    column_names_not_unique: t`Two columns of the combined dataset have the same name, or one is named ${sourceColumnName}. Rename one of them.`,
    reference_layout_required: t`Choose a reference layout before saving.`,
    layout_signatures_not_unique: changedElsewhere,
    item_not_in_crosswalk: changedElsewhere,
    dataset_not_readable: t`This change involves a dataset you can't open, so nothing was saved. Ask for access to it, then try again.`,
    entry_not_in_workspace: t`A dictionary entry this crosswalk uses was deleted. Choose another entry for that column.`,
    mappings_not_unique: changedElsewhere,
    fill_invalid: t`One of the mappings is incomplete, so nothing was saved. Check how each column is filled and try again.`,
    combined_dataset_name_required: t`Give the combined dataset a name.`,
    combined_columns_invalid: t`The combined dataset needs at least one column, and no two columns can share a name.`,
    binding_column_missing: changedElsewhere,
    binding_not_in_workspace: t`A dictionary this crosswalk uses changed. Reload the page and try again.`,
    dataset_creator_required: t`Only workspace admins can add datasets.`,
    combined_dataset_mismatch: t`This crosswalk's combined dataset changed while you were working. Reload the page and try again.`,
    dataset_editor_required: t`You need edit access to the combined dataset to update it.`,
  };
}

/**
 * The toast for a refused crosswalk save or combine, from the RPC's hint,
 * or the offline message when the connection dropped.
 */
export function useCrosswalkErrorMessage(): (error: unknown) => string {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const messages = useHintMessages();
  const fallback = t`Nothing was saved. Please try again.`;
  const offline = t`You're offline. Reconnect to save this.`;
  return (error) => {
    if (!getIsOnline()) {
      return offline;
    }
    const hint = Crosswalk.toSaveErrorHint(error) ?? Crosswalk.toCombineErrorHint(error);
    return hint ? messages[hint] : fallback;
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Create the invalidation helper and the save hook.** `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/invalidateCrosswalkQueries.ts`:

```ts
import { CrosswalkClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkClient";
import { CrosswalkColumnClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumnClient";
import { CrosswalkDatasetClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkDatasetClient";
import { CrosswalkLayoutClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayoutClient";
import { CrosswalkMappingClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkMappingClient";
import type { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

/**
 * Marks every crosswalk query stale: the crosswalks list and each
 * crosswalk's five tables. Called after a crosswalk is saved or deleted.
 */
export async function invalidateCrosswalkQueries(
  queryClient: QueryClient,
): Promise<void> {
  await Promise.all(
    [
      CrosswalkClient,
      CrosswalkColumnClient,
      CrosswalkLayoutClient,
      CrosswalkDatasetClient,
      CrosswalkMappingClient,
    ].map((client) => {
      return queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: [client.getClientName()],
      });
    }),
  );
}
```

`src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useSaveCrosswalk/useSaveCrosswalk.ts`:

```ts
import { getIsOnline } from "@avandar/browser-utils";
import { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CrosswalkClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkClient";
import { useCurrentUserProfile } from "@/hooks/users/useCurrentUserProfile";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import { Logger } from "@/utils/Logger";
import { notifyError } from "@/utils/notifications/notify";
import { invalidateCrosswalkQueries } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/invalidateCrosswalkQueries";
import { useCrosswalkErrorMessage } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkErrorMessage/useCrosswalkErrorMessage";
import type { UserProfile } from "$/models/User/UserProfile";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";
import type { CrosswalkAction } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

/** Saves a draft whole; resolves true once it is saved. */
export type SaveCrosswalk = (draft: CrosswalkDraft.T) => Promise<boolean>;

type WriteOptions = Readonly<{
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
  owner: Readonly<Pick<UserProfile.T, "userId" | "profileId">>;
}>;

/** Creates the crosswalk row unless an earlier attempt already did. Resolves true when it created it. */
async function _insertUnlessPresent(options: WriteOptions): Promise<boolean> {
  const { draft } = options;
  const existing = await CrosswalkClient.getById({ id: draft.crosswalkId });
  if (existing) {
    return false;
  }
  await CrosswalkClient.insert({
    data: Model.make("Crosswalk", {
      id: draft.crosswalkId,
      workspaceId: options.workspaceId,
      ownerId: options.owner.userId,
      ownerProfileId: options.owner.profileId,
      name: draft.name.trim(),
      description: draft.description,
      codesOutputAs: draft.codesOutputAs,
      addsSourceColumn: draft.addsSourceColumn,
    }),
  });
  return true;
}

/**
 * Writes a draft: for a new crosswalk the row first, then the contents in
 * one RPC. When the contents fail, a row this call created is removed
 * again, so the crosswalks list never gains an empty crosswalk.
 */
async function _writeDraft(options: WriteOptions): Promise<void> {
  const { draft } = options;
  const isInserted = draft.isSaved ? false : await _insertUnlessPresent(options);
  try {
    await CrosswalkClient.saveContents(CrosswalkDraft.toSavePayload(draft));
  } catch (error) {
    if (isInserted) {
      await CrosswalkClient.delete({ id: draft.crosswalkId }).catch(
        (deleteError: unknown) => {
          Logger.error(deleteError, { devMsg: "Removing an unsaved crosswalk failed" });
        },
      );
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Saves the crosswalk's draft whole, then dispatches `saved` and marks the
 * crosswalk queries stale. A second save while one is in flight is
 * ignored, a save while offline says so and sends nothing, and a refusal
 * is explained from its hint. Never navigates: `useCrosswalkFlow` does.
 */
export function useSaveCrosswalk(
  dispatch: (action: CrosswalkAction) => void,
): [save: SaveCrosswalk, isSaving: boolean] {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const [userProfile] = useCurrentUserProfile();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const toErrorMessage = useCrosswalkErrorMessage();
  const isSavingRef = useRef(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const save: SaveCrosswalk = async (draft) => {
    if (isSavingRef.current || !userProfile) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!getIsOnline()) {
      notifyError(t`You're offline. Reconnect to save this.`);
      return false;
    }
    isSavingRef.current = true;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      await _writeDraft({ draft, workspaceId: workspace.id, owner: userProfile });
      dispatch({ type: "saved", draft: { ...draft, isSaved: true } });
      invalidateCrosswalkQueries(queryClient).catch((error: unknown) => {
        Logger.error(error, { devMsg: "Refreshing after a crosswalk save failed" });
      });
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      Logger.error(error, { devMsg: "Saving a crosswalk failed" });
      notifyError(toErrorMessage(error));
      return false;
    } finally {
      isSavingRef.current = false;
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };
  return [save, isSaving];
}
```

`Model.make("Crosswalk", ...)` passes `id` because the draft's id is the crosswalk's id from the start (the URL, every layout's `crosswalk_id`, and the save payload use it); Task 6's `CrosswalkModel["Insert"]` makes `id` optional (with `ownerId`, `description`, `codesOutputAs`, `addsSourceColumn`, and the managed `outputDatasetId`, `compiledAt`, `compiledCodeLists`), so it is accepted, and the managed columns are left out of the insert, as `crosswalks__guard_managed_columns` requires.

```tsx
    );
    expect(isCrosswalkDirty(result.current.state)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("opens another layout without saving when nothing changed", async () => {
    const state = makeSeededState();
    const { result } = _renderFlow({ draft: state.draft, isSaved: true });

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.selectLayout(getLayoutOf(state, KINGS_MARCH.id).id);
    });

    expect(mocks.savedDrafts).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(mocks.navigate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow.ts`:**

```ts
import { useNavigate, useSearch } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import {
  crosswalkReducer,
  isCrosswalkDirty,
  makeInitialCrosswalkState,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer";
import { useSaveCrosswalk } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useSaveCrosswalk/useSaveCrosswalk";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkState,
  CrosswalkStep,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { RefObject } from "react";

const STEPS: readonly CrosswalkStep[] = ["datasets", "map", "combine"];

/** Everything a crosswalk step reads and does. */
export type CrosswalkFlow = {
  state: CrosswalkState;
  /** Applies an action now; later reads of the flow see its result. */
  dispatch: (action: CrosswalkAction) => void;
  step: CrosswalkStep;
  /** The layout in the URL, if any; Map each dataset picks one when it is missing. */
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
  reachableSteps: ReadonlySet<CrosswalkStep>;
  /** Opens a step on the crosswalk's own URL. Does nothing before the first save. */
  goToStep: (step: CrosswalkStep, layoutId?: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => void;
  /**
   * Saves unsaved changes, then opens a layout in Map each dataset. The
   * layout opens even when the save fails; the changes stay unsaved.
   */
  selectLayout: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => Promise<void>;
  save: (draft: CrosswalkDraft.T) => Promise<boolean>;
  /** Applies an action, then saves the draft it produced. */
  dispatchAndSave: (action: CrosswalkAction) => Promise<boolean>;
  isSaving: boolean;
};

/**
 * The steps the crosswalk can open now. Map each dataset needs saved
 * columns; Create combined dataset also needs a layout with a dataset.
 */
export function getReachableSteps(state: CrosswalkState): ReadonlySet<CrosswalkStep> {
  const hasSavedColumns = (state.savedDraft?.columns.length ?? 0) > 0;
  const hasDataset = state.draft.layouts.some((layout) => {
    return layout.datasetIds.length > 0;
  });
  return new Set<CrosswalkStep>([
    "datasets",
    ...(hasSavedColumns ? (["map"] as const) : []),
    ...(hasSavedColumns && hasDataset ? (["combine"] as const) : []),
  ]);
}

/** The step and layout the URL names, ignoring anything else in it. */
function useFlowSearch(): {
  searchStep: CrosswalkStep | undefined;
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
} {
  // Not strict: the view also renders on `/crosswalks/new`, which has no search.
  const search = useSearch({ strict: false }) as { step?: unknown; layoutId?: unknown };
  return {
    searchStep: STEPS.find((step) => {
      return step === search.step;
    }),
    layoutId: typeof search.layoutId === "string" ? (search.layoutId as CrosswalkLayout.Id) : undefined,
  };
}

/**
 * The view's state, updated once per action. The reducer mints ids, so it
 * runs here rather than in `useReducer`, which may call it twice; the ref
 * lets async callers read the state after the last action.
 */
function useCrosswalkState(
  initialDraft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  isSaved: boolean,
): {
  state: CrosswalkState;
  stateRef: RefObject<CrosswalkState>;
  dispatch: (action: CrosswalkAction) => void;
} {
  const [state, setState] = useState(() => {
    return makeInitialCrosswalkState(initialDraft, { isSaved });
  });
  const stateRef = useRef(state);
  const dispatch = useCallback((action: CrosswalkAction) => {
    const nextState = crosswalkReducer(stateRef.current, action);
    stateRef.current = nextState;
    setState(nextState);
  }, []);
  return { state, stateRef, dispatch };
}

/**
 * The crosswalk view's state and navigation: the reducer, the step and
 * layout in the URL (falling back to Choose datasets for a step the
 * crosswalk cannot open yet), and saving. Every action that saves goes
 * through `dispatchAndSave`, so the save always sends the draft after it.
 */
export function useCrosswalkFlow(
  options: Readonly<{
    crosswalkId: Crosswalk.Id;
    initialDraft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
    isSaved: boolean;
  }>,
): CrosswalkFlow {
  const { state, stateRef, dispatch } = useCrosswalkState(options.initialDraft, options.isSaved);
  const [save, isSaving] = useSaveCrosswalk(dispatch);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const { searchStep, layoutId } = useFlowSearch();
  const reachableSteps = getReachableSteps(state);
  const goToStep = (step: CrosswalkStep, nextLayoutId?: CrosswalkLayout.Id): void => {
    const { draft } = stateRef.current;
    if (!draft.isSaved) {
      return;
    }
    const link = AppLinks.dataManagerCrosswalkView({
      workspaceSlug: workspace.slug,
      crosswalkId: options.crosswalkId,
      crosswalkName: draft.name,
      step,
      layoutId: nextLayoutId,
    });
    navigate({ to: link.to, params: link.params, search: link.search });
  };
  const dispatchAndSave = (action: CrosswalkAction): Promise<boolean> => {
    dispatch(action);
    return save(stateRef.current.draft);
  };
  const selectLayout = async (nextLayoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id): Promise<void> => {
    // A failed save (offline, refused) has already said why; the changes stay
    // in the draft and the next action saves them, so the layout still opens.
    if (isCrosswalkDirty(stateRef.current)) {
      await save(stateRef.current.draft);
    }
    goToStep("map", nextLayoutId);
  };
  const step = searchStep && reachableSteps.has(searchStep) ? searchStep : "datasets";
  return { state, dispatch, step, layoutId, reachableSteps, goToStep, selectLayout, save, dispatchAndSave, isSaving };
}
```

`useCrosswalkFlow` is 34 lines; if formatting spreads the returned object over one line per field and pushes it past 45, move `goToStep` into a `useGoToStep({ crosswalkId, stateRef })` hook in the same file that returns it.

```ts
/** A flow over `makeSeededState()` on Choose datasets, with `overrides` laid on top. */
export function makeCrosswalkFlow(overrides: Partial<CrosswalkFlow> = {}): CrosswalkFlow {
  return {
    state: makeSeededState(),

    }),
    dispatchAndSave: vi.fn(() => {
      return Promise.resolve(true);
    }),
    isSaving: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** A catalog over `CONTEXT` that has finished loading. */
export function makeCrosswalkCatalog(): CrosswalkCatalog {
  return {
    context: CONTEXT,
    bindingsByDatasetId: new Map(),
    columnNameById: new Map(),

  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Create the header.** `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCanDeleteCrosswalk.ts`:

```ts
import { useUserAppRoles } from "@/hooks/permissions/useUserAppRoles/useUserAppRoles";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/users/useCurrentUser";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";

/**
 * True when the current user may delete the crosswalk: its owner, or a Data
 * Sources admin. Matches the delete policy on `crosswalks`, which silently
 * deletes nothing for any other editor. False before the first save.
 */
export function useCanDeleteCrosswalk(crosswalk: Crosswalk.T | undefined): boolean {
  const user = useCurrentUser();
  const [roles] = useUserAppRoles();
  if (!crosswalk) {
    return false;
  }
  const isOwner = user?.id !== undefined && crosswalk.ownerId === user.id;
  return isOwner || roles?.data_sources === "admin";
}
```

`src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/useCrosswalkFacts.ts`:

```ts
import { plural } from "@lingui/core/macro";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CrosswalkContext } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

/**
 * The crosswalk header's facts: `Crosswalk · 100 datasets · 10 columns ·
 * Reference: <layout>`. The reference is named by its first dataset, and
 * left out until there is one.
 */
export function useCrosswalkFacts(
  options: Readonly<{ draft: CrosswalkDraft.T; context: CrosswalkContext }>,
): Array<string | undefined> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { draft, context } = options;
  const datasetCount = CrosswalkDraft.getDatasetIds(draft).length;
  const datasetsText = plural(datasetCount, { one: "# dataset", other: "# datasets" });
  const columnsText = plural(draft.columns.length, { one: "# column", other: "# columns" });
  const firstId = CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(draft)?.datasetIds[0];
  const layoutName = firstId ? context.datasetsById.get(firstId)?.name : undefined;
  return [
    t`Crosswalk`,
    datasetsText,
    columnsText,
    layoutName ? t`Reference: ${layoutName}` : undefined,
  ];
}
```

`src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/CrosswalkNameField/CrosswalkNameField.tsx`:

```tsx
import { EditableDisplayText } from "@avandar/ui";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  flow: CrosswalkFlow;
};

/**
 * The crosswalk's name as inline-editable text. A crosswalk that exists is
 * saved on rename; a new one keeps the name for its first save, since a
 * crosswalk cannot be saved before it has a reference layout.
 */
export function CrosswalkNameField({ flow }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { draft } = flow.state;
  const [name, setName] = useState(draft.name);
  useEffect(() => {
    setName(draft.name);
  }, [draft.name]);

  return (
    <EditableDisplayText
      name={t`crosswalk name`}
      value={name}
      onChange={setName}
      onSave={(newName) => {
        const action = { type: "renamed", name: newName.trim() } as const;
        if (draft.isSaved) {
          void flow.dispatchAndSave(action);
          return;
        }
        flow.dispatch(action);
      }}
      onCancel={() => {
        setName(draft.name);
      }}
      isSaving={flow.isSaving}
      isSaveDisabled={name.trim().length === 0}
      emptyDisplayText={t`Untitled crosswalk`}
      displayTextProps={{ fz: "inherit", fw: "inherit", m: 0 }}
      fz="inherit"
      fw="inherit"
    />
  );
}
```

`src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/CrosswalkActionsMenu/CrosswalkActionsMenu.tsx`:

```tsx
import { ActionIcon } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Menu, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { modals } from "@mantine/modals";
import { IconDotsVertical, IconTrash } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { CrosswalkClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkClient";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { POPOVER_Z_INDEX } from "@/config/Theme";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { Logger } from "@/utils/Logger";
import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from "@/utils/notifications/notify";
import { invalidateCrosswalkQueries } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/invalidateCrosswalkQueries";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  crosswalk: Crosswalk.T;
  /** The combined dataset's name, when there is one the user can see. */
  combinedDatasetName: string | undefined;
};

/** Returns an opener for the delete confirmation of a crosswalk. */
function useDeleteCrosswalk({ crosswalk, combinedDatasetName }: Readonly<Props>): () => void {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const crosswalkName = crosswalk.name;
  const [deleteCrosswalk] = CrosswalkClient.useDelete({
    onSuccess: () => {
      invalidateCrosswalkQueries(queryClient).catch((error: unknown) => {
        Logger.error(error, { devMsg: "Refreshing after a crosswalk delete failed" });
      });
      navigate(AppLinks.dataManagerHome(workspace.slug));
      notifySuccess({
        title: t`Crosswalk deleted`,
        message: t`${crosswalkName} was deleted.`,
      });
    },
    onError: () => {
      notifyError(
        t`The crosswalk could not be deleted. Please try again or reach out to support.`,
      );
    },
  });
  return () => {
    modals.openConfirmModal({
      title: t`Delete crosswalk`,
      children: (
        <Text>
          {combinedDatasetName ? (
            <Trans>
              Delete {crosswalkName}? Its mappings are deleted. {combinedDatasetName} stays,
              but stops updating.
            </Trans>
          ) : (
            <Trans>Delete {crosswalkName}? Its mappings are deleted.</Trans>
          )}
        </Text>
      ),
      labels: { confirm: t`Delete`, cancel: t`Cancel` },
      confirmProps: { color: "danger" },
      onConfirm: () => {
        deleteCrosswalk({ id: crosswalk.id });
      },
    });
  };
}

/** Actions on a whole crosswalk that are not what someone came to do. */
export function CrosswalkActionsMenu(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const onDelete = useDeleteCrosswalk(props);
  return (
    <Menu position="bottom-end" width={230} zIndex={POPOVER_Z_INDEX}>
      <Menu.Target>
        <ActionIcon
          variant="default"
          color="neutral"
          tooltip={t`More crosswalk actions`}
          aria-label={t`More crosswalk actions`}
        >
          <IconDotsVertical size={16} />
        </ActionIcon>
      </Menu.Target>
      <Menu.Dropdown>
        <Menu.Item color="danger" leftSection={<IconTrash size={16} />} onClick={onDelete}>
          <Trans>Delete crosswalk</Trans>
        </Menu.Item>
      </Menu.Dropdown>
    </Menu>
  );
}
```

A Lingui `<Trans>` keeps the message on one line in the catalog regardless of how `oxfmt` wraps the JSX text, so the first message extracts as "Delete {crosswalkName}? Its mappings are deleted. {combinedDatasetName} stays, but stops updating.", which is what the test asserts.

```tsx
import { CrosswalkActionsMenu } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/CrosswalkActionsMenu/CrosswalkActionsMenu";
import { CrosswalkNameField } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/CrosswalkNameField/CrosswalkNameField";
import { useCrosswalkFacts } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/useCrosswalkFacts";
import { useCanDeleteCrosswalk } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCanDeleteCrosswalk";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { CrosswalkContext } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** The saved crosswalk row; undefined before the first save. */
  crosswalk: Crosswalk.T | undefined;
  flow: CrosswalkFlow;
  context: CrosswalkContext;
};

/**
 * The crosswalk's header band: its editable name, the facts that identify
 * it, and the actions on the whole crosswalk. Deleting is offered to the
 * owner and to Data Sources admins, once there is a crosswalk to delete.
 */
export function CrosswalkHeader({ crosswalk, flow, context }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const facts = useCrosswalkFacts({ draft: flow.state.draft, context });
  const canDelete = useCanDeleteCrosswalk(crosswalk);
  const outputDatasetId = crosswalk?.outputDatasetId;
  const combinedDatasetName = outputDatasetId
    ? context.datasetsById.get(outputDatasetId)?.name
    : undefined;
  return (
    <AppViewHeader
      title={<CrosswalkNameField flow={flow} />}
      facts={facts}
      actions={
        crosswalk && canDelete ? (
          <CrosswalkActionsMenu crosswalk={crosswalk} combinedDatasetName={combinedDatasetName} />
        ) : undefined
      }
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { AppView } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppView";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import { CrosswalkHeader } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/CrosswalkHeader";
import { CrosswalkStepBody } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkStepBody";
import { CrosswalkStepHeading } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkStepHeading/CrosswalkStepHeading";
import { CrosswalkStepper } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkStepper/CrosswalkStepper";
import { useCrosswalkCatalog } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkCatalog/useCrosswalkCatalog";
import { useCrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";
import { useCrosswalkStepLabels } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkStepLabels/useCrosswalkStepLabels";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** The saved crosswalk row; undefined for a new crosswalk. */
  crosswalk: Crosswalk.T | undefined;
  /** The draft the view starts from. Later changes to it are ignored. */
  initialDraft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  isSaved: boolean;
};

/**
 * The crosswalk once everything it reads has loaded: the header with its
 * facts and actions, the step bar, and the current step. Opening Map each
 * dataset from the step bar keeps the layout in the URL.
 */
export function CrosswalkFlowView({ crosswalk, initialDraft, isSaved }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const flow = useCrosswalkFlow({ crosswalkId: initialDraft.crosswalkId, initialDraft, isSaved });
  const { draft } = flow.state;
  const catalog = useCrosswalkCatalog(CrosswalkDraft.getDatasetIds(draft));
  const labels = useCrosswalkStepLabels({
    hasCombinedDataset: (crosswalk?.outputDatasetId ?? draft.outputDatasetId) !== undefined,
  });
  return (
    <AppView>
      <CrosswalkHeader crosswalk={crosswalk} flow={flow} context={catalog.context} />
      <CrosswalkStepper
        step={flow.step}
        labels={labels}
        reachableSteps={flow.reachableSteps}
        onStepClick={(step) => {
          flow.goToStep(step, step === "map" ? flow.layoutId : undefined);
        }}
      />
      <CrosswalkStepHeading step={flow.step} labels={labels} />
      <CrosswalkStepBody flow={flow} catalog={catalog} crosswalk={crosswalk} />
    </AppView>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Callout } from "@avandar/ui";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Center, Loader } from "@mantine/core";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { uuid } from "$/lib/uuid";
import { AppView } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppView";
import { useHasPermission } from "@/hooks/permissions/useHasPermission/useHasPermission";
import { useUserAppRoles } from "@/hooks/permissions/useUserAppRoles/useUserAppRoles";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import { CrosswalkFlowView } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkFlowView/CrosswalkFlowView";
import { CrosswalkNoAccess } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkNoAccess";
import { useCrosswalkCatalog } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkCatalog/useCrosswalkCatalog";
import { useCrosswalkContents } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkContents/useCrosswalkContents";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** Undefined for a new crosswalk. */
  crosswalkId: Crosswalk.Id | undefined;
};

function CrosswalkLoading({ label }: Readonly<{ label: string }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <AppView>
      <Center flex={1} p="lg">
        <Loader size="sm" role="status" aria-label={label} />
      </Center>
    </AppView>
  );
}

function CrosswalkUnavailable(props: Readonly<{ title: string; message: string }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <AppView>
      <Center flex={1} p="lg">
        <Callout maw={520} title={props.title} message={props.message} />
      </Center>
    </AppView>
  );
}

/** A crosswalk that does not exist yet, saved for the first time from Choose datasets. */
function NewCrosswalk(): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const [initialDraft] = useState(() => {
    return CrosswalkDraft.makeEmpty({
      crosswalkId: uuid<Crosswalk.Id>(),
      name: t`Untitled crosswalk`,
    });
  });
  return <CrosswalkFlowView crosswalk={undefined} initialDraft={initialDraft} isSaved={false} />;
}

/** A saved crosswalk, opened once its tables and the datasets it maps have loaded. */
function SavedCrosswalk({ crosswalkId }: Readonly<{ crosswalkId: Crosswalk.Id }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { status, contents } = useCrosswalkContents(crosswalkId);
  const datasetIds = useMemo(() => {
    return (contents?.datasets ?? []).map((membership) => {
      return membership.datasetId;
    });
  }, [contents]);
  const catalog = useCrosswalkCatalog(datasetIds);
  const { datasetsById } = catalog.context;
  const initialDraft = useMemo(() => {
    return contents && !catalog.isLoading
      ? CrosswalkDraft.fromContents(contents, { datasetsById })
      : undefined;
  }, [contents, catalog.isLoading, datasetsById]);
  if (status === "failed") {
    return (
      <CrosswalkUnavailable
        title={t`Crosswalk failed to load`}
        message={t`The crosswalk failed to load. Please try again later or reach out to support.`}
      />
    );
  }
  if (status === "missing") {
    return (
      <CrosswalkUnavailable
        title={t`This crosswalk no longer exists`}
        message={t`It may have been deleted. Open another one from Data Sources.`}
      />
    );
  }
  if (!contents || !initialDraft) {
    return <CrosswalkLoading label={t`Loading the crosswalk`} />;
  }
  return <CrosswalkFlowView crosswalk={contents.crosswalk} initialDraft={initialDraft} isSaved />;
}

/**
 * A crosswalk: many datasets with different column layouts mapped onto one
 * reference layout, one layout at a time, and saved as a combined dataset.
 * Opened from Data Sources' New crosswalk or its Crosswalks list. Only
 * someone who can edit crosswalks gets in, and nothing is read before that
 * is checked.
 */
export function CrosswalkView({ crosswalkId }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const [, areRolesLoading] = useUserAppRoles();
  const canEditCrosswalks = useHasPermission("data_sources__can_edit_crosswalks");
  if (areRolesLoading) {
    return <CrosswalkLoading label={t`Checking your access`} />;
  }
  if (!canEditCrosswalks) {
    return <CrosswalkNoAccess />;
  }
  return crosswalkId ? <SavedCrosswalk crosswalkId={crosswalkId} /> : <NewCrosswalk />;
}
```

`SavedCrosswalk` keeps `CrosswalkFlowView` mounted through background refetches: `useCrosswalkContents` stays `ready` once every table has fetched since mount (`isFetchedAfterMount` stays true during a refetch), and the catalog's `isLoading` is about missing data, not fetching. A new `initialDraft` from a refetch reaches the flow as a prop the flow ignores, so a save's own refetch never resets the user's work.

---

### Task 17: Choose datasets

Step 1 of the crosswalk: the user adds the datasets to combine, sees them grouped into layouts (datasets with the same column names, ignoring case and order), picks the reference layout whose columns seed the combined dataset, and presses **Next**. Pressing Next for the first time seeds the combined dataset's columns from the reference dataset (`columns_seeded`), saves, and moves to step 2. After that it saves when anything changed and moves on.

Load the `impeccable` skill before this task: the three crosswalk steps are new surfaces. Run `.claude/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable context --target src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/ChooseDatasetsStep.tsx` once, follow `reference/new-work.md`, and read `reference/craft-floor.md` right before editing UI. Direction: an **Operate** surface in the Data Sources world. The controls are the product's own (Mantine `Table`, `Select`, `Button`, `Badge`, `ActionIcon`, the shared `Modal` from `@avandar/ui`, `AppSlateEmptyState`, `AppViewSection`), neutral by default, with Brand Blue only on the primary action and the Reference tag. There are no new tokens, no `Paper` inside the slate, and no info `Callout`. Read `docs/design/app-view-layout.md` and DESIGN.md's Named Rules first. A task flow gets no rail.

Design decisions a reader could question:

- **Removing a dataset happens in an expandable row, not a per-layout menu.** One layout can hold 23 datasets. A menu of 23 "Remove" items is hard to scan, and it hides which datasets were grouped together, which is exactly what this step must let the user check. Each layout row's **Datasets** cell is a disclosure button ("2 datasets", `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`). It opens a full-width row listing the datasets, each with a **Remove {datasetName}** icon button. That is one native pattern with no menu, and it keeps three semantic table columns.
- **The Reference layout Select is `readOnly`, not `disabled`, once it is locked.** A disabled input drops out of the tab order, so a keyboard user would never hear why it cannot change. A read-only one stays focusable and announces its description ("You confirmed mappings against this layout, so the reference can't change.").
- **`AddDatasetsModal` reuses `PickDatasetsTable`**, which gains four optional props: `lockedDatasetIds` (shown checked and disabled: the datasets already in the crosswalk), `unavailableDatasetIds` with `unavailableReason` (shown unchecked and disabled, the reason under the name: datasets with no columns), and `emptyMessage`. The modal lists only datasets in `context.datasetsById` (the reducer reads their columns), never the crosswalk's own combined dataset.
- **The step takes `CrosswalkStepProps` (`{ flow, catalog, crosswalk }`)** and replaces the `datasets` placeholder in `CrosswalkStepBody.tsx` (Task 16). Every save goes through the flow. Next on a crosswalk with no columns awaits `flow.dispatchAndSave({ type: "columns_seeded", ... })`, which is also a new crosswalk's first save, so the draft saved is the one the reducer produced. Next on a crosswalk with columns awaits `flow.save(flow.state.draft)` when it is dirty. Either way it calls `flow.goToStep("map", layoutId)` only when the save resolved `true`, and `goToStep` moves a new crosswalk to its own URL because the first save has already marked the flow's draft saved.
- **A dataset with no columns is listed disabled** in Add datasets, with "This dataset has no columns yet." under its name. It cannot form a layout (the save refuses a layout with no column names, and `datasets_added` skips it), and showing it with the reason tells the user why it is missing rather than hiding it.
- **`holdsLabels` for a reference binding** is true when the binding is `reference` with `direction: "encode"` (the column holds labels), or `convert` with `direction: "decode"` (the dataset's view shows labels, and the crosswalk reads the view).

- [ ] **Step 1: Fixtures shared by the step tests.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/__tests__/crosswalkSteps.fixtures.ts`. It builds on Task 15's `crosswalk.fixtures.ts`: the datasets (Bronx, Kings March and April, Queens), the crosswalk id, and the sex entry come from there, and this file adds only what that one lacks, hand-built drafts, so step tests do not depend on scorer outcomes. Layout keys and signatures come from the real `CrosswalkLayout` module (Task 8). Bronx is the reference, as in `makeAddedState`. No name here is exported by `crosswalk.fixtures.ts`.

```ts
import { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import {
  BRONX,
  CROSSWALK_ID,
  KINGS_APRIL,
  KINGS_MARCH,
  SEX_CODES_ID,
  SEX_ENTRY_ID,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/__tests__/crosswalk.fixtures";
import { makeInitialCrosswalkState } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CrosswalkState } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

/** A catalog dataset as the workspace's dataset list returns it. */
export function toDatasetRecord(dataset: CrosswalkLayout.Dataset): Dataset.T {
  return Model.make("Dataset", {
    id: dataset.id,
    name: dataset.name,
    sourceType: "csv_file",
    workspaceId:
      "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" as Dataset.T["workspaceId"],
    ownerId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003" as Dataset.T["ownerId"],
    ownerProfileId:
      "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004" as Dataset.T["ownerProfileId"],
    createdAt: "2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    updatedAt: "2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    dateOfLastSync: undefined,
    description: undefined,
    isRestricted: false,
  });
}

export const BRONX_LAYOUT_ID =
  "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" as CrosswalkLayout.Id;
export const KINGS_LAYOUT_ID =
  "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002" as CrosswalkLayout.Id;

/** A layout of `datasets`, named by its first dataset's columns. */
function _layout(
  id: CrosswalkLayout.Id,
  datasets: readonly CrosswalkLayout.Dataset[],
  options: { isReference: boolean; status: CrosswalkLayout.Status },
): CrosswalkDraft.Layout {
  const columnNames = (datasets[0]?.columns ?? []).map((column) => {
    return column.name;
  });
  return {
    id,
    key: CrosswalkLayout.buildLayoutKey(columnNames),
    signature: CrosswalkLayout.buildSignature(columnNames),
    columnNames,
    isReference: options.isReference,
    status: options.status,
    datasetIds: datasets.map((dataset) => {
      return dataset.id;
    }),
  };
}

/** The reference layout: Bronx alone (case_id, sex, county). */
export const BRONX_LAYOUT = _layout(BRONX_LAYOUT_ID, [BRONX], {
  isReference: true,
  status: "mapped",
});

/**
 * Kings March and April, which share a layout. Its column names are
 * March's (`case_id`); April spells that column `CASE_ID`.
 */
export const KINGS_LAYOUT = _layout(
  KINGS_LAYOUT_ID,
  [KINGS_MARCH, KINGS_APRIL],
  { isReference: false, status: "review" },
);

function _column(
  index: number,
  name: string,
  dataType: CrosswalkDraft.Column["dataType"],
  entryId?: DataDictionaryEntry.Id,
): CrosswalkDraft.Column {
  return {
    id: `50000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000${index}` as CrosswalkColumn.Id,
    name,
    position: index,
    dataType,
    entryId,
  };
}

export const CASE_COLUMN = _column(0, "case_id", "varchar");
export const SEX_COLUMN = _column(1, "sex", "varchar", SEX_ENTRY_ID);
export const COUNTY_COLUMN = _column(2, "county", "varchar");
/** A column the user added: Bronx has no onset date. */
export const ONSET_COLUMN = _column(3, "rash_onset_date", "date");
/** Seeded from Bronx, then the added onset date. */
export const COLUMNS = [CASE_COLUMN, SEX_COLUMN, COUNTY_COLUMN, ONSET_COLUMN];

/** A `column` fill reading `sourceColumn`, with any field overridden. */
export function makeColumnFill(
  sourceColumn: string,
  overrides: Partial<Extract<CrosswalkMapping.Fill, { kind: "column" }>> = {},
): CrosswalkMapping.Fill {
  return {
    kind: "column",
    sourceColumn,
    convert: undefined,
    codeListId: undefined,
    holdsLabels: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

let mappingCount = 0;

/** A confirmed mapping with a fresh id, with any field overridden. */
export function makeMapping(
  fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill,
  overrides: Partial<Omit<CrosswalkDraft.Mapping, "id" | "fill">> = {},
): CrosswalkDraft.Mapping {
  mappingCount += 1;
  const suffix = String(mappingCount).padStart(12, "0");
  return {
    id: `60000000-0000-4000-8000-${suffix}` as CrosswalkMapping.Id,
    fill,
    status: "confirmed",
    confidence: undefined,
    reason: undefined,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function _baseDraft(): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  return {
    crosswalkId: CROSSWALK_ID,
    isSaved: true,
    name: "Measles line lists",
    description: undefined,
    codesOutputAs: "labels",
    addsSourceColumn: true,
    outputDatasetId: undefined,
    columns: [],
    layouts: [],
    mappings: {},
  };
}

/** A saved crosswalk with no dataset yet. */
export function makeEmptyDraft(
  overrides: Partial<CrosswalkDraft.T> = {},
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  return { ..._baseDraft(), ...overrides };
}

/** Bronx (the reference) and Kings, with no columns seeded yet. */
export function makeLayoutsDraft(
  overrides: Partial<CrosswalkDraft.T> = {},
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  return {
    ..._baseDraft(),
    layouts: [BRONX_LAYOUT, { ...KINGS_LAYOUT, status: "to_do" }],
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/**
 * Columns seeded from Bronx plus the added onset date, identity fills on
 * Bronx, and on Kings: a confirmed name match, a suggested code
 * translation, a date read, and county not filled yet.
 */
export function makeMappedDraft(
  overrides: Partial<CrosswalkDraft.T> = {},
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  return {
    ..._baseDraft(),
    columns: COLUMNS,
    layouts: [BRONX_LAYOUT, KINGS_LAYOUT],
    mappings: {
      [BRONX_LAYOUT_ID]: {
        [CASE_COLUMN.id]: makeMapping(makeColumnFill("case_id")),
        [SEX_COLUMN.id]: makeMapping(
          makeColumnFill("sex", { codeListId: SEX_CODES_ID }),
        ),
        [COUNTY_COLUMN.id]: makeMapping(makeColumnFill("county")),
      },
      [KINGS_LAYOUT_ID]: {
        [CASE_COLUMN.id]: makeMapping(makeColumnFill("case_id"), {
          reason: "name_and_type",
          confidence: 1,
        }),
        [SEX_COLUMN.id]: makeMapping(
          makeColumnFill("GENDER", { codeListId: SEX_CODES_ID }),
          { status: "suggested", reason: "same_values", confidence: 0.91 },
        ),
        [ONSET_COLUMN.id]: makeMapping(
          makeColumnFill("onset_dt", {
            convert: { kind: "parse_date", format: "%m/%d/%Y" },
          }),
        ),
      },
    },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/**
 * The reducer's starting state for `draft` (saved as it is when the draft
 * is saved), with any field overridden.
 */
export function makeStateFromDraft(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  overrides: Partial<CrosswalkState> = {},
): CrosswalkState {
  return {
    ...makeInitialCrosswalkState(draft, { isSaved: draft.isSaved }),
    ...overrides,
  };
}
```

Step tests build their flow with `makeCrosswalkFlow({ state: makeStateFromDraft(draft) })` and their catalog with `makeCrosswalkCatalog()`, both from `crosswalk.fixtures.ts` (Task 16).

- [ ] **Step 3: The layout name, three ways.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/getLayoutLabel.ts`:

```ts
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";

/** What a layout is called, as data a component translates. */
export type LayoutLabel = {
  /**
   * The name of the layout's first dataset by name. Undefined when the
   * layout holds no dataset, which only the reference layout can. Empty
   * while the catalog that names it is still loading.
   */
  firstDatasetName: string | undefined;
  /** How many other datasets share the layout. */
  otherDatasetCount: number;
};

/**
 * A layout has no name of its own: it is called after its first dataset,
 * with a count of the other datasets that share its columns.
 */
export function getLayoutLabel(
  layout: Pick<CrosswalkDraft.Layout, "datasetIds">,
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>,
): LayoutLabel {
  const [firstDatasetId] = layout.datasetIds;
  return {
    firstDatasetName: firstDatasetId
      ? (datasetsById.get(firstDatasetId)?.name ?? "")
      : undefined,
    otherDatasetCount: Math.max(layout.datasetIds.length - 1, 0),
  };
}
```

Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/useLayoutNamer.ts`:

```ts
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { getLayoutLabel } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/getLayoutLabel";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";

/**
 * A function giving each layout's name as one translated string, for a
 * Select option or an accessible name, where the two-line `LayoutName`
 * does not fit.
 */
export function useLayoutNamer(
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>,
): (layout: Pick<CrosswalkDraft.Layout, "datasetIds">) => string {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return (layout) => {
    return (
      getLayoutLabel(layout, datasetsById).firstDatasetName ??
      t`No datasets left`
    );
  };
}
```

Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/LayoutName.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Plural, Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { getLayoutLabel } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/getLayoutLabel";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  layout: Pick<CrosswalkDraft.Layout, "datasetIds">;
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
  /** The id other controls point at to say which layout they act on. */
  nameId?: string;
};

/**
 * A layout's name: its first dataset's name, and under it "+{count} with
 * the same layout" when other datasets share it.
 */
export function LayoutName({
  layout,
  datasetsById,
  nameId,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { firstDatasetName, otherDatasetCount } = getLayoutLabel(
    layout,
    datasetsById,
  );
  return (
    <Stack gap={0} miw={0}>
      <Text id={nameId} size="sm" fw={500} truncate>
        {firstDatasetName ?? <Trans>No datasets left</Trans>}
      </Text>
      {otherDatasetCount > 0 ? (
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
          <Plural
            value={otherDatasetCount}
            one="+# with the same layout"
            other="+# with the same layout"
          />
        </Text>
      ) : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";

]);

function _binding(

): DictionaryBinding.T {

/** A loaded catalog holding Bronx's sex binding. */

}

function _renderSeed(flow: CrosswalkFlow, catalog: CrosswalkCatalog = _catalog()) {

describe("buildReferenceBindings", () => {
  it("says which bound columns the crosswalk reads as labels", () => {
    const bindings = buildReferenceBindings({

      ["zip", false],

      columnNameById: COLUMN_NAME_BY_ID,
      bindings: [_binding("sex", { entryId: undefined }), _binding("gone")],

    expect(flow.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(state.draft);
    expect(flow.goToStep).toHaveBeenCalledWith("map", KINGS_LAYOUT_ID);

  it("moves on without saving when nothing changed", async () => {
    const flow = makeCrosswalkFlow({ state: makeStateFromDraft(makeMappedDraft()) });
    const { result } = _renderSeed(flow);

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.continueToMapping();
    });

    expect(flow.dispatchAndSave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(flow.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(flow.goToStep).toHaveBeenCalledWith("map", KINGS_LAYOUT_ID);
  });

  it("is not ready to seed while the catalog loads or with no reference dataset", async () => {
    const loading = makeCrosswalkFlow({ state: makeStateFromDraft(makeLayoutsDraft()) });
    const { result } = _renderSeed(loading, _catalog({ isLoading: true }));

      ),

    expect(_renderSeed(emptyReference).result.current.isReady).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Seeding and moving on.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/useSeedColumns/useSeedColumns.ts`:

```ts
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import { useIsMounted } from "@/lib/hooks/state/useIsMounted";
import { isCrosswalkDirty } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { ReferenceColumnBinding } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { CrosswalkCatalog } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkCatalog/useCrosswalkCatalog";
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";

/** What Next on the Choose datasets step needs, and the action itself. */
export type SeedColumns = {
  /** False while seeding cannot run yet: the catalog is loading or the reference has no dataset. */
  isReady: boolean;
  isWorking: boolean;
  /** Seeds the columns when there are none, saves, and opens step 2. */
  continueToMapping: () => Promise<void>;
};

type SeedOptions = Readonly<{ flow: CrosswalkFlow; catalog: CrosswalkCatalog }>;

/**
 * The reference dataset's bindings by the name of the column each one
 * binds, as `columns_seeded` reads them. The crosswalk reads the dataset's
 * view, so `holdsLabels` is true for a reference binding that encodes (the
 * column holds labels) and for a convert binding that decodes (the view
 * shows labels). A binding whose entry was deleted, or whose column the
 * catalog no longer has, is skipped.
 */
export function buildReferenceBindings(
  options: Readonly<{
    bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[];
    /** Every dataset column's name, by its id (`CrosswalkCatalog.columnNameById`). */
    columnNameById: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
  }>,
): Map<string, ReferenceColumnBinding> {
  return new Map(
    options.bindings.flatMap((binding) => {
      const columnName = options.columnNameById.get(binding.datasetColumnId);
      if (!columnName || !binding.entryId) {
        return [];
      }
      const holdsLabels =
        binding.mode === "reference"
          ? binding.direction === "encode"
          : binding.direction === "decode";
      return [
        [
          columnName,
          { entryId: binding.entryId, codeListId: binding.codeListId, holdsLabels },
        ] as const,
      ];
    }),
  );
}

/**
 * The layout step 2 opens on: the first layout that is not the reference
 * and is still To do or Review, otherwise the reference layout.
 */
export function getFirstLayoutToMap(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
): CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined {
  const toMap = draft.layouts.find((layout) => {
    return (
      !layout.isReference &&
      (layout.status === "to_do" || layout.status === "review")
    );
  });
  return (toMap ?? CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(draft))?.id;
}

/**
 * Saves what Next needs saved. With no columns it seeds them from the
 * reference dataset through `dispatchAndSave`, so the draft saved is the
 * one the reducer produced (for a new crosswalk this is its first save).
 * With columns it saves the draft when it changed. Resolves whether the
 * crosswalk is saved.
 */
function _saveForMapping(
  options: SeedOptions,
  referenceDatasetId: Dataset.Id | undefined,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const { flow, catalog } = options;
  if (flow.state.draft.columns.length === 0) {
    const bindings = referenceDatasetId
      ? (catalog.bindingsByDatasetId.get(referenceDatasetId) ?? [])
      : [];
    return flow.dispatchAndSave({
      type: "columns_seeded",
      bindingsByColumnName: buildReferenceBindings({
        bindings,
        columnNameById: catalog.columnNameById,
      }),
      context: catalog.context,
    });
  }
  return isCrosswalkDirty(flow.state)
    ? flow.save(flow.state.draft)
    : Promise.resolve(true);
}

/**
 * Next on the Choose datasets step. The first time, the combined dataset's
 * columns are seeded from the reference dataset: one per column, named and
 * typed as there, governed where the reference column has a binding. Then
 * it opens step 2 on the first layout to map, but only when the save
 * resolved true; `goToStep` moves a crosswalk saved for the first time to
 * its own URL. A second press while the first is working does nothing.
 */
export function useSeedColumns(options: SeedOptions): SeedColumns {
  const { flow, catalog } = options;
  const [isWorking, setIsWorking] = useState(false);
  const isWorkingRef = useRef(false);
  const isMountedRef = useIsMounted();
  const { draft } = flow.state;
  const referenceDatasetId = CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(draft)?.datasetIds[0];
  const isReady =
    draft.columns.length > 0 ||
    (!catalog.isLoading && referenceDatasetId !== undefined);
  const continueToMapping = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (isWorkingRef.current || !isReady) {
      return;
    }
    isWorkingRef.current = true;
    setIsWorking(true);
    const layoutId = getFirstLayoutToMap(draft);
    const isSaved = await _saveForMapping(options, referenceDatasetId);
    isWorkingRef.current = false;
    if (!isMountedRef.current) {
      return;
    }
    setIsWorking(false);
    if (isSaved) {
      flow.goToStep("map", layoutId);
    }
  };
  return { isReady, isWorking, continueToMapping };
}
```

`useSeedColumns` is 28 lines. The layout to open is picked before the save: seeding never adds, removes, or reorders layouts, and it leaves mapped and skipped layouts as they were, so the pick is the same afterwards. Run the test. Expected: PASS.

```tsx
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Checkbox, Group, Table, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "react";
import { useDatasetSourceLabels } from "@/hooks/datasets/useDatasetSourceLabels";
import { DatasetSourceIcon } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetSourceIcon";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/PickDatasetsStep/PickDatasetsStep.module.css";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  dataset: Dataset.T;
  columnCount: number;
  isPicked: boolean;
  /**
   * Shown picked and cannot be unpicked, such as a dataset a crosswalk
   * already holds.
   */
  isLocked?: boolean;
  /**
   * Why the dataset cannot be picked. When set, the row shows unpicked and
   * disabled, with this under the name.
   */
  unavailableReason?: ReactNode;
  onToggle: (datasetId: Dataset.Id) => void;
};

/**
 * One dataset on the Pick step. Clicking anywhere on the row picks it. The
 * checkbox stays the keyboard and screen reader control, and its own click
 * does not reach the row, so one click is one toggle. A locked row shows as
 * picked and does nothing on click; an unavailable row shows its reason and
 * does nothing on click.
 */
export function PickDatasetRow({
  dataset,
  columnCount,
  isPicked,
  isLocked = false,
  unavailableReason,
  onToggle,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  const sourceLabels = useDatasetSourceLabels();
  const reasonId = useId();
  const datasetName = dataset.name;
  const isUnavailable = unavailableReason !== undefined;
  const isDisabled = isLocked || isUnavailable;

  return (
    <Table.Tr
      className={css.pickDatasetRow}
      data-locked={isDisabled || undefined}
      onClick={() => {
        if (!isDisabled) {
          onToggle(dataset.id);
        }
      }}
    >
      <Table.Td>
        <Checkbox
          aria-label={t`Pick ${datasetName}`}
          aria-describedby={isUnavailable ? reasonId : undefined}
          checked={!isUnavailable && (isPicked || isLocked)}
          disabled={isDisabled}
          onClick={(event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
          }}
          onChange={() => {
            onToggle(dataset.id);
          }}
        />
      </Table.Td>
      <Table.Td>
        <Text size="sm" fw={500} c={isUnavailable ? "dimmed" : undefined}>
          {datasetName}
        </Text>
        {isUnavailable ? (
          <Text id={reasonId} size="xs" c="dimmed">
            {unavailableReason}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </Table.Td>
      <Table.Td>
        <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">
          <DatasetSourceIcon sourceType={dataset.sourceType} />
          <Text size="sm">{sourceLabels[dataset.sourceType]}</Text>
        </Group>
      </Table.Td>
      <Table.Td ta="right">
        <Text size="sm">{i18n.number(columnCount)}</Text>
      </Table.Td>
    </Table.Tr>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Table, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { PickDatasetRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/PickDatasetsStep/PickDatasetRow";
import { PickDatasetsTableHead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/PickDatasetsStep/PickDatasetsTableHead";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  datasets: readonly Dataset.T[];
  columnCounts: ReadonlyMap<Dataset.Id, number>;
  pickedDatasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[];
  /** Datasets shown picked that cannot be unpicked. */
  lockedDatasetIds?: readonly Dataset.Id[];
  /** Datasets shown unpicked that cannot be picked, with `unavailableReason`. */
  unavailableDatasetIds?: readonly Dataset.Id[];
  /** Why the unavailable datasets cannot be picked. */
  unavailableReason?: ReactNode;
  /** What to say when there is no dataset. Defaults to the create flow's copy. */
  emptyMessage?: ReactNode;
  onToggle: (datasetId: Dataset.Id) => void;
};

/** Every dataset in the workspace, each with a checkbox to pick it. */
export function PickDatasetsTable({
  datasets,
  columnCounts,
  pickedDatasetIds,
  lockedDatasetIds,
  unavailableDatasetIds,
  unavailableReason,
  emptyMessage,
  onToggle,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  if (datasets.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
        {emptyMessage ?? (
          <Trans>
            There are no datasets yet. Add one, then learn a dictionary from it.
          </Trans>
        )}
      </Text>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Table highlightOnHover verticalSpacing="xs">
      <PickDatasetsTableHead />
      <Table.Tbody>
        {datasets.map((dataset) => {
          const isUnavailable = unavailableDatasetIds?.includes(dataset.id) ?? false;
          return (
            <PickDatasetRow
              key={dataset.id}
              dataset={dataset}
              columnCount={columnCounts.get(dataset.id) ?? 0}
              isPicked={pickedDatasetIds.includes(dataset.id)}
              isLocked={lockedDatasetIds?.includes(dataset.id) ?? false}
              unavailableReason={isUnavailable ? unavailableReason : undefined}
              onToggle={onToggle}
            />
          );
        })}
      </Table.Tbody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```
