```tsx
import { Modal } from "@avandar/ui";
import { where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { Plural, Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Center, Group, Loader, ScrollArea, Stack } from "@mantine/core";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { PickDatasetsTable } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/PickDatasetsStep/PickDatasetsTable";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CrosswalkContext } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  context: CrosswalkContext;
  isCatalogLoading: boolean;
  /** Called with the newly picked datasets only. */
  onAdd: (datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[]) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
};

/**
 * The workspace's datasets the crosswalk can add, by name: those in the
 * catalog (the reducer reads their columns), except the crosswalk's own
 * combined dataset, which would read itself.
 */
function useAddableDatasets(
  options: Readonly<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    context: CrosswalkContext;
    outputDatasetId: Dataset.Id | undefined;
  }>,
): { datasets: Dataset.T[]; isLoading: boolean } {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const [datasets, isLoading] = DatasetClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("workspace_id", "eq", workspace.id),
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: options.isOpen },
  });
  const { context, outputDatasetId } = options;
  const addable = useMemo(() => {
    return (datasets ?? [])
      .filter((dataset) => {
        return (
          context.datasetsById.has(dataset.id) && dataset.id !== outputDatasetId
        );
      })
      .sort((datasetA, datasetB) => {
        return datasetA.name.localeCompare(datasetB.name);
      });
  }, [datasets, context.datasetsById, outputDatasetId]);
  return { datasets: addable, isLoading };
}

/** Each dataset's column count, from the catalog. */
function useColumnCounts(
  datasets: readonly Dataset.T[],
  context: CrosswalkContext,
): ReadonlyMap<Dataset.Id, number> {
  return useMemo(() => {
    return new Map(
      datasets.map((dataset) => {
        const columns = context.datasetsById.get(dataset.id)?.columns ?? [];
        return [dataset.id, columns.length] as const;
      }),
    );
  }, [datasets, context.datasetsById]);
}

/** The newly picked dataset ids, with a toggle and a reset. */
function usePickedIds(): {
  pickedIds: readonly Dataset.Id[];
  toggle: (datasetId: Dataset.Id) => void;
  reset: () => void;
} {
  const [pickedIds, setPickedIds] = useState<readonly Dataset.Id[]>([]);
  const toggle = (datasetId: Dataset.Id): void => {
    setPickedIds((current) => {
      return current.includes(datasetId)
        ? current.filter((id) => {
            return id !== datasetId;
          })
        : [...current, datasetId];
    });
  };
  return {
    pickedIds,
    toggle,
    reset: () => {
      setPickedIds([]);
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The modal's list: a loader while reading, then the datasets to pick. A
 * dataset with no columns cannot form a layout, so it is shown disabled
 * with the reason.
 */
function AddableDatasetsList(
  props: Readonly<{
    isLoading: boolean;
    datasets: readonly Dataset.T[];
    columnCounts: ReadonlyMap<Dataset.Id, number>;
    pickedIds: readonly Dataset.Id[];
    inCrosswalkIds: readonly Dataset.Id[];
    onToggle: (datasetId: Dataset.Id) => void;
  }>,
): ReactNode {
  const noColumnIds = props.datasets
    .filter((dataset) => {
      return props.columnCounts.get(dataset.id) === 0;
    })
    .map((dataset) => {
      return dataset.id;
    });
  if (props.isLoading) {
    return (
      <Center py="xl">
        <Loader size="sm" />
      </Center>
    );
  }
  return (
    <ScrollArea.Autosize mah="60vh">
      <PickDatasetsTable
        datasets={props.datasets}
        columnCounts={props.columnCounts}
        pickedDatasetIds={props.pickedIds}
        lockedDatasetIds={props.inCrosswalkIds}
        unavailableDatasetIds={noColumnIds}
        unavailableReason={<Trans>This dataset has no columns yet.</Trans>}
        emptyMessage={<Trans>There are no datasets you can add.</Trans>}
        onToggle={props.onToggle}
      />
    </ScrollArea.Autosize>
  );
}

/**
 * **Add datasets**: the workspace's datasets with a checkbox each. Those
 * already in the crosswalk show picked and cannot be unpicked; removing
 * one happens in the layouts table. Those with no columns show disabled.
 */
export function AddDatasetsModal(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { pickedIds, toggle, reset } = usePickedIds();
  const inCrosswalkIds = useMemo(() => {
    return props.draft.layouts.flatMap((layout) => {
      return layout.datasetIds;
    });
  }, [props.draft.layouts]);
  const addable = useAddableDatasets({
    isOpen: props.isOpen,
    context: props.context,
    outputDatasetId: props.draft.outputDatasetId,
  });
  const columnCounts = useColumnCounts(addable.datasets, props.context);
  const close = (): void => {
    reset();
    props.onClose();
  };
  return (
    <Modal opened={props.isOpen} onClose={close} title={t`Add datasets`} size="lg">
      <Stack gap="md">
        <AddableDatasetsList
          isLoading={addable.isLoading || props.isCatalogLoading}
          datasets={addable.datasets}
          columnCounts={columnCounts}
          pickedIds={pickedIds}
          inCrosswalkIds={inCrosswalkIds}
          onToggle={toggle}
        />
        <Group justify="flex-end" gap="sm">
          <Button variant="default" onClick={close}>
            <Trans>Cancel</Trans>
          </Button>
          <Button
            disabled={pickedIds.length === 0}
            onClick={() => {
              props.onAdd(pickedIds);
              reset();
            }}
          >
            <Plural value={pickedIds.length} one="Add # dataset" other="Add # datasets" />
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

```tsx
    expect(kings.getByText("4")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("opens a layout's datasets and removes one", () => {
    const flow = _renderStep(makeLayoutsDraft());

    const toggle = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "2 datasets" });
    fireEvent.click(toggle);
    expect(toggle).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    fireEvent.click(
      screen.getByRole("button", { name: `Remove ${KINGS_APRIL.name}` }),
    );

    expect(flow.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      type: "dataset_removed",
      datasetId: KINGS_APRIL.id,
    });
  });

  it("says how well the reference covers the other datasets, and changes it", () => {
    const flow = _renderStep(makeLayoutsDraft());

    expect(
      screen.getByText(/^Matches \d+% of the columns in the other datasets\.$/),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    pickMantineSelectOption("Reference layout", KINGS_MARCH.name);

    expect(flow.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      type: "reference_chosen",
      layoutId: KINGS_LAYOUT_ID,
    });
  });

  it("locks the reference once another layout is mapped, and says why", () => {
    _renderStep(
      makeMappedDraft({
        layouts: [BRONX_LAYOUT, { ...KINGS_LAYOUT, status: "mapped" }],
      }),
    );

    expect(
      screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Reference layout" }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("readonly");
    expect(
      screen.getByText(
        "You confirmed mappings against this layout, so the reference can't change.",
      ),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("seeds the columns and saves on Next, then opens the first layout to map", async () => {
    const flow = _renderStep(makeLayoutsDraft({ isSaved: false }));

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Next" }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(flow.goToStep).toHaveBeenCalledWith("map", KINGS_LAYOUT_ID);
    });
    expect(flow.dispatchAndSave).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ type: "columns_seeded" }),
    );
  });

  it("moves on to mapping when the columns are already seeded", async () => {
    const flow = _renderStep(makeMappedDraft());

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Next" }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(flow.goToStep).toHaveBeenCalledWith("map", KINGS_LAYOUT_ID);
    });
    expect(flow.dispatchAndSave).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("opens Add datasets", () => {
    _renderStep(makeLayoutsDraft());

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add datasets" }));

    expect(screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Add datasets" })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { Plural, Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { ActionIcon, Badge, Button, Group, Table, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconChevronDown, IconChevronRight, IconTrash } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/ChooseDatasetsStep.module.css";
import { LayoutName } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/LayoutName";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout;
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
  isExpanded: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onRemoveDataset: (datasetId: Dataset.Id) => void;
};

/** A layout's name cell: the name, and the Reference tag on the reference. */
function LayoutNameCell(
  props: Readonly<Pick<Props, "layout" | "datasetsById"> & { nameId: string }>,
): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">
      <LayoutName
        layout={props.layout}
        datasetsById={props.datasetsById}
        nameId={props.nameId}
      />
      {props.layout.isReference ? (
        <Badge size="sm" variant="light" color="primary" tt="none">
          <Trans>Reference</Trans>
        </Badge>
      ) : null}
    </Group>
  );
}

/** The dataset count, as the button that opens the layout's datasets. */
function DatasetsToggle(
  props: Readonly<{
    count: number;
    isExpanded: boolean;
    nameId: string;
    detailsId: string;
    onToggle: () => void;
  }>,
): ReactNode {
  const Chevron = props.isExpanded ? IconChevronDown : IconChevronRight;
  return (
    <Button
      variant="subtle"
      color="neutral"
      size="compact-sm"
      leftSection={<Chevron size={14} aria-hidden />}
      aria-expanded={props.isExpanded}
      aria-controls={props.isExpanded ? props.detailsId : undefined}
      aria-describedby={props.nameId}
      onClick={props.onToggle}
    >
      <Plural value={props.count} one="# dataset" other="# datasets" />
    </Button>
  );
}

/** An opened layout's datasets, each with its own Remove button. */
function LayoutDatasetList(
  props: Readonly<Pick<Props, "layout" | "datasetsById" | "onRemoveDataset">>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return (
    <ul className={css.layoutDatasetList}>
      {props.layout.datasetIds.map((datasetId) => {
        const datasetName = props.datasetsById.get(datasetId)?.name ?? "";
        return (
          <li key={datasetId} className={css.layoutDataset}>
            <Text size="sm" truncate>
              {datasetName}
            </Text>
            <ActionIcon
              variant="subtle"
              color="neutral"
              size="sm"
              aria-label={t`Remove ${datasetName}`}
              onClick={() => {
                props.onRemoveDataset(datasetId);
              }}
            >
              <IconTrash size={14} aria-hidden />
            </ActionIcon>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

/**
 * One layout in the Choose datasets table: its name and Reference tag,
 * its dataset count as a disclosure button, and its column count. Opened,
 * a full-width row under it lists its datasets.
 */
export function LayoutRows(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  const { layout, isExpanded } = props;
  const nameId = `crosswalk-layout-name-${layout.id}`;
  const detailsId = `crosswalk-layout-datasets-${layout.id}`;
  return (
    <Table.Tbody>
      <Table.Tr>
        <Table.Td>
          <LayoutNameCell
            layout={layout}
            datasetsById={props.datasetsById}
            nameId={nameId}
          />
        </Table.Td>
        <Table.Td>
          <DatasetsToggle
            count={layout.datasetIds.length}
            isExpanded={isExpanded}
            nameId={nameId}
            detailsId={detailsId}
            onToggle={props.onToggle}
          />
        </Table.Td>
        <Table.Td ta="right">
          <Text size="sm">{i18n.number(layout.columnNames.length)}</Text>
        </Table.Td>
      </Table.Tr>
      {isExpanded ? (
        <Table.Tr id={detailsId}>
          <Table.Td colSpan={3} className={css.layoutDatasets}>
            <LayoutDatasetList {...props} />
          </Table.Td>
        </Table.Tr>
      ) : null}
    </Table.Tbody>
  );
}
```

The disclosure button's accessible name is its text ("2 datasets"), and the layout's name is its description, so a voice user can say what they see.

Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/LayoutsTable.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Table } from "@mantine/core";
import { useState } from "react";
import { LayoutRows } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/LayoutRows";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
  onRemoveDataset: (datasetId: Dataset.Id) => void;
};

/** Which layouts are opened, with a toggle for one. */
function useExpandedLayoutIds(): {
  expandedIds: ReadonlySet<string>;
  toggle: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => void;
} {
  const [expandedIds, setExpandedIds] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(
    () => {
      return new Set();
    },
  );
  const toggle = (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id): void => {
    setExpandedIds((current) => {
      const nextIds = new Set(current);
      if (nextIds.has(layoutId)) {
        nextIds.delete(layoutId);
      } else {
        nextIds.add(layoutId);
      }
      return nextIds;
    });
  };
  return { expandedIds, toggle };
}

/**
 * The crosswalk's layouts, the reference first: Layout, Datasets (opens
 * the layout's datasets to remove one), and Columns. One `tbody` per
 * layout keeps an opened layout's dataset row with it.
 */
export function LayoutsTable({
  draft,
  datasetsById,
  onRemoveDataset,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { expandedIds, toggle } = useExpandedLayoutIds();
  return (
    <Table layout="fixed" verticalSpacing="xs">
      <Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tr>
          <Table.Th>
            <Trans>Layout</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th w="11rem">
            <Trans>Datasets</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th w="7rem" ta="right">
            <Trans>Columns</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
        </Table.Tr>
      </Table.Thead>
      {draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
        return (
          <LayoutRows
            key={layout.id}
            layout={layout}
            datasetsById={datasetsById}
            isExpanded={expandedIds.has(layout.id)}
            onToggle={() => {
              toggle(layout.id);
            }}
            onRemoveDataset={onRemoveDataset}
          />
        );
      })}
    </Table>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Select } from "@mantine/core";
import { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import { canChangeReference } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer";
import { useLayoutNamer } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/useLayoutNamer";
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
  dispatch: CrosswalkFlow["dispatch"];
};

/**
 * "Matches {percent} of the columns in the other datasets." for the
 * reference, weighted by how many datasets each other layout holds, or
 * undefined when there is no other dataset to cover.
 */
function useCoverageText(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  reference: CrosswalkDraft.Layout | undefined,
): string | undefined {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  if (!reference) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const others = draft.layouts
    .filter((layout) => {
      return layout.id !== reference.id && layout.datasetIds.length > 0;
    })
    .map((layout) => {
      return {
        columnNames: layout.columnNames,
        datasetCount: layout.datasetIds.length,
      };
    });
  const coverage = CrosswalkLayout.getCoverage({
    candidate: reference.columnNames,
    others,
  });
  if (coverage.totalCount === 0) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const percent = i18n.number(coverage.matchedCount / coverage.totalCount, {
    style: "percent",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  });
  return t`Matches ${percent} of the columns in the other datasets.`;
}

/**
 * The layout whose columns seed the combined dataset. Once a layout other
 * than the reference is mapped it is read-only, and stays focusable so its
 * description says why.
 */
export function ReferenceLayoutSelect({
  draft,
  datasetsById,
  dispatch,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const nameLayout = useLayoutNamer(datasetsById);
  const reference = CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(draft);
  const coverageText = useCoverageText(draft, reference);
  const isLocked = !canChangeReference(draft);
  return (
    <Select
      label={t`Reference layout`}
      maw={420}
      data={draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
        return { value: layout.id, label: nameLayout(layout) };
      })}
      value={reference?.id ?? null}
      allowDeselect={false}
      readOnly={isLocked}
      description={
        isLocked
          ? t`You confirmed mappings against this layout, so the reference can't change.`
          : coverageText
      }
      onChange={(value) => {
        if (value && value !== reference?.id) {
          // The options' values are the layouts' ids.
          dispatch({
            type: "reference_chosen",
            layoutId: value as CrosswalkLayout.Id,
          });
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Stack } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconPlus, IconTableShortcut } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { AppSlateEmptyState } from "@/components/AppSlateEmptyState/AppSlateEmptyState";
import { AppViewBody } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewBody/AppViewBody";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import { AddDatasetsModal } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/AddDatasetsModal/AddDatasetsModal";
import { ChooseDatasetsFooter } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/ChooseDatasetsFooter";
import { LayoutsTable } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/LayoutsTable";
import { ReferenceLayoutSelect } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/ReferenceLayoutSelect";
import { useSeedColumns } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/useSeedColumns/useSeedColumns";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CrosswalkContext } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { CrosswalkStepProps } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkStepBody";
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/** **Add datasets**, light, since Next is the step's primary action. */
function AddDatasetsButton(props: Readonly<{ onClick: () => void }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Button
      variant="light"
      size="compact-sm"
      leftSection={<IconPlus size={14} aria-hidden />}
      onClick={props.onClick}
    >
      <Trans>Add datasets</Trans>
    </Button>
  );
}

/** What step 1 shows before any dataset is added. */
function NoDatasetsYet(props: Readonly<{ onAdd: () => void }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <AppSlateEmptyState
      icon={<IconTableShortcut size={32} aria-hidden />}
      title={<Trans>Add the datasets to combine.</Trans>}
      message={
        <Trans>Datasets with the same columns are mapped once, together.</Trans>
      }
      action={<AddDatasetsButton onClick={props.onAdd} />}
    />
  );
}

/** The Layouts section: the reference Select, then the layouts table. */
function LayoutsSection(
  props: Readonly<{
    draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
    context: CrosswalkContext;
    dispatch: CrosswalkFlow["dispatch"];
    onAdd: () => void;
  }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  const { draft, context, dispatch } = props;
  return (
    <AppViewSection
      title={t`Layouts`}
      meta={i18n.number(draft.layouts.length)}
      actions={<AddDatasetsButton onClick={props.onAdd} />}
    >
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <ReferenceLayoutSelect
          draft={draft}
          datasetsById={context.datasetsById}
          dispatch={dispatch}
        />
        <LayoutsTable
          draft={draft}
          datasetsById={context.datasetsById}
          onRemoveDataset={(datasetId) => {
            dispatch({ type: "dataset_removed", datasetId });
          }}
        />
      </Stack>
    </AppViewSection>
  );
}

/**
 * Step 1, Choose datasets: add datasets, see them grouped into layouts,
 * remove one, pick the reference layout, and Next. Next seeds the combined
 * dataset's columns from the reference the first time, saves through the
 * flow, and opens Map each dataset once the save went through. Adding,
 * removing, and changing the reference only dispatch: Next saves them.
 */
export function ChooseDatasetsStep({
  flow,
  catalog,
}: Readonly<CrosswalkStepProps>): ReactNode {
  const { draft } = flow.state;
  const { context } = catalog;
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const seed = useSeedColumns({ flow, catalog });
  const hasDatasets = draft.layouts.some((layout) => {
    return layout.datasetIds.length > 0;
  });
  const openAdd = (): void => {
    setIsAdding(true);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <AppViewBody>
        {hasDatasets ? (
          <LayoutsSection
            draft={draft}
            context={context}
            dispatch={flow.dispatch}
            onAdd={openAdd}
          />
        ) : (
          <NoDatasetsYet onAdd={openAdd} />
        )}
      </AppViewBody>
      <AddDatasetsModal
        isOpen={isAdding}
        draft={draft}
        context={context}
        isCatalogLoading={catalog.isLoading}
        onAdd={(datasetIds) => {
          flow.dispatch({ type: "datasets_added", datasetIds, context });
          setIsAdding(false);
        }}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsAdding(false);
        }}
      />
      <ChooseDatasetsFooter
        canContinue={hasDatasets && seed.isReady}
        isWorking={seed.isWorking || flow.isSaving}
        onNext={() => {
          void seed.continueToMapping();
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { ChooseDatasetsStep } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/ChooseDatasetsStep/ChooseDatasetsStep";
```

### Task 18: Reading a layout's values, with date-format detection

Step 2 matches a layout's columns onto the combined dataset's columns by values, not only by names and types, and it offers **Read as a date** with the right format already chosen. Both need one read per layout on this device: profile the layout's first dataset, profile the reference dataset once for the targets, and find which date format each text column uses. This task adds that read as `useLayoutValues({ draft, layoutId, readLayoutIds, context, dispatch })`. It dispatches `values_read` once per layout (tracked by `readLayoutIds`), dispatches it again from the read it already holds when the reducer drops the layout from `readLayoutIds` (a new reference or a column's new dictionary entry asks for every layout to be matched again), and drops a reply that arrives after the selected layout changed (through `useTaggedRead`). It returns `{ status, profilesBySourceColumn, dateFormatsBySourceColumn, targets }`, so the pane can show example values and prefill **Read as a date** every time the layout is opened (Tasks 21 and 22), and meaning suggestions can send the targets (Task 29).

Every result is keyed by the layout's own spelling. A layout keeps the column names of the dataset it was formed from, but its first dataset by name can change: a dataset whose name sorts earlier can join it, or the first one can be removed, and that dataset may spell a column differently (`CASE_ID` where the layout says `case_id`). The hook profiles `datasetIds[0]` with its own column names, then renames each profile, and each detected date format, to the matching name in `layout.columnNames`, matched ignoring case and surrounding spaces. A fill's `sourceColumn` therefore always uses the layout's spelling, as `carryOverFills` does.

The reference layout is read like any other. Selecting it profiles its first dataset once, uses those profiles as both the sources and the targets, and dispatches `values_read`, which is when the reducer gives a confirmed governed reference fill its code list from the values (unless the user chose the list by hand).

`detectDateFormats` reads a sample of the dataset with one query. For each text column and each format in `DATE_FORMATS`, it counts the sampled values that format parses, and picks the first format that parses 90% or more of the non-blank values. It parses with `try_strptime(CAST(v AS VARCHAR), format)`, the same expression the combined SQL's `parse_date` fill renders, so a format chosen here parses the same values there. The format list and the sample come from `ColumnProfileSql`, which now exports `DATE_FORMATS` and `buildDateSampleSql` instead of keeping them private. Profiling's own date share keeps working from the same list. ISO comes first, then US before day-first, so an ambiguous `01/02/2026` column reads as US. The user can change the format in the pane (Task 21). Only text columns whose profiled `dateShare` is already 0.9 or more are checked, so most layouts send no format query at all.

Both reads use the dataset's own view (`"<datasetId>"`), not `ava_raw_<datasetId>`. The combined SQL, the pane's example, and the preview all read `FROM "<datasetId>"`, and the catalog's column types are the view's types. Matching must see the same values the compiled SQL will translate: a converted column's labels, not its stored codes. See the contract notes.

- [ ] **Step 4: The detect SQL.** Create `src/lib/crosswalks/detectDateFormats/DateFormatSql/DateFormatSql.ts`:

```ts
import { quoteSqlIdentifier, quoteSqlLiteral } from "@avandar/utils/sql";
import { ColumnProfileSql } from "@/lib/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfileSql/ColumnProfileSql";

/** The share of a column's non-blank sampled values one format must parse. */
const MIN_FORMAT_SHARE = 0.9;

/** The detect query's one row: counts keyed by column and format index. */
export type DateFormatCountsRow = Record<string, unknown>;

/**
 * One column's counts: its non-blank values, then how many each format
 * parses. Values are parsed as text exactly as a `parse_date` fill parses
 * them in the combined dataset.
 */
function _buildColumnParts(columnName: string, columnIndex: number): string[] {
  const text = `CAST(${quoteSqlIdentifier(columnName)} AS VARCHAR)`;
  const formatParts = ColumnProfileSql.DATE_FORMATS.map(
    (format, formatIndex) => {
      return `count(try_strptime(${text}, ${quoteSqlLiteral(format)})) AS "parsed_${columnIndex}_${formatIndex}"`;
    },
  );
  return [`count(NULLIF(${text}, '')) AS "values_${columnIndex}"`, ...formatParts];
}

function buildDetectSql(
  options: Readonly<{ relationName: string; columnNames: readonly string[] }>,
): string {
  const parts = options.columnNames.flatMap(_buildColumnParts);
  const sampleSql = ColumnProfileSql.buildDateSampleSql(
    quoteSqlIdentifier(options.relationName),
  );
  return `WITH "sample" AS (${sampleSql}) SELECT ${parts.join(", ")} FROM "sample"`;
}

function _toNumber(value: unknown): number {
  if (typeof value === "bigint") {
    return Number(value);
  }
  return typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value ?? 0);
}

function pickFormats(
  options: Readonly<{ columnNames: readonly string[]; row: DateFormatCountsRow }>,
): Map<string, string> {
  const { row } = options;
  return new Map(
    options.columnNames.flatMap((columnName, columnIndex) => {
      const valueCount = _toNumber(row[`values_${columnIndex}`]);
      if (valueCount === 0) {
        return [];
      }
      const format = ColumnProfileSql.DATE_FORMATS.find((_, formatIndex) => {
        const parsedCount = _toNumber(row[`parsed_${columnIndex}_${formatIndex}`]);
        return parsedCount / valueCount >= MIN_FORMAT_SHARE;
      });
      return format ? [[columnName, format] as const] : [];
    }),
  );
}

/**
 * The DuckDB SQL that finds each text column's date format, and the step
 * that reads its one row. One query over a repeatable sample of the
 * relation, the same sample profiling's date share reads. Used by
 * `detectDateFormats`.
 */
export const DateFormatSql = {
  /** The share of non-blank values a format must parse to be chosen. */
  MIN_FORMAT_SHARE,

  /** One query counting, per column, the values each format parses. */
  buildDetectSql,

  /** Each column's first format reaching `MIN_FORMAT_SHARE`, by column name. */
  pickFormats,
};
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The browser-side read.** Create `src/lib/crosswalks/detectDateFormats/detectDateFormats.ts`:

```ts
import { WorkspaceQuerySession } from "@/clients/qetl/WorkspaceQuerySession/WorkspaceQuerySession";
import { DateFormatSql } from "@/lib/crosswalks/detectDateFormats/DateFormatSql/DateFormatSql";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";
import type { DateFormatCountsRow } from "@/lib/crosswalks/detectDateFormats/DateFormatSql/DateFormatSql";

/**
 * The first date format, of `DATE_FORMATS`, that parses 90% or more of
 * each text column's sample, by column name. A column no format reaches is
 * left out. It runs on this device through the QETL query layer and reads
 * the dataset's own view, which is what the combined dataset reads, with
 * one query for every column. Pass only text columns.
 */
export async function detectDateFormats(
  options: Readonly<{
    workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;
    columnNames: readonly string[];
  }>,
): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  const { datasetId, columnNames } = options;
  if (columnNames.length === 0) {
    return new Map();
  }
  const result = await WorkspaceQuerySession.runQuery<DateFormatCountsRow>({
    workspaceId: options.workspaceId,
    neededColumnsByDatasetId: { [datasetId]: [...columnNames] },
    rawSql: DateFormatSql.buildDetectSql({ relationName: datasetId, columnNames }),
  });
  return DateFormatSql.pickFormats({ columnNames, row: result.data[0] ?? {} });
}
```

```ts
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { CrosswalkMatch } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatch";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import { DateFormatSql } from "@/lib/crosswalks/detectDateFormats/DateFormatSql/DateFormatSql";
import { detectDateFormats } from "@/lib/crosswalks/detectDateFormats/detectDateFormats";
import { profileDatasetColumns } from "@/lib/dataDictionaries/profileDatasetColumns/profileDatasetColumns";
import { useTaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";
import type { TaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkContext,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { Dispatch } from "react";

/**
 * Where reading a layout's values has got to, and what was read. Both
 * maps are keyed by the column names as spelled in `layout.columnNames`,
 * and both maps and `targets` are empty until the read is ready.
 */
export type LayoutValues = {
  status: "reading" | "ready" | "failed";
  /** The layout's first dataset's profiles, by column name. */
  profilesBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnProfile.T>;
  /** The date format of each source column that reads as dates. */
  dateFormatsBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
  /** The combined dataset's columns, with the profiles they are matched by. */
  targets: readonly CrosswalkMatch.Target[];
};

/** What one read of a layout learns. */
type LayoutValuesRead = {
  /** The source profiles, each named as the layout spells its column. */
  sources: readonly ColumnProfile.T[];
  profilesBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnProfile.T>;
  referenceProfiles: readonly ColumnProfile.T[];
  dateFormatsBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
};

/** The datasets a layout's read profiles. */
type ReadPlan = {
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
  /** The layout's column names: the spelling every result is keyed by. */
  columnNames: readonly string[];
  source: CrosswalkLayout.Dataset;
  reference: CrosswalkLayout.Dataset | undefined;
};

const NO_TARGETS: readonly CrosswalkMatch.Target[] = [];

/** What the hook returns before a read is ready, or with nothing to read. */
const NOTHING_READ: Omit<LayoutValues, "status"> = {
  profilesBySourceColumn: new Map(),
  dateFormatsBySourceColumn: new Map(),
  targets: NO_TARGETS,
};

function _toNameKey(name: string): string {
  return name.trim().toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * What a layout's columns are matched against: for each column of the
 * combined dataset, the reference dataset's profile of the column with its
 * name (ignoring case and surrounding spaces), or a name-and-type profile
 * for a column the reference dataset does not have, such as an added one.
 */
export function buildLayoutTargets(
  options: Readonly<{
    columns: readonly CrosswalkDraft.Column[];
    referenceProfiles: readonly ColumnProfile.T[];
    /** Names a name-and-type profile's dataset; the scorer ignores it. */
    dataset: Readonly<{ id: Dataset.Id; name: string }>;
  }>,
): CrosswalkMatch.Target[] {
  const profileByName = new Map(
    options.referenceProfiles.map((profile) => {
      return [_toNameKey(profile.columnName), profile] as const;
    }),
  );
  return options.columns.flatMap((column) => {
    const [profile] = profileByName.has(_toNameKey(column.name))
      ? [profileByName.get(_toNameKey(column.name))]
      : CrosswalkMatch.toNameAndTypeProfiles({
          datasetId: options.dataset.id,
          datasetName: options.dataset.name,
          columns: [{ name: column.name, dataType: column.dataType }],
        });
    return profile ? [{ columnId: column.id, profile }] : [];
  });
}

/** The datasets to profile for a layout, or undefined when it has none. */
function _planRead(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined,
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>,
): ReadPlan | undefined {
  const layout = draft.layouts.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === layoutId;
  });
  const sourceId = layout?.datasetIds[0];
  const source = sourceId ? datasetsById.get(sourceId) : undefined;
  if (!layout || !source) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const referenceId = CrosswalkDraft.getReferenceLayout(draft)?.datasetIds[0];
  return {
    layoutId: layout.id,
    columnNames: layout.columnNames,
    source,
    reference: referenceId ? datasetsById.get(referenceId) : undefined,
  };
}

/** The tag of a read: the layout, its spelling, and both datasets' columns. */
function _buildReadKey(plan: ReadPlan | undefined): string | undefined {
  return plan
    ? JSON.stringify([
        plan.layoutId,
        plan.columnNames,
        plan.source.id,
        plan.source.columns,
        plan.reference?.id ?? null,
        plan.reference?.columns ?? null,
      ])
    : undefined;
}

/** Text columns whose sample already reads mostly as dates. */
function _getDateCandidates(profiles: readonly ColumnProfile.T[]): string[] {
  return profiles.flatMap((profile) => {
    const isDateLike =
      profile.dataType === "varchar" &&
      (profile.dateShare ?? 0) >= DateFormatSql.MIN_FORMAT_SHARE;
    return isDateLike ? [profile.columnName] : [];
  });
}

/**
 * A function giving a dataset column's name as the layout spells it,
 * matched ignoring case and surrounding spaces. A name the layout does not
 * have stays as it is.
 */
function _makeRespeller(columnNames: readonly string[]): (name: string) => string {
  const spellingByKey = new Map(
    columnNames.map((columnName) => {
      return [_toNameKey(columnName), columnName] as const;
    }),
  );
  return (name) => {
    return spellingByKey.get(_toNameKey(name)) ?? name;
  };
}

/**
 * Profiles the layout's first dataset and, unless it is the same one, the
 * reference dataset, then finds the date format of each source column
 * that reads as dates. Both run with the dataset's own column names; the
 * source profiles and the formats are then keyed by the layout's spelling.
 */
async function _readLayoutValues(
  workspaceId: Workspace.Id,
  plan: ReadPlan,
): Promise<LayoutValuesRead> {
  const { source, reference } = plan;
  const ownProfiles = await profileDatasetColumns({
    workspaceId,
    dataset: source,
    columns: source.columns,
  });
  const referenceProfiles = !reference
    ? []
    : reference.id === source.id
      ? ownProfiles
      : await profileDatasetColumns({
          workspaceId,
          dataset: reference,
          columns: reference.columns,
        });
  const ownDateFormats = await detectDateFormats({
    workspaceId,
    datasetId: source.id,
    columnNames: _getDateCandidates(ownProfiles),
  });
  const respell = _makeRespeller(plan.columnNames);
  const sources = ownProfiles.map((profile) => {
    return { ...profile, columnName: respell(profile.columnName) };
  });
  return {
    sources,
    profilesBySourceColumn: new Map(
      sources.map((profile) => {
        return [profile.columnName, profile] as const;
      }),
    ),
    referenceProfiles,
    dateFormatsBySourceColumn: new Map(
      [...ownDateFormats].map(([columnName, format]) => {
        return [respell(columnName), format] as const;
      }),
    ),
  };
}

/** The targets of a ready read, against the draft's current columns. */
function useLayoutTargets(
  read: TaggedRead<LayoutValuesRead>,
  plan: ReadPlan | undefined,
  columns: readonly CrosswalkDraft.Column[],
): readonly CrosswalkMatch.Target[] {
  return useMemo(() => {
    if (read.status !== "ready" || !plan) {
      return NO_TARGETS;
    }
    return buildLayoutTargets({
      columns,
      referenceProfiles: read.result.referenceProfiles,
      dataset: plan.reference ?? plan.source,
    });
  }, [read, plan, columns]);
}

type DispatchOptions = Readonly<{
  read: TaggedRead<LayoutValuesRead>;
  plan: ReadPlan | undefined;
  targets: readonly CrosswalkMatch.Target[];
  hasColumns: boolean;
  readLayoutIds: readonly CrosswalkLayout.Id[];
  context: CrosswalkContext;
  dispatch: Dispatch<CrosswalkAction>;
}>;

/**
 * Dispatches `values_read` for the layout when its read is ready and the
 * reducer has not recorded it in `readLayoutIds`. The ref holds layouts
 * dispatched but not yet recorded, so a render before the state catches up
 * never dispatches twice; once recorded they leave the ref, so a layout the
 * reducer later forgets is dispatched again from the same read.
 */
function useDispatchValuesRead(options: DispatchOptions): void {
  const pendingLayoutIdsRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const { read, plan, targets, hasColumns, readLayoutIds, context, dispatch } =
    options;
  useEffect(() => {
    readLayoutIds.forEach((layoutId) => {
      pendingLayoutIdsRef.current.delete(layoutId);
    });
    if (read.status !== "ready" || !plan || !hasColumns) {
      return;
    }
    const isRead =
      readLayoutIds.includes(plan.layoutId) ||
      pendingLayoutIdsRef.current.has(plan.layoutId);
    if (isRead) {
      return;
    }
    pendingLayoutIdsRef.current.add(plan.layoutId);
    dispatch({
      type: "values_read",
      layoutId: plan.layoutId,
      sources: read.result.sources,
      targets,
      dateFormatsBySourceColumn: read.result.dateFormatsBySourceColumn,
      context,
    });
  }, [read, plan, targets, hasColumns, readLayoutIds, context, dispatch]);
}

/**
 * Reads the selected layout's values on this device: its first dataset's
 * profiles, the reference dataset's profiles for the targets, and the
 * date format of each text column. The reference layout is read like any
 * other. A read the reducer has not recorded dispatches `values_read`,
 * which fills the layout's suggestions by values; later renders only
 * return what was read, for the pane's example values. A reply for a
 * layout no longer selected is dropped. It reads the datasets' own views,
 * the same values the combined dataset reads.
 */
export function useLayoutValues(
  options: Readonly<{
    draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
    layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
    /** Layouts already read this session, from the reducer's state. */
    readLayoutIds: readonly CrosswalkLayout.Id[];
    context: CrosswalkContext;
    dispatch: Dispatch<CrosswalkAction>;
  }>,
): LayoutValues {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const { draft, layoutId, readLayoutIds, context, dispatch } = options;
  const plan = useMemo(() => {
    return _planRead(draft, layoutId, context.datasetsById);
  }, [draft, layoutId, context.datasetsById]);
  const read = useTaggedRead({
    key: _buildReadKey(plan),
    devMsg: "Reading a crosswalk layout's values failed",
    read: () => {
      // `read` runs only with a key, and a key needs a plan.
      return plan
        ? _readLayoutValues(workspace.id, plan)
        : Promise.reject(new Error("No layout to read"));
    },
  });
  const targets = useLayoutTargets(read, plan, draft.columns);
  const hasColumns = draft.columns.length > 0;
  useDispatchValuesRead({ read, plan, targets, hasColumns, readLayoutIds, context, dispatch });
  if (!plan) {
    return { status: "ready", ...NOTHING_READ };
  }
  if (read.status !== "ready") {
    return { status: read.status, ...NOTHING_READ };
  }
  const { profilesBySourceColumn, dateFormatsBySourceColumn } = read.result;
  return { status: "ready", profilesBySourceColumn, dateFormatsBySourceColumn, targets };
}
```

`useLayoutValues` is 34 lines. `plan` is memoized on the draft, so it changes whenever the draft does. The effect then reruns, but the pending ref and `readLayoutIds` keep it to one dispatch per layout until the reducer forgets the layout, and the read itself is keyed by `_buildReadKey`, which changes only with the layout, its spelling, and its datasets' columns. `targets` changes with `draft.columns`, so a dispatch after a column was added carries a target for it. ### Task 19: Map each dataset: the layout stub

The stub is step 2's left flank, about 260px wide. At the top it shows how far the crosswalk has got ("36 of 100 mapped", counting datasets, from `CrosswalkDraft.countDatasets`) as a progress bar, then one row per layout: its name, "+{count} with the same layout", and a stamp (Reference, Mapped, Review, To do, Skipped). Skipped layouts stay in the list, so a skipped dataset is one click from being mapped after all. Task 22 places the stub beside the mapping table, and Part B (Task 30) virtualizes it past 100 layouts. Under 100 it renders every row.

The list is a single-select `listbox` that owns focus and points at its active option with `aria-activedescendant`. A roving `tabIndex` would also work, but Task 30's virtualizer unmounts rows scrolled out of view, and focus must not live on a row that can unmount. The arrow keys, Home, and End move the active option, and Enter or Space selects it. Selection does not follow the arrows, because selecting a layout saves a dirty draft first, and arrowing past ten layouts must not send ten saves. A click selects the row at once. The active option shows the focus ring only while the list has keyboard focus (`:focus-visible` on the list).

Selecting goes through the flow. `LayoutStub` calls `onSelectLayout(layoutId)`, and the step passes `(layoutId) => { void flow.selectLayout(layoutId); }`. Task 16's `selectLayout` saves a dirty draft first and opens the layout only once that save went through (or nothing needed saving), so the layout the next edit lands in is the one the user picked. A failed save, offline included, keeps the user on the current layout with the error `useSaveCrosswalk` already showed. `selectLayout` reads the flow's latest state, so a stale closure never saves an old draft.

```tsx
import { matchLiteral } from "@avandar/utils";
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Badge } from "@mantine/core";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  layout: Pick<CrosswalkDraft.Layout, "isReference" | "status">;
};

/**
 * Where a layout stands: Reference for the reference layout, otherwise
 * Mapped, Review, To do, or Skipped. Neutral except Reference (the one
 * the others are mapped onto) and Mapped (done).
 */
export function LayoutStamp({ layout }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  if (layout.isReference) {
    return (
      <Badge size="sm" variant="light" color="primary" tt="none">
        <Trans>Reference</Trans>
      </Badge>
    );
  }
  return matchLiteral(layout.status, {
    mapped: () => {
      return (
        <Badge size="sm" variant="light" color="success" tt="none">
          <Trans>Mapped</Trans>
        </Badge>
      );
    },
    review: () => {
      return (
        <Badge size="sm" variant="light" color="neutral" tt="none">
          <Trans>Review</Trans>
        </Badge>
      );
    },
    to_do: () => {
      return (
        <Badge size="sm" variant="outline" color="neutral" tt="none">
          <Trans>To do</Trans>
        </Badge>
      );
    },
    skipped: () => {
      return (
        <Badge size="sm" variant="outline" color="neutral" tt="none" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>Skipped</Trans>
        </Badge>
      );
    },
  });
}
```

```tsx
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Progress, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
};

/**
 * "{mapped} of {total} mapped", counting datasets, over a progress bar. A
 * dataset in the reference layout or in a mapped layout counts as mapped.
 * The visible line is hidden from screen readers, since the bar carries
 * the same words as its name and value.
 */
export function MappedProgress({ draft }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  const counts = CrosswalkDraft.countDatasets(draft);
  const mapped = i18n.number(counts.mapped);
  const total = i18n.number(counts.total);
  const label = t`${mapped} of ${total} mapped`;
  const percent =
    counts.total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((counts.mapped / counts.total) * 100);
  return (
    <Stack gap={6}>
      <Text size="sm" fw={600} aria-hidden>
        {label}
      </Text>
      <Progress.Root size="sm">
        <Progress.Section value={percent} aria-label={label} aria-valuetext={label} />
      </Progress.Root>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The keyboard.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/LayoutStub/useLayoutListKeyboard.ts`:

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";

/** The active option of the stub's listbox, and what moves it. */
export type LayoutListKeyboard = {
  activeLayoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
  setActiveLayoutId: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => void;
  onKeyDown: (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
};

/** The index the key moves to, or undefined for a key that does not move. */
function _getMovedIndex(key: string, index: number, count: number): number | undefined {
  if (key === "ArrowDown") {
    return Math.min(index + 1, count - 1);
  }
  if (key === "ArrowUp") {
    return Math.max(index - 1, 0);
  }
  if (key === "Home") {
    return 0;
  }
  return key === "End" ? count - 1 : undefined;
}

/**
 * Keyboard for a single-select listbox that keeps focus on itself and
 * points at its active option (`aria-activedescendant`). Arrows, Home, and
 * End move the active option without selecting it; Enter and Space select
 * it. The active option starts at the selected one and follows it when the
 * selection changes from outside, such as Confirm and next. It is scrolled
 * into view as it moves.
 */
export function useLayoutListKeyboard(
  options: Readonly<{
    layoutIds: readonly CrosswalkLayout.Id[];
    selectedLayoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
    getOptionId: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => string;
    onSelectLayout: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => void;
  }>,
): LayoutListKeyboard {
  const { layoutIds, selectedLayoutId } = options;
  // The active option, and the selection it was chosen under.
  const [active, setActive] = useState<{
    underSelectedId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
    layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
  }>();
  const activeLayoutId =
    active?.underSelectedId === selectedLayoutId &&
    layoutIds.includes(active.layoutId)
      ? active.layoutId
      : (selectedLayoutId ?? layoutIds[0]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeLayoutId) {
      document
        .getElementById(options.getOptionId(activeLayoutId))
        ?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "nearest" });
    }
    // `getOptionId` is stable for the life of the list.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [activeLayoutId]);
  const setActiveLayoutId = (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id): void => {
    setActive({ underSelectedId: selectedLayoutId, layoutId });
  };
  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>): void => {
    const index = activeLayoutId ? layoutIds.indexOf(activeLayoutId) : -1;
    if ((event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") && activeLayoutId) {
      event.preventDefault();
      options.onSelectLayout(activeLayoutId);
      return;
    }
    const movedIndex = _getMovedIndex(event.key, index, layoutIds.length);
    const movedLayoutId = movedIndex === undefined ? undefined : layoutIds[movedIndex];
    if (movedLayoutId) {
      event.preventDefault();
      setActiveLayoutId(movedLayoutId);
    }
  };
  return { activeLayoutId, setActiveLayoutId, onKeyDown };
}
```

`useLayoutListKeyboard` is 44 lines. `scrollIntoView?.` guards jsdom, which does not implement it.

```tsx
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { useId } from "react";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/LayoutStub/LayoutStub.module.css";
import { LayoutStubRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/LayoutStub/LayoutStubRow";
import { MappedProgress } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/LayoutStub/MappedProgress";
import { useLayoutListKeyboard } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/LayoutStub/useLayoutListKeyboard";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/** What the stub shows and the one thing it does. */
export type LayoutStubProps = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
  selectedLayoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
  /**
   * Called when a layout is chosen by click, Enter, or Space. The step
   * passes `(layoutId) => { void flow.selectLayout(layoutId); }`, which
   * saves a dirty draft before it opens the layout.
   */
  onSelectLayout: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => void;
};

/**
 * Step 2's flank: how many datasets are mapped, then every layout, the
 * reference first, each with its stamp. Skipped layouts stay listed. The
 * list is a single-select listbox named after the step.
 */
export function LayoutStub(props: Readonly<LayoutStubProps>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const listId = useId();
  const { layouts } = props.draft;
  const getOptionId = (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id): string => {
    return `${listId}-${layoutId}`;
  };
  const keyboard = useLayoutListKeyboard({
    layoutIds: layouts.map((layout) => {
      return layout.id;
    }),
    selectedLayoutId: props.selectedLayoutId,
    getOptionId,
    onSelectLayout: props.onSelectLayout,
  });
  const { activeLayoutId } = keyboard;
  return (
    <div className={css.layoutStub}>
      <div className={css.layoutStubHeader}>
        <MappedProgress draft={props.draft} />
      </div>
      <div
        role="listbox"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label={t`Map each dataset`}
        aria-activedescendant={activeLayoutId ? getOptionId(activeLayoutId) : undefined}
        className={css.layoutStubList}
        onKeyDown={keyboard.onKeyDown}
      >
        {layouts.map((layout) => {
          return (
            <LayoutStubRow
              key={layout.id}
              layout={layout}
              datasetsById={props.datasetsById}
              optionId={getOptionId(layout.id)}
              isSelected={layout.id === props.selectedLayoutId}
              isActive={layout.id === activeLayoutId}
              onSelect={() => {
                keyboard.setActiveLayoutId(layout.id);
                props.onSelectLayout(layout.id);
              }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Task 20: Map each dataset: the mapping table

The center of step 2. It has one row per column of the combined dataset, in position order, and three columns:

- **Column of the combined dataset**: the column's name (a button that selects the row for the side pane), its type in the user's words (`avaDataTypeLabel`, the translated labels the dataset page uses), and a "Code list" tag when it is governed by a dictionary entry.
- **Filled from this dataset**: what fills the column for the selected layout. That is a source column with its conversion or code list underneath, a fixed value, a Combine expression, Leave empty, or "Not filled yet".
- **Match**: why the fill was suggested ("Name and type · 93%", "Same values · 91%", "From a similar layout", "Meaning") and a Suggested tag while it waits for Accept.

A connector line joins the reference column to its fill: solid for a confirmed fill, dashed for a suggestion, none for Leave empty or no fill. It is decorative (`aria-hidden`), because the Filled from and Match cells already say the same in text. It is drawn inside the Filled from cell, at its leading edge, rather than in a column of its own: an `aria-hidden` cell in every row would leave screen-reader table navigation counting a column it cannot read. Solid lines are neutral, and only the selected row's line turns Brand Blue (the One Blue Rule: blue marks what you are looking at).

Row selection follows the apply flow's pairing table (`ColumnNameCell`): the name is the keyboard and screen-reader control (`aria-current` when selected), and a click anywhere on the row selects it too. A date format shows in the user's terms (`MM/DD/YYYY`, not `%m/%d/%Y`) through a small shared helper, `toDateFormatLabel`, which Task 21's format Select can reuse.

```ts
/** The strptime parts a person reads as a date pattern. */
const PART_LABELS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  "%Y": "YYYY",
  "%y": "YY",
  "%m": "MM",
  "%d": "DD",
};

/**
 * A strptime date format as people write date patterns: `%m/%d/%Y`
 * becomes `MM/DD/YYYY`. A part it does not know stays as written. The
 * pattern letters are the same in every language, so it is not
 * translated.
 */
export function toDateFormatLabel(format: string): string {
  return format.replace(/%[A-Za-z]/g, (part) => {
    return PART_LABELS[part] ?? part;
  });
}
```

```tsx
function _renderTable(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T = makeMappedDraft(),
  selectedColumnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id | undefined = undefined,
) {
  const onSelectColumn = vi.fn();
  render(
    <MappingTable
      draft={draft}
      layoutId={KINGS_LAYOUT_ID}
      entriesById={CONTEXT.entriesById}
      selectedColumnId={selectedColumnId}

  return { onSelectColumn };

function _row(columnName: string): HTMLElement {
  const row = screen.getByRole("button", { name: columnName }).closest("tr");
  if (!row) {
    throw new Error(`No row for ${columnName}`);
  }
  return row;
}

/**
 * A row's three cells, by heading. A source column can share its name with
 * the combined dataset's column, so each cell is searched on its own.
 */
function _cells(columnName: string) {
  const [column, filledFrom, match] = within(_row(columnName)).getAllByRole("cell");
  if (!column || !filledFrom || !match) {

  return {
    column: within(column),
    filledFrom: within(filledFrom),
    match: within(match),
```

```ts
import { toDateFormatLabel } from "@/lib/crosswalks/toDateFormatLabel/toDateFormatLabel";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";

/** A fill as the Filled from cell shows it. */
export type FillSummary = {
  /** The source column, the fixed value, the expression, or Leave empty. */
  main: string;
  /** What is done to it, or what kind of fill it is. */
  detail: string | undefined;
  /** True for Leave empty, which is shown dimmed. */
  isEmpty: boolean;
};

/** Translates a conversion into a short phrase. */
function useConvertDescriber(): (convert: CrosswalkMapping.Convert) => string {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  return (convert) => {
    return matchLiteral(convert.kind, {
      parse_date: () => {
        const format = toDateFormatLabel(
          convert.kind === "parse_date" ? convert.format : "",
        );
        return t`Read as a date (${format})`;
      },
      pad_text: () => {
        const length = i18n.number(convert.kind === "pad_text" ? convert.length : 0);
        return t`Padded with zeros to ${length}`;
      },
      multiply: () => {
        const factor = i18n.number(convert.kind === "multiply" ? convert.factor : 1, {
          maximumFractionDigits: 6,
        });
        return t`Multiplied by ${factor}`;
      },
      trim_and_fix_case: () => {
        const letterCase =
          convert.kind === "trim_and_fix_case" ? convert.letterCase : "keep";
        return matchLiteral(letterCase, {
          keep: () => {
            return t`Spaces trimmed`;
          },
          lower: () => {
            return t`Spaces trimmed, lowercase`;
          },
          upper: () => {
            return t`Spaces trimmed, UPPERCASE`;
          },
        });
      },
    });
  };
}

/**
 * A function describing a fill for the Filled from cell: the source
 * column and its conversion or code list, a fixed value, a Combine
 * expression, or Leave empty. Code lists are named from
 * `codeListNamesById`; a list no longer there is said to be deleted.
 */
export function useFillSummary(
  codeListNamesById: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
): (fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill) => FillSummary {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const describeConvert = useConvertDescriber();
  return (fill) => {
    if (fill.kind === "constant") {
      return { main: fill.value, detail: t`Fixed value`, isEmpty: false };
    }
    if (fill.kind === "expression") {
      return { main: fill.sql, detail: t`Combine`, isEmpty: false };
    }
    if (fill.kind === "empty") {
      return { main: t`Leave empty`, detail: undefined, isEmpty: true };
    }
    const codeListName = fill.codeListId
      ? codeListNamesById.get(fill.codeListId)
      : undefined;
    const translation = !fill.codeListId
      ? undefined
      : codeListName
        ? t`Translated with ${codeListName}`
        : t`Translated with a code list that was deleted`;
    return {
      main: fill.sourceColumn,
      detail: fill.convert ? describeConvert(fill.convert) : translation,
      isEmpty: false,
    };
  };
}
```

`matchLiteral` narrows on the kind string, not on the object, so each branch re-checks `convert.kind` to read its field. TypeScript needs that, and it never changes the result.

```tsx
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/MappingTable.module.css";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/** How the line joining a column to its fill is drawn. */
export type ConnectorVariant = "solid" | "dashed" | "none";

/**
 * Solid for a confirmed fill, dashed for a suggestion, and none for Leave
 * empty or no fill yet.
 */
export function getConnectorVariant(
  mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping | undefined,
): ConnectorVariant {
  if (!mapping || mapping.fill.kind === "empty") {
    return "none";
  }
  return mapping.status === "suggested" ? "dashed" : "solid";
}

/**
 * The line from the reference column to its fill. Decorative and hidden
 * from screen readers: the Filled from and Match cells carry the same
 * information as text.
 */
export function ConnectorLine(
  props: Readonly<{ variant: ConnectorVariant }>,
): ReactNode {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden="true" className={css.connectorLine} data-variant={props.variant} />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Text } from "@mantine/core";
import type { FillSummary } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/useFillSummary";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** The fill described, or undefined when the column has none yet. */
  summary: FillSummary | undefined;
};

/**
 * What fills a column for this layout: a main line (the source column,
 * the fixed value, the expression, or Leave empty) and a dimmed detail
 * under it, or "Not filled yet".
 */
export function FilledFromCell({ summary }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  if (!summary) {
    return (
      <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
        <Trans>Not filled yet</Trans>
      </Text>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <Text size="sm" fw={summary.isEmpty ? 400 : 500} c={summary.isEmpty ? "dimmed" : undefined} truncate>
        {summary.main}
      </Text>
      {summary.detail ? (
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>
          {summary.detail}
        </Text>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { matchLiteral } from "@avandar/utils";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Badge, Group, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconSparkles } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping | undefined;
};

/** Why a fill was suggested, with its score where it has one. */
function useReasonText(
  reason: CrosswalkMapping.Reason,
  confidence: number | undefined,
): string {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  const percent =
    confidence === undefined
      ? undefined
      : i18n.number(confidence, { style: "percent", maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  return matchLiteral(reason, {
    name_and_type: () => {
      return percent ? t`Name and type · ${percent}` : t`Name and type`;
    },
    same_values: () => {
      return percent ? t`Same values · ${percent}` : t`Same values`;
    },
    similar_layout: () => {
      return t`From a similar layout`;
    },
    meaning: () => {
      return t`Meaning`;
    },
  });
}

/** The reason line, for a fill that came from a match. */
function ReasonText(
  props: Readonly<{ reason: CrosswalkMapping.Reason; confidence: number | undefined }>,
): ReactNode {
  const text = useReasonText(props.reason, props.confidence);
  return (
    <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
      {text}
    </Text>
  );
}

/**
 * Why a fill is there: its match reason and score, and a Suggested tag
 * while it waits for Accept. Empty for a fill the user set.
 */
export function MatchCell({ mapping }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  if (!mapping || (!mapping.reason && mapping.status !== "suggested")) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="wrap">
      {mapping.reason ? (
        <ReasonText reason={mapping.reason} confidence={mapping.confidence} />
      ) : null}
      {mapping.status === "suggested" ? (
        <Badge
          size="sm"
          variant="light"
          color="neutral"
          tt="none"
          leftSection={<IconSparkles size={10} aria-hidden />}
        >
          <Trans>Suggested</Trans>
        </Badge>
      ) : null}
    </Group>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Badge, Group, Table, Text, UnstyledButton } from "@mantine/core";
import { avaDataTypeLabel } from "$/copy/avaDataTypeLabel";
import {
  ConnectorLine,
  getConnectorVariant,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/ConnectorLine";
import { FilledFromCell } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/FilledFromCell";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/MappingTable.module.css";
import { MatchCell } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/MatchCell";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { FillSummary } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/useFillSummary";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  column: CrosswalkDraft.Column;
  mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping | undefined;
  isSelected: boolean;
  describeFill: (fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill) => FillSummary;
  onSelect: () => void;
};

/**
 * A column of the combined dataset: its name, which selects the row, its
 * type, and the Code list tag when a dictionary entry governs it.
 */
function CombinedColumnCell(
  props: Readonly<Pick<Props, "column" | "isSelected" | "onSelect">>,
): ReactNode {
  const { column } = props;
  return (
    <>
      <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">
        <UnstyledButton
          fw={500}
          fz="sm"
          aria-current={props.isSelected || undefined}
          onClick={(event) => {
            // The row selects on click too; one click is one selection.
            event.stopPropagation();
            props.onSelect();
          }}
        >
          {column.name}
        </UnstyledButton>
        {column.entryId ? (
          <Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="neutral" tt="none">
            <Trans>Code list</Trans>
          </Badge>
        ) : null}
      </Group>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
        {avaDataTypeLabel(column.dataType)}
      </Text>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * One row of the mapping table: the combined dataset's column, the line to
 * its fill, what fills it for this layout, and why. Clicking anywhere on
 * the row selects it; the column's name is the keyboard control.
 */
export function MappingRow(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { mapping } = props;
  return (
    <Table.Tr
      className={css.mappingRow}
      data-selected={props.isSelected}
      onClick={props.onSelect}
    >
      <Table.Td>
        <CombinedColumnCell
          column={props.column}
          isSelected={props.isSelected}
          onSelect={props.onSelect}
        />
      </Table.Td>
      <Table.Td className={css.filledFrom}>
        <ConnectorLine variant={getConnectorVariant(mapping)} />
        <FilledFromCell summary={mapping ? props.describeFill(mapping.fill) : undefined} />
      </Table.Td>
      <Table.Td>
        <MatchCell mapping={mapping} />
      </Table.Td>
    </Table.Tr>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Table } from "@mantine/core";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/MappingTable.module.css";
import { MappingRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/MappingRow";
import { useFillSummary } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/useFillSummary";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { DictionaryMatch } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryMatch/DictionaryMatch";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/** What the mapping table shows and the one thing it does. */
export type MappingTableProps = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  /** The layout whose fills the table shows. */
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
  /** Names the code lists that fills translate with. */
  entriesById: ReadonlyMap<string, DictionaryMatch.Entry>;
  /** The row the side pane edits, if any. */
  selectedColumnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id | undefined;
  onSelectColumn: (columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id) => void;
};

/** Every code list's name, by id, across the entries. */
function useCodeListNames(
  entriesById: ReadonlyMap<string, DictionaryMatch.Entry>,
): ReadonlyMap<string, string> {
  return useMemo(() => {
    return new Map(
      [...entriesById.values()].flatMap((entry) => {
        return entry.codeLists.map((codeList) => {
          return [codeList.id, codeList.name] as const;
        });
      }),
    );
  }, [entriesById]);
}

/**
 * Step 2's table for one layout: one row per column of the combined
 * dataset, in position order, with what fills it from this layout and
 * why. Selecting a row sets the column the side pane edits.
 */
export function MappingTable(props: Readonly<MappingTableProps>): ReactNode {
  const describeFill = useFillSummary(useCodeListNames(props.entriesById));
  const mappings = props.draft.mappings[props.layoutId] ?? {};
  return (
    <Table layout="fixed" verticalSpacing="xs">
      <Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tr>
          <Table.Th w="30%">
            <Trans>Column of the combined dataset</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th className={css.filledFrom}>
            <Trans>Filled from this dataset</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th w="13rem">
            <Trans>Match</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
        </Table.Tr>
      </Table.Thead>
      <Table.Tbody>
        {props.draft.columns.map((column) => {
          return (
            <MappingRow
              key={column.id}
              column={column}
              mapping={mappings[column.id]}
              isSelected={column.id === props.selectedColumnId}
              describeFill={describeFill}
              onSelect={() => {
                props.onSelectColumn(column.id);
              }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </Table.Tbody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```

### Task 21: Map each dataset: the side pane

Step 2's side pane edits the selected column of the combined dataset for the selected layout (spec section 7.6). It is a new surface: load the `impeccable` skill before this task. Direction: an Operate surface in the Data Sources world, sitting in `AppViewBody`'s rail on the tinted body surface exactly like the apply flow's column pane (`--ava-app-view-rail-width: 22rem`), built from the product's own Mantine controls at `size="xs"`, neutral by default, Brand Blue only on the chosen segment and the focused field. No new tokens, no `Paper`, no informational `Callout`.

From top to bottom the pane holds: the column's name and type as its heading; **Column settings** (`ColumnSettings`: rename, the type of an ungoverned column, the dictionary entry that governs it, **Remove column**); "How this column is filled" (`FillKindControl`, a four-option `SegmentedControl`: **A column** · **A fixed value** · **Combine** · **Leave empty**); the controls for the chosen kind (`SourceColumnSelect` with an example value, then `ConvertControl` for an ungoverned column or `TranslateCodesControl` for a governed one; `ConstantInput`; `CombineInput`); the before/after **Example** (`FillExample` through `useFillExample`, which runs the exact `CrosswalkSql.toFillSql` the combined dataset will run); and **Accept** / **Reject** while the fill is a suggestion. Every change dispatches `fill_set`, which stores the fill as confirmed (reducer rules), so editing a suggestion also accepts it.

Decisions a reader would question:

- Switching the kind builds a sensible starting fill (`makeFillForKind`): a column fill reads the current source, else the layout column named like the target, else the first column; a governed column starts translating with its entry's primary list; a Combine fill starts as `{<that column>}`, because `rpc_crosswalks__save` refuses a blank expression (`fill_invalid`).
- The Combine textarea keeps its own text and dispatches only non-blank text; a blank or invalid formula shows its error live and `compileCrosswalk` blocks an invalid one in step 3.
- The example is debounced by 300 ms so typing a formula or a factor does not run a query per keystroke, and `useTaggedRead` drops late replies.
- The conversions offered follow the planning probes: **Pad with zeros** only for whole-number and text sources (`CAST(501.0 AS VARCHAR)` is `501.0`), and every date format is parsed with `TRY_STRPTIME` by the compiler, so a bad value becomes empty, which the example shows as "Becomes empty".

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import type { DataDictionary } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionary/DataDictionary";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry";
import type { DictionaryMatch } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryMatch/DictionaryMatch";

const MALE = { code: "1", label: "Male", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false };
const LETTER_MALE = { code: "M", label: "Male", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false };

function _entry(
  entryId: string,
  codeLists: DictionaryMatch.Entry["codeLists"],
```

```ts
import type { CrosswalkSql } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkSql/CrosswalkSql";
import type { DictionaryMatch } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryMatch/DictionaryMatch";

/**
 * The two maps a crosswalk fill is rendered with: the code lists of every
 * matchable entry by id, and each entry's primary list, which a translation
 * reconciles to. The primary list is an entry's first one, since
 * `DictionaryMatch.Entry` lists the primary first; an entry with no code
 * list has no primary. Use it wherever `CrosswalkSql` renders fills: the
 * combined dataset's compile and the side pane's example.
 */
export function buildCodeListLookups(
  entriesById: ReadonlyMap<string, DictionaryMatch.Entry>,
): CrosswalkSql.CodeLists {
  const entries = [...entriesById.values()];
  const codeListsById = new Map(
    entries.flatMap((entry) => {
      return entry.codeLists.map((codeList) => {
        return [codeList.id as string, { pairs: codeList.pairs }] as const;
      });
    }),
  );
  const primaryCodeListIdByEntryId = new Map(
    entries.flatMap((entry) => {
      const primaryList = entry.codeLists[0];
      return primaryList
        ? [[entry.entryId as string, primaryList.id as string] as const]
        : [];
    }),
  );
  return { codeListsById, primaryCodeListIdByEntryId };
}
```

The `as string` casts are the ones `compileCrosswalk` made: they key both maps by plain strings, as `CrosswalkSql.CodeLists` declares. Run it. Expected: PASS.

```ts
function _compileSql(
  options: CompileOptions,
  sqlLayouts: readonly CrosswalkSql.Layout[],
  codeLists: CrosswalkSql.CodeLists,
): CrosswalkSql.Output | undefined {
  try {
    return CrosswalkSql.compile({
      codesOutputAs: options.draft.codesOutputAs,
      sourceColumnName: options.draft.addsSourceColumn
        ? Crosswalk.SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME
        : undefined,
      columns: options.draft.columns,
      layouts: sqlLayouts,
      ...codeLists,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error instanceof Error &&
      error.message === "crosswalk-nothing-to-combine"
    ) {
      return undefined;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

and `compileCrosswalk` (its docstring stays as it is) with

```ts
export function compileCrosswalk(
  options: CompileOptions,
): CompileCrosswalkResult {
  const codeLists = buildCodeListLookups(options.entriesById);
  const { sqlLayouts, problems } = _compileLayouts(
    options,
    codeLists.codeListsById,
  );
  const output = _compileSql(options, sqlLayouts, codeLists);
  if (output === undefined) {
    return {
      status: "blocked",
      problems: [...problems, { kind: "nothing_to_combine" }],
    };
  }
  if (
    problems.some((problem) => {
      return problem.kind === "invalid_expression";
    })
  ) {
    return { status: "blocked", problems };
  }
  return {
    status: "ready",
    sql: output.sql,
    columns: output.columns,
    bindings: _getBindings(options.draft, options.entriesById),
    compiledCodeLists: _getCompiledCodeLists(
      output.usedCodeListIds,
      codeLists.codeListsById,
    ),
    includedDatasetIds: sqlLayouts.flatMap((layout) => {
      return layout.datasets.map((dataset) => {
        return dataset.id;
      });
    }),
    problems,
  };
}
```

```ts
  };
```
