```ts
/** The draft with one layout's fill for one column replaced. */
export function withFill(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  options: Readonly<{
    layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
    columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
    fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill;
    status?: CrosswalkMapping.Status;
  }>,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const layoutMappings = draft.mappings[options.layoutId] ?? {};
  return {
    ...draft,
    mappings: {
      ...draft.mappings,
      [options.layoutId]: {
        ...layoutMappings,
        [options.columnId]: _mapping(`m-${options.columnId}`, options.fill, options.status ?? "confirmed"),
      },
    },
  };
}

    dateShare: undefined,

]);

/**
 * A flow on step 2 over `draft`, saved as it is, with every callback a mock
 * from `makeCrosswalkFlow`: `save`, `dispatchAndSave`, and `selectLayout`
 * resolve as a successful save would.
 */
export function makeFlow(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T = makeDraft(),
  overrides: Partial<CrosswalkFlow> = {},
): CrosswalkFlow {
  return makeCrosswalkFlow({
    state: makeInitialCrosswalkState(draft, { isSaved: true }),
    step: "map",
    reachableSteps: new Set(["datasets", "map", "combine"]),
    ...overrides,
  });
}

/** The catalog every step receives, over `CONTEXT`, finished loading. */
export function makeCatalog(): CrosswalkCatalog {
  return {
    context: CONTEXT,
    bindingsByDatasetId: new Map(),
    columnNameById: new Map(),
    isLoading: false,
  };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
```

```ts
describe("makeFillForKind", () => {

    const current = columnFill("GENDER");
    expect(
      makeFillForKind({
        kind: "column",
        current,
        targetName: "sex",
        columnNames: COLUMN_NAMES,
        primaryCodeListId: undefined,
      }),
    ).toBe(current);
  });

  it("starts a column fill from the column named like the target, translating a governed one", () => {
    expect(
      makeFillForKind({
        kind: "column",
        current: { kind: "empty" },
        targetName: "sex",
        columnNames: COLUMN_NAMES,
        primaryCodeListId: SEX_CODES_LIST_ID,
      }),
    ).toEqual({ ...columnFill("Sex"), codeListId: SEX_CODES_LIST_ID });
  });

  it("falls back to the first column, and starts Combine as that column's placeholder", () => {
    const options = {
      current: undefined,
      targetName: "county",
      columnNames: COLUMN_NAMES,
      primaryCodeListId: undefined,
    };
    expect(makeFillForKind({ ...options, kind: "column" })).toEqual(columnFill("CaseNo"));
    expect(makeFillForKind({ ...options, kind: "expression" })).toEqual({
      kind: "expression",
      sql: "{CaseNo}",
    });

  it("starts Combine from the current column fill's source", () => {
    expect(
      makeFillForKind({
        kind: "expression",
        current: columnFill("GENDER"),
        targetName: "sex",
        columnNames: COLUMN_NAMES,
        primaryCodeListId: undefined,
      }),
    ).toEqual({ kind: "expression", sql: "{GENDER}" });
  });

  it("starts a fixed value blank and an empty fill empty", () => {
    const options = {
      current: columnFill("GENDER"),
      targetName: "sex",
      columnNames: COLUMN_NAMES,
      primaryCodeListId: undefined,
    };
    expect(makeFillForKind({ ...options, kind: "constant" })).toEqual({ kind: "constant", value: "" });
    expect(makeFillForKind({ ...options, kind: "empty" })).toEqual({ kind: "empty" });
```

```ts
import { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";

/** Why a name cannot name a column of the combined dataset. */
export type ColumnNameProblem = "blank" | "taken" | "source_column";

function _toNameKey(name: string): string {
  return name.trim().toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * Whether a name can name a column of the combined dataset: not blank, not
 * another column's name ignoring case and surrounding spaces, and not the
 * source column's name while the crosswalk adds it. These are the rules
 * `rpc_crosswalks__save` enforces, checked before a save is sent.
 */
export function getColumnNameProblem(
  options: Readonly<{
    name: string;
    draft: Pick<CrosswalkDraft.T, "columns" | "addsSourceColumn">;
    /** The column being renamed, which may keep its own name. */
    exceptColumnId?: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
  }>,
): ColumnNameProblem | undefined {
  const key = _toNameKey(options.name);
  if (key === "") {
    return "blank";
  }
  if (options.draft.addsSourceColumn && key === Crosswalk.SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME) {
    return "source_column";
  }
  const isTaken = options.draft.columns.some((column) => {
    return column.id !== options.exceptColumnId && _toNameKey(column.name) === key;
  });
  return isTaken ? "taken" : undefined;
}
```

```ts
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { ColumnNameProblem } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/getColumnNameProblem/getColumnNameProblem";

/** The error a name field shows for a column name problem, or undefined. */
export function useColumnNameError(): (
  problem: ColumnNameProblem | undefined,
  name: string,
) => string | undefined {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const sourceColumnName = Crosswalk.SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME;
  return (problem, name) => {
    const trimmedName = name.trim();
    switch (problem) {
      case "blank":
        return t`Enter a name.`;
      case "taken":
        return t`${trimmedName} is already a column of the combined dataset.`;
      case "source_column":
        return t`${sourceColumnName} is the column that names each row's dataset. Choose another name.`;
      default:
        return undefined;
    }
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";

/** The ways a column can be filled, in the order the control offers them. */
export const FILL_KINDS = ["column", "constant", "expression", "empty"] as const;

/** One way a column can be filled. */
export type FillKind = (typeof FILL_KINDS)[number];

type Options = Readonly<{
  kind: FillKind;
  current: CrosswalkMapping.Fill | undefined;
  /** The name of the combined dataset's column being filled. */
  targetName: string;
  /** The layout's columns. */
  columnNames: readonly string[];
  /** The governing entry's primary list, for a governed column. */
  primaryCodeListId: DataDictionaryCodeList.Id | undefined;
}>;

function _pickSourceColumn(options: Options): string {
  if (options.current?.kind === "column") {
    return options.current.sourceColumn;
  }
  const targetKey = options.targetName.trim().toLowerCase();
  const sameName = options.columnNames.find((name) => {
    return name.trim().toLowerCase() === targetKey;
  });
  return sameName ?? options.columnNames[0] ?? "";
}

/**
 * The fill a column starts with when the user switches it to another kind.
 * A column fill reads the current fill's source, else the layout column
 * named like the target (ignoring case), else the layout's first column; a
 * governed column translates with its entry's primary list. Combine starts
 * as that column's placeholder, so it is never blank. Choosing the kind the
 * fill already has keeps it.
 */
export function makeFillForKind(options: Options): CrosswalkMapping.Fill {
  const { kind, current } = options;
  if (current?.kind === kind) {
    return current;
  }
  switch (kind) {
    case "column":
      return {
        kind: "column",
        sourceColumn: _pickSourceColumn(options),
        convert: undefined,
        codeListId: options.primaryCodeListId,
        holdsLabels: false,
      };
    case "constant":
      return { kind: "constant", value: "" };
    case "expression":
      return { kind: "expression", sql: `{${_pickSourceColumn(options)}}` };
    case "empty":
      return { kind: "empty" };
  }
}
```

```ts
import { ColumnProfileSql } from "@/lib/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfileSql/ColumnProfileSql";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType";

/** A change to a source column's values, or none. */
export type ConvertKind = CrosswalkMapping.Convert["kind"] | "none";

/** Multiply's presets, by the unit change each stands for. */
export const MULTIPLY_PRESETS = [
  { key: "months_to_years", factor: 1 / 12 },
  { key: "years_to_months", factor: 12 },
  { key: "days_to_years", factor: 1 / 365.25 },
] as const;

/** One of Multiply's presets. */
export type MultiplyPresetKey = (typeof MULTIPLY_PRESETS)[number]["key"];

/** The digits Pad with zeros starts at: a US ZIP code. */
const DEFAULT_PAD_LENGTH = 5;

/** The format Read as a date starts at when none was detected: ISO. */
const FALLBACK_DATE_FORMAT: string = ColumnProfileSql.DATE_FORMATS[0];

/**
 * The conversions offered for a source column, in the order the Select
 * lists them. Padding needs whole numbers or text: a decimal reads as
 * `501.0`, which no padding fixes.
 */
export function getConvertKinds(
  sourceDataType: AvaDataType.T | undefined,
): ConvertKind[] {
  const canPad =
    sourceDataType === undefined ||
    sourceDataType === "bigint" ||
    sourceDataType === "varchar";
  return [
    "none",
    "parse_date",
    ...(canPad ? (["pad_text"] as const) : []),
    "multiply",
    "trim_and_fix_case",
  ];
}

/** The preset a factor is, or undefined for any other number. */
export function getMultiplyPreset(factor: number): MultiplyPresetKey | undefined {
  return MULTIPLY_PRESETS.find((preset) => {
    return preset.factor === factor;
  })?.key;
}

/**
 * The conversion a fill starts with when the user picks a kind: the
 * current one when it is already that kind, otherwise that kind's default.
 * Read as a date starts with the format detected in the column.
 */
export function makeConvertForKind(
  options: Readonly<{
    kind: ConvertKind;
    current: CrosswalkMapping.Convert | undefined;
    detectedDateFormat: string | undefined;
  }>,
): CrosswalkMapping.Convert | undefined {
  const { kind, current } = options;
  if (kind === "none") {
    return undefined;
  }
  if (current?.kind === kind) {
    return current;
  }
  switch (kind) {
    case "parse_date":
      return { kind, format: options.detectedDateFormat ?? FALLBACK_DATE_FORMAT };
    case "pad_text":
      return { kind, length: DEFAULT_PAD_LENGTH };
    case "multiply":
      return { kind, factor: MULTIPLY_PRESETS[0].factor };
    case "trim_and_fix_case":
      return { kind, letterCase: "keep" };
  }
}
```

```ts
import { quoteSqlIdentifier } from "@avandar/utils/sql";
import { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import { CrosswalkSql } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkSql/CrosswalkSql";
import { WorkspaceQuerySession } from "@/clients/qetl/WorkspaceQuerySession/WorkspaceQuerySession";
import { validateCombineExpression } from "@/lib/crosswalks/validateCombineExpression/validateCombineExpression";
import { useTaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";
import type { TaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";

/** How many example rows the pane shows. */
const EXAMPLE_ROW_COUNT = 3;

/** One example: a value in the dataset, and what the combined dataset holds for it. */
export type FillExampleRow = {
  before: string;
  /** Undefined when the combined dataset holds nothing for the value. */
  after: string | undefined;
};

/** Everything an example reads: what `CrosswalkSql.toFillSql` takes, and where to read. */
export type FillExampleOptions = CrosswalkSql.CodeLists & {
  workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
  /** The layout's first dataset. */
  datasetId: Dataset.Id;
  fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill | undefined;
  /** The column of the combined dataset being filled; a `CrosswalkDraft.Column` fits. */
  column: CrosswalkSql.Column;
  codesOutputAs: Crosswalk.CodesOutput;
  /** The layout's columns, which a Combine formula may name. */
  columnNames: readonly string[];
};

function _toBeforeSql(fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill): string | undefined {
  if (fill.kind === "column") {
    return `CAST(${quoteSqlIdentifier(fill.sourceColumn)} AS VARCHAR)`;
  }
  if (fill.kind !== "expression") {
    return undefined;
  }
  const parts = CrosswalkMapping.getCombineColumnNames(fill.sql).map((name) => {
    return `CAST(${quoteSqlIdentifier(name)} AS VARCHAR)`;
  });
  return parts.length === 0 ? undefined : `concat_ws(', ', ${parts.join(", ")})`;
}

/**
 * The example's query: up to three different values of the fill's source
 * (a column, or a Combine formula's columns joined), each beside exactly
 * the SQL the combined dataset fills the column with, as text. Undefined
 * for a fill with nothing to show: a fixed value, an empty fill, or a
 * Combine formula that is not valid yet.
 */
export function buildFillExampleSql(
  options: Readonly<Omit<FillExampleOptions, "workspaceId">>,
): string | undefined {
  const { fill } = options;
  if (!fill) {
    return undefined;
  }
  if (
    fill.kind === "expression" &&
    !validateCombineExpression({ sql: fill.sql, columnNames: options.columnNames }).isValid
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const beforeSql = _toBeforeSql(fill);
  if (beforeSql === undefined) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const afterSql = CrosswalkSql.toFillSql({
    fill,
    column: options.column,
    codesOutputAs: options.codesOutputAs,
    codeListsById: options.codeListsById,
    primaryCodeListIdByEntryId: options.primaryCodeListIdByEntryId,
  });
  const relation = quoteSqlIdentifier(options.datasetId);
  return (
    `SELECT DISTINCT ${beforeSql} AS "before", CAST(${afterSql} AS VARCHAR) AS "after" ` +
    `FROM ${relation} WHERE ${beforeSql} IS NOT NULL AND ${beforeSql} <> '' LIMIT ${EXAMPLE_ROW_COUNT}`
  );
}

function _toExampleRow(row: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): FillExampleRow {
  const { before, after } = row;
  return {
    before: before === null || before === undefined ? "" : String(before),
    after: after === null || after === undefined ? undefined : String(after),
  };
}

/**
 * Reads a fill's before and after example on this device, once per query,
 * dropping a reply that arrives after the fill changed. Undefined when the
 * fill has no example.
 */
export function useFillExample(
  options: Readonly<FillExampleOptions>,
): TaggedRead<FillExampleRow[]> | undefined {
  const sql = buildFillExampleSql(options);
  const read = useTaggedRead({
    key: sql,
    devMsg: "Reading a crosswalk fill example failed",
    read: async () => {
      const result = await WorkspaceQuerySession.runQuery<Record<string, unknown>>({
        workspaceId: options.workspaceId,
        rawSql: sql ?? "",
      });
      return result.data.map(_toExampleRow);
    },
  });
  return sql === undefined ? undefined : read;
}
```

`useTaggedRead` only runs `read` while its key is defined, so `sql ?? ""` is never sent. Run the test. Expected: PASS.

- [ ] **Step 13: Dictionary names and the type Select.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/useDictionaryNames.ts`. The catalog already loaded every dictionary through the same query (Task 15), so this reads the cache:

```ts
import { where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { DataDictionaryClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryClient/DataDictionaryClient";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";

/** Every dictionary's name in the workspace, by dictionary id. */
export function useDictionaryNames(): ReadonlyMap<string, string> {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const [dictionaries] = DataDictionaryClient.useGetAll(
    where("workspace_id", "eq", workspace.id),
  );
  return useMemo(() => {
    return new Map(
      (dictionaries ?? []).map((dictionary) => {
        return [dictionary.id, dictionary.name] as const;
      }),
    );
  }, [dictionaries]);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 14: Column settings.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/ColumnSettings.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Select, Stack, TextInput } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconTrash } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { ColumnTypeSelect } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/ColumnTypeSelect";
import { getColumnNameProblem } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/getColumnNameProblem/getColumnNameProblem";
import { useColumnNameError } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/useColumnNameError";
import { useDictionaryNames } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/useDictionaryNames";
import type { DataDictionaryEntry } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkContext,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { ComboboxData } from "@mantine/core";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  column: CrosswalkDraft.Column;
  context: CrosswalkContext;
  dispatch: Dispatch<CrosswalkAction>;
};

/** The entry Select's value for "No code list". */
const NO_ENTRY = "";

/** Renames the column when the field is left, if the name is usable. */
function ColumnNameInput({ draft, column, context, dispatch }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const toError = useColumnNameError();
  const [name, setName] = useState(column.name);
  const problem = getColumnNameProblem({ name, draft, exceptColumnId: column.id });
  const commit = (): void => {
    if (problem === undefined && name.trim() !== column.name) {
      dispatch({ type: "column_changed", columnId: column.id, changes: { name: name.trim() }, context });
    }
  };
  return (
    <TextInput
      size="xs"
      label={t`Name`}
      value={name}
      error={toError(problem, name)}
      onChange={(event) => {
        setName(event.currentTarget.value);
      }}
      onBlur={commit}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter") {
          commit();
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}

/**
 * The entry Select's options: "No code list", then every entry with a code
 * list, grouped by dictionary in the user's dictionary order.
 */
function useEntryOptions(context: CrosswalkContext): ComboboxData {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const dictionaryNames = useDictionaryNames();
  const entries = [...context.entriesById.values()]
    .filter((entry) => {
      return entry.codeLists.length > 0;
    })
    .sort((entryA, entryB) => {
      return entryA.dictionaryRank - entryB.dictionaryRank || entryA.position - entryB.position;
    });
  const dictionaryIds = [...new Set(entries.map((entry) => {
    return entry.dictionaryId;
  }))];
  const groups = dictionaryIds.map((dictionaryId) => {
    return {
      group: dictionaryNames.get(dictionaryId) ?? "",
      items: entries
        .filter((entry) => {
          return entry.dictionaryId === dictionaryId;
        })
        .map((entry) => {
          return { value: entry.entryId, label: entry.entryName };
        }),
    };
  });
  return [{ value: NO_ENTRY, label: t`No code list` }, ...groups];
}

function EntrySelect({ column, context, dispatch }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const options = useEntryOptions(context);
  return (
    <Select
      size="xs"
      label={t`Dictionary entry`}
      searchable
      allowDeselect={false}
      value={column.entryId ?? NO_ENTRY}
      data={options}
      onChange={(value) => {
        const entryId = value ? (value as DataDictionaryEntry.Id) : null;
        if (entryId !== (column.entryId ?? null)) {
          dispatch({ type: "column_changed", columnId: column.id, changes: { entryId }, context });
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}

/**
 * The selected column of the combined dataset itself: its name, the type
 * of an ungoverned column (a governed column's type follows its code list
 * and Labels or Codes), the dictionary entry that governs it, and Remove
 * column, unless it is the only column.
 */
export function ColumnSettings(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { draft, column, context, dispatch } = props;
  const columnName = column.name;
  return (
    <Stack gap="sm">
      <ColumnNameInput {...props} />
      {column.entryId ? null : (
        <ColumnTypeSelect
          value={column.dataType}
          onChange={(dataType) => {
            dispatch({ type: "column_changed", columnId: column.id, changes: { dataType }, context });
          }}
        />
      )}
      <EntrySelect {...props} />
      <Button
        variant="subtle"
        color="danger"
        size="compact-xs"
        justify="flex-start"
        leftSection={<IconTrash size={14} aria-hidden />}
        disabled={draft.columns.length <= 1}
        aria-label={t`Remove column ${columnName}`}
        onClick={() => {
          dispatch({ type: "column_removed", columnId: column.id });
        }}
      >
        <Trans>Remove column</Trans>
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

The entry id cast is safe: every option value but `NO_ENTRY` is an entry id from `entriesById`. `ColumnNameInput` keeps its own text while typing; `MappingPane` keys `ColumnSettings` by column id, so selecting another column resets it.

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { SegmentedControl, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "react";
import { FILL_KINDS } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/makeFillForKind/makeFillForKind";
import type { FillKind } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/makeFillForKind/makeFillForKind";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** Undefined while the column has no fill. */
  kind: FillKind | undefined;
  onChange: (kind: FillKind) => void;
};

/**
 * How this column is filled: a column, a fixed value, a Combine formula, or
 * left empty. A radio group named by its visible label; none is chosen
 * while the column has no fill.
 */
export function FillKindControl({ kind, onChange }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labelId = useId();
  const labels: Record<FillKind, string> = {
    column: t`A column`,
    constant: t`A fixed value`,
    expression: t`Combine`,
    empty: t`Leave empty`,
  };
  return (
    <Stack gap={6}>
      <Text id={labelId} size="xs" fw={600} c="dimmed">
        <Trans>How this column is filled</Trans>
      </Text>
      <SegmentedControl
        fullWidth
        size="xs"
        aria-labelledby={labelId}
        value={kind ?? ""}
        data={FILL_KINDS.map((value) => {
          return { value, label: labels[value] };
        })}
        onChange={(value) => {
          const chosen = FILL_KINDS.find((candidate) => {
            return candidate === value;
          });
          if (chosen) {
            onChange(chosen);
          }
        }}
      />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Group, Select, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import type { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  sourceColumn: string;
  /** The layout's first dataset's columns, in column order. */
  sourceColumns: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; dataType: AvaDataType.T }>;
  profilesBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnProfile.T>;
  onChange: (sourceColumn: string) => void;
};

/** The column's most common non-blank value, when profiling listed its values. */
function _getExampleValue(profile: ColumnProfile.T | undefined): string | undefined {
  return profile?.values?.find((item) => {
    return item.value.trim() !== "";
  })?.value;
}

/**
 * The layout column this column is filled from. Each option shows an
 * example of what that column holds, and the chosen one's example sits
 * under the field.
 */
export function SourceColumnSelect(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { profilesBySourceColumn } = props;
  const example = _getExampleValue(profilesBySourceColumn.get(props.sourceColumn));
  return (
    <Select
      size="xs"
      label={t`Column`}
      searchable
      allowDeselect={false}
      value={props.sourceColumn}
      description={example === undefined ? undefined : t`For example: ${example}`}
      data={props.sourceColumns.map((column) => {
        return { value: column.name, label: column.name };
      })}
      renderOption={({ option }) => {
        const optionExample = _getExampleValue(profilesBySourceColumn.get(option.value));
        return (
          <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap" justify="space-between" w="100%">
            <Text size="xs">{option.label}</Text>
            {optionExample === undefined ? null : (
              <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate maw="50%">
                {optionExample}
              </Text>
            )}
          </Group>
        );
      }}
      onChange={(value) => {
        if (value) {
          props.onChange(value);
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 16: Changing the values.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/ConvertControl.tsx`. Each conversion's details live in a small control here; the fill's other fields stay as they were:

```tsx
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { NumberInput, SegmentedControl, Select, Stack, Text, TextInput } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { toDateFormatLabel } from "@/lib/crosswalks/toDateFormatLabel/toDateFormatLabel";
import { ColumnProfileSql } from "@/lib/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfileSql/ColumnProfileSql";
import {
  getConvertKinds,
  getMultiplyPreset,
  makeConvertForKind,
  MULTIPLY_PRESETS,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/convertDefaults/convertDefaults";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType";
import type {
  ConvertKind,
  MultiplyPresetKey,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/convertDefaults/convertDefaults";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Convert = CrosswalkMapping.Convert;
type OnConvert = (convert: Convert | undefined) => void;

/** The format and factor Selects' value for typing one's own. */
const OWN_VALUE = "own";

/** The formats the date Select offers, the ones a layout's values are checked against. */
const DATE_FORMATS: readonly string[] = ColumnProfileSql.DATE_FORMATS;

const LETTER_CASES = ["keep", "lower", "upper"] as const;

function DateFormatControl(props: Readonly<{ format: string; onChange: OnConvert }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const [isOwnFormat, setIsOwnFormat] = useState(!DATE_FORMATS.includes(props.format));
  const exampleFormat = "%d.%m.%Y";
  return (
    <>
      <Select
        size="xs"
        label={t`Date format`}
        allowDeselect={false}
        value={isOwnFormat ? OWN_VALUE : props.format}
        data={[
          ...DATE_FORMATS.map((format) => {
            return { value: format, label: toDateFormatLabel(format) };
          }),
          { value: OWN_VALUE, label: t`Another format` },
        ]}
        onChange={(value) => {
          setIsOwnFormat(value === OWN_VALUE);
          if (value && value !== OWN_VALUE) {
            props.onChange({ kind: "parse_date", format: value });
          }
        }}
      />
      {isOwnFormat ? (
        <TextInput
          size="xs"
          label={t`Format`}
          description={t`Use %Y for the year, %m for the month, and %d for the day, such as ${exampleFormat}.`}
          defaultValue={props.format}
          onChange={(event) => {
            const format = event.currentTarget.value;
            if (format.trim() !== "") {
              props.onChange({ kind: "parse_date", format });
            }
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

function MultiplyControl(props: Readonly<{ factor: number; onChange: OnConvert }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const preset = getMultiplyPreset(props.factor);
  const [isOwnFactor, setIsOwnFactor] = useState(preset === undefined);
  const labels: Record<MultiplyPresetKey, string> = {
    months_to_years: t`Months to years`,
    years_to_months: t`Years to months`,
    days_to_years: t`Days to years`,
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Select
        size="xs"
        label={t`Factor`}
        allowDeselect={false}
        value={isOwnFactor ? OWN_VALUE : (preset ?? OWN_VALUE)}
        data={[
          ...MULTIPLY_PRESETS.map((item) => {
            return { value: item.key, label: labels[item.key] };
          }),
          { value: OWN_VALUE, label: t`Another number` },
        ]}
        onChange={(value) => {
          const chosen = MULTIPLY_PRESETS.find((item) => {
            return item.key === value;
          });
          setIsOwnFactor(chosen === undefined);
          if (chosen) {
            props.onChange({ kind: "multiply", factor: chosen.factor });
          }
        }}
      />
      {isOwnFactor ? (
        <NumberInput
          size="xs"
          label={t`Multiply by`}
          decimalScale={10}
          defaultValue={props.factor}
          onChange={(value) => {
            if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value !== 0) {
              props.onChange({ kind: "multiply", factor: value });
            }
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

function LetterCaseControl(
  props: Readonly<{ letterCase: (typeof LETTER_CASES)[number]; onChange: OnConvert }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labelId = useId();
  const labels = { keep: t`Keep case`, lower: t`lowercase`, upper: t`UPPERCASE` };
  return (
    <Stack gap={6}>
      <Text id={labelId} size="xs" fw={600} c="dimmed">
        {t`Letter case`}
      </Text>
      <SegmentedControl
        fullWidth
        size="xs"
        aria-labelledby={labelId}
        value={props.letterCase}
        data={LETTER_CASES.map((value) => {
          return { value, label: labels[value] };
        })}
        onChange={(value) => {
          const letterCase = LETTER_CASES.find((candidate) => {
            return candidate === value;
          });
          if (letterCase) {
            props.onChange({ kind: "trim_and_fix_case", letterCase });
          }
        }}
      />
    </Stack>
  );
}

function PadLengthInput(props: Readonly<{ length: number; onChange: OnConvert }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return (
    <NumberInput
      size="xs"
      label={t`Length`}
      description={t`Values made only of digits get leading zeros up to this length. Longer values stay as they are.`}
      min={1}
      max={64}
      allowDecimal={false}
      allowNegative={false}
      value={props.length}
      onChange={(value) => {
        if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 1) {
          props.onChange({ kind: "pad_text", length: value });
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}

/** The chosen conversion's own settings. */
function ConvertDetails(props: Readonly<{ convert: Convert | undefined; onChange: OnConvert }>): ReactNode {
  const { convert, onChange } = props;
  switch (convert?.kind) {
    case "parse_date":
      return <DateFormatControl format={convert.format} onChange={onChange} />;
    case "pad_text":
      return <PadLengthInput length={convert.length} onChange={onChange} />;
    case "multiply":
      return <MultiplyControl factor={convert.factor} onChange={onChange} />;
    case "trim_and_fix_case":
      return <LetterCaseControl letterCase={convert.letterCase} onChange={onChange} />;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

function useConvertKindLabels(): Record<ConvertKind, string> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return {
    none: t`No change`,
    parse_date: t`Read as a date`,
    pad_text: t`Pad with zeros`,
    multiply: t`Multiply`,
    trim_and_fix_case: t`Trim spaces`,
  };
}

type Props = {
  convert: Convert | undefined;
  /** The source column's type, which decides whether padding is offered. */
  sourceDataType: AvaDataType.T | undefined;
  detectedDateFormat: string | undefined;
  onChange: OnConvert;
};

/**
 * Change the values: no change, read as a date, pad with zeros, multiply,
 * or trim spaces, each with its own settings below the Select.
 */
export function ConvertControl(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labels = useConvertKindLabels();
  const { convert } = props;
  const offered = getConvertKinds(props.sourceDataType);
  const kinds = convert && !offered.includes(convert.kind) ? [...offered, convert.kind] : offered;
  return (
    <Stack gap="xs">
      <Select
        size="xs"
        label={t`Change the values`}
        allowDeselect={false}
        value={convert?.kind ?? "none"}
        data={kinds.map((kind) => {
          return { value: kind, label: labels[kind] };
        })}
        onChange={(value) => {
          const kind = kinds.find((candidate) => {
            return candidate === value;
          });
          if (kind) {
            props.onChange(makeConvertForKind({ kind, current: convert, detectedDateFormat: props.detectedDateFormat }));
          }
        }}
      />
      <ConvertDetails convert={convert} onChange={props.onChange} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

A conversion stored before its source changed type stays listed, so the Select never shows blank.

- [ ] **Step 17: Translating codes, a fixed value, and Combine.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/TranslateCodesControl.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { SegmentedControl, Select, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "react";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DictionaryMatch } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryMatch/DictionaryMatch";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/** The list Select's value for "Don't translate". */
const NO_TRANSLATION = "";

/** What translating a column's codes changes in its fill. */
export type TranslationChange = {
  codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeList.Id | undefined;
  holdsLabels: boolean;
};

type Props = TranslationChange & {
  /** The entry that governs the column, or undefined when it is gone. */
  entry: DictionaryMatch.Entry | undefined;
  onChange: (change: TranslationChange) => void;
};

function HoldsControl(props: Readonly<Props & { codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeList.Id }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labelId = useId();
  return (
    <Stack gap={6}>
      <Text id={labelId} size="xs" fw={600} c="dimmed">
        <Trans>The column holds</Trans>
      </Text>
      <SegmentedControl
        fullWidth
        size="xs"
        aria-labelledby={labelId}
        value={props.holdsLabels ? "labels" : "codes"}
        data={[
          { value: "codes", label: t`Codes` },
          { value: "labels", label: t`Labels` },
        ]}
        onChange={(value) => {
          props.onChange({ codeListId: props.codeListId, holdsLabels: value === "labels" });
        }}
      />
    </Stack>
  );
}

/**
 * For a governed column: which of the entry's code lists this dataset's
 * values are written in, and whether they are its codes or its labels. The
 * combined dataset reconciles them to the entry's primary list. A list
 * that was deleted is called out until another is chosen.
 */
export function TranslateCodesControl(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const codeLists = props.entry?.codeLists ?? [];
  const { codeListId } = props;
  const isMissing =
    codeListId !== undefined &&
    !codeLists.some((codeList) => {
      return codeList.id === codeListId;
    });
  return (
    <Stack gap="xs">
      <Select
        size="xs"
        label={t`Translate codes with`}
        allowDeselect={false}
        value={isMissing ? null : (codeListId ?? NO_TRANSLATION)}
        error={isMissing ? t`The code list this used was deleted. Choose another.` : undefined}
        data={[
          { value: NO_TRANSLATION, label: t`Don't translate` },
          ...codeLists.map((codeList) => {
            return { value: codeList.id, label: codeList.name };
          }),
        ]}
        onChange={(value) => {
          const chosen = codeLists.find((codeList) => {
            return codeList.id === value;
          });
          props.onChange({ codeListId: chosen?.id, holdsLabels: chosen ? props.holdsLabels : false });
        }}
      />
      {codeListId && !isMissing ? <HoldsControl {...props} codeListId={codeListId} /> : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/CombineInput.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Menu, Stack, Textarea } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconPlus } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { validateCombineExpression } from "@/lib/crosswalks/validateCombineExpression/validateCombineExpression";
import type { CombineExpressionCheck } from "@/lib/crosswalks/validateCombineExpression/validateCombineExpression";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  sql: string;
  /** The layout's columns, the only ones a formula may name. */
  columnNames: readonly string[];
  /** Called with every non-blank text. */
  onChange: (sql: string) => void;
};

/** The text with `token` in place of the textarea's selection, or at its end. */
function _insertAtSelection(text: string, textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null, token: string): string {
  const start = textarea?.selectionStart ?? text.length;
  const end = textarea?.selectionEnd ?? start;
  return `${text.slice(0, start)}${token}${text.slice(end)}`;
}

function useCombineError(check: CombineExpressionCheck): string | undefined {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  if (check.isValid) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const columnName = check.columnName ?? "";
  switch (check.reason) {
    case "empty":
      return t`Write a formula, or choose another way to fill this column.`;
    case "unknown_column":
      return t`${columnName} isn't a column of this dataset.`;
    case "invalid_sql":
      return t`This isn't a single SQL expression. Check its brackets, quotes, and commas.`;
  }
}

function InsertColumnMenu(props: Readonly<{ columnNames: readonly string[]; onInsert: (name: string) => void }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Menu position="bottom-start" shadow="md">
      <Menu.Target>
        <Button variant="default" size="compact-xs" leftSection={<IconPlus size={12} aria-hidden />}>
          <Trans>Insert column</Trans>
        </Button>
      </Menu.Target>
      <Menu.Dropdown mah={240} style={{ overflowY: "auto" }}>
        {props.columnNames.map((name) => {
          return (
            <Menu.Item key={name} onClick={() => {
                props.onInsert(name);
              }}>
              {name}
            </Menu.Item>
          );
        })}
      </Menu.Dropdown>
    </Menu>
  );
}

/**
 * A Combine formula: one SQL expression over this layout's columns, named
 * in braces. It is checked as it is typed, and Insert column puts a
 * column's placeholder where the cursor is. Blank text is never sent, since
 * a Combine fill cannot be saved blank.
 */
export function CombineInput(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const [text, setText] = useState(props.sql);
  const error = useCombineError(validateCombineExpression({ sql: text, columnNames: props.columnNames }));
  const exampleFormula = "{first_name}";
  const update = (nextText: string): void => {
    setText(nextText);
    if (nextText.trim() !== "") {
      props.onChange(nextText);
    }
  };
  return (
    <Stack gap={6} align="flex-start">
      <Textarea
        ref={textareaRef}
        w="100%"
        size="xs"
        autosize
        minRows={2}
        label={t`Formula`}
        description={t`One SQL expression. Put column names in braces, such as ${exampleFormula}.`}
        value={text}
        error={error}
        onChange={(event) => {
          update(event.currentTarget.value);
        }}
      />
      <InsertColumnMenu
        columnNames={props.columnNames}
        onInsert={(name) => {
          update(_insertAtSelection(text, textareaRef.current, `{${name}}`));
        }}
      />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

The `mah` and `style` on `Menu.Dropdown` are the one inline style here: Mantine's dropdown takes no `className` scroll token, and a long layout needs the list to scroll. If the design detector flags it, move `overflow-y: auto` into `MappingPane.module.css` as `.insertColumnList` and pass `className`. `MappingPane` keys `CombineInput` by layout and column, so its text resets when either changes.

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Group, Loader, Stack, Table, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useDebouncedValue } from "@mantine/hooks";
import { useId } from "react";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/MappingPane.module.css";
import { useFillExample } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/useFillExample/useFillExample";
import type {
  FillExampleOptions,
  FillExampleRow,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/useFillExample/useFillExample";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/** How long the fill must stay unchanged before its example is read. */
const EXAMPLE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;

type Props = FillExampleOptions & { datasetName: string };

function ExampleTable(props: Readonly<{ rows: readonly FillExampleRow[]; labelId: string }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Table fz="xs" verticalSpacing={4} aria-labelledby={props.labelId}>
      <Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tr>
          <Table.Th>
            <Trans>In this dataset</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th>
            <Trans>In the combined dataset</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
        </Table.Tr>
      </Table.Thead>
      <Table.Tbody>
        {props.rows.map((row) => {
          return (
            <Table.Tr key={row.before}>
              <Table.Td className={css.exampleValue}>{row.before}</Table.Td>
              <Table.Td className={css.exampleValue}>
                {row.after === undefined ? (
                  <Text span size="xs" c="dimmed" fs="italic">
                    <Trans>Becomes empty</Trans>
                  </Text>
                ) : (
                  row.after
                )}
              </Table.Td>
            </Table.Tr>
          );
        })}
      </Table.Tbody>
    </Table>
  );
}

/**
 * Up to three values from the layout's first dataset and what the combined
 * dataset holds for each, read with the SQL it will run. A value the fill
 * cannot convert says it becomes empty. Nothing shows for a fill with no
 * example.
 */
export function FillExample(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labelId = useId();
  const [fill] = useDebouncedValue(props.fill, EXAMPLE_DEBOUNCE_MS);
  const example = useFillExample({ ...props, fill });
  if (!example) {
    return null;
  }
  const { datasetName } = props;
  return (
    <Stack gap={6}>
      <Text id={labelId} size="xs" fw={600} c="dimmed">
        <Trans>Example</Trans>
      </Text>
      {example.status === "reading" ? (
        <Group gap="xs" role="status" aria-label={t`Reading an example`}>
          <Loader size="xs" />
        </Group>
      ) : null}
      {example.status === "failed" ? (
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>The example could not be read. The column is still filled this way.</Trans>
        </Text>
      ) : null}
      {example.status === "ready" && example.result.length === 0 ? (
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>{datasetName} has no values to show here.</Trans>
        </Text>
      ) : null}
      {example.status === "ready" && example.result.length > 0 ? (
        <ExampleTable rows={example.result} labelId={labelId} />
      ) : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

The example query is `SELECT DISTINCT`, so `before` is unique per row and a safe key.

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Badge, Group, Stack, Text, Title } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId, useMemo } from "react";
import { avaDataTypeLabel } from "$/copy/avaDataTypeLabel";
import { buildCodeListLookups } from "@/lib/crosswalks/buildCodeListLookups/buildCodeListLookups";
import { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { ColumnSettings } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/ColumnSettings";
import { CombineInput } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/CombineInput";
import { ConstantInput } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/ConstantInput";
import { ConvertControl } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/ConvertControl";
import { FillExample } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/FillExample";
import { FillKindControl } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/FillKindControl";
import { makeFillForKind } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/makeFillForKind/makeFillForKind";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/MappingPane.module.css";
import { SourceColumnSelect } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/SourceColumnSelect";
import { SuggestionActions } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/SuggestionActions";
import { TranslateCodesControl } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/TranslateCodesControl";
import type { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { CrosswalkSql } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkSql/CrosswalkSql";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkContext,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout;
  column: CrosswalkDraft.Column;
  /** The layout's first dataset's columns, in column order. */
  sourceColumns: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; dataType: AvaDataType.T }>;
  profilesBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnProfile.T>;
  dateFormatsBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
  context: CrosswalkContext;
  dispatch: Dispatch<CrosswalkAction>;
};

type FillProps = Props & {
  lookups: CrosswalkSql.CodeLists;
  setFill: (fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill) => void;
};

function _sameName(nameA: string, nameB: string): boolean {
  return nameA.trim().toLowerCase() === nameB.trim().toLowerCase();
}

function PaneHeading(props: Readonly<{ id: string; column: CrosswalkDraft.Column }>): ReactNode {
  const { column } = props;
  return (
    <Stack gap={2}>
      <Title order={3} size="h5" id={props.id}>
        {column.name}
      </Title>
      <Group gap="xs">
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
          {avaDataTypeLabel(column.dataType)}
        </Text>
        {column.entryId ? (
          <Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="neutral">
            <Trans>Code list</Trans>
          </Badge>
        ) : null}
      </Group>
    </Stack>
  );
}

function ColumnFillControls(props: Readonly<FillProps & { fill: Extract<CrosswalkMapping.Fill, { kind: "column" }> }>): ReactNode {
  const { fill, column, setFill } = props;
  const sourceDataType = props.sourceColumns.find((source) => {
    return _sameName(source.name, fill.sourceColumn);
  })?.dataType;
  return (
    <>
      <SourceColumnSelect
        sourceColumn={fill.sourceColumn}
        sourceColumns={props.sourceColumns}
        profilesBySourceColumn={props.profilesBySourceColumn}
        onChange={(sourceColumn) => {
          setFill({ ...fill, sourceColumn });
        }}
      />
      {column.entryId ? (
        <TranslateCodesControl
          entry={props.context.entriesById.get(column.entryId)}
          codeListId={fill.codeListId}
          holdsLabels={fill.holdsLabels}
          onChange={(change) => {
            setFill({ ...fill, ...change, convert: undefined });
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <ConvertControl
          convert={fill.convert}
          sourceDataType={sourceDataType}
          detectedDateFormat={props.dateFormatsBySourceColumn.get(fill.sourceColumn)}
          onChange={(convert) => {
            setFill({ ...fill, convert, codeListId: undefined, holdsLabels: false });
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/** The controls for the fill's kind. */
function FillDetails(props: Readonly<FillProps & { fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill }>): ReactNode {
  const { fill, setFill } = props;
  const columnName = props.column.name;
  switch (fill.kind) {
    case "column":
      return <ColumnFillControls {...props} fill={fill} />;
    case "constant":
      return (
        <ConstantInput
          value={fill.value}
          onChange={(value) => {
            setFill({ kind: "constant", value });
          }}
        />
      );
    case "expression":
      return (
        <CombineInput
          key={`${props.layout.id}:${props.column.id}`}
          sql={fill.sql}
          columnNames={props.layout.columnNames}
          onChange={(sql) => {
            setFill({ kind: "expression", sql });
          }}
        />
      );
    case "empty":
      return (
        <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>Rows from these datasets leave {columnName} empty.</Trans>
        </Text>
      );
  }
}

/** The example for a fill, read from the layout's first dataset. */
function FillExampleSlot(props: Readonly<FillProps & { fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill }>): ReactNode {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const { layout } = props;
  const datasetId = layout.datasetIds[0];
  if (!datasetId) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <FillExample
      workspaceId={workspace.id}
      datasetId={datasetId}
      datasetName={props.context.datasetsById.get(datasetId)?.name ?? ""}
      fill={props.fill}
      column={props.column}
      codesOutputAs={props.draft.codesOutputAs}
      columnNames={layout.columnNames}
      {...props.lookups}
    />
  );
}

function FillSection(props: Readonly<FillProps>): ReactNode {
  const { draft, layout, column, dispatch } = props;
  const mapping = CrosswalkDraft.getFill(draft, layout.id, column.id);
  const fill = mapping?.fill;
  const primaryCodeListId = column.entryId
    ? (props.lookups.primaryCodeListIdByEntryId.get(column.entryId) as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id | undefined)
    : undefined;
  return (
    <Stack gap="md" className={css.fillSection}>
      <FillKindControl
        kind={fill?.kind}
        onChange={(kind) => {
          props.setFill(makeFillForKind({ kind, current: fill, targetName: column.name, columnNames: layout.columnNames, primaryCodeListId }));
        }}
      />
      {fill ? (
        <>
          <FillDetails {...props} fill={fill} />
          <FillExampleSlot {...props} fill={fill} />
        </>
      ) : (
        <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>Not filled yet</Trans>
        </Text>
      )}
      {mapping?.status === "suggested" ? (
        <SuggestionActions
          columnName={column.name}
          onAccept={() => {
            dispatch({ type: "suggestion_accepted", layoutId: layout.id, columnId: column.id });
          }}
          onReject={() => {
            dispatch({ type: "suggestion_rejected", layoutId: layout.id, columnId: column.id });
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}

/**
 * Step 2's side pane: the selected column of the combined dataset, its own
 * settings, and how the selected layout fills it, with an example of what
 * that gives and Accept or Reject while the fill is a suggestion. Every
 * change is stored as a confirmed fill.
 */
export function MappingPane(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const headingId = useId();
  const { layout, column, dispatch, context } = props;
  const lookups = useMemo(() => {
    return buildCodeListLookups(context.entriesById);
  }, [context.entriesById]);
  const setFill = (fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill): void => {
    dispatch({ type: "fill_set", layoutId: layout.id, columnId: column.id, fill });
  };
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headingId}>
      <Stack gap="md">
        <PaneHeading id={headingId} column={column} />
        <ColumnSettings key={column.id} draft={props.draft} column={column} context={context} dispatch={dispatch} />
        <FillSection {...props} lookups={lookups} setFill={setFill} />
      </Stack>
    </section>
  );
}
```

`CrosswalkDraft` is imported as a value here because `getFill` is on the module (Task 15); its namespace types come with it. The primary list id cast is safe: `primaryCodeListIdByEntryId` holds code list ids as plain strings.

### Task 22: Map each dataset: the step assembled, the footer, added columns

This task puts step 2 together (spec section 7.6) and replaces the `map` placeholder in Task 16's `CrosswalkStepBody`. Direction, with the `impeccable` skill still loaded from Task 21: three regions of one surface, left to right. The layout stub (Task 19, about 260px) sits on the tinted body surface with a hairline on its trailing edge; the mapping table (Task 20) is the only lit region, inside `AppViewBody`'s content column under an `AppViewSection` whose title is the layout's name and whose meta is "+n with the same layout"; the side pane (Task 21) is `AppViewBody`'s rail, widened to `22rem` like the apply flow's. **Add a column to the combined dataset** sits under the table as a subtle button that opens a small popover form. The footer is the step's sticky action bar (`NewDictionaryFooter`, which carries `data-sticky-action-bar`): **Skip this dataset** on the leading edge, **Accept all suggestions** (default) and **Confirm and next** (the one filled button) on the trailing edge; a skipped layout shows **Map this dataset** as its only action.

The shown layout is the search param's `layoutId` when it names a layout of the draft, otherwise the first layout that is To do or Review, otherwise the reference layout. The selected column is local state, reset per layout by keying the layout's subtree on its id; it starts at the first column whose fill is missing or a suggestion, and falls back to that rule again when the selected column is removed. The reference layout renders like any other: its fills are the identity fills `columns_seeded` confirmed, so the table and pane show them and let the user add a conversion.

Every footer action goes through the flow, which runs the reducer once per action and keeps the result in a ref: **Skip this dataset**, **Accept all suggestions**, **Confirm and next**, and **Map this dataset** each call `flow.dispatchAndSave(action)`, which saves the draft that action produced. The step never runs `crosswalkReducer` itself: the reducer mints uuids, so a second run would predict a different draft from the one the flow keeps. A failed save keeps the user's change in the draft and does not move on; `useSaveCrosswalk` has already shown why. Moving on selects the next layout after this one that is To do or Review, wrapping, through `flow.selectLayout`, or goes to step 3 with `flow.goToStep("combine")` when none is left. That next layout is chosen from the draft before the action: Skip and Confirm change only this layout's status, which the choice never reads. Selecting a layout in the stub calls `flow.selectLayout` too, which saves a dirty draft first and stays put when that save fails.

**What this task builds on** (Tasks 16 to 20):

```ts
// CV/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow.ts (Task 16)
type CrosswalkFlow = {
  state: CrosswalkState; // { draft; savedDraft; readLayoutIds }
  dispatch: (action: CrosswalkAction) => void;
  step: CrosswalkStep;
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
  reachableSteps: ReadonlySet<CrosswalkStep>;
  goToStep: (step: CrosswalkStep, layoutId?: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => void;
  selectLayout: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => Promise<void>; // saves first when dirty
  save: (draft: CrosswalkDraft.T) => Promise<boolean>;
  dispatchAndSave: (action: CrosswalkAction) => Promise<boolean>;
  isSaving: boolean;
};
// CV/CrosswalkStepBody.tsx (Task 16)
type CrosswalkStepProps = { flow: CrosswalkFlow; catalog: CrosswalkCatalog; crosswalk: Crosswalk.T | undefined };
// CV/MapLayoutsStep/LayoutStub/LayoutStub.tsx (Task 19)
type LayoutStubProps = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
  selectedLayoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined;
  onSelectLayout: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => void;
};
// CV/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/MappingTable.tsx (Task 20)
type MappingTableProps = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
  entriesById: ReadonlyMap<string, DictionaryMatch.Entry>;
  selectedColumnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id | undefined;
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/mapStepSelection/mapStepSelection.ts`:**

```ts
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";

type Layouts = Pick<CrosswalkDraft.T, "layouts">;

function _isToMap(layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout): boolean {
  return layout.status === "to_do" || layout.status === "review";
}

/**
 * The layout step 2 shows: the one the search names when the draft has it,
 * otherwise the first layout that is To do or Review, otherwise the
 * reference layout, otherwise the first one.
 */
export function chooseShownLayout(
  draft: Layouts,
  layoutId: string | undefined,
): CrosswalkDraft.Layout | undefined {
  const named = draft.layouts.find((layout) => {
    return layout.id === layoutId;
  });
  const reference = draft.layouts.find((layout) => {
    return layout.isReference;
  });
  return named ?? draft.layouts.find(_isToMap) ?? reference ?? draft.layouts[0];
}

/**
 * The layout to map after `afterLayoutId`: the first one after it, wrapping
 * around, that is To do or Review, never `afterLayoutId` itself. Undefined
 * when none is left, which sends the user to step 3.
 */
export function findNextLayoutToMap(
  draft: Layouts,
  afterLayoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id,
): CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined {
  const index = draft.layouts.findIndex((layout) => {
    return layout.id === afterLayoutId;
  });
  const ordered = [
    ...draft.layouts.slice(index + 1),
    ...draft.layouts.slice(0, Math.max(index, 0)),
  ];
  return ordered.find(_isToMap)?.id;
}

/**
 * The column the side pane shows: the chosen one while it still exists,
 * otherwise the first column whose fill in this layout is missing or a
 * suggestion, otherwise the first column.
 */
export function chooseSelectedColumnId(
  draft: Pick<CrosswalkDraft.T, "columns" | "mappings">,
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id,
  chosenColumnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id | undefined,
): CrosswalkColumn.Id | undefined {
  const isChosenPresent = draft.columns.some((column) => {
    return column.id === chosenColumnId;
  });
  if (isChosenPresent) {
    return chosenColumnId;
  }
  const layoutMappings = draft.mappings[layoutId] ?? {};
  const needingAttention = draft.columns.find((column) => {
    const mapping = layoutMappings[column.id];
    return !mapping || mapping.status === "suggested";
  });
  return (needingAttention ?? draft.columns[0])?.id;
}

/** Whether a layout still has a suggested fill, for Accept all suggestions. */
export function hasSuggestions(
  draft: Pick<CrosswalkDraft.T, "mappings">,
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id,
): boolean {
  return Object.values(draft.mappings[layoutId] ?? {}).some((mapping) => {
    return mapping.status === "suggested";
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/useMapStepActions/useMapStepActions.ts`:**

```ts
import { useIsMounted } from "@/lib/hooks/state/useIsMounted";
import { findNextLayoutToMap } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/mapStepSelection/mapStepSelection";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkAction } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";

type LayoutAction = (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => Promise<void>;

/** The actions that finish with a layout and move on to the next one. */
type MovingAction = Extract<
  CrosswalkAction,
  { type: "layout_confirmed" | "layout_skipped" }
>;

/** What step 2's footer does. Each action saves the draft it produced. */
export type MapStepActions = {
  /** Skip this dataset, then the next layout to map. */
  skip: LayoutAction;
  /** Map this dataset: returns a skipped layout to the list to map. */
  reopen: LayoutAction;
  /** Accept all suggestions. */
  acceptAll: LayoutAction;
  /** Confirm and next. */
  confirmAndNext: LayoutAction;
};

/**
 * Step 2's footer actions. Each applies its action and saves the draft it
 * produced through `flow.dispatchAndSave`. Skip and Confirm then move on to
 * the next layout after this one that is To do or Review, or to step 3 when
 * none is left. That next layout is read from the draft before the action:
 * both actions change only this layout's status, which the choice skips
 * anyway, and `flow.state` here is the state this render saw, not the one
 * the action produced. A failed save keeps the change and stays put;
 * nothing moves once the user has left the view.
 */
export function useMapStepActions(flow: CrosswalkFlow): MapStepActions {
  const isMountedRef = useIsMounted();
  const saveThenMove = async (action: MovingAction): Promise<void> => {
    const nextLayoutId = findNextLayoutToMap(flow.state.draft, action.layoutId);
    if (!(await flow.dispatchAndSave(action)) || !isMountedRef.current) {
      return;
    }
    if (nextLayoutId) {
      await flow.selectLayout(nextLayoutId);
    } else {
      flow.goToStep("combine");
    }
  };
  return {
    skip: async (layoutId) => {
      await saveThenMove({ type: "layout_skipped", layoutId });
    },
    reopen: async (layoutId) => {
      await flow.dispatchAndSave({ type: "layout_reopened", layoutId });
    },
    acceptAll: async (layoutId) => {
      await flow.dispatchAndSave({ type: "suggestions_accepted", layoutId });
    },
    confirmAndNext: async (layoutId) => {
      await saveThenMove({ type: "layout_confirmed", layoutId });
    },
  };
}
```

Every action saves through the flow's one `useSaveCrosswalk`, so its second-press guard covers them all, and the footer reads `flow.isSaving`. After a successful save the draft is clean, so `flow.selectLayout` only opens the next layout. Run the test. Expected: PASS.

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button } from "@mantine/core";
import { OfflineGated } from "@/components/offline/OfflineGated/OfflineGated";
import { NewDictionaryFooter } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/NewDictionaryFooter/NewDictionaryFooter";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout;
  hasSuggestions: boolean;
  isSaving: boolean;
  onSkip: () => void;
  onReopen: () => void;
  onAcceptAll: () => void;
  onConfirm: () => void;
};

function SkipButton(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  if (props.layout.isReference) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <OfflineGated>
      <Button variant="subtle" color="neutral" disabled={props.isSaving} onClick={props.onSkip}>
        <Trans>Skip this dataset</Trans>
      </Button>
    </OfflineGated>
  );
}

/**
 * Step 2's action bar for the shown layout: Skip this dataset (never for
 * the reference layout), Accept all suggestions while any are left, and
 * Confirm and next. A skipped layout offers only Map this dataset.
 */
export function MapLayoutsFooter(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  if (props.layout.status === "skipped") {
    return (
      <NewDictionaryFooter>
        <OfflineGated>
          <Button loading={props.isSaving} onClick={props.onReopen}>
            <Trans>Map this dataset</Trans>
          </Button>
        </OfflineGated>
      </NewDictionaryFooter>
    );
  }
  return (
    <NewDictionaryFooter start={<SkipButton {...props} />}>
      <OfflineGated>
        <Button variant="default" disabled={!props.hasSuggestions || props.isSaving} onClick={props.onAcceptAll}>
          <Trans>Accept all suggestions</Trans>
        </Button>
      </OfflineGated>
      <OfflineGated>
        <Button loading={props.isSaving} onClick={props.onConfirm}>
          <Trans>Confirm and next</Trans>
        </Button>
      </OfflineGated>
    </NewDictionaryFooter>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Group, Popover, Stack, TextInput } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconPlus } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { uuid } from "$/lib/uuid";
import { ColumnTypeSelect } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/ColumnTypeSelect";
import { getColumnNameProblem } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/getColumnNameProblem/getColumnNameProblem";
import { useColumnNameError } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/useColumnNameError";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CrosswalkAction } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  dispatch: Dispatch<CrosswalkAction>;
};

function AddColumnForm(
  props: Readonly<{ draft: CrosswalkDraft.T; onAdd: (name: string, dataType: AvaDataType.T) => void }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const toError = useColumnNameError();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [dataType, setDataType] = useState<AvaDataType.T>("varchar");
  const [hasTriedToAdd, setHasTriedToAdd] = useState(false);
  const problem = getColumnNameProblem({ name, draft: props.draft });
  const isShowingProblem = hasTriedToAdd || name.trim() !== "";
  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        setHasTriedToAdd(true);
        if (problem === undefined) {
          props.onAdd(name.trim(), dataType);
        }
      }}
    >
      <Stack gap="sm" w={260}>
        <TextInput
          size="xs"
          label={t`Column name`}
          data-autofocus
          value={name}
          error={isShowingProblem ? toError(problem, name) : undefined}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setName(event.currentTarget.value);
          }}
        />
        <ColumnTypeSelect value={dataType} onChange={setDataType} />
        <Group justify="flex-end">
          <Button type="submit" size="xs">
            <Trans>Add column</Trans>
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </form>
  );
}

/**
 * Add a column to the combined dataset: a small form for its name and
 * type. A name another column has, ignoring case, or the source column's
 * name while it is added, is refused with the reason. The new column has
 * no fill in any layout until the user gives it one.
 */
export function AddColumnButton({ draft, dispatch }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Popover opened={isOpen} onChange={setIsOpen} position="bottom-start" shadow="md" trapFocus>
      <Popover.Target>
        <Button
          variant="subtle"
          size="compact-sm"
          leftSection={<IconPlus size={14} aria-hidden />}
          onClick={() => {
            setIsOpen((wasOpen) => {
              return !wasOpen;
            });
          }}
        >
          <Trans>Add a column to the combined dataset</Trans>
        </Button>
      </Popover.Target>
      <Popover.Dropdown>
        <AddColumnForm
          draft={draft}
          onAdd={(name, dataType) => {
            dispatch({ type: "column_added", columnId: uuid<CrosswalkColumn.Id>(), name, dataType });
            setIsOpen(false);
          }}
        />
      </Popover.Dropdown>
    </Popover>
  );
}
```

```tsx
      return <p>pane for {props.column.name}</p>;
    },
  };
});

function _render(flow: CrosswalkFlow = makeFlow()): CrosswalkFlow {
  render(<MapLayoutsStep flow={flow} catalog={makeCatalog()} crosswalk={undefined} />);
  return flow;
}

function _withStatus(layoutId: string, status: CrosswalkDraft.Layout["status"]): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const draft = makeDraft();
  return {
    ...draft,
    layouts: draft.layouts.map((layout) => {
      return layout.id === layoutId ? { ...layout, status } : layout;
    }),
  };
}

describe("MapLayoutsStep", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mocks.valuesStatus = "ready";
  });

  it("shows the first layout to map, named by its first dataset, with the column needing attention", () => {
    _render();

    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { name: "Queens 2026-03" })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("+1 with the same layout")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("pane for sex")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "stub" })).toHaveAttribute("data-selected", QUEENS_LAYOUT_ID);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "table" })).toHaveAttribute("data-layout", QUEENS_LAYOUT_ID);
  });

  it("says while the layout's values are read", () => {
    mocks.valuesStatus = "reading";
    _render();

    expect(screen.getByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent("Reading the values of Queens 2026-03 on this device");
  });

  it("shows the column picked in the table", () => {
    _render();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "table" }));

    expect(screen.getByText(`pane for ${ONSET_COLUMN.name}`)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("selects the layout picked in the stub through the flow, which saves first", () => {
    const flow = _render();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "stub" }));

    expect(flow.selectLayout).toHaveBeenCalledWith(BRONX_LAYOUT_ID);
    expect(flow.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("confirms the layout and moves to the next one to map", async () => {
    const flow = _render();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm and next" }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(flow.selectLayout).toHaveBeenCalledWith(BRONX_LAYOUT_ID);
    });
    expect(flow.dispatchAndSave).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ type: "layout_confirmed", layoutId: QUEENS_LAYOUT_ID });
  });

  it("offers Accept all suggestions only while one is left", () => {
    _render(makeFlow(makeDraft(), { layoutId: BRONX_LAYOUT_ID }));

    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Accept all suggestions" })).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("offers Map this dataset, and nothing else, for a skipped layout", () => {
    const flow = _render(makeFlow(_withStatus(BRONX_LAYOUT_ID, "skipped"), { layoutId: BRONX_LAYOUT_ID }));

    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Confirm and next" })).toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Map this dataset" }));

    expect(flow.dispatchAndSave).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ type: "layout_reopened", layoutId: BRONX_LAYOUT_ID });
  });

  it("never offers to skip the reference layout", () => {
    _render(makeFlow(makeDraft(), { layoutId: REFERENCE_LAYOUT_ID }));

    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { name: "Kings line list" })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Skip this dataset" })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("adds a column, refusing a name already used and the source column's name", async () => {
    const flow = _render();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add a column to the combined dataset" }));
    const form = (await screen.findByRole("textbox", { name: "Column name" })).closest("form")!;
    const nameInput = within(form).getByRole("textbox", { name: "Column name" });
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: "Case_ID" } });
    expect(within(form).getByText("Case_ID is already a column of the combined dataset.")).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: "source_dataset" } });
    expect(
      within(form).getByText("source_dataset is the column that names each row's dataset. Choose another name."),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.change(nameInput, { target: { value: "county" } });
    fireEvent.click(within(form).getByRole("button", { name: "Add column" }));

    expect(flow.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      type: "column_added",
      columnId: expect.any(String),
      name: "county",
      dataType: "varchar",
    });
  });
});
```
