```tsx
import { Callout } from "@avandar/ui";
import { plural } from "@lingui/core/macro";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Center, Group, Loader, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useState } from "react";
import { AppViewBody } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewBody/AppViewBody";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import { getLayoutLabel } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/getLayoutLabel";
import { useLayoutNamer } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/useLayoutNamer";
import { AddColumnButton } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/AddColumnButton";
import { LayoutStub } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/LayoutStub/LayoutStub";
import { MapLayoutsFooter } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MapLayoutsFooter";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MapLayoutsStep.module.css";
import {
  chooseSelectedColumnId,
  chooseShownLayout,
  hasSuggestions,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/mapStepSelection/mapStepSelection";
import { MappingPane } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingPane/MappingPane";
import { MappingTable } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/MappingTable/MappingTable";
import { useLayoutValues } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/useLayoutValues/useLayoutValues";
import { useMapStepActions } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/useMapStepActions/useMapStepActions";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CrosswalkContext } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { CrosswalkStepProps } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkStepBody";
import type { LayoutValues } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/useLayoutValues/useLayoutValues";
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type LayoutProps = {
  flow: CrosswalkFlow;
  context: CrosswalkContext;
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout;
};

type ValuesStatus = LayoutValues["status"];

/** The layout's first dataset's columns, the sources a fill can read. */
function _getSourceColumns(
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout,
  context: CrosswalkContext,
): CrosswalkLayout.Dataset["columns"] {
  const firstDatasetId = layout.datasetIds[0];
  const columns = firstDatasetId ? context.datasetsById.get(firstDatasetId)?.columns : undefined;
  return (
    columns ??
    layout.columnNames.map((name) => {
      return { name, dataType: "varchar" as const };
    })
  );
}

/**
 * The section meta under the layout's name: Reference, or "+n with the
 * same layout" (the same message `LayoutName` shows in the stub).
 */
function useLayoutMeta(layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout, context: CrosswalkContext): string | undefined {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  if (layout.isReference) {
    return t`Reference`;
  }
  const { otherDatasetCount } = getLayoutLabel(layout, context.datasetsById);
  return otherDatasetCount > 0
    ? plural(otherDatasetCount, { one: "+# with the same layout", other: "+# with the same layout" })
    : undefined;
}

function ValuesNote(props: Readonly<{ status: ValuesStatus; datasetName: string }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { datasetName } = props;
  if (props.status === "reading") {
    return (
      <Group gap="xs" role="status">
        <Loader size="xs" />
        <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>Reading the values of {datasetName} on this device</Trans>
        </Text>
      </Group>
    );
  }
  if (props.status === "failed") {
    return (
      <Callout
        color="warning"
        titleOrder={3}
        titleSize="sm"
        messageSize="sm"
        title={t`The values could not be read`}
        message={t`Matches use column names and types only. You can still map ${datasetName}.`}
      />
    );
  }
  return null;
}

function LayoutTableSection(
  props: Readonly<
    LayoutProps & {
      valuesStatus: ValuesStatus;
      selectedColumnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id | undefined;
      onSelectColumn: (columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id) => void;
    }
  >,
): ReactNode {
  const { layout, context, flow } = props;
  const name = useLayoutNamer(context.datasetsById)(layout);
  const meta = useLayoutMeta(layout, context);
  return (
    <AppViewSection title={name} meta={meta}>
      <Stack gap="sm" align="flex-start">
        <ValuesNote status={props.valuesStatus} datasetName={name} />
        <MappingTable
          draft={flow.state.draft}
          layoutId={layout.id}
          entriesById={context.entriesById}
          selectedColumnId={props.selectedColumnId}
          onSelectColumn={props.onSelectColumn}
        />
        <AddColumnButton draft={flow.state.draft} dispatch={flow.dispatch} />
      </Stack>
    </AppViewSection>
  );
}

function LayoutFooter({ flow, layout }: Readonly<LayoutProps>): ReactNode {
  const actions = useMapStepActions(flow);
  return (
    <MapLayoutsFooter
      layout={layout}
      hasSuggestions={hasSuggestions(flow.state.draft, layout.id)}
      isSaving={flow.isSaving}
      onSkip={() => {
        void actions.skip(layout.id);
      }}
      onReopen={() => {
        void actions.reopen(layout.id);
      }}
      onAcceptAll={() => {
        void actions.acceptAll(layout.id);
      }}
      onConfirm={() => {
        void actions.confirmAndNext(layout.id);
      }}
    />
  );
}

/** The shown layout: the stub, its table and pane, and its footer. */
function LayoutMapping({ flow, context, layout }: Readonly<LayoutProps>): ReactNode {
  const { draft, readLayoutIds } = flow.state;
  const values = useLayoutValues({ draft, layoutId: layout.id, readLayoutIds, context, dispatch: flow.dispatch });
  const [chosenColumnId, setChosenColumnId] = useState(() => {
    return chooseSelectedColumnId(draft, layout.id, undefined);
  });
  const selectedColumnId = chooseSelectedColumnId(draft, layout.id, chosenColumnId);
  const column = draft.columns.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === selectedColumnId;
  });
  const pane = column ? (
    <MappingPane
      draft={draft}
      layout={layout}
      column={column}
      sourceColumns={_getSourceColumns(layout, context)}
      profilesBySourceColumn={values.profilesBySourceColumn}
      dateFormatsBySourceColumn={values.dateFormatsBySourceColumn}
      context={context}
      dispatch={flow.dispatch}
    />
  ) : undefined;
  return (
    <>
      <div className={css.mapLayoutsBody}>
        <LayoutStub
          draft={draft}
          datasetsById={context.datasetsById}
          selectedLayoutId={layout.id}
          onSelectLayout={(layoutId) => {
            void flow.selectLayout(layoutId);
          }}
        />
        <AppViewBody className={css.mapLayoutsMain} rail={pane}>
          <LayoutTableSection
            flow={flow}
            context={context}
            layout={layout}
            valuesStatus={values.status}
            selectedColumnId={selectedColumnId}
            onSelectColumn={setChosenColumnId}
          />
        </AppViewBody>
      </div>
      <LayoutFooter flow={flow} context={context} layout={layout} />
    </>
  );
}

function NoLayouts({ onBack }: Readonly<{ onBack: () => void }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Center flex={1} p="xxl">
      <Stack align="center" gap="sm" maw={720}>
        <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>Add the datasets to combine first.</Trans>
        </Text>
        <Button variant="default" onClick={onBack}>
          <Trans>Choose datasets</Trans>
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    </Center>
  );
}

/**
 * Step 2, Map each dataset: the layout stub, the shown layout's mapping
 * table with Add a column under it, the selected column's side pane, and
 * the footer that skips, accepts suggestions, or confirms and moves on.
 * The shown layout's subtree is keyed by its id, so the selected column
 * starts over on every layout. Pane edits only dispatch; they are saved
 * by the next footer action or layout change.
 */
export function MapLayoutsStep({ flow, catalog }: Readonly<CrosswalkStepProps>): ReactNode {
  const layout = chooseShownLayout(flow.state.draft, flow.layoutId);
  if (!layout) {
    return (
      <NoLayouts
        onBack={() => {
          flow.goToStep("datasets");
        }}
      />
    );
  }
  return <LayoutMapping key={layout.id} flow={flow} context={catalog.context} layout={layout} />;
}
```

### Task 23: Create combined dataset

Step 3 compiles the draft, says what will happen, previews the stacked rows, and saves the combined dataset (spec sections 7.6, 9, 11, and 12). It replaces the `combine` placeholder in Task 16's `CrosswalkStepBody`. Direction, with the `impeccable` skill loaded: a task step on the lit content column with no rail, three `AppViewSection`s in one stack (**Combined dataset**: the name, "Add a source_dataset column", "Coded columns come out as" **Labels** · **Codes**; **Before you combine**: every problem, only when there is one; **Preview**: the row count as the section meta and the first 20 rows in a plain labelled Mantine `Table`, the same reasons the apply preview gave for not using the grid), then the sticky footer with **Back** and one filled button, **Create combined dataset** or **Update combined dataset**. When the button cannot be used, the reason sits as dimmed text beside **Back** and is the button's description, rather than a tooltip on a disabled button that a keyboard user cannot reach.

How it works:

- `compileCrosswalk` runs over the draft and the catalog's context whenever either changes (memoized), so the problems and the preview follow every settings change. A `blocked` result shows its problems and no preview. Problems come out of the compile per layout (`columns_changed`, then `invalid_expression` and `missing_code_list`), then `unconfirmed`, `skipped`, and `nothing_to_combine` last; the list shows them worst first and keeps that order within each weight.
- The preview runs `useCombinedPreview` only while the result is `ready`. The first combine reads every source dataset onto the device, which can take minutes for many datasets (spec section 9), so the reading state says so. The read is keyed by the SQL, so a settings change re-reads and a late reply is dropped.
- **Name** starts at the existing combined dataset's name when the crosswalk has one, otherwise the crosswalk's name; it is local state until saved, because the name lives on the dataset row, not the crosswalk.
- Access (`useCombineAccess`): creating needs `useCanCreateDatasets` and `useIsUnderDatasetLimit` (spec section 11, the same people `rpc_crosswalks__save_combined_dataset` lets create through `util__can_manage_workspace_settings` and `rpc_datasets__add_virtual_dataset`'s limit); updating needs editor or admin on the dataset through `useResourceRole`, as `useApplyAccess` reads it. The server checks both again.
- Saving: when the draft is dirty (a settings change), `CombineStep` saves the crosswalk first with `flow.save(draft)` (the flow's one `useSaveCrosswalk`, so its second-press guard and refusal copy apply), so the crosswalk row always matches the SQL it produced; then `useSaveCombinedDataset` sends the compile result. That hook ignores a second press, refuses offline with the offline copy, maps a refusal's hint to copy through `useCrosswalkErrorMessage`, then clears every cached copy of the combined dataset's rows and the virtual dataset query cache (`clearCombinedDatasetCaches`: a combined dataset's loaded view in DuckDB is not keyed by its SQL, decision "Two more findings"), shows a success toast, and opens the dataset page unless the user has left.
- Toggling "Add a source_dataset column" on while a column of the combined dataset is already named `source_dataset` would make the save fail (`column_names_not_unique`), so the checkbox refuses and says why instead of dispatching.
- The step-bar label switches to **Update combined dataset** in `useCrosswalkStepLabels` (Task 16, contract copy); this task only switches the button.

```ts
import { DictionaryBindingClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBindingClient";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { DatasetColumnClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetColumnClient";
import { VirtualDatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/source-datasets/VirtualDatasetClient";
import { invalidateCrosswalkQueries } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/invalidateCrosswalkQueries";
import { clearCachedDatasetRows } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/clearCachedDatasetRows";
import { invalidateDatasetRowQueries } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/invalidateDatasetRowQueries/invalidateDatasetRowQueries";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { User } from "$/models/User/User";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";
import type { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

/**
 * Drops every copy of a combined dataset's rows this tab holds after its
 * SQL, columns, or bindings were written: the cached rows and loaded table
 * (a virtual dataset's loaded view is not keyed by its SQL), the virtual
 * dataset records QETL reads the SQL from, and the queries that show the
 * dataset, its columns, its bindings, or any rows. It also marks every
 * crosswalk query stale through `invalidateCrosswalkQueries`, so the
 * crosswalk's new `output_dataset_id` turns the step label into Update
 * combined dataset.
 */
export async function clearCombinedDatasetCaches(
  options: Readonly<{
    queryClient: QueryClient;
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;
    userId: User.Id;
    workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
  }>,
): Promise<void> {
  const { queryClient, datasetId, userId, workspaceId } = options;
  await clearCachedDatasetRows({ datasetId, userId, workspaceId });
  // Removed, not invalidated: QETL reads `raw_sql` with `ensureQueryData`,
  // which serves cached data even after an invalidation.
  queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: [VirtualDatasetClient.getClientName()] });
  const clients = [DatasetClient, DatasetColumnClient, DictionaryBindingClient];
  await Promise.all([
    ...clients.map((client) => {
      return queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [client.getClientName()] });
    }),
    invalidateDatasetRowQueries(queryClient),
    invalidateCrosswalkQueries(queryClient),
  ]);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/useCombinedPreview/useCombinedPreview.ts`:**

```ts
import { quoteSqlIdentifier } from "@avandar/utils/sql";
import { WorkspaceQuerySession } from "@/clients/qetl/WorkspaceQuerySession/WorkspaceQuerySession";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { useTaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";
import type { TaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";

/** How many stacked rows the preview shows. */
export const COMBINED_PREVIEW_ROW_COUNT = 20;

/** One preview row: each column's value as text, undefined when empty. */
export type CombinedPreviewRow = Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>;

/** The first stacked rows and how many rows the combined dataset has. */
export type CombinedPreviewResult = {
  rows: CombinedPreviewRow[];
  rowCount: number;
};

/**
 * The preview's two queries over the combined SQL: the first rows with
 * every column cast to text, so dates and big whole numbers read as DuckDB
 * prints them, and the row count.
 */
export function buildCombinedPreviewSql(
  options: Readonly<{ sql: string; columnNames: readonly string[] }>,
): { rowsSql: string; countSql: string } {
  const selects = options.columnNames.map((name) => {
    const identifier = quoteSqlIdentifier(name);
    return `CAST(${identifier} AS VARCHAR) AS ${identifier}`;
  });
  return {
    rowsSql: `SELECT ${selects.join(", ")} FROM (${options.sql}) LIMIT ${COMBINED_PREVIEW_ROW_COUNT}`,
    countSql: `SELECT count(*) AS "rows" FROM (${options.sql})`,
  };
}

function _toPreviewRow(
  row: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
  columnNames: readonly string[],
): CombinedPreviewRow {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    columnNames.map((name) => {
      const value = row[name];
      return [name, value === null || value === undefined ? undefined : String(value)];
    }),
  );
}

/**
 * Reads the combined dataset's preview on this device: the first rows,
 * then the row count. The first read loads every source dataset, so it can
 * take minutes. Keyed by the SQL and its columns, so a settings change
 * reads again and a late reply is dropped; nothing is read without SQL.
 */
export function useCombinedPreview(
  options: Readonly<{ sql: string | undefined; columnNames: readonly string[] }>,
): TaggedRead<CombinedPreviewResult> {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const { sql, columnNames } = options;
  return useTaggedRead({
    key: sql === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify([sql, columnNames]),
    devMsg: "Reading the combined dataset preview failed",
    read: async () => {
      const { rowsSql, countSql } = buildCombinedPreviewSql({ sql: sql ?? "", columnNames });
      const rows = await WorkspaceQuerySession.runQuery<Record<string, unknown>>({
        workspaceId: workspace.id,
        rawSql: rowsSql,
      });
      const count = await WorkspaceQuerySession.runQuery<{ rows: unknown }>({
        workspaceId: workspace.id,
        rawSql: countSql,
      });
      return {
        rows: rows.data.map((row) => {
          return _toPreviewRow(row, columnNames);
        }),
        rowCount: Number(count.data[0]?.rows ?? 0),
      };
    },
  });
}
```

The two queries run one after the other: the first loads every source onto the device, and the count then reads what is already loaded. Run the test. Expected: PASS.

- [ ] **Step 7: Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/useCombineAccess/useCombineAccess.ts`:**

```ts
import { useResourceRole } from "@/hooks/permissions/useResourceRole/useResourceRole";
import { useIsUnderDatasetLimit } from "@/hooks/datasets/useIsUnderDatasetLimit/useIsUnderDatasetLimit";
import { useCanCreateDatasets } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCanCreateDatasets/useCanCreateDatasets";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";

/** Why the user cannot save the combined dataset. */
export type CombineDeniedReason =
  /** Creating needs a workspace owner or Settings admin. */
  | "not_admin"
  /** Creating would pass the plan's dataset limit. */
  | "dataset_limit"
  /** Updating needs edit access to the combined dataset. */
  | "not_dataset_editor"
  /** The user's role on the combined dataset could not be read. */
  | "failed";

/** Whether the user may create or update the combined dataset yet. */
export type CombineAccess =
  | { status: "checking" }
  | { status: "allowed" }
  | { status: "denied"; reason: CombineDeniedReason };

/**
 * Updating's access: editor or admin on the combined dataset. A role that
 * is not known yet counts as checking, while `null` means no access, as
 * `useApplyAccess` reads it.
 */
function useUpdateAccess(outputDatasetId: Dataset.Id | undefined): CombineAccess {
  const [role, isRoleLoading, hasRoleFailed] = useResourceRole({
    resourceType: "dataset",
    resourceId: outputDatasetId,
  });
  if (hasRoleFailed) {
    return { status: "denied", reason: "failed" };
  }
  if (isRoleLoading || role === undefined) {
    return { status: "checking" };
  }
  return role === "editor" || role === "admin"
    ? { status: "allowed" }
    : { status: "denied", reason: "not_dataset_editor" };
}

/**
 * Whether the user may save the combined dataset: creating it needs the
 * people who may add datasets, under the plan's dataset limit; updating it
 * needs edit access to it. The server checks both again.
 */
export function useCombineAccess(outputDatasetId: Dataset.Id | undefined): CombineAccess {
  const canCreateDatasets = useCanCreateDatasets();
  const isUnderDatasetLimit = useIsUnderDatasetLimit();
  const updateAccess = useUpdateAccess(outputDatasetId);
  if (outputDatasetId) {
    return updateAccess;
  }
  if (!canCreateDatasets) {
    return { status: "denied", reason: "not_admin" };
  }
  return isUnderDatasetLimit ? { status: "allowed" } : { status: "denied", reason: "dataset_limit" };
}
```

`useResourceRole` with an undefined id leaves its query disabled, so creating never waits on it. Run the test. Expected: PASS.

```ts
import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { uuid } from "$/lib/uuid";
import { CrosswalkClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkClient";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/users/useCurrentUser";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { clearCombinedDatasetCaches } from "@/lib/crosswalks/clearCombinedDatasetCaches/clearCombinedDatasetCaches";
import { useIsMounted } from "@/lib/hooks/state/useIsMounted";
import { Logger } from "@/utils/Logger";
import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from "@/utils/notifications/notify";
import { useCrosswalkErrorMessage } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkErrorMessage/useCrosswalkErrorMessage";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { User } from "$/models/User/User";
import type { CompileCrosswalkResult } from "@/lib/crosswalks/compileCrosswalk/compileCrosswalk";

/** One save of the combined dataset: what was compiled, and what to call it. */
export type SaveCombinedOptions = {
  crosswalkId: Crosswalk.Id;
  /** The crosswalk's combined dataset, or undefined to create one. */
  outputDatasetId: Dataset.Id | undefined;
  result: Extract<CompileCrosswalkResult, { status: "ready" }>;
  datasetName: string;
};

function _toCombinePayload(options: SaveCombinedOptions, datasetId: Dataset.Id): Crosswalk.CombinePayload {
  const { result } = options;
  return {
    crosswalkId: options.crosswalkId,
    datasetId,
    datasetName: options.datasetName.trim(),
    rawSql: result.sql,
    columns: result.columns,
    bindings: result.bindings,
    compiledCodeLists: result.compiledCodeLists,
  };
}

/**
 * What a saved combined dataset does next: drop every cached copy of its
 * rows and the queries that show it, say it was created or updated, and
 * open it, unless the user already left the view. A failure to clear the
 * caches is logged; the save itself already succeeded.
 */
function useAfterCombine(): (datasetId: Dataset.Id, options: SaveCombinedOptions) => Promise<void> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const user = useCurrentUser();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMountedRef = useIsMounted();
  return async (datasetId, options) => {
    const datasetName = options.datasetName.trim();
    if (user) {
      await clearCombinedDatasetCaches({
        queryClient,
        datasetId,
        userId: user.id as User.Id,
        workspaceId: workspace.id,
      }).catch((error: unknown) => {
        Logger.error(error, { devMsg: "Clearing a combined dataset's caches failed" });
      });
    }
    notifySuccess(options.outputDatasetId ? t`Updated ${datasetName}.` : t`Created ${datasetName}.`);
    if (isMountedRef.current) {
      navigate(AppLinks.dataManagerDatasetView({ workspaceSlug: workspace.slug, datasetId, datasetName }));
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Creates or updates a crosswalk's combined dataset from a compile result
 * in one call, then clears its caches, says so, and opens it. A second
 * press while one is in flight is ignored, a save while offline says so and
 * sends nothing, and a refusal is explained from its hint. Resolves to the
 * dataset's id, or undefined when nothing was saved.
 */
export function useSaveCombinedDataset(): [
  save: (options: SaveCombinedOptions) => Promise<Dataset.Id | undefined>,
  isSaving: boolean,
] {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const isSavingRef = useRef(false);
  const toErrorMessage = useCrosswalkErrorMessage();
  const afterCombine = useAfterCombine();
  const [, isSaving, mutation] = CrosswalkClient.useSaveCombinedDataset({
    onError: (error: unknown) => {
      Logger.error(error, { devMsg: "Saving a combined dataset failed" });
      notifyError(toErrorMessage(error));
    },
  });
  const save = async (options: SaveCombinedOptions): Promise<Dataset.Id | undefined> => {
    if (isSavingRef.current) {
      return undefined;
    }
    if (!getIsOnline()) {
      notifyError(t`You're offline. Reconnect to save this.`);
      return undefined;
    }
    isSavingRef.current = true;
    try {
      const datasetId = await mutation.mutateAsync(
        _toCombinePayload(options, options.outputDatasetId ?? uuid<Dataset.Id>()),
      );
      await afterCombine(datasetId, options);
      return datasetId;
    } catch {
      // The mutation's onError has logged it and said why.
      return undefined;
    } finally {
      isSavingRef.current = false;
    }
  };
  return [save, isSaving];
}
```

The guard is released only after the caches are cleared and the page opened, so a second press during that time cannot send a create whose new id the server would refuse (`combined_dataset_mismatch`). The mutation's own `onError` shows the toast, which also keeps `@avandar/query-hooks` from reporting the error a second time. Run the test. Expected: PASS.

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Checkbox, SegmentedControl, Stack, Text, TextInput } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkContext,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  datasetName: string;
  onDatasetNameChange: (datasetName: string) => void;
  context: CrosswalkContext;
  dispatch: Dispatch<CrosswalkAction>;
};

function SourceColumnCheckbox({ draft, context, dispatch }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const [isRefused, setIsRefused] = useState(false);
  const sourceColumnName = Crosswalk.SOURCE_COLUMN_NAME;
  const hasColumnNamedLikeIt = draft.columns.some((column) => {
    return column.name.trim().toLowerCase() === sourceColumnName;
  });
  return (
    <Checkbox
      label={t`Add a ${sourceColumnName} column`}
      description={t`Names the dataset each row came from.`}
      checked={draft.addsSourceColumn}
      error={
        isRefused && !draft.addsSourceColumn
          ? t`A column is already named ${sourceColumnName}. Rename it in Map each dataset first.`
          : undefined
      }
      onChange={(event) => {
        const addsSourceColumn = event.currentTarget.checked;
        if (addsSourceColumn && hasColumnNamedLikeIt) {
          setIsRefused(true);
          return;
        }
        setIsRefused(false);
        dispatch({ type: "settings_changed", changes: { addsSourceColumn }, context });
      }}
    />
  );
}

function CodesOutputControl({ draft, context, dispatch }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labelId = useId();
  if (
    !draft.columns.some((column) => {
      return column.entryId !== undefined;
    })
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <Stack gap={6} align="flex-start">
      <Text id={labelId} size="sm" fw={500}>
        <Trans>Coded columns come out as</Trans>
      </Text>
      <SegmentedControl
        size="xs"
        aria-labelledby={labelId}
        value={draft.codesOutputAs}
        data={[
          { value: "labels", label: t`Labels` },
          { value: "codes", label: t`Codes` },
        ]}
        onChange={(value) => {
          const codesOutputAs = value === "codes" ? "codes" : "labels";
          dispatch({ type: "settings_changed", changes: { codesOutputAs }, context });
        }}
      />
    </Stack>
  );
}

/**
 * The combined dataset's own settings: its name, whether it gets a
 * source_dataset column, and, when a column is governed, whether coded
 * columns come out as labels or codes. The two settings change the draft;
 * the name is saved with the dataset.
 */
export function CombineSettings(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return (
    <AppViewSection title={<Trans>Combined dataset</Trans>}>
      <Stack gap="md" maw="40rem">
        <TextInput
          label={t`Name`}
          value={props.datasetName}
          error={props.datasetName.trim() === "" ? t`Enter a name.` : undefined}
          onChange={(event) => {
            props.onDatasetNameChange(event.currentTarget.value);
          }}
        />
        <SourceColumnCheckbox {...props} />
        <CodesOutputControl {...props} />
      </Stack>
    </AppViewSection>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { plural } from "@lingui/core/macro";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { List } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconAlertCircle, IconAlertTriangle, IconInfoCircle } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useId } from "react";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import { getLayoutLabel } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/getLayoutLabel";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CrosswalkProblem } from "@/lib/crosswalks/compileCrosswalk/compileCrosswalk";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  problems: readonly CrosswalkProblem[];
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
};

/** How much a problem matters: it stops the save, changes the data, or informs. */
type ProblemWeight = "blocks" | "changes" | "informs";

function _getWeight(problem: CrosswalkProblem): ProblemWeight {
  switch (problem.kind) {
    case "invalid_expression":
    case "nothing_to_combine":
      return "blocks";
    case "columns_changed":
    case "missing_code_list":
      return "changes";
    case "unconfirmed":
    case "skipped":
      return "informs";
  }
}

function _toProblemKey(problem: CrosswalkProblem): string {
  if (problem.kind === "columns_changed") {
    return `${problem.kind}:${problem.datasetId}`;
  }
  if (problem.kind === "invalid_expression" || problem.kind === "missing_code_list") {
    return `${problem.kind}:${problem.layoutId}:${problem.columnId}`;
  }
  return problem.kind;
}

function ProblemIcon({ weight }: Readonly<{ weight: ProblemWeight }>): ReactNode {
  if (weight === "blocks") {
    return <IconAlertCircle size={16} color="var(--mantine-color-danger-7)" aria-hidden />;
  }
  if (weight === "changes") {
    return <IconAlertTriangle size={16} color="var(--mantine-color-warning-7)" aria-hidden />;
  }
  return <IconInfoCircle size={16} color="var(--mantine-color-dimmed)" aria-hidden />;
}

/**
 * The names a problem's sentence uses: its column, and its layout's name,
 * which is the layout's first dataset's (`getLayoutLabel`). A layout the
 * compile reports on always holds a dataset.
 */
function _getNames(
  props: Readonly<Props>,
  problem: Extract<CrosswalkProblem, { layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id }>,
): { columnName: string; layoutName: string } {
  const column = props.draft.columns.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === problem.columnId;
  });
  const layout = props.draft.layouts.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === problem.layoutId;
  });
  return {
    columnName: column?.name ?? "",
    layoutName: layout ? (getLayoutLabel(layout, props.datasetsById).firstDatasetName ?? "") : "",
  };
}
```

Append the sentences and the component to the same file:

```tsx
function useProblemSentence(props: Readonly<Props>): (problem: CrosswalkProblem) => string {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return (problem) => {
    switch (problem.kind) {
      case "columns_changed": {
        const { datasetName } = problem;
        return t`${datasetName} was left out: its columns changed since it was mapped. Remove it and add it again to map its new columns.`;
      }
      case "invalid_expression": {
        const { columnName, layoutName } = _getNames(props, problem);
        return t`The formula that fills ${columnName} for ${layoutName} isn't a valid expression. Fix it in Map each dataset.`;
      }
      case "missing_code_list": {
        const { columnName, layoutName } = _getNames(props, problem);
        return t`${columnName} for ${layoutName} translates with a code list that was deleted, so its values come through unchanged.`;
      }
      case "nothing_to_combine":
        return t`There is nothing to combine yet. Map at least one dataset that isn't skipped.`;
      case "unconfirmed":
        return plural(problem.datasetCount, {
          one: "# dataset has mappings you haven't confirmed.",
          other: "# datasets have mappings you haven't confirmed.",
        });
      case "skipped":
        return plural(problem.datasetCount, {
          one: "# dataset is skipped.",
          other: "# datasets are skipped.",
        });
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Before you combine: everything the compile found, worst first. What
 * stops the save, what changes the data (a dataset left out, values passed
 * through), and what is only worth knowing (skipped and unconfirmed
 * datasets). The sort is stable, so problems of one weight keep the
 * compile's order. Nothing shows when there is nothing to say.
 */
export function CombineProblems(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const toSentence = useProblemSentence(props);
  const headingId = useId();
  if (props.problems.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }
  const order: ProblemWeight[] = ["blocks", "changes", "informs"];
  const sorted = [...props.problems].sort((problemA, problemB) => {
    return order.indexOf(_getWeight(problemA)) - order.indexOf(_getWeight(problemB));
  });
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headingId}>
      <AppViewSection title={<span id={headingId}><Trans>Before you combine</Trans></span>}>
        <List spacing="xs" size="sm" listStyleType="none" center>
          {sorted.map((problem) => {
            return (
              <List.Item key={_toProblemKey(problem)} icon={<ProblemIcon weight={_getWeight(problem)} />}>
                {toSentence(problem)}
              </List.Item>
            );
          })}
        </List>
      </AppViewSection>
    </section>
  );
}
```

`AppViewSection` already renders a `<section>` but takes no `aria-labelledby`, so the outer `<section>` is what makes "Before you combine" a named region for the test and for screen-reader navigation; nested sections are valid. If the design detector objects to the double `section`, add an optional `"aria-labelledby"` prop to `AppViewSection` instead (outside this task's scope: list it as an out-of-scope file in the commit message body) and drop the outer element. The icon colors use the theme's CSS variables because `@tabler/icons-react` takes a `color` prop, not Mantine's `c`.

```tsx
import { plural } from "@lingui/core/macro";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Callout } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Center, Loader, Stack, Table, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "react";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/CombinedPreview/CombinedPreview.module.css";
import type { TaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";
import type {
  CombinedPreviewResult,
  CombinedPreviewRow,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/useCombinedPreview/useCombinedPreview";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  preview: TaggedRead<CombinedPreviewResult>;
  columnNames: readonly string[];
  /** How many datasets the combined dataset stacks. */
  datasetCount: number;
};

function PreviewTable(
  props: Readonly<{ rows: readonly CombinedPreviewRow[]; columnNames: readonly string[]; labelId: string }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return (
    <div className={css.combinedPreviewScroller}>
      <Table fz="xs" verticalSpacing={4} horizontalSpacing="sm" aria-labelledby={props.labelId}>
        <Table.Thead>
          <Table.Tr>
            {props.columnNames.map((name) => {
              return <Table.Th key={name}>{name}</Table.Th>;
            })}
          </Table.Tr>
        </Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tbody>
          {props.rows.map((row, rowIndex) => {
            return (
              // The rows have no identity of their own; their order is fixed.
              <Table.Tr key={rowIndex}>
                {props.columnNames.map((name) => {
                  const value = row[name];
                  return (
                    <Table.Td key={name} className={css.combinedPreviewCell}>
                      {value === undefined ? <span className={css.combinedPreviewEmpty}>{t`empty`}</span> : value}
                    </Table.Td>
                  );
                })}
              </Table.Tr>
            );
          })}
        </Table.Tbody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}

function ReadingPreview({ datasetCount }: Readonly<{ datasetCount: number }>): ReactNode {
  const message = plural(datasetCount, {
    one: "Reading # dataset on this device. The first time can take a few minutes.",
    other: "Reading # datasets on this device. The first time can take a few minutes.",
  });
  return (
    <Center py="lg" role="status">
      <Stack align="center" gap="sm">
        <Loader size="sm" />
        <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
          {message}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Center>
  );
}

/** "40 rows from 3 datasets", once the rows are counted. */
function usePreviewMeta(props: Readonly<Props>): string | undefined {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  if (props.preview.status !== "ready") {
    return undefined;
  }
  const rowsText = plural(props.preview.result.rowCount, { one: "# row", other: "# rows" });
  const datasetsText = plural(props.datasetCount, { one: "# dataset", other: "# datasets" });
  return t`${rowsText} from ${datasetsText}`;
}

/**
 * The stacked rows as the combined dataset will hold them: the row count
 * and the first 20 rows. Reading says that the first combine loads every
 * dataset onto this device and can take minutes.
 */
export function CombinedPreview(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labelId = useId();
  const { preview } = props;
  return (
    <AppViewSection title={<span id={labelId}><Trans>Preview</Trans></span>} meta={usePreviewMeta(props)}>
      {preview.status === "reading" ? <ReadingPreview datasetCount={props.datasetCount} /> : null}
      {preview.status === "failed" ? (
        <Callout
          titleOrder={3}
          titleSize="sm"
          messageSize="sm"
          title={t`The preview could not be read`}
          message={t`Avandar could not combine these datasets on this device. Check the mappings and try again.`}
        />
      ) : null}
      {preview.status === "ready" ? (
        <PreviewTable rows={preview.result.rows} columnNames={props.columnNames} labelId={labelId} />
      ) : null}
    </AppViewSection>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Stack } from "@mantine/core";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { AppViewBody } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewBody/AppViewBody";
import { compileCrosswalk } from "@/lib/crosswalks/compileCrosswalk/compileCrosswalk";
import { CombinedPreview } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/CombinedPreview/CombinedPreview";
import { CombineFooter } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/CombineFooter";
import { CombineProblems } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/CombineProblems";
import { CombineSettings } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/CombineSettings";
import { useCombineAccess } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/useCombineAccess/useCombineAccess";
import { useCombinedPreview } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/useCombinedPreview/useCombinedPreview";
import { useSaveCombinedDataset } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/useSaveCombinedDataset/useSaveCombinedDataset";
import { isCrosswalkDirty } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CompileCrosswalkResult } from "@/lib/crosswalks/compileCrosswalk/compileCrosswalk";
import type { CombineAccess } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CombineStep/useCombineAccess/useCombineAccess";
import type { CrosswalkStepProps } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkStepBody";
import type { CrosswalkFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/useCrosswalkFlow/useCrosswalkFlow";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

const NO_COLUMN_NAMES: readonly string[] = [];

/** The existing combined dataset's name, else the crosswalk's. */
function useDefaultDatasetName(draft: CrosswalkDraft.T): string {
  const [existing] = DatasetClient.useGetById({
    id: draft.outputDatasetId,
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: draft.outputDatasetId !== undefined },
  });
  return existing?.name ?? draft.name;
}

/** Why the primary button cannot be used yet, or undefined. */
function useDisabledReason(
  result: CompileCrosswalkResult,
  access: CombineAccess,
  datasetName: string,
): string | undefined {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  if (result.status === "blocked") {
    return t`Fix the problems above to combine.`;
  }
  if (datasetName.trim() === "") {
    return t`Enter a name for the combined dataset.`;
  }
  if (access.status !== "denied") {
    return undefined;
  }
  switch (access.reason) {
    case "not_admin":
      return t`Only workspace admins can add datasets.`;
    case "dataset_limit":
      return t`Your plan's dataset limit is reached, so a new dataset can't be added.`;
    case "not_dataset_editor":
      return t`You need edit access to ${datasetName} to update it.`;
    case "failed":
      return t`Avandar couldn't check your access to ${datasetName}. Reload the page and try again.`;
  }
}

/**
 * Saving from step 3: the crosswalk first through `flow.save` when its
 * draft changed, so the crosswalk row always matches the SQL it produced,
 * then the combined dataset. A crosswalk save that did not go through
 * (offline, refused, or a second press) stops here; the flow has said why.
 */
function useCombineSave(
  flow: CrosswalkFlow,
  result: CompileCrosswalkResult,
  datasetName: string,
): { save: () => Promise<void>; isSaving: boolean } {
  const [saveCombined, isSavingCombined] = useSaveCombinedDataset();
  const save = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (result.status !== "ready") {
      return;
    }
    const { draft } = flow.state;
    if (isCrosswalkDirty(flow.state) && !(await flow.save(draft))) {
      return;
    }
    await saveCombined({ crosswalkId: draft.crosswalkId, outputDatasetId: draft.outputDatasetId, result, datasetName });
  };
  return { save, isSaving: flow.isSaving || isSavingCombined };
}
```

Append the component to the same file:

```tsx
/**
 * Step 3, Create combined dataset (Update once it exists): the combined
 * dataset's settings, what the compile found, a preview of the stacked
 * rows, and the button that saves it, with the reason when it cannot.
 */
export function CombineStep({ flow, catalog }: Readonly<CrosswalkStepProps>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { context } = catalog;
  const { draft } = flow.state;
  const result = useMemo(() => {
    return compileCrosswalk({ draft, datasetsById: context.datasetsById, entriesById: context.entriesById });
  }, [draft, context.datasetsById, context.entriesById]);
  const ready = result.status === "ready" ? result : undefined;
  const columnNames = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      ready?.columns.map((column) => {
        return column.name;
      }) ?? NO_COLUMN_NAMES
    );
  }, [ready]);
  const preview = useCombinedPreview({ sql: ready?.sql, columnNames });
  const defaultName = useDefaultDatasetName(draft);
  const [typedName, setTypedName] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const datasetName = typedName ?? defaultName;
  const access = useCombineAccess(draft.outputDatasetId);
  const disabledReason = useDisabledReason(result, access, datasetName);
  const { save, isSaving } = useCombineSave(flow, result, datasetName);
  return (
    <>
      <AppViewBody>
        <Stack gap="xl">
          <CombineSettings draft={draft} datasetName={datasetName} onDatasetNameChange={setTypedName} context={context} dispatch={flow.dispatch} />
          <CombineProblems problems={result.problems} draft={draft} datasetsById={context.datasetsById} />
          {ready ? <CombinedPreview preview={preview} columnNames={columnNames} datasetCount={ready.includedDatasetIds.length} /> : null}
        </Stack>
      </AppViewBody>
      <CombineFooter
        label={draft.outputDatasetId ? t`Update combined dataset` : t`Create combined dataset`}
        disabledReason={disabledReason}
        isDisabled={disabledReason !== undefined || access.status === "checking"}
        isSaving={isSaving}
        onBack={() => {
          flow.goToStep("map");
        }}
        onSave={() => {
          void save();
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Task 24: Export mapping

**Export mapping** in the crosswalk header downloads the mapping as a CSV, so someone can review it in a spreadsheet, keep it with a protocol, or hand it to a colleague. Each row is one dataset and one column of the combined dataset, and says how that column is filled for that dataset (spec 7.6). Rows come in layout order: the reference layout first, then the others in the draft's order. Within a layout, the datasets come by name, then the columns by position. The Layout cell names a layout exactly as the stub, the layouts table, and the header's facts do: `useExportMapping` passes the builder a `nameLayout` built on Task 17's `getLayoutLabel`, so the builder in `src/lib/` never imports the view's helper.

The row builder is pure and returns structured values, never English. The header hook translates every header and value with Lingui, inside hooks (never by passing `t` to a module-level helper). It builds the text with `Papa.unparse` and downloads it. Papa's `escapeFormulae` prefixes a value that starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab, or a carriage return with `'` and quotes it. A dataset named `=HYPERLINK(...)` therefore stays text in a spreadsheet. The text starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark, so Excel reads accented labels correctly.

The export is what the page shows, unsaved edits included: it reads the draft, not the saved rows. The cell after the fill kind is "Filled from", not spec 7.6's "source column": it holds the source column, the fixed value, or the Combine expression, and the mapping table already calls it "Filled from this dataset". The repo has no shared download helper. `downloadRowsAsCsv` and `ConsentLogPanel` each build their own anchor. So this task adds a small local `downloadTextFile`, and the button's test mocks that module rather than the DOM.

Every directory may hold one test file (`docs/rules/testing.md`), so the export's files live in `CV/CrosswalkHeader/ExportMapping/` with one test: the button's. That test covers the hook and the copy too.

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the builder.** `src/lib/crosswalks/buildMappingCsvRows/buildMappingCsvRows.ts`:

```ts
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";

/** Where one row of the exported mapping stands. */
export type MappingCsvStatus =
  | "confirmed"
  | "suggested"
  | "not_filled"
  | "skipped";

/**
 * One row of the exported mapping: how one column of the combined dataset
 * is filled for one dataset. Values are structured, not words, so the view
 * that exports the rows translates them.
 */
export type MappingCsvRow = {
  /** The layout's name, from `nameLayout`, given its readable datasets. */
  layoutName: string;
  isReferenceLayout: boolean;
  datasetName: string;
  /** The column of the combined dataset. */
  columnName: string;
  /** "none" while the column has no fill for this layout. */
  fillKind: CrosswalkMapping.Fill["kind"] | "none";
  /** The source column, the fixed value, or the Combine expression. */
  filledFrom: string | undefined;
  convert: CrosswalkMapping.Convert | undefined;
  /** Set when the fill translates codes through a code list. */
  translation:
    | {
        /** Undefined once the list is deleted or no longer readable. */
        codeListName: string | undefined;
        holdsLabels: boolean;
      }
    | undefined;
  status: MappingCsvStatus;
};

type BuildOptions = Readonly<{
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
  codeListNamesById: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
  /**
   * A layout's name, given the ids of its datasets the user can read, in
   * the layout's order. Always called with at least one id.
   */
  nameLayout: (datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[]) => string;
}>;

function _getFilledFrom(fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill): string | undefined {
  switch (fill.kind) {
    case "column":
      return fill.sourceColumn;
    case "constant":
      return fill.value;
    case "expression":
      return fill.sql;
    case "empty":
      return undefined;
  }
}

function _getTranslation(
  fill: CrosswalkMapping.Fill,
  codeListNamesById: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
): MappingCsvRow["translation"] {
  if (fill.kind !== "column" || fill.codeListId === undefined) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return {
    codeListName: codeListNamesById.get(fill.codeListId),
    holdsLabels: fill.holdsLabels,
  };
}

function _getStatus(
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout,
  mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping | undefined,
): MappingCsvStatus {
  if (layout.status === "skipped") {
    return "skipped";
  }
  return mapping ? mapping.status : "not_filled";
}

function _toRow(
  options: Readonly<{
    layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout;
    layoutName: string;
    datasetName: string;
    column: CrosswalkDraft.Column;
    mapping: CrosswalkDraft.Mapping | undefined;
    codeListNamesById: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
  }>,
): MappingCsvRow {
  const { layout, mapping } = options;
  const fill = mapping?.fill;
  return {
    layoutName: options.layoutName,
    isReferenceLayout: layout.isReference,
    datasetName: options.datasetName,
    columnName: options.column.name,
    fillKind: fill?.kind ?? "none",
    filledFrom: fill ? _getFilledFrom(fill) : undefined,
    convert: fill?.kind === "column" ? fill.convert : undefined,
    translation: fill
      ? _getTranslation(fill, options.codeListNamesById)
      : undefined,
    status: _getStatus(layout, mapping),
  };
}

function _getLayoutRows(
  options: BuildOptions & Readonly<{ layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout }>,
): MappingCsvRow[] {
  const { draft, layout } = options;
  const datasets = layout.datasetIds.flatMap((datasetId) => {
    const dataset = options.datasetsById.get(datasetId);
    return dataset ? [dataset] : [];
  });
  if (datasets.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  const layoutName = options.nameLayout(
    datasets.map((dataset) => {
      return dataset.id;
    }),
  );
  return datasets.flatMap((dataset) => {
    return draft.columns.map((column) => {
      return _toRow({
        layout,
        layoutName,
        datasetName: dataset.name,
        column,
        mapping: draft.mappings[layout.id]?.[column.id],
        codeListNamesById: options.codeListNamesById,
      });
    });
  });
}

/**
 * One row per dataset and column of the combined dataset, in layout order
 * (the reference layout first), then the layout's datasets by name, then
 * column position. A dataset the user can no longer read is left out, and
 * a layout is named by `nameLayout` from the datasets that remain. Used by
 * Export mapping.
 */
export function buildMappingCsvRows(options: BuildOptions): MappingCsvRow[] {
  return options.draft.layouts.flatMap((layout) => {
    return _getLayoutRows({ ...options, layout });
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Write the download.** `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/ExportMapping/downloadTextFile.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Saves `text` as a file named `fileName` through the browser's download,
 * then releases the object URL. Used by Export mapping.
 */
export function downloadTextFile(
  options: Readonly<{ text: string; fileName: string; mimeType: string }>,
): void {
  const blob = new Blob([options.text], { type: options.mimeType });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const anchor = document.createElement("a");
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = options.fileName;
  document.body.appendChild(anchor);
  anchor.click();
  anchor.remove();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Write the copy.** `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/ExportMapping/useMappingCsvCopy.ts`:

```ts
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import type { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import type {
  MappingCsvRow,
  MappingCsvStatus,
} from "@/lib/crosswalks/buildMappingCsvRows/buildMappingCsvRows";

/** The words for a change to a source column's values. */
function useConvertCopy(): (convert: CrosswalkMapping.Convert) => string {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  return (convert) => {
    switch (convert.kind) {
      case "parse_date": {
        const format = convert.format;
        return t`Read as a date (${format})`;
      }
      case "pad_text": {
        const length = i18n.number(convert.length);
        return t`Pad with zeros to ${length} characters`;
      }
      case "multiply": {
        // A factor such as 1/12 is exact in the export, not rounded to 0.083.
        const factor = i18n.number(convert.factor, {
          maximumSignificantDigits: 15,
        });
        return t`Multiply by ${factor}`;
      }
      case "trim_and_fix_case": {
        if (convert.letterCase === "lower") {
          return t`Trim spaces, lowercase`;
        }
        return convert.letterCase === "upper"
          ? t`Trim spaces, UPPERCASE`
          : t`Trim spaces`;
      }
    }
  };
}

/** The words for how a column is filled. */
function useFillKindCopy(): Record<MappingCsvRow["fillKind"], string> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return {
    column: t`A column`,
    constant: t`A fixed value`,
    expression: t`Combine`,
    empty: t`Leave empty`,
    none: t`Not filled yet`,
  };
}

/** The words for where a row's mapping stands. */
function useStatusCopy(): Record<MappingCsvStatus, string> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return {
    confirmed: t`Confirmed`,
    suggested: t`Suggested`,
    not_filled: t`Not filled yet`,
    skipped: t`Skipped`,
  };
}

/** The exported mapping's header row, and a row's cells, in words. */
export type MappingCsvCopy = {
  headers: string[];
  toCells: (row: MappingCsvRow) => string[];
};

/**
 * Translates the exported mapping: its headers, and each row's cells in
 * the same order. Used by Export mapping.
 */
export function useMappingCsvCopy(): MappingCsvCopy {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const describeConvert = useConvertCopy();
  const fillKinds = useFillKindCopy();
  const statuses = useStatusCopy();
  const describeChange = (row: MappingCsvRow): string => {
    if (row.translation) {
      return row.translation.holdsLabels
        ? t`Translate labels`
        : t`Translate codes`;
    }
    return row.convert ? describeConvert(row.convert) : "";
  };
  const toCells = (row: MappingCsvRow): string[] => {
    const layoutName = row.layoutName;
    return [
      row.isReferenceLayout ? t`${layoutName} (reference)` : layoutName,
      row.datasetName,
      row.columnName,
      fillKinds[row.fillKind],
      row.filledFrom ?? "",
      describeChange(row),
      row.translation
        ? (row.translation.codeListName ?? t`A code list that no longer exists`)
        : "",
      statuses[row.status],
    ];
  };
  return {
    headers: [
      t`Layout`,
      t`Dataset`,
      t`Column of the combined dataset`,
      t`How it is filled`,
      t`Filled from`,
      t`Change to the values`,
      t`Code list`,
      t`Status`,
    ],
    toCells,
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Write the hook.** `src/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/ExportMapping/useExportMapping.ts`:

```ts
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import Papa from "papaparse";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { buildMappingCsvRows } from "@/lib/crosswalks/buildMappingCsvRows/buildMappingCsvRows";
import { downloadTextFile } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/ExportMapping/downloadTextFile";
import { useMappingCsvCopy } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/CrosswalkHeader/ExportMapping/useMappingCsvCopy";
import { getLayoutLabel } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/layoutLabel/getLayoutLabel";
import type { DictionaryMatch } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryMatch/DictionaryMatch";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type { CrosswalkContext } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";

/** A byte order mark, so spreadsheet apps read the file as UTF-8. */
const UTF8_BOM = "﻿";

/** Runs of characters a file name cannot hold on common systems. */
const UNSAFE_FILE_NAME_CHARACTERS = /[\\/:*?"<>|\p{Cc}]+/gu;

/** Every code list name the user can read, by code list id. */
function _getCodeListNamesById(
  entriesById: ReadonlyMap<string, DictionaryMatch.Entry>,
): Map<string, string> {
  return new Map(
    [...entriesById.values()].flatMap((entry) => {
      return entry.codeLists.map((codeList) => {
        return [codeList.id, codeList.name] as const;
      });
    }),
  );
}

function _toCsvFileName(baseName: string): string {
  return `${baseName.replace(UNSAFE_FILE_NAME_CHARACTERS, "-").trim()}.csv`;
}

/** Export mapping's action, and whether there is anything to export. */
export type ExportMapping = {
  exportMapping: () => void;
  /** False while the crosswalk has no readable dataset. */
  canExport: boolean;
};

/**
 * Downloads the crosswalk's mapping as a CSV named "<crosswalk> mapping",
 * one row per dataset and column of the combined dataset, translated. It
 * reads the draft, so unsaved edits are exported as shown. A value that
 * starts like a spreadsheet formula is escaped.
 */
export function useExportMapping(
  options: Readonly<{ draft: CrosswalkDraft.T; context: CrosswalkContext }>,
): ExportMapping {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const copy = useMappingCsvCopy();
  const { draft, context } = options;
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    return buildMappingCsvRows({
      draft,
      datasetsById: context.datasetsById,
      codeListNamesById: _getCodeListNamesById(context.entriesById),
      nameLayout: (datasetIds) => {
        // The builder passes only readable datasets, at least one.
        return (
          getLayoutLabel({ datasetIds }, context.datasetsById)
            .firstDatasetName ?? ""
        );
      },
    });
  }, [draft, context.datasetsById, context.entriesById]);
  const exportMapping = (): void => {
    const csv = Papa.unparse(
      { fields: copy.headers, data: rows.map(copy.toCells) },
      { escapeFormulae: true },
    );
    const crosswalkName = draft.name;
    downloadTextFile({
      text: `${UTF8_BOM}${csv}`,
      fileName: _toCsvFileName(t`${crosswalkName} mapping`),
      mimeType: "text/csv;charset=utf-8",
    });
  };
  return { exportMapping, canExport: rows.length > 0 };
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";

 * column of the combined dataset is filled for every dataset. Disabled
 * until the crosswalk has a dataset.
 */
export function ExportMappingButton({
  draft,
  context,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {

      variant="default"
      leftSection={<IconDownload size={16} aria-hidden />}
```

### Task 25: Stale banner, Used by, the combined dataset's rail and menu, and refreshing a source

A combined dataset embeds its code lists' pairs at the moment it is combined (spec 9). Task 23 records one fingerprint per embedded list in `compiled_code_lists`: every list a translation uses, plus the entry's primary list whenever a second coding is reconciled to it, since its labels or codes are embedded too (`CrosswalkSql.compile`'s `usedCodeListIds`). This task compares them with the lists as they are now: a list that is gone, or whose `CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint` differs, makes the crosswalk stale. The comparison is one pure function, `isCrosswalkStale`, used in two places. The crosswalk view shows, above the step bar, "A dictionary this crosswalk uses has changed." with **Update combined dataset**, which goes to step 3. The dictionary's Used by tab lists the combined dataset as **Crosswalk** ("Through {crosswalkName}"), with "Up to date" or "A code list changed since it was combined". A crosswalk editor also gets **Open crosswalk** on a row that is behind. The combined dataset's bindings are reference bindings (Task 4), so without this task Used by would call it Reference.

On the combined dataset's own page, the rail says "Combined by {crosswalkName}": a link for crosswalk editors, text for everyone else. The ⋯ menu hides **Apply a dictionary**, because the crosswalk writes the dataset's code lists and replaces its bindings whole on every update (Task 4), so anything applied by hand would vanish without a word. Refreshing a source dataset clears the cached rows of every combined dataset that stacks it, exactly as slice 4 clears a linked dataset's: those rows are copies of the source's.

A code list the viewer cannot read looks gone, so it reads as changed. That errs toward offering an update, and the update itself is the crosswalk editor's action. While the code lists are loading, or when they fail to load, nothing is called stale: a banner that flickers on and off would be worse than one that appears a moment late.

- [ ] **Step 3: Write it.** `src/lib/crosswalks/isCrosswalkStale/isCrosswalkStale.ts`:

```ts
import { CrosswalkSql } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkSql/CrosswalkSql";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";

/**
 * Whether a combined dataset is behind its code lists: a list it embedded
 * is gone (or no longer readable), or its pairs no longer give the
 * fingerprint recorded when it was combined. Used by the crosswalk's stale
 * banner and by the dictionary's Used by tab.
 */
export function isCrosswalkStale(
  options: Readonly<{
    compiledCodeLists: readonly Crosswalk.CompiledCodeList[];
    /** The embedded lists as they are now, as far as the user can read them. */
    codeLists: ReadonlyArray<Pick<DataDictionaryCodeList.T, "id" | "pairs">>;
  }>,
): boolean {
  const pairsById = new Map(
    options.codeLists.map((codeList) => {
      return [codeList.id as string, codeList.pairs] as const;
    }),
  );
  return options.compiledCodeLists.some((compiled) => {
    const pairs = pairsById.get(compiled.codeListId);
    return (
      pairs === undefined ||
      CrosswalkSql.getCodeListFingerprint(pairs) !== compiled.fingerprint
    );
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Write the hook.** `src/hooks/crosswalks/useCrosswalkStaleness/useCrosswalkStaleness.ts`:

```ts
import { prop, where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { DataDictionaryCodeListClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeListClient";
import { isCrosswalkStale } from "@/lib/crosswalks/isCrosswalkStale/isCrosswalkStale";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";

/** Whether a crosswalk's combined dataset is behind its code lists. */
export type CrosswalkStaleness = {
  isStale: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
};

const NO_COMPILED_CODE_LISTS: readonly Crosswalk.CompiledCodeList[] = [];

/**
 * Reads the code lists a crosswalk's combined dataset embedded and says
 * whether any is gone or changed since it was combined. Nothing is stale
 * without a crosswalk, before it was combined, or while the lists are
 * loading or failed to load.
 */
export function useCrosswalkStaleness(
  crosswalk: Crosswalk.T | undefined,
): CrosswalkStaleness {
  const compiledCodeLists =
    crosswalk?.compiledCodeLists ?? NO_COMPILED_CODE_LISTS;
  const codeListIds = useMemo(() => {
    return compiledCodeLists.map(prop("codeListId"));
  }, [compiledCodeLists]);
  const hasCodeLists = codeListIds.length > 0;
  const [codeLists, isLoading] = DataDictionaryCodeListClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("id", "in", codeListIds),
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: hasCodeLists },
  });
  const isStale = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      hasCodeLists &&
      codeLists !== undefined &&
      isCrosswalkStale({ compiledCodeLists, codeLists })
    );
  }, [hasCodeLists, codeLists, compiledCodeLists]);
  return { isStale, isLoading };
}
```

```tsx
import { Callout } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Group } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconAlertTriangle } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useCrosswalkStaleness } from "@/hooks/crosswalks/useCrosswalkStaleness/useCrosswalkStaleness";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /**
   * The saved crosswalk row, refetched after every combine; undefined
   * before the first save.
   */
  crosswalk: Crosswalk.T | undefined;
  /** True on step 3, whose footer already offers the update. */
  isOnCombineStep: boolean;
  /** Goes to step 3. */
  onUpdate: () => void;
};

/**
 * The warning above the crosswalk's steps once a code list its combined
 * dataset embedded has changed, with Update combined dataset. Renders
 * nothing before the crosswalk has a combined dataset, since it has no
 * recorded code lists until then.
 */
export function CrosswalkStaleBanner({
  crosswalk,
  isOnCombineStep,
  onUpdate,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { isStale } = useCrosswalkStaleness(crosswalk);
  if (!isStale) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <Callout
      color="warning"
      icon={<IconAlertTriangle size={18} aria-hidden />}
      messageSize="sm"
      message={t`A dictionary this crosswalk uses has changed.`}
    >
      {isOnCombineStep ? null : (
        <Group>
          <Button size="compact-sm" variant="light" onClick={onUpdate}>
            <Trans>Update combined dataset</Trans>
          </Button>
        </Group>
      )}
    </Callout>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { prop, where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { CrosswalkClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkClient";
import { DataDictionaryCodeListClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeListClient";
import { DictionaryBindingClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBindingClient";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT } from "@/config/queryOptions.constants";
import { isCrosswalkStale } from "@/lib/crosswalks/isCrosswalkStale/isCrosswalkStale";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { DataDictionary } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionary/DataDictionary";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";

/**
 * How a dictionary reaches a dataset's values: attached as reference,
 * converted as the dataset loads (a linked dataset), converted in place
 * with the version it was given, or translated by a crosswalk into its
 * combined dataset.
 */
export type DictionaryUsageHow = "reference" | "linked" | "changed" | "crosswalk";

/** The crosswalk whose combined dataset a Used by row is. */
export type DictionaryUsageCrosswalk = {
  id: Crosswalk.Id;
  name: string;
};

/** One dataset a dictionary is applied to, as the Used by tab lists it. */
export type DictionaryUsageRow = {
  datasetId: Dataset.Id;
  datasetName: string;
  sourceType: Dataset.T["sourceType"];
  /** How many of the dictionary's entries the dataset's columns use. */
  entryCount: number;
  howApplied: DictionaryUsageHow;
  /**
   * The oldest version a pinned conversion that can be re-applied was
   * given, or undefined when none is pinned.
   */
  appliedVersion: number | undefined;
  /**
   * For a crosswalk's combined dataset, whether a code list it embedded
   * changed since it was combined. Otherwise, whether the applied version
   * is older than the dictionary's.
   */
  isBehind: boolean;
  /** The crosswalk that combined this dataset, if one did. */
  crosswalk: DictionaryUsageCrosswalk | undefined;
};

/** The datasets a dictionary is applied to, sorted by name. */
export type DictionaryUsage = {
  dictionaryId: DataDictionary.Id;
  dictionaryName: string;
  rows: readonly DictionaryUsageRow[];
  /** The dictionary's version now. */
  currentVersion: number;
  isLoading: boolean;
  /** True when the bindings, their datasets, or their crosswalks could not be read. */
  hasError: boolean;
};

/** A combined dataset's crosswalk, and whether a list it embedded changed. */
type CrosswalkOutput = {
  crosswalk: DictionaryUsageCrosswalk;
  isStale: boolean;
};

const NO_COMPILED_CODE_LISTS: readonly Crosswalk.CompiledCodeList[] = [];

function _getHowApplied(
  dataset: Dataset.T,
  bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[],
): DictionaryUsageHow {
  const isConverted = bindings.some((binding) => {
    return binding.mode === "convert";
  });
  if (!isConverted) {
    return "reference";
  }
  return dataset.sourceType === "virtual" ? "linked" : "changed";
}

/** The oldest version a re-appliable pinned conversion was given. */
function _getAppliedVersion(
  bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[],
): number | undefined {
  const versions = bindings
    .filter((binding) => {
      return (
        binding.mode === "convert" &&
        binding.pinnedPairs !== undefined &&
        binding.codeListId !== undefined
      );
    })
    .map(prop("appliedDictionaryVersion"));
  return versions.length === 0 ? undefined : Math.min(...versions);
}

function _toRow(
  options: Readonly<{
    dataset: Dataset.T;
    allBindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[];
    currentVersion: number;
    crosswalkOutput: CrosswalkOutput | undefined;
  }>,
): DictionaryUsageRow {
  const { dataset, crosswalkOutput } = options;
  const bindings = options.allBindings.filter((binding) => {
    return binding.datasetId === dataset.id;
  });
  const appliedVersion = crosswalkOutput
    ? undefined
    : _getAppliedVersion(bindings);
  return {
    datasetId: dataset.id,
    datasetName: dataset.name,
    sourceType: dataset.sourceType,
    entryCount: new Set(bindings.map(prop("entryId"))).size,
    howApplied: crosswalkOutput ? "crosswalk" : _getHowApplied(dataset, bindings),
    appliedVersion,
    isBehind: crosswalkOutput
      ? crosswalkOutput.isStale
      : appliedVersion !== undefined && appliedVersion < options.currentVersion,
    crosswalk: crosswalkOutput?.crosswalk,
  };
}

function _toCrosswalkOutputs(
  crosswalks: readonly Crosswalk.T[],
  codeLists: readonly DataDictionaryCodeList.T[] | undefined,
): Map<string, CrosswalkOutput> {
  return new Map(
    crosswalks.flatMap((crosswalk) => {
      if (crosswalk.outputDatasetId === undefined) {
        return [];
      }
      const isStale =
        codeLists !== undefined &&
        isCrosswalkStale({
          compiledCodeLists: crosswalk.compiledCodeLists ?? NO_COMPILED_CODE_LISTS,
          codeLists,
        });
      const output = {
        crosswalk: { id: crosswalk.id, name: crosswalk.name },
        isStale,
      };
      return [[crosswalk.outputDatasetId as string, output] as const];
    }),
  );
}

/**
 * The crosswalks whose combined datasets are among `datasetIds`, by
 * dataset id, each with whether a code list it embedded changed.
 */
function useCrosswalkOutputs(datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[]): {
  byDatasetId: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkOutput>;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
} {
  const hasDatasets = datasetIds.length > 0;
  const [crosswalks, isLoadingCrosswalks, crosswalksQuery] =
    CrosswalkClient.useGetAll({
      ...where("output_dataset_id", "in", datasetIds),
      useQueryOptions: { ...ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT, enabled: hasDatasets },
    });
  const codeListIds = useMemo(() => {
    const compiled = (crosswalks ?? []).flatMap((crosswalk) => {
      return crosswalk.compiledCodeLists ?? NO_COMPILED_CODE_LISTS;
    });
    return [...new Set(compiled.map(prop("codeListId")))];
  }, [crosswalks]);
  const [codeLists, isLoadingCodeLists] = DataDictionaryCodeListClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("id", "in", codeListIds),
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: codeListIds.length > 0 },
  });
  const byDatasetId = useMemo(() => {
    return _toCrosswalkOutputs(hasDatasets ? (crosswalks ?? []) : [], codeLists);
  }, [hasDatasets, crosswalks, codeLists]);
  return {
    byDatasetId,
    isLoading: isLoadingCrosswalks || isLoadingCodeLists,
    isError: crosswalksQuery.isError,
  };
}

function _toSortedRows(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasets: readonly Dataset.T[];
    bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[];
    currentVersion: number;
    crosswalkOutputs: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkOutput>;
  }>,
): DictionaryUsageRow[] {
  return options.datasets
    .map((dataset) => {
      return _toRow({
        dataset,
        allBindings: options.bindings,
        currentVersion: options.currentVersion,
        crosswalkOutput: options.crosswalkOutputs.get(dataset.id),
      });
    })
    .sort((rowA, rowB) => {
      return rowA.datasetName.localeCompare(rowB.datasetName);
    });
}

/**
 * The datasets one dictionary is applied to, that the user can see, with
 * how each uses it and whether it is behind: a pinned conversion older
 * than the dictionary's current version, or a crosswalk's combined dataset
 * whose embedded code lists changed. A dataset the user cannot read is
 * never counted, because its bindings are hidden with it. Bindings and
 * crosswalks refetch on mount, so an apply or a combine made a moment ago
 * is listed. Used by the Dictionary view's header and Used by tab.
 */
export function useDictionaryUsage(
  options: Readonly<{
    dictionaryId: DataDictionary.Id;
    dictionaryName: string;
    currentVersion: number;
  }>,
): DictionaryUsage {
  const { dictionaryId, dictionaryName, currentVersion } = options;
  const [bindings, isLoadingBindings, bindingsQuery] =
    DictionaryBindingClient.useGetAll({
      ...where("dictionary_id", "eq", dictionaryId),
      useQueryOptions: ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT,
    });
  const datasetIds = useMemo(() => {
    return [...new Set((bindings ?? []).map(prop("datasetId")))];
  }, [bindings]);
  const [datasets, isLoadingDatasets, datasetsQuery] = DatasetClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("id", "in", datasetIds),
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: datasetIds.length > 0 },
  });
  const crosswalkOutputs = useCrosswalkOutputs(datasetIds);
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    return _toSortedRows({
      datasets: datasetIds.length > 0 ? (datasets ?? []) : [],
      bindings: bindings ?? [],
      currentVersion,
      crosswalkOutputs: crosswalkOutputs.byDatasetId,
    });
  }, [bindings, datasets, datasetIds, currentVersion, crosswalkOutputs.byDatasetId]);
  return {
    dictionaryId,
    dictionaryName,
    rows,
    currentVersion,
    isLoading:
      isLoadingBindings || isLoadingDatasets || crosswalkOutputs.isLoading,
    hasError:
      bindingsQuery.isError || datasetsQuery.isError || crosswalkOutputs.isError,
  };
}
```
