```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Badge, Group, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import {
  IconArrowMerge,
  IconLink,
  IconReplace,
  IconTag,
} from "@tabler/icons-react";
import type { DictionaryUsageHow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/useDictionaryUsage/useDictionaryUsage";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  howApplied: DictionaryUsageHow;
  /** The crosswalk that combined the dataset, for a crosswalk row. */
  crosswalkName: string | undefined;
};

const ICON_BY_HOW = {
  reference: IconTag,
  linked: IconLink,
  changed: IconReplace,
  crosswalk: IconArrowMerge,
} as const satisfies Record<DictionaryUsageHow, unknown>;

/** The badge naming how a dataset uses the dictionary. */
function HowAppliedBadgeText({
  howApplied,
}: Readonly<{ howApplied: DictionaryUsageHow }>): ReactNode {
  switch (howApplied) {
    case "reference":
      return <Trans>Reference</Trans>;
    case "linked":
      return <Trans>Linked</Trans>;
    case "changed":
      return <Trans>Changed the data</Trans>;
    case "crosswalk":
      return <Trans>Crosswalk</Trans>;
  }
}

/** What that means for the dataset's values. */
function HowAppliedNote({ howApplied, crosswalkName }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  switch (howApplied) {
    case "reference":
      return <Trans>data unchanged, always current</Trans>;
    case "linked":
      return <Trans>updates when this dictionary changes</Trans>;
    case "changed":
      return <Trans>keeps the version it was given</Trans>;
    case "crosswalk":
      return <Trans>Through {crosswalkName}</Trans>;
  }
}

/**
 * The Used by tab's "How it was applied" cell: a badge, then what it
 * means for the dataset's values, or which crosswalk combined it.
 */
export function HowAppliedCell({
  howApplied,
  crosswalkName,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const Icon = ICON_BY_HOW[howApplied];
  return (
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">
      <Badge
        size="sm"
        variant="light"
        color="neutral"
        tt="none"
        flex="none"
        leftSection={<Icon size={12} aria-hidden />}
      >
        <HowAppliedBadgeText howApplied={howApplied} />
      </Badge>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
        <HowAppliedNote howApplied={howApplied} crosswalkName={crosswalkName} />
      </Text>
    </Group>
  );
}
```

  `crosswalkName` is always set on a crosswalk row (`useDictionaryUsage` sets `crosswalk` exactly when `howApplied` is `crosswalk`), and Lingui renders an undefined value as empty text.

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Badge, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import type { DictionaryUsageRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/useDictionaryUsage/useDictionaryUsage";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  row: DictionaryUsageRow;
  currentVersion: number;
  /** Shown under a status that is behind, such as Re-apply. */
  action?: ReactNode;
};

function UpToDateBadge(): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Badge size="sm" variant="light" color="success" tt="none">
      <Trans>Up to date</Trans>
    </Badge>
  );
}

function BehindStatus({
  children,
  action,
}: Readonly<{ children: ReactNode; action: ReactNode }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Stack gap={4} align="flex-start">
      <Text size="xs" fw={500}>
        {children}
      </Text>
      {action}
    </Stack>
  );
}

/**
 * The Used by tab's Status cell: "Up to date"; for a dataset changed in
 * place, the version it was given beside the dictionary's current one;
 * for a crosswalk's combined dataset, that a code list changed since it
 * was combined. `action` goes under a status that is behind.
 */
export function UsageStatusCell({
  row,
  currentVersion,
  action,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  if (row.howApplied === "crosswalk") {
    return row.isBehind ? (
      <BehindStatus action={action}>
        <Trans>A code list changed since it was combined</Trans>
      </BehindStatus>
    ) : (
      <UpToDateBadge />
    );
  }
  if (!row.isBehind || row.appliedVersion === undefined) {
    return <UpToDateBadge />;
  }
  const appliedVersion = i18n.number(row.appliedVersion);
  const nowVersion = i18n.number(currentVersion);
  return (
    <BehindStatus action={action}>
      <Trans>
        Applied version {appliedVersion}, now version {nowVersion}
      </Trans>
    </BehindStatus>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import type { DictionaryUsageCrosswalk } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/useDictionaryUsage/useDictionaryUsage";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  crosswalk: DictionaryUsageCrosswalk;
};

/**
 * Opens a crosswalk on its Create combined dataset step, where its editor
 * updates the combined dataset with the current code lists. Its
 * accessible name names the crosswalk, since several rows can carry one.
 */
export function OpenCrosswalkLink({ crosswalk }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const crosswalkName = crosswalk.name;
  const link = AppLinks.dataManagerCrosswalkView({
    workspaceSlug: workspace.slug,
    crosswalkId: crosswalk.id,
    crosswalkName,
    step: "combine",
  });
  return (
    <Link
      to={link.to}
      params={link.params}
      search={link.search}
      size="xs"
      fw={500}
      aria-label={t`Open crosswalk ${crosswalkName}`}
    >
      <Trans>Open crosswalk</Trans>
    </Link>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Table } from "@mantine/core";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { ReapplyButton } from "@/components/dataDictionaries/ReapplyButton/ReapplyButton";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useHasPermission } from "@/hooks/permissions/useHasPermission/useHasPermission";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { HowAppliedCell } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/DictionaryUsedByTab/HowAppliedCell";
import { OpenCrosswalkLink } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/DictionaryUsedByTab/OpenCrosswalkLink";
import { UsageStatusCell } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/DictionaryUsedByTab/UsageStatusCell";
import type {
  DictionaryUsage,
  DictionaryUsageRow,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/useDictionaryUsage/useDictionaryUsage";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  usage: DictionaryUsage;
};

type RowProps = {
  row: DictionaryUsageRow;
  usage: DictionaryUsage;
  /** Whether the user can edit the row's dataset. */
  canEdit: boolean;
  /** Whether the user can edit crosswalks. */
  canEditCrosswalks: boolean;
};

/**
 * What a row that is behind offers: Open crosswalk on a crosswalk's
 * combined dataset, for crosswalk editors, and Re-apply on any other
 * dataset the user can edit.
 */
function RowStatusAction({
  row,
  usage,
  canEdit,
  canEditCrosswalks,
}: Readonly<RowProps>): ReactNode {
  if (!row.isBehind) {
    return null;
  }
  if (row.crosswalk) {
    return canEditCrosswalks ? (
      <OpenCrosswalkLink crosswalk={row.crosswalk} />
    ) : null;
  }
  return canEdit ? (
    <ReapplyButton
      dataset={{
        id: row.datasetId,
        name: row.datasetName,
        sourceType: row.sourceType,
      }}
      dictionaryId={usage.dictionaryId}
      dictionaryName={usage.dictionaryName}
    />
  ) : null;
}

function UsageRow({
  row,
  usage,
  canEdit,
  canEditCrosswalks,
}: Readonly<RowProps>): ReactNode {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const link = AppLinks.dataManagerDatasetView({
    workspaceSlug: workspace.slug,
    datasetId: row.datasetId,
    datasetName: row.datasetName,
  });
  return (
    <Table.Tr>
      <Table.Td>
        <Link to={link.to} params={link.params} size="sm" fw={500}>
          {row.datasetName}
        </Link>
      </Table.Td>
      <Table.Td>
        <HowAppliedCell
          howApplied={row.howApplied}
          crosswalkName={row.crosswalk?.name}
        />
      </Table.Td>
      <Table.Td ta="end">{i18n.number(row.entryCount)}</Table.Td>
      <Table.Td>
        <UsageStatusCell
          row={row}
          currentVersion={usage.currentVersion}
          action={
            <RowStatusAction
              row={row}
              usage={usage}
              canEdit={canEdit}
              canEditCrosswalks={canEditCrosswalks}
            />
          }
        />
      </Table.Td>
    </Table.Tr>
  );
}

/**
 * One row per dataset the dictionary is applied to, and how, with
 * Re-apply on a dataset that is behind and that the user can edit, and
 * Open crosswalk on a combined dataset whose code lists changed.
 */
export function DictionaryUsedByTable({ usage }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const canEditCrosswalks = useHasPermission("data_sources__can_edit_crosswalks");
  const [editableIds] = DatasetClient.useGetEditableIds({
    workspaceId: workspace.id,
  });
  const editableIdSet = new Set<string>(editableIds ?? []);
  return (
    <Table layout="fixed" verticalSpacing="xs">
      <Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tr>
          <Table.Th>
            <Trans>Dataset</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th w="40%">
            <Trans>How it was applied</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th w="10%" ta="end">
            <Trans>Entries</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th w="22%">
            <Trans>Status</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
        </Table.Tr>
      </Table.Thead>
      <Table.Tbody>
        {usage.rows.map((row) => {
          return (
            <UsageRow
              key={row.datasetId}
              row={row}
              usage={usage}
              canEdit={editableIdSet.has(row.datasetId)}
              canEditCrosswalks={canEditCrosswalks}
            />
          );
        })}
      </Table.Tbody>
```

```ts
import { where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { CrosswalkClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkClient";
import { ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT } from "@/config/queryOptions.constants";
import type { Crosswalk } from "$/models/crosswalks/Crosswalk/Crosswalk";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";

/** The crosswalk that combined a dataset, if one did. */
export type CombiningCrosswalk = {
  crosswalk: Crosswalk.T | undefined;
  isLoading: boolean;
};

/**
 * The crosswalk whose combined dataset `datasetId` is, read fresh on
 * mount so a dataset combined a moment ago is recognized. Used by the
 * dataset's rail and its menu.
 */
export function useCombiningCrosswalk(datasetId: Dataset.Id): CombiningCrosswalk {
  const [crosswalks, isLoading] = CrosswalkClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("output_dataset_id", "eq", datasetId),
    useQueryOptions: ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT,
  });
  return { crosswalk: crosswalks?.[0], isLoading };
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from "@avandar/ui";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { AppViewRail } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewRail/AppViewRail";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCombiningCrosswalk } from "@/hooks/crosswalks/useCombiningCrosswalk/useCombiningCrosswalk";
import { useHasPermission } from "@/hooks/permissions/useHasPermission/useHasPermission";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  datasetId: Dataset.Id;
};

/**
 * The rail fact naming the crosswalk that combined this dataset: a link
 * for crosswalk editors, its name for everyone else. Renders nothing for
 * a dataset no crosswalk combined.
 */
export function CombinedByFact({ datasetId }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const canEditCrosswalks = useHasPermission("data_sources__can_edit_crosswalks");
  const { crosswalk } = useCombiningCrosswalk(datasetId);
  if (!crosswalk) {
    return null;
  }
  const link = AppLinks.dataManagerCrosswalkView({
    workspaceSlug: workspace.slug,
    crosswalkId: crosswalk.id,
    crosswalkName: crosswalk.name,
  });
  return (
    <AppViewRail.Fact label={t`Combined by`}>
      {canEditCrosswalks ? (
        <Link to={link.to} params={link.params} search={link.search} size="sm">
          {crosswalk.name}
        </Link>
      ) : (
        crosswalk.name
      )}
    </AppViewRail.Fact>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 45: Clear them.** Replace `clearCachedDatasetRows.ts` with:

```ts
import { prop, promiseMap, where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { makePrincipalKeyFromWorkspaceSession } from "$/models/relations/RelationCacheKey/RelationCacheKey";
import { CrosswalkClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkClient";
import { CrosswalkDatasetClient } from "@/clients/crosswalks/CrosswalkDatasetClient";
import { LocalDatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/LocalDatasetClient/LocalDatasetClient";
import { VirtualDatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/source-datasets/VirtualDatasetClient";
import { DexieRelationCache } from "@/clients/qetl/RelationCache/DexieRelationCache/DexieRelationCache";
import { AvaQueryClient } from "@/config/AvaQueryClient";
import { Logger } from "@/utils/Logger";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { User } from "$/models/User/User";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";

/**
 * The linked datasets that read `datasetId`, whose cached rows are copies of
 * its rows. A failed read finds none, so the dataset itself is still
 * cleared.
 */
async function _getLinkedDatasetIds(
  datasetId: Dataset.Id,
): Promise<Dataset.Id[]> {
  try {
    const linkedDatasets = await VirtualDatasetClient.withCache(AvaQueryClient)
      .withEnsureQueryData()
      .getAll(where("linked_source_dataset_id", "eq", datasetId));
    return linkedDatasets.map((linkedDataset) => {
      return linkedDataset.datasetId;
    });
  } catch (error) {
    Logger.error("Could not read the linked datasets to refresh", { error });
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * The combined datasets of every crosswalk that stacks `datasetId`, whose
 * cached rows hold copies of its rows. A failed read finds none, so the
 * dataset itself is still cleared.
 */
async function _getCombinedDatasetIds(
  datasetId: Dataset.Id,
): Promise<Dataset.Id[]> {
  try {
    const memberships = await CrosswalkDatasetClient.withCache(AvaQueryClient)
      .withEnsureQueryData()
      .getAll(where("dataset_id", "eq", datasetId));
    const crosswalkIds = [...new Set(memberships.map(prop("crosswalkId")))];
    if (crosswalkIds.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    const crosswalks = await CrosswalkClient.withCache(AvaQueryClient)
      .withEnsureQueryData()
      .getAll(where("id", "in", crosswalkIds));
    return crosswalks.flatMap((crosswalk) => {
      return crosswalk.outputDatasetId === undefined
        ? []
        : [crosswalk.outputDatasetId];
    });
  } catch (error) {
    Logger.error("Could not read the combined datasets to refresh", { error });
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Drops every copy of a dataset's rows this tab has cached, and of the
 * linked datasets that read it and the combined datasets that stack it:
 * the user's relation cache entries and the tables loaded into this tab's
 * DuckDB. The next query that reads any of them acquires its rows from
 * the source.
 */
export async function clearCachedDatasetRows(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;
    userId: User.Id;
    workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
  }>,
): Promise<void> {
  const { datasetId, userId, workspaceId } = options;
  const [linkedIds, combinedIds] = await Promise.all([
    _getLinkedDatasetIds(datasetId),
    _getCombinedDatasetIds(datasetId),
  ]);
  const datasetIds = [...new Set([datasetId, ...linkedIds, ...combinedIds])];
  await DexieRelationCache.evict(
    datasetIds.map((id) => {
      return { kind: "dataset", id } as const;
    }),
    makePrincipalKeyFromWorkspaceSession({ workspaceId, userId }),
  );
  await promiseMap(datasetIds, async (id) => {
    await LocalDatasetClient.dropLocalDataset({ datasetId: id });
  });
}
```

### Task 26: End-to-end: map and combine

One test, driven through the UI after three preconditions: a dictionary seeded before the first page load, sign-in, and three small line lists imported through the UI. A workspace owner opens **New crosswalk** and adds the three datasets. Two Kings files share `CaseNo, GENDER, onset_dt, zip`; a Queens file names the same facts `case_id, sex, rash_onset, zip_code`, codes sex as `M/F/U`, and writes its dates as text. The owner makes sure the reference is the Kings layout (the scorer suggests it when coverage ties, since it holds more datasets; the spec picks it explicitly, a no-op when it is already chosen, so the test does not hang on the coverage scorer's details), and goes to **Map each dataset**. The owner opens the Queens layout, governs `GENDER` with the dictionary's `sex` entry, fills it from `sex`, and translates it with `Sex (M/F/U)`, and the example shows `Male`. The owner then opens the reference layout and sees that it now translates `GENDER` with `Sex (1/2/9)` on its own. Back on Queens, `onset_dt` is filled from `rash_onset` read as a date: the detected format `MM/DD/YYYY` fills in and the example shows an ISO date. **Confirm and next** goes to step 3, whose preview counts 18 rows from 3 datasets. **Create combined dataset** opens the new dataset's page, which shows `Male` and `Female`, a `source_dataset` column, the code-list tag on `GENDER`, and "Combined by Untitled crosswalk" in the rail. The database is read only as the final oracle (the combined dataset's columns in order, its one reference binding, and two fingerprints) and for cleanup.

**Why three UI imports.** `docs/rules/e2e-testing.md` allows seeding preconditions through the service role, but no helper in `tests/e2e/helpers/` seeds a file-backed dataset (its Parquet in storage, its source row, and its columns). Writing one would take more schema knowledge than this spec should own. `importDatasetViaUi` is the sanctioned path every dictionary spec uses, and these files are a few rows each. Three imports is one more than any existing spec makes, so the 45-second budget is tight (see Step 6). The spec never raises the timeout.

**Why the Queens dates have one bad value.** DuckDB's CSV sniffer reads `03/02/2026` as a `DATE`. A column of nothing but dates would arrive typed, and **Read as a date** would never be offered. One `unknown` among twelve values keeps the column text. 11 of 12 still parse as `%m/%d/%Y`, above the 90% `detectDateFormats` needs, so the format is detected. The bad value becomes empty in the combined dataset, as spec 9 intends. The example reads three distinct values in no set order, so `unknown` may be one of them and show "Becomes empty"; the spec therefore checks the detected format and one converted date, never the absence of "Becomes empty".

**Why GENDER's entry is set in the test.** Freshly imported datasets have no bindings, so seeding the columns gives `GENDER` no entry (`columns_seeded` reads entries only from the reference dataset's bindings). The test sets it in the pane. Choosing the entry dispatches `column_changed`, which empties `readLayoutIds`. Opening the reference layout afterwards mounts a fresh `useLayoutValues` (step 2 keys the shown layout's subtree by its id), so it reads the Kings values and dispatches `values_read`, and the reducer gives the reference's confirmed `GENDER` fill `chooseCodeList`. The spec waits for step 2's "Reading the values of ..." status to clear after each layout opens and after the entry changes, so it never edits a pane that a late `values_read` is about to refill.

The selectors are the names Tasks 14, 17, and 19 to 23 render (contract note 10 of this file lists each with its source). If a task's name changes, use the new name here rather than changing its copy. Choosing an option a Mantine `Select` already shows would deselect it (`allowDeselect` defaults to true). So `_chooseOption` reads the input first and acts only when the value is wrong, which converges as `docs/rules/e2e-testing.md` asks.

```ts
async function _seedCodeList(
  options: Readonly<{
    admin: AvaSupabaseDBClient;
    workspaceId: string;
    dictionaryId: string;
    entryId: string;
    codeList: SeedCodeList;
    isPrimary: boolean;
  }>,
): Promise<void> {
  const { admin, workspaceId, dictionaryId } = options;
  const { data: codeList } = await admin
    .from("data_dictionaries__code_lists")
    .insert({
      workspace_id: workspaceId,
      dictionary_id: dictionaryId,
      name: options.codeList.name,
      pairs: codePairsToDBJson(options.codeList.pairs),
    })
    .select("id")
    .single()
    .throwOnError();
  await admin
    .from("data_dictionaries__entry_codings")
    .insert({
      workspace_id: workspaceId,
      dictionary_id: dictionaryId,
      entry_id: options.entryId,
      code_list_id: codeList.id,
      is_primary: options.isPrimary,
    })
    .throwOnError();
}

async function _seedEntry(
  options: Readonly<{
    admin: AvaSupabaseDBClient;
    workspaceId: string;
    dictionaryId: string;
    entry: SeedEntry;
    position: number;
  }>,
): Promise<void> {
  const { admin, workspaceId, dictionaryId, entry } = options;
  const { data: entryRow } = await admin
    .from("data_dictionaries__entries")
    .insert({
      workspace_id: workspaceId,
      dictionary_id: dictionaryId,
      name: entry.name,
      column_names: [...entry.columnNames],
      kind: entry.kind,
      description: entry.description ?? null,
      position: options.position,
    })
    .select("id")
    .single()
    .throwOnError();
  const codeLists = [
    ...(entry.codeList ? [{ codeList: entry.codeList, isPrimary: true }] : []),
    ...(entry.otherCodeLists ?? []).map((codeList) => {
      return { codeList, isPrimary: false };
    }),
  ];
  for (const { codeList, isPrimary } of codeLists) {
    await _seedCodeList({
      admin,
      workspaceId,
      dictionaryId,
      entryId: entryRow.id,
      codeList,
      isPrimary,
    });
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the spec.** `tests/e2e/crosswalk-map-and-combine.spec.ts`:

```ts
/*
 * A workspace owner combines three line lists in two column layouts into
 * one combined dataset with a crosswalk. Two Kings files share CaseNo,
 * GENDER, onset_dt, and zip; a Queens file names the same facts case_id,
 * sex, rash_onset, and zip_code, codes sex as M/F/U, and writes its dates
 * as text. The owner makes the Kings layout the reference, governs GENDER
 * with the dictionary's sex entry, translates the Queens codes with M/F/U,
 * sees the reference translate with 1/2/9 on its own, reads rash_onset as
 * a date, and creates the combined dataset. Its page shows
 * labels, a source_dataset column, the code-list tag, and the crosswalk
 * that combined it. The imported datasets are preconditions and the
 * dictionary is seeded before the first page load. Everything the test
 * creates is deleted afterwards.
 */
import { expect, test as base } from "./fixtures/e2e.fixture";
import { signInWithEmailPassword } from "./helpers/auth";
import {
  CROSSWALK_KINGS_APRIL_CSV_PATH,
  CROSSWALK_KINGS_CSV_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNT,
  CROSSWALK_KINGS_MARCH_CSV_PATH,
  CROSSWALK_QUEENS_CSV_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNT,
  CROSSWALK_QUEENS_MARCH_CSV_PATH,
} from "./helpers/constants";
import { deleteDatasetFixture } from "./helpers/deleteDatasetFixture";
import { importDatasetViaUi } from "./helpers/importDatasetViaUi";
import { seedDataDictionary } from "./helpers/seedDataDictionary";
import {
  createSupabaseAdminClient,
  getWorkspaceIdBySlug,
} from "./helpers/supabaseAdminClient";
import { LONG_WAIT, MEDIUM_WAIT } from "./helpers/timeouts";
import type { AvaSupabaseDBClient } from "$/types/AvaSupabaseDbClient.types";
import type { SeedEntry } from "./helpers/seedDataDictionary";
import type { Locator, Page } from "@playwright/test";

const DICTIONARY_NAME = "E2E crosswalk codes";
const CROSSWALK_NAME = "Untitled crosswalk";
const COMBINED_NAME = "E2E measles, Kings and Queens";

/** Sex coded 1/2/9 (primary, as the Kings files hold it) and M/F/U. */
const ENTRIES: readonly SeedEntry[] = [
  {
    name: "sex",
    columnNames: ["GENDER", "sex"],
    kind: "categorical",
    description: "Sex recorded on the case report.",
    codeList: {
      name: "Sex (1/2/9)",
      pairs: [
        { code: "1", label: "Male", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
        { code: "2", label: "Female", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
        { code: "9", label: "Unknown", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: true },
      ],
    },
    otherCodeLists: [
      {
        name: "Sex (M/F/U)",
        pairs: [
          { code: "M", label: "Male", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
          { code: "F", label: "Female", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
          { code: "U", label: "Unknown", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: true },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
];

/** An imported dataset, by its id and the name the import gave it. */
type SourceDataset = { id: string; name: string };

/** The three imported line lists. */
type SourceDatasets = {
  kingsMarch: SourceDataset;
  kingsApril: SourceDataset;
  queens: SourceDataset;
};

/** The crosswalk the test made, once its combined dataset exists. */
type CombinedCrosswalk = {
  outputDatasetId: string;
  compiledCodeListCount: number;
};

function _escapeRegExp(text: string): string {
  return text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
}

/** The current step's sticky footer, where its actions live. */
function _footer(page: Page): Locator {
  return page.locator("[data-sticky-action-bar]");
}

function _mappingTable(page: Page): Locator {
  return page.getByRole("table").filter({
    has: page.getByRole("columnheader", {
      name: "Column of the combined dataset",
    }),
  });
}

/** The side pane's before-and-after example table. */
function _exampleTable(page: Page): Locator {
  return page.getByRole("table", { name: "Example" });
}

/**
 * Waits until step 2 has read the shown layout's values, so a late
 * `values_read` cannot refill the pane after the test edits it.
 */
async function _waitForLayoutValues(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await expect(
    page
      .getByRole("status")
      .filter({ hasText: /^Reading the values of .+ on this device$/ }),
  ).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: LONG_WAIT });
}

/**
 * Picks `optionName` in the Select labelled `label` unless it already
 * shows it: choosing the shown option again would deselect it. An option's
 * name starts with its label and may go on with an example value, as the
 * pane's Column Select's options do.
 */
async function _chooseOption(
  page: Page,
  label: string,
  optionName: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const select = page.getByLabel(label, { exact: true });
  await expect(select).toBeVisible();
  if ((await select.inputValue()) === optionName) {
    return;
  }
  await select.click();
  await page
    .getByRole("option", {
      name: new RegExp(`^${_escapeRegExp(optionName)}(?!\\w)`),
    })
    .click();
  await expect(select).toHaveValue(optionName);
}

/** Selects the mapping table's row for one column of the combined dataset. */
async function _selectColumn(page: Page, columnName: string): Promise<void> {
  const nameButton = _mappingTable(page).getByRole("button", {
    name: columnName,
    exact: true,
  });
  await nameButton.click();
  await expect(nameButton).toHaveAttribute("aria-current", "true");
}

/** Selects a layout in the stub by its first dataset's name, then waits for its values. */
async function _selectLayout(page: Page, layoutName: string): Promise<void> {
  const option = page
    .getByRole("listbox", { name: "Map each dataset" })
    .getByRole("option", { name: new RegExp(_escapeRegExp(layoutName)) });
  await option.click();
  await expect(option).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "true", {
    timeout: MEDIUM_WAIT,
  });
  await _waitForLayoutValues(page);
}

/** Opens New crosswalk and adds the three line lists. */
async function _addDatasets(page: Page, sources: SourceDatasets): Promise<void> {
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New crosswalk" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Add datasets", exact: true }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Add datasets" });
  for (const source of [sources.kingsMarch, sources.kingsApril, sources.queens]) {
    await dialog.getByRole("checkbox", { name: `Pick ${source.name}` }).check();
  }
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Add 3 datasets" }).click();
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();
}

/** Makes the Kings layout the reference, then saves and opens Map each dataset. */
async function _chooseReferenceAndMap(
  page: Page,
  kingsLayoutName: string,
): Promise<void> {
  await expect(page.getByText("+1 with the same layout")).toBeVisible();
  await _chooseOption(page, "Reference layout", kingsLayoutName);
  await _footer(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Next", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/crosswalks\/[0-9a-f-]{36}\?.*step=map/, {
    timeout: LONG_WAIT,
  });
  await expect(_mappingTable(page)).toBeVisible({ timeout: LONG_WAIT });
}

/** Governs GENDER with the sex entry and translates Queens' M/F/U codes. */
async function _translateQueensSex(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await _selectColumn(page, "GENDER");
  await _chooseOption(page, "Dictionary entry", "sex");
  // The entry change empties the layouts read this session.
  await _waitForLayoutValues(page);
  await page.getByText("A column", { exact: true }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("radio", { name: "A column", exact: true }),
  ).toBeChecked();
  await _chooseOption(page, "Column", "sex");
  await _chooseOption(page, "Translate codes with", "Sex (M/F/U)");
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("radio", { name: "Codes", exact: true }),
  ).toBeChecked();
  await expect(_exampleTable(page)).toContainText("Male", {
    timeout: MEDIUM_WAIT,
  });
}

/** The reference layout picks the primary list for GENDER when it is read. */
async function _expectReferenceTranslates(
  page: Page,
  kingsLayoutName: string,
): Promise<void> {
  await _selectLayout(page, kingsLayoutName);
  await _selectColumn(page, "GENDER");
  await expect(
    page.getByLabel("Translate codes with", { exact: true }),
  ).toHaveValue("Sex (1/2/9)", { timeout: MEDIUM_WAIT });
}

/** Fills onset_dt from Queens' text dates, read as month/day/year. */
async function _readQueensOnsetAsDate(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await _selectColumn(page, "onset_dt");
  await page.getByText("A column", { exact: true }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("radio", { name: "A column", exact: true }),
  ).toBeChecked();
  await _chooseOption(page, "Column", "rash_onset");
  await _chooseOption(page, "Change the values", "Read as a date");
  // The format detected from the values fills in, so the dates convert.
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Date format", { exact: true })).toHaveValue(
    "MM/DD/YYYY",
  );
  await expect(
    _exampleTable(page).getByRole("cell", { name: /^2026-03-\d{2}$/ }).first(),
  ).toBeVisible({ timeout: MEDIUM_WAIT });
}

/** Confirms Queens, names the combined dataset, and creates it. */
async function _createCombinedDataset(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await _footer(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm and next" }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/step=combine/, { timeout: MEDIUM_WAIT });
  const nameInput = page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Name", exact: true });
  await nameInput.fill(COMBINED_NAME);
  await expect(nameInput).toHaveValue(COMBINED_NAME);
  await expect(page.getByText("18 rows from 3 datasets")).toBeVisible({
    timeout: LONG_WAIT,
  });
  await _footer(page)
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Create combined dataset" })
    .click();
}

/** The combined dataset's page: labels, the source column, the tag, the rail. */
async function _expectCombinedDatasetPage(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("columnheader", { name: "source_dataset", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible({ timeout: LONG_WAIT });
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("gridcell", { name: "Male", exact: true }).first(),
  ).toBeVisible({ timeout: LONG_WAIT });
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("gridcell", { name: "Female", exact: true }).first(),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("button", { name: "Code list for GENDER" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("definition").filter({ hasText: CROSSWALK_NAME }),
  ).toBeVisible();
}

/** Waits for the crosswalk this test made to record its combined dataset. */
async function _waitForCombinedCrosswalk(
  options: Readonly<{
    admin: AvaSupabaseDBClient;
    workspaceId: string;
    startedAt: string;
  }>,
): Promise<CombinedCrosswalk> {
  let combined: CombinedCrosswalk | undefined;
  await expect
    .poll(
      async () => {
        const { data } = await options.admin
          .from("crosswalks")
          .select("output_dataset_id, compiled_code_lists")
          .eq("workspace_id", options.workspaceId)
          .gte("created_at", options.startedAt)
          .not("output_dataset_id", "is", null)
          .throwOnError();
        const row = data[0];
        combined = row?.output_dataset_id
          ? {
              outputDatasetId: row.output_dataset_id,
              compiledCodeListCount: (row.compiled_code_lists as unknown[])
                .length,
            }
          : undefined;
        return combined;
      },
      { timeout: LONG_WAIT },
    )
    .toBeDefined();
  return combined!;
}

/** The combined dataset's columns in order, and its one reference binding. */
async function _expectCombinedDatasetColumns(
  admin: AvaSupabaseDBClient,
  datasetId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const { data: columns } = await admin
    .from("dataset_columns")
    .select("name")
    .eq("dataset_id", datasetId)
    .order("column_idx")
    .throwOnError();
  expect(
    columns.map((column) => {
      return column.name;
    }),
  ).toEqual(["source_dataset", "CaseNo", "GENDER", "onset_dt", "zip"]);
  const { data: bindings } = await admin
    .from("dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings")
    .select("mode")
    .eq("dataset_id", datasetId)
    .throwOnError();
  expect(
    bindings.map((binding) => {
      return binding.mode;
    }),
  ).toEqual(["reference"]);
}

async function _readDatasetName(
  admin: AvaSupabaseDBClient,
  datasetId: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const { data } = await admin
    .from("datasets")
    .select("name")
    .eq("id", datasetId)
    .single()
    .throwOnError();
  return data.name;
}

/** The seeded dictionary, and the line lists a test imports through the UI. */
type CrosswalkSourcesFixture = {
  admin: AvaSupabaseDBClient;
  workspaceId: string;
  /** When the test began, to find the crosswalk it creates. */
  startedAt: string;
  /** Signs in and imports the three line lists. */
  signInAndImport: () => Promise<SourceDatasets>;
};

/** Deletes the crosswalks this test made, then their combined datasets. */
async function _deleteCrosswalks(
  options: Readonly<{
    admin: AvaSupabaseDBClient;
    workspaceId: string;
    startedAt: string;
  }>,
): Promise<void> {
  const { admin, workspaceId } = options;
  const { data: crosswalks } = await admin
    .from("crosswalks")
    .select("id, output_dataset_id")
    .eq("workspace_id", workspaceId)
    .gte("created_at", options.startedAt)
    .throwOnError();
  if (crosswalks.length === 0) {
    return;
  }
  await admin
    .from("crosswalks")
    .delete()
    .in(
      "id",
      crosswalks.map((crosswalk) => {
        return crosswalk.id;
      }),
    )
    .throwOnError();
  for (const crosswalk of crosswalks) {
    if (crosswalk.output_dataset_id) {
      await deleteDatasetFixture({
        admin,
        datasetId: crosswalk.output_dataset_id,
        workspaceId,
      });
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Seeds the dictionary before the first page load. Afterwards it deletes
 * the crosswalks the test made (their layouts, columns, memberships, and
 * mappings cascade) and their combined datasets, the imports, then the
 * dictionary, whose children cascade.
 */
const test = base.extend<{ crosswalkSources: CrosswalkSourcesFixture }>({
  crosswalkSources: async ({ page, e2eWorkerDb }, use) => {
    const admin = createSupabaseAdminClient();
    const workspaceId = await getWorkspaceIdBySlug({
      supabaseAdminClient: admin,
      slug: e2eWorkerDb.workspaceSlug,
    });
    const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const dictionaryId = await seedDataDictionary({
      admin,
      workspaceId,
      name: DICTIONARY_NAME,
      entries: ENTRIES,
    });
    const importedIds: string[] = [];
    const importOne = async (filePath: string, rowCount: number) => {
      const id = await importDatasetViaUi({
        page,
        filePath,
        expectedRowCount: rowCount,
        workspaceSlug: e2eWorkerDb.workspaceSlug,
        onDatasetCreated: (datasetId) => {
          importedIds.push(datasetId);
        },
      });
      return { id, name: await _readDatasetName(admin, id) };
    };
    const signInAndImport = async (): Promise<SourceDatasets> => {
      await signInWithEmailPassword(page, {
        email: e2eWorkerDb.primaryUser.email,
        password: e2eWorkerDb.primaryUser.password,
        workspaceSlug: e2eWorkerDb.workspaceSlug,
      });
      return {
        kingsMarch: await importOne(
          CROSSWALK_KINGS_MARCH_CSV_PATH,
          CROSSWALK_KINGS_CSV_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNT,
        ),
        kingsApril: await importOne(
          CROSSWALK_KINGS_APRIL_CSV_PATH,
          CROSSWALK_KINGS_CSV_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNT,
        ),
        queens: await importOne(
          CROSSWALK_QUEENS_MARCH_CSV_PATH,
          CROSSWALK_QUEENS_CSV_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNT,
        ),
      };
    };
    try {
      await use({ admin, workspaceId, startedAt, signInAndImport });
    } finally {
      await _deleteCrosswalks({ admin, workspaceId, startedAt });
      for (const datasetId of importedIds) {
        await deleteDatasetFixture({ admin, datasetId, workspaceId });
      }
      await admin
        .from("data_dictionaries")
        .delete()
        .eq("id", dictionaryId)
        .throwOnError();
    }
  },
});

test.describe("combining datasets with a crosswalk", () => {
  test("a combined dataset stacks both layouts with every code read as the primary list's label", async ({
    page,
    crosswalkSources,
  }) => {
    const sources = await crosswalkSources.signInAndImport();
    const [kingsLayoutName] = [
      sources.kingsMarch.name,
      sources.kingsApril.name,
    ].sort((nameA, nameB) => {
      return nameA.localeCompare(nameB);
    });

    await _addDatasets(page, sources);
    await _chooseReferenceAndMap(page, kingsLayoutName!);
    // Step 2 may open on either layout; map Queens first.
    await _selectLayout(page, sources.queens.name);
    await _translateQueensSex(page);
    await _expectReferenceTranslates(page, kingsLayoutName!);
    await _selectLayout(page, sources.queens.name);
    await _readQueensOnsetAsDate(page);
    await _createCombinedDataset(page);

    const combined = await _waitForCombinedCrosswalk(crosswalkSources);
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(combined.outputDatasetId), {
      timeout: LONG_WAIT,
    });
    await _expectCombinedDatasetPage(page);
    // Both sex lists were embedded: 1/2/9 for Kings and as the primary list
    // Queens' M/F/U codes are reconciled to, and M/F/U itself.
    expect(combined.compiledCodeListCount).toBe(2);
    await _expectCombinedDatasetColumns(
      crosswalkSources.admin,
      combined.outputDatasetId,
    );
  });
});
```

### Task 29: Meaning suggestions for a layout

The scorer matches a layout's columns onto the combined dataset's by name, type, and values. It misses columns that mean the same thing under unrelated names (`dob` and `birth_date`, `vax_status` and `mmr_status`). Spec 8.4 already asks the suggestion model for exactly those pairs in the create flow, through `DictionarySuggestions` and the `chat` route's `dictionary-suggestions-v1` prompt. This task reuses that path with no server or prompt change: a **Suggest matches** button in step 2's footer builds a `task: "matches"` request from the combined dataset's columns that this layout has not filled and the layout's columns no fill uses, sends it through `useDictionarySuggestions` (consent online, the offline model on device, nothing when neither is available), parses the reply with `parseDictionaryMeaningMatches`, keeps only pairs that join a combined-dataset column to a layout column, and dispatches `meaning_matches_found`. The reducer stores each as a `suggested` column fill with reason `meaning`, so the Match cell says "Meaning" beside the Suggested tag and the user accepts or rejects it like any other suggestion. It never replaces a fill that exists, confirmed or suggested.

The request follows the create flow's rules, through one new exported builder in `DictionarySuggestions` rather than a copy of its private helpers: names always; codes only for a column profiling calls coded, whose names do not identify a person, with every code within the schema's length; at most 12 codes per column; cut to fit the model that will answer. A layout column named like a combined-dataset column (ignoring case) is left out of the request: the scorer already compares those, and leaving them out keeps every name in the request on exactly one side, so a reply pair can be oriented without guessing.

Why no new prompt: the matches prompt asks for "columns that record the same thing under different names", which is the crosswalk's question. Its columns come "from a dataset", and here they come from two (the reference and this layout).

```ts
 * such as a crosswalk's combined-dataset column or a layout's column: its
 * name, its type, and its profile when its values were read.
```

```ts
/** A column's kind from its profile, or from its type when it was not read. */
function _getMatchColumnKind(
  column: Readonly<DictionaryMatchColumn>,
): DataDictionaryEntry.Kind {
  if (column.profile) {
    return ColumnProfile.getEntryKind(column.profile);
  }
  if (column.dataType === "date" || column.dataType === "timestamp") {
    return "date";
  }
  return column.dataType === "bigint" || column.dataType === "double"
    ? "number"
    : "text";
}

/**
 * The codes a column may send in a matches request: none unless profiling
 * calls it coded and none of its names identify a person, and none when a
 * code is over the schema's length, since a cut code is never sent.
 */
function _getMatchColumnValues(
  column: Readonly<DictionaryMatchColumn>,
): string[] {
  const { profile } = column;
  if (
    !profile ||
    !ColumnProfile.isCodedColumn(profile) ||
    [column.name, profile.columnName].some(isIdentifyingColumnName)
  ) {
    return [];
  }
  const values = (profile.values ?? [])
    .slice(0, DICTIONARY_SUGGESTIONS_MAX_MATCH_VALUES)
    .map(prop("value"));
  return _areValuesShortEnough(values) ? values : [];
}

function makeMatchesRequestFromColumns(
  options: Readonly<{
    columns: readonly DictionaryMatchColumn[];
    locale: string;
    model: DictionarySuggestionModel;
  }>,
): DictionarySuggestionsRequest | undefined {
  // A name is never cut: the reply names columns, and a cut name would
  // match nothing back.
  const columns = options.columns
    .filter((column) => {
      return (
        column.name.length > 0 &&
        column.name.length <= DICTIONARY_SUGGESTIONS_MAX_NAME_LENGTH
      );
    })
    .slice(0, DICTIONARY_SUGGESTIONS_MAX_MATCH_COLUMNS)
    .map((column) => {
      return {
        name: column.name,
        otherNames: [],
        kind: _getMatchColumnKind(column),
        values: _getMatchColumnValues(column),
      };
    });
  return _fitMatchesRequest(
    { task: "matches", locale: options.locale, columns },
    options.model,
  );
}
```

```ts
export const QUEENS_LAYOUT = "a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002" as CrosswalkLayout.Id;

export const QUEENS_DATASET = "d0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002" as Dataset.Id;

/** The dictionary entry the `sex` column is governed by. */

/** A profile of 400 rows: listed codes when given, otherwise unique per row. */
export function makeProfile(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;
    columnName: string;
    dataType: AvaDataType.T;
    codes?: readonly string[];
  }>,
): ColumnProfile.T {
  return {
    datasetId: options.datasetId,
    datasetName: options.datasetId === KINGS_DATASET ? "Kings" : "Queens",
    columnName: options.columnName,
    dataType: options.dataType,
    rowCount: 400,
    nonNullCount: 400,
    distinctCount: options.codes?.length ?? 400,
    values: options.codes?.map((value) => {
      return { value, rowCount: 400 / options.codes!.length };
    }),
    dateShare: undefined,
    numberRange: undefined,
  };
}

/** A confirmed fill from a source column with no conversion. */
export function makeColumnFill(sourceColumn: string): CrosswalkMapping.Fill {
  return {
    kind: "column",
    sourceColumn,
    convert: undefined,
    codeListId: undefined,
    holdsLabels: false,
  };
}

function _confirmed(
  id: string,
  sourceColumn: string,
): CrosswalkDraft.Mapping {
  return {
    id: id as CrosswalkMapping.Id,
    fill: makeColumnFill(sourceColumn),
    status: "confirmed",
    confidence: 1,
    reason: "name_and_type",
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Write the request builder.** `src/lib/crosswalks/makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest/makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest.ts`:

```ts
import { CrosswalkMapping } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMapping/CrosswalkMapping";
import { DictionarySuggestions } from "@/lib/dataDictionaries/DictionarySuggestions/DictionarySuggestions";
import type { DictionarySuggestionsRequest } from "$/agent/dictionarySuggestions/dictionarySuggestionsPrompt";
import type { CrosswalkColumn } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkColumn/CrosswalkColumn";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkMatch } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatch";
import type { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile";
import type { DictionaryProposal } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryProposal/DictionaryProposal";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type {
  DictionaryMatchColumn,
  DictionarySuggestionModel,
} from "@/lib/dataDictionaries/DictionarySuggestions/DictionarySuggestions";

/** A layout column the suggestion model says means a combined-dataset column. */
export type CrosswalkMeaningMatch = {
  columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id;
  sourceColumn: string;
};

/**
 * A meaning-match request for one layout, and which side of the crosswalk
 * each name in it is on, so a reply's pairs can be oriented.
 */
export type CrosswalkMatchesRequest = {
  request: Extract<DictionarySuggestionsRequest, { task: "matches" }>;
  /** Each combined-dataset column in the request, by the name it is sent as. */
  columnIdByName: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkColumn.Id>;
  /** The layout columns in the request, as the layout spells them. */
  sourceNames: ReadonlySet<string>;
};

function _toKey(name: string): string {
  return name.trim().toLowerCase();
}

/** Every layout column a fill of this layout reads, by comparison key. */
function _getUsedSourceKeys(
  mappings: Readonly<Record<string, CrosswalkDraft.Mapping>>,
): Set<string> {
  return new Set(
    Object.values(mappings).flatMap(({ fill }) => {
      if (fill.kind === "column") {
        return [_toKey(fill.sourceColumn)];
      }
      return fill.kind === "expression"
        ? CrosswalkMapping.getCombineColumnNames(fill.sql).map(_toKey)
        : [];
    }),
  );
}

/** The combined dataset's columns this layout has no fill for. */
function _getTargetColumns(
  options: Readonly<{
    draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
    mappings: Readonly<Record<string, CrosswalkDraft.Mapping>>;
    targets: readonly CrosswalkMatch.Target[];
  }>,
): Array<DictionaryMatchColumn & { columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id }> {
  return options.draft.columns
    .filter((column) => {
      return options.mappings[column.id] === undefined;
    })
    .map((column) => {
      return {
        columnId: column.id,
        name: column.name,
        dataType: column.dataType,
        profile: options.targets.find((target) => {
          return target.columnId === column.id;
        })?.profile,
      };
    });
}

/**
 * The layout's columns no fill reads and no combined-dataset column is
 * named like (ignoring case), typed from the layout's first dataset.
 */
function _getSourceColumns(
  options: Readonly<{
    draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
    layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout;
    mappings: Readonly<Record<string, CrosswalkDraft.Mapping>>;
    datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
    profilesBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnProfile.T>;
  }>,
): DictionaryMatchColumn[] {
  const takenKeys = new Set([
    ..._getUsedSourceKeys(options.mappings),
    ...options.draft.columns.map((column) => {
      return _toKey(column.name);
    }),
  ]);
  const [firstDatasetId] = options.layout.datasetIds;
  const datasetColumns = firstDatasetId
    ? (options.datasetsById.get(firstDatasetId)?.columns ?? [])
    : [];
  return options.layout.columnNames
    .filter((name) => {
      return !takenKeys.has(_toKey(name));
    })
    .map((name) => {
      const datasetColumn = datasetColumns.find((column) => {
        return _toKey(column.name) === _toKey(name);
      });
      return {
        name,
        dataType: datasetColumn?.dataType ?? "varchar",
        profile: options.profilesBySourceColumn.get(name),
      };
    });
}

/**
 * The meaning-match request for one layout: the combined dataset's columns
 * it has not filled, then its own columns that no fill reads. Undefined for
 * the reference layout, and when either side is empty, before or after the
 * request is cut to fit the model.
 */
export function makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest(
  options: Readonly<{
    draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
    layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
    /** Every readable dataset with its columns, for the layout's column types. */
    datasetsById: ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset>;
    targets: readonly CrosswalkMatch.Target[];
    profilesBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnProfile.T>;
    locale: string;
    model: DictionarySuggestionModel;
  }>,
): CrosswalkMatchesRequest | undefined {
  const layout = options.draft.layouts.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === options.layoutId;
  });
  if (!layout || layout.isReference) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const mappings = options.draft.mappings[layout.id] ?? {};
  const targetColumns = _getTargetColumns({ ...options, mappings });
  const sourceColumns = _getSourceColumns({ ...options, layout, mappings });
  const request = DictionarySuggestions.makeMatchesRequestFromColumns({
    columns: [...targetColumns, ...sourceColumns],
    locale: options.locale,
    model: options.model,
  });
  return request?.task === "matches"
    ? _toCrosswalkRequest(request, targetColumns)
    : undefined;
}

/** Splits a fitted request's names back into the crosswalk's two sides. */
function _toCrosswalkRequest(
  request: Extract<DictionarySuggestionsRequest, { task: "matches" }>,
  targetColumns: ReadonlyArray<{ columnId: CrosswalkColumn.Id; name: string }>,
): CrosswalkMatchesRequest | undefined {
  const sentNames = new Set(
    request.columns.map((column) => {
      return column.name;
    }),
  );
  const columnIdByName = new Map(
    targetColumns.flatMap((column) => {
      return sentNames.has(column.name)
        ? [[column.name, column.columnId] as const]
        : [];
    }),
  );
  const sourceNames = new Set(
    [...sentNames].filter((name) => {
      return !columnIdByName.has(name);
    }),
  );
  return columnIdByName.size > 0 && sourceNames.size > 0
    ? { request, columnIdByName, sourceNames }
    : undefined;
}

function _orientMatch(
  request: CrosswalkMatchesRequest,
  match: Readonly<DictionaryProposal.MeaningMatch>,
): CrosswalkMeaningMatch | undefined {
  const fromName = request.columnIdByName.get(match.name);
  if (fromName && request.sourceNames.has(match.sameAs)) {
    return { columnId: fromName, sourceColumn: match.sameAs };
  }
  const fromSameAs = request.columnIdByName.get(match.sameAs);
  if (fromSameAs && request.sourceNames.has(match.name)) {
    return { columnId: fromSameAs, sourceColumn: match.name };
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * The reply's pairs that join a combined-dataset column to a layout
 * column, each column in at most one pair, first pair first. A pair within
 * one side is dropped.
 */
export function toCrosswalkMeaningMatches(
  options: Readonly<{
    request: CrosswalkMatchesRequest;
    matches: readonly DictionaryProposal.MeaningMatch[];
  }>,
): CrosswalkMeaningMatch[] {
  const pairedColumnIds = new Set<string>();
  const pairedSources = new Set<string>();
  return options.matches.flatMap((match) => {
    const pair = _orientMatch(options.request, match);
    if (
      !pair ||
      pairedColumnIds.has(pair.columnId) ||
      pairedSources.has(pair.sourceColumn)
    ) {
      return [];
    }
    pairedColumnIds.add(pair.columnId);
    pairedSources.add(pair.sourceColumn);
    return [pair];
  });
}
```

  `CrosswalkDraft.Mapping` and `CrosswalkDraft.Layout` are Task 15's namespace members for `CrosswalkDraftMapping` and `CrosswalkDraftLayout` (`src/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft.types.ts`). `CrosswalkMapping.getCombineColumnNames` is Task 7's module function; `CrosswalkLayout.Dataset` is Task 6's namespace type.

```ts
/**
 * The column fill a meaning match suggests: the source column with no
 * conversion, and for a governed column the code list the source's values
 * fit, as a values match would choose it.
 */
function _toMeaningFill(
  options: Readonly<{
    column: CrosswalkDraft.Column;
    sourceColumn: string;
    action: MeaningMatchesFound;
  }>,
): CrosswalkMapping.Fill {
  const { column, sourceColumn, action } = options;
  const entry = column.entryId
    ? action.context.entriesById.get(column.entryId)
    : undefined;
  const profile = action.sources.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.columnName.toLowerCase() === sourceColumn.toLowerCase();
  });
  const choice =
    entry && profile
      ? CrosswalkMatch.chooseCodeList({ profile, entry })
      : undefined;
  return {
    kind: "column",
    sourceColumn,
    convert: undefined,
    codeListId: choice?.codeListId,
    holdsLabels: choice?.holdsLabels ?? false,
  };
}

/**
 * The suggested mappings meaning matches add to one layout: one per column
 * with no fill, from a layout column (spelled as the layout spells it) that
 * no fill reads yet. Each column and each source is used once, first match
 * first.
 */
function _makeMeaningMappings(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  layout: CrosswalkDraft.Layout,
  action: MeaningMatchesFound,
): Record<string, CrosswalkDraft.Mapping> {
  const current = draft.mappings[layout.id] ?? {};
  const usedSources = _usedSourceColumns(current);
  const added: Record<string, CrosswalkDraft.Mapping> = {};
  action.matches.forEach((match) => {
    const column = draft.columns.find((candidate) => {
      return candidate.id === match.columnId;
    });
    const sourceColumn = layout.columnNames.find((name) => {
      return name.toLowerCase() === match.sourceColumn.toLowerCase();
    });
    if (
      !column ||
      !sourceColumn ||
      current[column.id] ||
      added[column.id] ||
      usedSources.has(sourceColumn.toLowerCase())
    ) {
      return;
    }
    usedSources.add(sourceColumn.toLowerCase());
    added[column.id] = {
      id: uuid<CrosswalkMapping.Id>(),
      fill: _toMeaningFill({ column, sourceColumn, action }),
      status: "suggested",
      confidence: undefined,
      reason: "meaning",
    };
  });
  return added;
}

/**
 * Stores meaning matches as suggested fills of one layout, marked
 * `meaning`. A fill that exists is never replaced, the reference layout and
 * a mapped or skipped layout are left alone, and the layout's status is
 * refreshed, so a To do layout becomes Review once every column has a fill.
 * Returns the same draft when nothing is added.
 */
export function applyMeaningMatches(
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T,
  action: MeaningMatchesFound,
): CrosswalkDraft.T {
  const layout = draft.layouts.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.id === action.layoutId;
  });
  if (
    !layout ||
    layout.isReference ||
    layout.status === "mapped" ||
    layout.status === "skipped"
  ) {
    return draft;
  }
  const added = _makeMeaningMappings(draft, layout, action);
  return Object.keys(added).length === 0
    ? draft
    : withLayoutMappings(draft, layout.id, {
        ...draft.mappings[layout.id],
        ...added,
      });
}
```

```ts
import { useMutation } from "@avandar/query-hooks";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { useState } from "react";
import { parseDictionaryMeaningMatches } from "$/agent/dictionarySuggestions/dictionarySuggestionsPrompt";
import {
  makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest,
  toCrosswalkMeaningMatches,
} from "@/lib/crosswalks/makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest/makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest";
import { useDictionarySuggestions } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/useDictionarySuggestions/useDictionarySuggestions";
import type { CrosswalkLayout } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkLayout/CrosswalkLayout";
import type { CrosswalkMatch } from "$/models/crosswalks/CrosswalkMatch/CrosswalkMatch";
import type { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile";
import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";
import type {
  CrosswalkMatchesRequest,
  CrosswalkMeaningMatch,
} from "@/lib/crosswalks/makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest/makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest";
import type { DictionarySuggestionModel } from "@/lib/dataDictionaries/DictionarySuggestions/DictionarySuggestions";
import type {
  CrosswalkAction,
  CrosswalkContext,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/crosswalkReducer/crosswalkReducer.types";
import type { SuggestionConsent } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/newDictionaryReducer/newDictionaryReducer";
import type {
  DictionarySuggestionAvailability,
  RequestSuggestionReply,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/useDictionarySuggestions/useDictionarySuggestions";
import type { MeaningMatchStatus } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/useMeaningMatches";

/** What step 2's Suggest matches shows and does for the selected layout. */
export type CrosswalkMeaningMatches = {
  availability: DictionarySuggestionAvailability;
  /** True when a model can answer and the layout has something to ask about. */
  canSuggest: boolean;
  /** The search for this layout; another layout's search reads as idle. */
  status: MeaningMatchStatus;
  /** How many pairs the last search for this layout found, once it is done. */
  foundCount: number | undefined;
  suggestMatches: () => void;
};

/** The user's answer to sending column names online, and how it is given. */
export type CrosswalkSuggestionConsent = {
  consent: SuggestionConsent;
  onConsentDecided: (isApproved: boolean) => void;
};

/** What the hook reads: the step's draft, layout, values, consent, and dispatch. */
type MeaningMatchesOptions = Readonly<{
  draft: CrosswalkDraft.T;
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
  context: CrosswalkContext;
  targets: readonly CrosswalkMatch.Target[];
  profilesBySourceColumn: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnProfile.T>;
  suggestionConsent: CrosswalkSuggestionConsent;
  dispatch: (action: CrosswalkAction) => void;
}>;

type MatchesVariables = {
  request: CrosswalkMatchesRequest;
  layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id;
  /** The layout's profiles when it was asked about, for the dispatch. */
  sources: readonly ColumnProfile.T[];
};

/**
 * Keeps the user's answer to sending suggestions online. Step 2 holds it
 * above the shown layout, so one answer covers every layout of the
 * crosswalk while the step is open.
 */
export function useCrosswalkSuggestionConsent(): CrosswalkSuggestionConsent {
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState<SuggestionConsent>("not_asked");
  return {
    consent,
    onConsentDecided: (isApproved) => {
      setConsent(isApproved ? "approved" : "declined");
    },
  };
}

async function _requestMatches(
  request: CrosswalkMatchesRequest,
  requestReply: RequestSuggestionReply,
): Promise<CrosswalkMeaningMatch[]> {
  const reply = await requestReply(request.request);
  if (reply === undefined) {
    return [];
  }
  const names = request.request.columns.map((column) => {
    return column.name;
  });
  const matches = parseDictionaryMeaningMatches(reply, names) ?? [];
  return toCrosswalkMeaningMatches({ request, matches });
}

function _toStatus(result: {
  isPending: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  isSuccess: boolean;
}): MeaningMatchStatus {
  if (result.isPending) {
    return "finding";
  }
  if (result.isError) {
    return "failed";
  }
  return result.isSuccess ? "done" : "idle";
}

/** The layout's request, cut to fit the model that will answer, if any. */
function _makeRequest(
  options: MeaningMatchesOptions,
  locale: string,
  model: DictionarySuggestionModel,
): CrosswalkMatchesRequest | undefined {
  return makeCrosswalkMatchesRequest({
    draft: options.draft,
    layoutId: options.layoutId,
    datasetsById: options.context.datasetsById,
    targets: options.targets,
    profilesBySourceColumn: options.profilesBySourceColumn,
    locale,
    model,
  });
}

/** The search itself: asks, then dispatches what it found for the layout asked about. */
function _useFindMatches(
  options: Readonly<{
    requestReply: RequestSuggestionReply;
    context: CrosswalkContext;
    dispatch: (action: CrosswalkAction) => void;
  }>,
) {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (variables: MatchesVariables) => {
      return _requestMatches(variables.request, options.requestReply);
    },
    onSuccess: (matches, variables) => {
      if (matches.length > 0) {
        options.dispatch({
          type: "meaning_matches_found",
          layoutId: variables.layoutId,
          matches,
          sources: variables.sources,
          context: options.context,
        });
      }
    },
    onError: () => {
      // The footer's note says the search did not finish.
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Asks the suggestion model which of a layout's unused columns mean the
 * combined dataset's unfilled columns, and dispatches the pairs as
 * `meaning_matches_found` for the layout that was asked about. Online
 * sends go through the chat's consent gate, with the answer the step keeps;
 * on device nothing is asked; with no model nothing is sent. A failure is
 * shown by the footer's note, not a toast: the matches by name and values
 * are still there.
 */
export function useCrosswalkMeaningMatches(
  options: MeaningMatchesOptions,
): CrosswalkMeaningMatches {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  const suggestions = useDictionarySuggestions(options.suggestionConsent);
  const request = _makeRequest(options, i18n.locale, suggestions.model);
  const [findMatches, , result] = _useFindMatches({
    requestReply: suggestions.requestReply,
    context: options.context,
    dispatch: options.dispatch,
  });
  const isThisLayout = result.variables?.layoutId === options.layoutId;
  const isModelReady =
    suggestions.availability === "online" ||
    suggestions.availability === "on_device";
  return {
    availability: suggestions.availability,
    canSuggest: isModelReady && request !== undefined,
    status: isThisLayout ? _toStatus(result) : "idle",
    foundCount: isThisLayout && result.isSuccess ? result.data.length : undefined,
    suggestMatches: () => {
      if (request && isModelReady && !result.isPending) {
        findMatches({
          request,
          layoutId: options.layoutId,
          sources: [...options.profilesBySourceColumn.values()],
        });
      }
    },
  };
}
```

  `useCrosswalkMeaningMatches` is 33 lines once formatted. `useDictionarySuggestions` takes `{ consent, onConsentDecided }`, which `CrosswalkSuggestionConsent` is. The test asserts `sources: MEANING_SOURCES`: `MEANING_SOURCES_BY_NAME` is built from `MEANING_SOURCES` in order, so its values spread back to an equal array.

```tsx
import { plural } from "@lingui/core/macro";
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Group, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "@mantine/hooks";
import { IconSparkles } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { MeaningMatchStatusLine } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/ReviewColumnsStep/MeaningMatchStatusLine";
import type { CrosswalkMeaningMatches } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/CrosswalkView/MapLayoutsStep/useCrosswalkMeaningMatches/useCrosswalkMeaningMatches";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  meaningMatches: CrosswalkMeaningMatches;
};

/** Why Suggest matches is off, or what the last search found, or nothing. */
function _getNote(meaningMatches: CrosswalkMeaningMatches): ReactNode {
  const { availability, canSuggest, status, foundCount } = meaningMatches;
  if (availability === "unavailable") {
    return (
      <Trans>
        Suggestions need a connection or the offline model. Mapping still
        works.
      </Trans>
    );
  }
  if (availability === "declined") {
    return (
      <Trans>
        You chose not to send column names to the AI provider, so suggestions
        are off for this crosswalk. Mapping still works.
      </Trans>
    );
  }
  if (status === "done" && foundCount !== undefined) {
    return foundCount === 0
      ? <Trans>No other matches found.</Trans>
      : plural(foundCount, {
          one: "Found # more match. It's marked Suggested.",
          other: "Found # more matches. They're marked Suggested.",
        });
  }
  if (!canSuggest && status !== "finding") {
    return <Trans>Nothing is left to match in this dataset.</Trans>;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Step 2's Suggest matches: asks the suggestion model for the layout's
 * columns that mean the combined dataset's unfilled ones, under names the
 * scorer cannot match. Off, with the reason beside it, when no model can
 * answer, the user declined, or nothing is left to ask about. The search's
 * progress and failure are read out politely.
 */
export function SuggestMatchesButton({
  meaningMatches,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const noteId = useId();
  const note = _getNote(meaningMatches);
  const isFinding = meaningMatches.status === "finding";
  return (
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap" miw={0}>
      <MeaningMatchStatusLine status={meaningMatches.status} />
      <div aria-live="polite">
        {note ? (
          <Text id={noteId} size="xs" c="dimmed">
            {note}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <Button
        variant="default"
        leftSection={<IconSparkles size={14} aria-hidden />}
        loading={isFinding}
        disabled={!meaningMatches.canSuggest || isFinding}
        aria-describedby={note ? noteId : undefined}
        onClick={meaningMatches.suggestMatches}
      >
        <Trans>Suggest matches</Trans>
      </Button>
    </Group>
  );
}
```

### Task 30: Long layout lists

Spec 14 allows 200 datasets in a crosswalk and says the stub list virtualizes past 100 layouts. Task 19's `LayoutStub` renders one `LayoutStubRow` per layout; at a few hundred rows that is still cheap to render once, but each draft change (every fill, every accept) re-renders the stub, so past 100 layouts only the rows in view are rendered, with `@tanstack/react-virtual` as `DataCatalogListingList` uses it (`src/views/DataManagerApp/DataImportView/DataCatalogView/DataCatalogListingList/`). At 100 or fewer the stub renders every row exactly as before, so small crosswalks keep native scrolling and nothing a test or screen reader relies on changes.

Task 19 already built the list for this: the listbox is the one tab stop and keeps focus, `aria-activedescendant` names the active row (`useLayoutListKeyboard`), arrow keys, Home, and End move it, and Enter or Space selects it through `onSelectLayout` (which saves first when dirty). Only two things change past 100 layouts. A row outside the window is not in the DOM, so `scrollIntoView` on its id finds nothing: the keyboard hook gains an optional `scrollToLayout`, which the list passes as the virtualizer's `scrollToIndex`. And a screen reader cannot count rows that are not rendered, so each rendered row gets `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` and is still heard as "12 of 200". When the selected layout changes from outside (Confirm and next jumps to the next To do layout), the active row follows it and is scrolled into view, as it is today.

The listbox moves out of `LayoutStub.tsx` into `LayoutStubList.tsx`, which owns the listbox, the keyboard, and the virtualizer. Each rendered row of a long list sits in a measured wrapper placed at its offset, so `LayoutStubRow` keeps its root element, its class, and its props (`{ layout; datasetsById; optionId; isSelected; isActive; onSelect }`), plus one optional prop for its position. `LayoutStub`'s props (`{ draft; datasetsById; selectedLayoutId; onSelectLayout }`) do not change, so Task 22's step does not change either.

```tsx
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@/test-utils";
import {
  LAYOUT_STUB_VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD,
  LayoutStubList,

import type { CrosswalkDraft } from "@/lib/crosswalks/CrosswalkDraft/CrosswalkDraft";

/** How many rows the mocked virtualizer says are in view. */
const WINDOW_SIZE = 12;

const { scrollToIndexMock } = vi.hoisted(() => {
  return { scrollToIndexMock: vi.fn() };
});

// jsdom lays nothing out, so a real virtualizer would render no rows. The
// mock renders the first rows as in view and records scrolling, as
// DataCatalogListingList's test does.

  return {
    useVirtualizer: (options: { count: number }) => {
      return {
        getTotalSize: () => {
          return options.count * 52;
        },
        getVirtualItems: () => {
          return Array.from(
            { length: Math.min(options.count, WINDOW_SIZE) },
            (_item, index) => {
              return {
                index,
                key: index,
                start: index * 52,
                size: 52,
                end: (index + 1) * 52,
                lane: 0,
              };
            },
          );
        },
        measureElement: () => {},
        scrollToIndex: scrollToIndexMock,
      };

function _makeLayouts(count: number): CrosswalkDraft.Layout[] {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_item, index) => {
    return {
      id: `layout-${index}` as CrosswalkLayout.Id,
      key: `key-${index}`,
      signature: `l1.${index}`,
      columnNames: [`column_${index}`],
      isReference: index === 0,
      status: index === 0 ? "mapped" : "to_do",
      datasetIds: [`dataset-${index}` as Dataset.Id],
    };
  });
}

/** One dataset per layout, named "Dataset <index>", so each row has a name. */
function _makeDatasetsById(
  layouts: readonly CrosswalkDraft.Layout[],
): ReadonlyMap<string, CrosswalkLayout.Dataset> {
  return new Map(
    layouts.map((layout, index) => {
      const datasetId = layout.datasetIds[0] as Dataset.Id;
      return [datasetId, { id: datasetId, name: `Dataset ${index}`, columns: [] }] as const;
    }),
  );
}

function _render(options: Readonly<{ count: number; selectedIndex?: number }>) {
  const layouts = _makeLayouts(options.count);
  const onSelectLayout = vi.fn();
  const props = { layouts, datasetsById: _makeDatasetsById(layouts), onSelectLayout };
  const rendered = render(
    <LayoutStubList {...props} selectedLayoutId={layouts[options.selectedIndex ?? 0]?.id} />,
  );
  const rerenderWithSelection = (index: number) => {
    rendered.rerender(<LayoutStubList {...props} selectedLayoutId={layouts[index]?.id} />);
  };
  return { layouts, onSelectLayout, rerenderWithSelection };
}

function _listbox(): HTMLElement {
  return screen.getByRole("listbox", { name: "Map each dataset" });
}

/** The rendered option of the layout whose dataset is "Dataset <index>". */
function _option(index: number): HTMLElement {
  const option = screen
    .getByText(`Dataset ${index}`)
    .closest<HTMLElement>('[role="option"]');
  if (!option) {
    throw new Error(`No option holds Dataset ${index}`);
  }
  return option;
}

describe("LayoutStubList", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("renders every row up to the threshold, as before", () => {
    _render({ count: LAYOUT_STUB_VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD });

    expect(screen.getAllByRole("option")).toHaveLength(LAYOUT_STUB_VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD);
    expect(_option(3)).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-setsize");
  });

  it("renders only the rows in view past the threshold, each saying where it sits", () => {
    _render({ count: 150 });

    expect(screen.getAllByRole("option")).toHaveLength(WINDOW_SIZE);
    expect(_option(3)).toHaveAttribute("aria-setsize", "150");
    expect(_option(3)).toHaveAttribute("aria-posinset", "4");
    expect(_option(0)).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
    expect(_option(1)).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
  });

  it("moves the active row with the keys and scrolls it in through the virtualizer", () => {
    _render({ count: 150 });

    fireEvent.keyDown(_listbox(), { key: "ArrowDown" });

    expect(_listbox()).toHaveAttribute("aria-activedescendant", _option(1).id);
    expect(scrollToIndexMock).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(1, { align: "auto" });

    fireEvent.keyDown(_listbox(), { key: "End" });
    expect(scrollToIndexMock).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(149, { align: "auto" });
  });

  it("selects the active row with Enter, and a row by clicking it", () => {
    const { layouts, onSelectLayout } = _render({ count: 150 });

    fireEvent.keyDown(_listbox(), { key: "ArrowDown" });
    fireEvent.keyDown(_listbox(), { key: "Enter" });
    expect(onSelectLayout).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(layouts[1]?.id);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("Dataset 5"));
    expect(onSelectLayout).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(layouts[5]?.id);
  });

  it("scrolls a layout selected from outside into view and makes it active", () => {
    const { layouts, rerenderWithSelection } = _render({ count: 150 });

    rerenderWithSelection(120);

    expect(scrollToIndexMock).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(120, { align: "auto" });
    expect(_listbox().getAttribute("aria-activedescendant")).toContain(layouts[120]?.id);
  });

  it("never asks the virtualizer to scroll a short list", () => {
    _render({ count: 10 });

    fireEvent.keyDown(_listbox(), { key: "ArrowDown" });

    expect(_listbox()).toHaveAttribute("aria-activedescendant", _option(1).id);
    expect(scrollToIndexMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
/** Scrolls the active option into view whenever it changes. */
function _useScrollActiveIntoView(
  activeLayoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id | undefined,
  options: Readonly<{
    getOptionId: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => string;
    scrollToLayout?: (layoutId: CrosswalkLayout.Id) => void;
  }>,
): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeLayoutId) {
      return;
    }
    if (options.scrollToLayout) {
      options.scrollToLayout(activeLayoutId);
      return;
    }
    // jsdom has no scrollIntoView, so it is called only where it exists.
    document
      .getElementById(options.getOptionId(activeLayoutId))
      ?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "nearest" });
    // Only a change of the active option scrolls; `getOptionId` and
    // `scrollToLayout` stand for the same rows in the meantime.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [activeLayoutId]);
}
```
